jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **What is PlayerZero?** ----------------------- Building great software takes more than writing code. It takes teams working together, and too often, the information they need is scattered across tools, conversations, and systems. PlayerZero is an AI platform that connects work across enterprise Support, Engineering, Product, QA, and SRE teams, helping them resolve issues faster, improve software quality, and plan what to build next. At its core is our Engineering World Model: a living understanding of a company’s software, how it runs, and the people and decisions behind it. By connecting codebases, tickets, production telemetry, and the conversations that shape the work, our model links what software is intended to do with how it actually behaves in production—and learns from where the two diverge. Our agents (we call them Players :) use that context to take on work across the software lifecycle. They learn from each outcome, earning trust and taking on more responsibility over time. We’re building a future where AI plays an active role in how teams plan, build, and run software. We’re looking for people across disciplines to help shape it. **About the AI Infra team** --------------------------- Most AI tools help one person perform a task faster, a session at a time. But real software work doesn’t happen in one session or one tool. A bug moves from a customer to a ticket to a Slack thread to a PR to a deploy, across people and systems that never see the whole picture. The most interesting context lives between those systems of record, and so does the real work. For our agents to take on that work, something has to sit in between. The AI Infrastructure team builds it: where agents execute, what context they access, and how work moves between agents and people. Because the work runs through this infrastructure, it’s also what lets the Engineering World Model learn from every outcome and earn our agents the right to do more. It has to be fast, composable, and built to scale. We’re hiring infrastructure engineers who like hard distributed\-systems problems and want to own them end to end. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Build agentic infrastructure.** Our agents don’t answer a question and disappear. They take on units of work that run for hours or days, change hands, and keep driving toward completion. You’ll build the runtime that creates continuity for that work: long\-running sessions that survive failures, durable workflow state, lifecycle and cancellation, and workflows that track each piece of work across every stage and every party involved. * **Architect how context is represented and delivered.** Because work flows through our platform, we’re present when the connections between code, tickets, units of work, and past decisions are made. The context between these systems of record is necessary for agents to do their work well, and the data models behind it shape everything an agent can know. You’ll design how that context is represented and delivered: what gets precomputed ahead of time versus resolved on demand, and how the right slice reaches each agent at the right moment. * **Build the communication layer.** Real work doesn’t happen in isolation. Agents work alongside other agents (subagents, teammates, agents on customer machines, agents over MCP) and alongside people. You’ll build the layer that connects them: messaging between agents within and across sessions, escalations that pull in the right person at the right time, and agents that can be interrupted when new information arrives. * **Scale sandboxes and fleets.** An organization’s work is spread across laptops, QA fleets, production hosts, and ephemeral scripts. You’ll build our own sandbox infrastructure, environments that spin up instantly and run by the hundreds, and the fleet layer that lets agents work on the machines where customer work already happens. You don’t need experience in all of these. We expect you to go deep on one or two and pick up the rest along the way. **What you bring** ------------------ * A builder mindset. You own projects end to end, think carefully about data models, performance, and maintainability, and have taken prototypes to production with a clear sense of the reliability and scale tradeoffs. * 3–5\+ years building backend systems, ideally real\-time, stateful, or event\-driven workloads, with strong distributed systems fundamentals: message queues (Pulsar, Kafka), distributed locks, pub/sub, and their failure modes. * Experience building infrastructure for LLMs in production: tool calling, streaming, token budgets, or evaluation harnesses, and a sense of what agents need from the systems beneath them. * Experience designing data models for messy, interconnected domains. You know how to structure data so it stays correct as it grows and changes, and you think about how it will be queried and served before you write the schema. You’ve made schema and storage decisions that held up under scale, and you know the cost of getting them wrong. * You keep work moving. You balance speed of execution with code quality, unblock yourself when you can, and pull in the right people at the right time when you can’t. **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Turbopuffer) or hybrid search systems * Experience with Kotlin/JVM (our primary stack) or Rust, MongoDB, Turbopuffer, or Redis, and WebSockets or other real\-time patterns * You’ve built sandboxing or isolation systems with containers or microVMs (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor), or managed fleets across heterogeneous machines * You’ve worked on filesystem layers such as FUSE, overlay filesystems, or remote\-backed storage * You’ve worked with event sourcing, lineage, or provenance data, where the record of what happened is itself a product **What success looks like** --------------------------- In your first month, you’ve shipped to production, learned how work moves through the platform end to end, and taken ownership of a real component in one of the layers above. By three months, you own a meaningful piece of the system and have made it measurably better: longer\-running work that survives failures, faster sandbox startup, context that reaches agents more reliably, or fewer dropped handoffs between agents and people. By six months to a year, you’re the person the team trusts with a layer of the machine. You set its technical direction, anticipate where it will break as customers and workloads grow, and your work shows up directly in how much our agents can take on. **Why PlayerZero?** ------------------- PlayerZero is an early leader in AI\-powered production engineering, defining how enterprises use AI to understand, improve, and operate their software. We’re a small team with meaningful problems to solve and room for each person to make their mark. Whether you’re building the technology, working with customers, or growing the business, you’ll help shape the product, the company, and what customers expect from this emerging category. If you’re excited by work where the answers aren’t all written yet, and want a hand in writing them, you’ll fit right in. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

validate batch integrations, APIs, file transfers, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cloud\-based data movement processes. * Validate end\-to\-end data movement across source systems, staging environments, jobs.title: Foundation Model Data Engineer
jobs.description: Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next\-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high\-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi\-million\-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands\-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real\-time applications. **Role Overview** ----------------- Sciforium is seeking a highly technical and visionary **Foundation Model Data Engineer** to lead the strategy, creation, and curation of the massive datasets that power our foundation models. We believe that in the era of LLMs, data is the primary competitive advantage. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end data lifecycle—from raw web\-scale crawling to the fine\-grained human\-alignment datasets that define model behavior. This position is ideal for a scientist who views data as a high\-scale engineering challenge and an analytical puzzle. You will not just "provide" data; you will design the taxonomies, filtering heuristics, and post\-training pipelines that ensure our models are world\-class in reasoning, safety, and multimodal understanding. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Foundation Dataset Strategy:** Own the end\-to\-end creation of pre\-training datasets for LLMs. This includes defining the mix of web data, code, books, and technical papers to optimize for downstream model performance. * **Petabyte\-Scale Curation:** Design and implement sophisticated pipelines for data cleaning, exact/fuzzy deduplication, and high\-quality signal extraction from petabytes of raw, unstructured data. * **Post\-Training \& Alignment Data:** Lead the development of high\-quality post\-training datasets, including Supervised Fine\-Tuning (SFT) instructions, multi\-turn dialogues, and preference modeling data (RLHF/DPO). * **Multimodal Expansion:** Drive the acquisition and processing of vision and video data, navigating the complexities of multimodal alignment, video compression, and temporal data consistency. * **High\-Performance Engineering:** Develop high\-throughput data processing scripts using Python, leveraging multiprocessing and multithreading to handle massive\-scale ingestion and transformation without bottlenecks. * **Data Profiling \& Analysis:** Conduct deep\-dive statistical analysis on training corpora to identify biases, gaps in knowledge, and quality regressions, ensuring the "diet" of the model is mathematically balanced. * **Synthetic Data Generation:** (Added Value) Design pipelines to generate high\-reasoning synthetic data to augment gaps in natural datasets, utilizing existing models for data labeling and refinement. **Must\-Haves** --------------- * **5\+ years of industry experience** in Data Science or Machine Learning, with a proven track record of building and managing datasets for foundation models. * **Deep Proficiency in Python:** Expert\-level skills with a focus on high\-performance code, including **multiprocessing, multithreading**, and efficient memory management for large\-scale data tasks. * **Petabyte\-Scale Experience:** Demonstrated experience working with **petabyte\-scale datasets** that have been directly used to train production\-grade LLMs or Large Vision Models. * **Dataset Reconstruction:** Experience building massive LLM training sets **from scratch**, including raw web crawls (e.g., Common Crawl) and specialized domain data. * **Post\-Training Expertise:** Hands\-on experience building datasets for **RLHF, DPO, and multi\-turn instruction following**, including the management of human\-labeling workflows and quality gold\-sets. * **Data Tooling:** Mastery of data\-at\-scale frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or high\-performance data\-loading formats (e.g., WebDataset, Parquet). **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * **Computer Vision (CV) Curation:** Experience building large\-scale image or video datasets from scratch (e.g., LAION\-style pipelines). * **Multimodal Crawling:** Familiarity with large\-scale crawling of multimodal data and the associated challenges of **video processing, codecs, and compression.** * **Taxonomy Design:** Experience in designing complex labeling schemas for reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks. * **Research Background:** A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field with a focus on data\-centric AI or information retrieval. **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k plan * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Sciforium is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Compensation Range: $155K \- $210K

jobs.title: Founding Data Engineer San Francisco
jobs.description: San Francisco **About the company** --------------------- Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them. Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve. **About the Role** ------------------ Braintrust is growing quickly across enterprise and self\-serve customers, and our internal systems need to scale with us. You will establish our data foundation, make architectural decisions, work directly with our executive team, and help shape the data function as it grows. This is a founding, hands on role. You will decide what good looks like, and be able to build it. The core of the job is analytics engineering. That means defining the business entities and metrics the company runs on, modeling them so they can be trusted, and making them accessible without a data person in the loop. Around that core, you will own the ingestion pipelines that feed it, the architecture decisions that hold it together, and the reliability of the whole path. You'll partner with stakeholders across the business, and directly with executives. You will work with Product and Engineering on usage data and event schemas, with Finance on revenue and consumption reporting, and with Sales, RevOps, and Marketing on the pipeline and customer data they operate from. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Define the business entities, metrics, and semantics that Product, Finance, and GTM all build on * Design and build the core data models in SQL and dbt * Build and own ingestion from product events, CRM, and other business systems, including vendor APIs, webhooks, and sync gaps * Make architectural decisions by determining how storage, orchestration, and transformation evolve from here * Stand up self\-serve analytics that includes building semantic models and trusted metrics that stakeholders can query without filing a ticket * Partner with Engineering and Product on usage data and event schemas as the product surface grows * Treat governance and reliability as part of the data model * Use AI to accelerate your own build, and keep the foundation clean and well\-described enough that AI tooling on top of it has something reliable to stand on. **Where You’ll Work in the Stack:** * Ingestion: Product events, CRM, and other business data sources * Modeling: SQL, dbt, business entities, and shared metric definitions * Storage and orchestration: The current environment includes Snowflake; you’ll help determine how the architecture evolves * Analytics: Semantic models and self\-serve access to trusted metrics * Governance and reliability: Data quality, access controls, lineage, monitoring, and debugging **About You** ------------- * You've defined business entities and metrics, and built the models behind them * Strong command of SQL and dbt, and experience with a cloud warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, or similar) * Enough engineering depth to own pipelines end to end. You can write and maintain production code, not only transformation models. * Clear judgment about data modeling, schema evolution, contracts, and lineage * Strong debugging instincts across a multi\-system path, and the patience to trace a wrong number to its source * Ability to work directly with executives and functional leaders: clarifying vague requests, explaining how the data works, and negotiating priorities and tradeoffs * Comfort operating as the only data hire, balancing foundational architecture against urgent business needs **Bonus Points** ---------------- * You've built a data foundation from scratch, rather than inheriting a mature one * Startup experience, especially as an early or first data hire * Experience across multiple business functions that includes Product, Finance, and GTM * Familiarity with usage\-based pricing, consumption models, or PLG\-plus\-sales\-assisted funnels * Experience with our stack, or close equivalents: Snowflake, dbt, Dagster, AWS Batch/Lambda, Fivetran, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Soda, or semantic\-layer tools like Omni or Looker * You've built or used agents for internal workflows and analysis * Braintrust user :) **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Braintrust has a governed set of core entities and metrics that Product, Finance, and GTM all build on * Product usage data is reliable enough that people act on it without checking it against something else first * Stakeholders can answer their own questions through trusted, self\-serve models * Every automated decision and every metric has a traceable path back to its source * The foundation is documented and maintainable. Simple enough for a startup team to run solo, structured enough to hand to a larger data team as it grows. **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity * Wifi \& cellphone stipend **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Braintrust is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Data centers run on thousands of sensors, meters, and control systems, and the teams who run their power infrastructure have to make sense of all of it in real time. Teserac is building Neuron™, an AI\-native observability and automation platform that gives those teams full visibility into their power operations and helps them get ahead of problems. At its core is an AI teammate that works alongside every operator around the clock: detecting anomalies, correlating events, and recommending what to do next. As a Full Stack Developer, you'll own features end to end, from the ingestion path that pulls telemetry off a BMS in a live facility, through the time\-series layer that stores it, to the dashboard an operator is watching at 2am. This is a small team with real customers in production. Your code ships in days, not quarters, and it runs in facilities where being wrong has physical consequences. You'll work directly with the Principal Software \& Architecture Lead, Product, and Solution Engineering. We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and expect engineers to own outcomes rather than tickets. This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office, and visa sponsorship is available. **Who We Are Looking For** You're a full\-stack engineer who is comfortable on both sides of the line, and who gets interested rather than annoyed when the data is messy, the vendor's API is undocumented, and the protocol spec is a PDF from 2009\. You likely: * Build front to back. You can trace a value from a Modbus register to a rendered chart without handing off, and you know where it's likely to break. * Take databases seriously. You know that a query plan, an index, and a migration on a large table are engineering decisions, not configuration. * Have worked with real time\-series data at a volume where naive approaches stop working, and understand what that costs at read time and write time. * Debug production calmly. When CPU is pinned and a queue is backing up, you reason from evidence rather than restarting things. * Use AI tooling well. You get real leverage from Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and your standards didn't drop when you started using it. **What You'll Do** **Product and front end** * Build operator\-facing features for Neuron™ in React and TypeScript: real\-time dashboards, alerting, alarm and ticket workflows, capacity planning views, and power\-flow visualizations. * Build the interfaces the AI teammate works through: interaction panels, recommendation displays, approval workflows, and audit trails. * Keep large, data\-dense views fast and responsive across devices. **Data ingestion and integrations** * Build and maintain the ingestion path that brings telemetry from customer sites into Neuron™: edge collectors, MQTT over AWS IoT Core, queue\-based workers, and normalization into a canonical metric model. * Write integration modules against real building and power systems: Siemens Desigo, Schneider PME and EcoStruxure, Niagara, Eaton, and generic BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP sources. * Own the correctness of what lands: point mapping, unit and phase semantics, deduplication, and backfill. **Time\-series platform** * Develop against PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB: hypertables, continuous aggregates, compression, and retention. * Design schema and migrations that stay safe as tables grow into the billions of rows. * Find and fix the performance problems that only appear with real customer data volumes. **Quality and operations** * Write tested, reviewed code, and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing. * Troubleshoot production issues across the stack, and share on\-call as the platform scales. **Why Teserac** We're not building incremental improvements to legacy tools. We're re\-architecting how data centers see, understand, and act on their own operations. * Ship features that directly shape how some of the world's most critical AI infrastructure is powered and managed. * Join a small engineering team where every developer has outsized impact and direct visibility into product decisions. * Work where AI, real\-time systems, and physical infrastructure meet. * Grow with the company from Series A through scale. **Requirements** * **Required** * + 7\+ years building and shipping production software across the stack + Strong Python, ideally Django. Our backend is Django and Celery, and it's the language you'll write most days. + Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, and migrations you'd run against a live production database + Practical time\-series experience. TimescaleDB is ideal, and deep experience with another time\-series or high\-volume streaming store transfers. + Solid React and TypeScript, and the judgment to keep a data\-heavy interface fast + Experience with asynchronous and event\-driven systems: task queues, pub/sub, streaming, or WebSockets + Comfortable on AWS. We run ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, and IoT Core. + Able to work independently, define your own scope from a rough requirement, and ship * **Preferred** * + Industrial or IoT telemetry experience: BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar OT data sources + Hands\-on experience with industrial protocols: BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, or vendor BMS APIs + Data center infrastructure familiarity: power distribution topology, UPS and PDU behavior, or PUE + Experience building observability or monitoring products, commercial or internal + Early\-stage startup experience, Seed through Series B * Nobody checks every box here. If some of these describe you, apply. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Free Food \& Snacks * Stock Option Plan * 401(k)

jobs.title: IT Director
jobs.description: **About SpyGlass Pharma:** At SpyGlass Pharma (NASDAQ: SGP), we are focused on improving and preserving the vision of patients living with chronic eye diseases, while minimizing the burden treatment can place on their daily lives. We are advancing innovative long\-term ophthalmic drug delivery technologies designed to provide sustained therapy through cataract surgery and help improve patient outcomes. We have built a highly collaborative team with deep expertise across ophthalmology, drug delivery, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices. Our scientists, engineers, and clinical leaders bring decades of experience developing and commercializing breakthrough technologies, united by a shared commitment to patients and our guiding principle: “We create for patients.” That mindset shapes how we build our products, our teams, and our culture. Backed by strong clinical progress, significant funding, and a growing organization, SpyGlass Pharma is entering an exciting stage of growth as we advance our lead program, the SpyGlass BIM\-IOL, through Phase 3 clinical development. **Summary:** The Director of IT will serve as SpyGlass Pharma’s first dedicated in\-house IT leader — a hands\-on builder who also brings the experience to know what good looks like. This role owns IT strategy, systems administration, and infrastructure across SpyGlass’s Microsoft 365\-based environment and directs our managed IT and security services provider (MSP/MSSP), responsible for IT service delivery and security operations and partners closely with our fractional CISO, who owns cybersecurity strategy, AI governance, and third\-party security risk. The ideal candidate will operate independently as an individual contributor initially, while leveraging the services and skills of our Managed Service Provider (MSP). Eventually, this individual will be a key contributor to the strategy for building out SpyGlass’ IT infrastructure as the company scales. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead the design, implementation, and administration of SpyGlass Pharma’s IT infrastructure, including its Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, networking, and cloud environment. * Own the full lifecycle of enterprise IT systems — configuration, security, maintenance, monitoring, and upgrades — across platforms including Egnyte (file storage), NetSuite (ERP), MasterControl (QMS), Bamboo (HRIS \& ATS), and Veeva Vault and iMednet/Medrio (clinical systems). * Direct and manage SpyGlass’s outsourced IT and help desk provider, including SLAs, escalation, and an ongoing evaluation of what should remain outsourced versus move in\-house as the company scales. * Partner with SpyGlass’s fractional CISO to operationalize cybersecurity, AI governance, and access\-control policy — the CISO sets policy and risk direction; this role builds and runs the systems that implement it. * Develop and implement IT policies, standard operating procedures, and governance frameworks that scale with the company from approximately 90 to 300–500 employees, including support for new office locations. * Oversee all aspects of system backup and disaster recovery planning, execution, and testing. * Collaborate with business functions — including Quality, Clinical, Commercial, Finance, and HR — to assess IT needs, implement solutions, and support strategic projects across the organization. * Manage user access, system provisioning, and secure integrations across key business platforms, and build scalable onboarding/offboarding and device\-lifecycle processes that don’t require linear headcount growth in IT. * Serve as a trusted advisor for IT project management and cross\-functional support—ensuring clear documentation, timeline management, and issue resolution. * Lead vendor evaluations and manage third\-party partnerships related to hardware, software, and IT services, and evaluate and implement new tools and platforms as SpyGlass adds functions and headcount. * Build the business case for, and hire, SpyGlass’s first internal IT support/systems team member within the first year, then mentor and guide the team as it grows. * Ensure regulatory compliance in IT systems operations, including alignment with 21 CFR Part 11, other relevant GxP requirements, and SOX IT general controls, where applicable. * Provide exceptional support and training to end users, maintaining a team\-first, service\-oriented approach. **Qualifications Required For Position:** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline preferred; an equivalent combination of professional experience, military technical training, and industry certifications will be considered in lieu of a degree. * Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive IT systems experience, including experience operating as a hands\-on individual contributor as well as in a leadership capacity. * Required: prior IT experience within a life sciences, pharma, biotech, or other GxP\-regulated company, with working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and computer system validation. * Experience supporting SOX IT General Controls (ITGCs), including access reviews, change management, and segregation\-of\-duties controls, preferred. * Experience scaling an IT function through a significant headcount inflection point (e.g., helped take a company from roughly 100 to 400\+ employees). * Deep, hands\-on experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Conditional Access, along with experience managing an outsourced MSP or IT vendor relationship, including SLA management and vendor governance. * Comfort operating as SpyGlass’s sole IT leader initially — hands\-on and strategic simultaneously — with the ability to build the case for and onboard the company’s first internal IT hire within year one. Exposure to clinical, quality, or ERP systems (e.g., Veeva, MasterControl, NetSuite, or similar) is a strong plus. * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives and communicate effectively across all levels of the organization. **Why SpyGlass Pharma?** * We are offering a range of $200,000 \- $240,000, based on experience and qualifications, along with an Annual Bonus opportunity. * Share in our success with stock options, giving you a stake in the company’s future. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans to keep you and your family healthy and happy, with a variety of plan and coverage options. * Generous paid time off, including holidays, vacation days, and personal leave. *SpyGlass Pharma is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify. SpyGlass Pharma takes pride in maintaining a diverse environment and our policies are not to discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.* *SpyGlass Pharma is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an email to JOBS@SPYGLASSPHARMA.COM and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.*

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: Description: AvonRisk is the nation’s leading specialty risk manager for self\-insured organizations, uniting respected regional leaders in workers’ compensation, liability, managed care, and risk management across 32 states. With nearly 700 professionals and brands including Intercare, InterMed, George Hills, and AS\&G Claims Administration, we’re a people\-focused, operations\-driven organization that prioritizes reasonable caseloads, strong training, collaborative teams, and expert support. We invest in tools and workflows that reduce friction—not increase volume—and create real career paths for professionals who want to grow their careers or move into leadership. At AvonRisk, you’re part of a team that values good judgment, curiosity, and accountability, and gives you the support to succeed. **Position Summary:** The IT Support Engineer will deliver white glove technical support to employees across the organization, ensuring seamless technology experiences throughout the employee lifecycle. Requirements: **Required Skills \& Experience** * 3\+ years of experience in an internal IT support role within an enterprise environment. * Hands\-on experience supporting Active Directory, Entra ID, and Group Policy. * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive). * Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PCs, Intune device management, and Autopilot deployment. * Strong experience supporting both Windows and Mac operating systems. * Familiarity with copy/print hardware deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting. * Demonstrated experience with IT Asset Management practices and tools. * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a genuine client\-first mindset. * Ability to deliver white glove service with professionalism, patience, and empathy. * Strong organizational skills and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment. * Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members. **Preferred Qualifications** * Microsoft certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator, Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals). * Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms. * Experience supporting VIP or executive\-level users. * Knowledge of endpoint security tools and best practices. **Salary Range:** $20\-$30 per hour per hour The salary range listed is an estimate. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors such as a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skill set, and work location. **Benefits:** We take care of our people so they can take care of their work and their teams. AvonRisk offers a competitive, people first benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and career growth, including: * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits * Company contributions to HSA and FSA plans * Employer paid life and disability insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off (PTO) and company paid holidays * Learning and development opportunities that support real career advancement * Employee assistance resources and a supportive culture that values balance and wellbeing We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Pursuant to the Los Angeles and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records. \#LI\-Onsite

jobs.title: Junior IT Systems Engineer (Athena Support)
jobs.description: Description: **Department:** IT Operations **Location:** Must live in the DMV (Washington, DC, Maryland, Virginia) area **Schedule:** Hybrid **Job Summary:** The Junior IT Systems Engineer (Athena Support) will provide technical support and routine systems administration within a HIPAA\-compliant healthcare environment, with a particular emphasis on supporting the athenaOne electronic health record (EHR) platform. Responsibilities include troubleshooting IT systems, supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, and network infrastructure, and assisting with athenaOne user administration, configurations, and clinical workflows. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on athenaOne experience, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to support both technical and clinical staff. Complex EHR configurations and clinical workflow changes will be escalated to the designated EHR administrator. **Key Responsibilities:** **IT Support and Troubleshooting:** * Provide first\- and second\-level support for hardware and software issues, including those related to Windows, macOS, and Microsoft Office, utilizing the Zendesk ticketing system. * Assist in the management and troubleshooting of network devices such as laptops, desktops, and printers, as well as supporting systems like Active Directory, Azure, and Intune. **Systems Administration:** * Support the administration and maintenance of Active Directory, Azure services, and device management through Intune. * Assist in the configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of network hardware and software, specifically Meraki solutions. * Help deploy, configure, and troubleshoot end\-user devices such as laptops, desktops, monitors, and printers. **AthenaOne EHR Administration and Support:** * Manage routine athenaOne user administration, including onboarding, offboarding, permissions, and access troubleshooting. * Assist with Clinical Admin, Billing Admin, and Schedule Admin procedures in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies. * Assist with employee onboarding, technical training, and troubleshooting of business applications and communication systems. * Collaborate with senior IT staff to improve support processes, maintain documentation, and ensure timely resolution of technical issues. **Why Join CloseKnit** * Competitive compensation based on continuing education opportunities. * Supportive, collaborative, and inclusive work culture. This is a hybrid position, and candidates must reside in the Washington, DC, Maryland, or Northern Virginia (DMV) region and be available to work onsite as required. * This position may require on\-call support after hours and/or on weekends as needed. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to meet the physical demands of the position, including extended periods of sitting, manual dexterity for handling tasks, occasional standing and walking, and the ability to lift and move up to 40 pounds. * Adaptability to a typical office work environment, which may include moderate noise levels, with accommodation provided for individuals with disabilities to fulfill essential job functions.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer – Robotics & Autonomous Systems
jobs.description: **Location:** Clearwater, Florida (Onsite) **Company:** Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions ### **About Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions** Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions is a fast\-growing Defense technology company headquartered in Clearwater, Florida. Founded by US and UK veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real\-world employment of unmanned systems. Marcurius is building a new kind of unmanned systems company – multi\-domain, multi\-platform, and mission\-driven. We fuse battle\-proven technologies, resilient command\-and\-control architectures, and operator\-led doctrine to deliver capabilities that work in contested environments. Our initial focus is the rapid fielding of advanced Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) for modern maritime operations. ### **Role Overview** We're looking for a motivated, curious, and hands\-on **Junior Software Engineer** to join our growing engineering team at Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to develop, integrate, and test software supporting our advanced unmanned and autonomous systems. You'll contribute across a range of technologies, from software development and embedded systems to robotics, autonomy, and hardware integration. We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building things, solving technical challenges, and learning new technologies. You don't need to be an expert in every area, but you should have strong programming fundamentals, a practical problem\-solving mindset, and the drive to take ownership of your work. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, test, debug, and maintain software components using Python, C\+\+, or other relevant technologies. * Support software development and integration for unmanned and autonomous maritime systems. * Collaborate with software, hardware, and systems engineers to solve technical challenges. * Contribute to embedded software development and integration with microcontrollers, sensors, and onboard systems. * Support robotics, autonomy, and machine learning\-related development activities. * Assist with frontend interfaces, databases, and supporting software tools as needed. * Participate in hardware/software integration, prototype development, and system testing. * Troubleshoot software issues, investigate root causes, and implement improvements. * Maintain clear code documentation and follow established development and version control practices. * Take ownership of assigned development tasks while supporting broader engineering projects. ### **Required Qualifications** * Strong programming fundamentals with practical experience in **Python or C\+\+**. * Familiarity with Linux\-based development environments. * Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and troubleshoot software through academic, personal, or professional projects. * Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and willingness to learn new technologies. * Interest in working across software development, embedded systems, and hardware integration. * Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers while independently managing assigned tasks. Recent graduates and early\-career engineers with strong technical projects are encouraged to apply. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded systems, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar platforms. * Interest in or exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, or machine learning. * Experience with frontend development, databases, Git, or software development tools. * Personal software projects, GitHub repositories, or hands\-on engineering projects demonstrating technical curiosity and initiative. ### **Work Environment** * Onsite engineering and integration environment. * Direct involvement in prototype development and system testing, including sea trials. * Fast\-paced development cycles with aggressive timelines. * Close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Customer, end\-user, and internal team\-facing activities. ### **Why Marcurius** Marcurius is a people\-first, execution\-focused organization assembling a high\-impact team of Engineers and Operators. This role offers the opportunity to directly shape real\-world systems, support strategic national security priorities, and be part of an incredibly exciting journey \- building the foundations of a next\-generation Defense technology company. ### **Equal Opportunity Employment** Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse, mission\-driven team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We strongly encourage applications from veterans and individuals with experience in maritime, defense, communications, and advanced technology sectors.

Our employees are integral to achieving our goals so we are proud to offer competitive salaries with equity packages, robust medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible working hours, hybrid work options and an inclusive environment that fosters creativity and innovation. **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status. **Pay \& Benefits:** The pay range for this role is between $230,000 and $350,000, depending on skills, qualifications, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits. Join our mission to revolutionize healthcare with AI. To apply, please send your resume through the application below.

jobs.title: ML Researcher
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ Conduit is a frontier AI research company, training on a new modality of data: brain signals. Our first goal is to decode thought into text through a non\-invasive headset. We're a team of about ten ML researchers and software engineers, working together in San Francisco. Conduit's mission is to increase the communication bandwidth between humans and AIs—and to do so soon. We believe AGI is about to be a solved problem, but keeping humans empowered is not. We have about 30,000 hours (and counting) of time\-aligned brain signals and typing data, from about 1% of San Franciscans. Your job is to 1\) train useful models given the data, and 2\) steer our data collection operation so we get more useful data. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Train models:** We're in a data\-limited regime. As we scale up to 100x the amount of data we have now, we hope to also get 10\-60x data efficiency wins. Research spans encoders, decoders, synthetic data, multimodal training, scaling laws, evals, post\-training, and more. **Steer data collection:** As we expand data operations, we want to track where our data collection can be improved. You'll be answering questions like: does sensor X or sensor Y lead to better downstream model performance? If we put the sensors on a dummy head that has known physical properties, do we see sensors performing as expected? Answering these questions involves physical experiments, statistical heuristics, and training many models. **Optionally, a bit of everything:** We're a team of about ten. If you want to wear many hats – hardware, fundraising, recruiting, product – we welcome your efforts! If you prefer to focus solely on research, we welcome that too. Your analyses will heavily rely on AI, and you'll have all the AI tokens you could want. **Who you are** --------------- Most important qualities: * Brilliant and curious * Deep and broad knowledge of ML * Bonuses: undergrad\-level physics and/or neuroscience intuitions Example current employees include: * Former lead of an AI alignment fellowship who studied physics and ML. * PhD in ML architecture research with a B.A. in math, who questions everything from first principles. * Top\-5 college computer science dropout who joined a frontier AI company at age 21 and had previously interned at a top quant finance firm. Our bar is a bit higher than the bar for researcher hiring at OpenAI/Anthropic/DeepMind, with the exception that we'll consider candidates with exceptional physics intuitions. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: San Francisco, fully in office * Schedule: Full\-time * Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance. Free food for lunch, dinner, and whenever you're hungry. Personal trainer available. We pay for your commute. **Application process** ----------------------- Our process: * A 30\-minute call to get to know each other. * A 2\-hour coding assignment, where you're allowed to use AI. * An hour\-long chat about ML and the company. * An approximately two\-day work trial, where you'll do real tasks alongside us. * Offer.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we? At Mergon, we mould ideas for a sustainable future. We work with leading brands like Tesla, BMW, Xerox, and Abbott to design, manufacture, and deliver sustainable products for the vehicles and equipment of the future. We care deeply about our colleagues, customers, and our community and we have a curiosity that constantly pushes us to innovate and improve. We are competent, capable, and we invest in our people and in our processes to ensure we continue to grow and do our best work every day. What's the job? We are currently recruiting for a Manufacturing Engineer. Scope of the position The Manufacturing Engineer will support a highly automated blow molding facility, playing a key role in improving Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and ensuring efficient operations through the troubleshooting and optimization of blow molding process and automation systems. This is a hands\-on role that demands versatility, quick learning, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. While extensive experience is not required in all areas, a strong technical aptitude and a passion for learning new systems and processes are essential. Availability for overtime and weekend work is required periodically to ensure production runs smoothly. Key Responsibility Quickly learn and understand the operation and maintenance of ABB robots, Omron PLCs, and other automation systems used in blow molding. Work closely with Production and Maintenance teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting OEE Lead efforts to improve the performance and reliability of automation equipment, ensuring smooth and efficient production. Assist in the commissioning, installation, and fine\-tuning of automation systems, ensuring optimal setup for maximum efficiency. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, suppliers, and automation experts to introduce new technologies, troubleshoot existing systems, and drive process improvements. Continuously seek ways to improve machine reliability, reduce downtime, and enhance overall production efficiency. Provide technical training and support to other team members, fostering a collaborative environment for knowledge sharing. Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in robotics, PLC programming, and automation technologies. Be available for overtime and weekend shifts as needed to resolve urgent issues and ensure production targets are met. Key Performance Indicators Significant improvements in OEE, focusing on reducing downtime in highly automated equipment, including robots and PLC systems. Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly, contributing to increased production efficiency and reduced troubleshooting time. Successful implementation of process optimizations that lead to measurable gains in performance and cost savings. A reduction in the frequency and duration of equipment breakdowns through proactive maintenance and problem\-solving. 4\. Decision Making Authority The Manufacturing Engineer has the authority to make decisions related to automation system troubleshooting, equipment improvements, and OEE enhancement initiatives. Significant changes that impact production capacity or involve large investments require higher management approval. Preferred Qualifications Technical aptitude and a strong willingness to learn quickly, especially in the areas of robotics, PLCs, and other automation systems. A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to handle multiple tasks and challenges in a fast\-paced production environment. Experience in a blow molding or automated manufacturing facility is a plus but not required. Willingness to work overtime and weekends to address critical production and maintenance issues. The above is not exhaustive. Other duties and responsibilities may be added as the employee’s immediate supervisor deems appropriate. You should be proficient in: * PLC Troubleshooting Skills * Time Study Analysis * Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering * Continuous Improvement * Equipment Troubleshooting * Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) * 5 Why (Root Cause Analysis Method) * Mechanical Troubleshooting Skills * Fishbone Diagram (Ishikawa Diagram) * Pneumatics Experience * CAD Software * Industrial Robot Programming * Electrical Troubleshooting * Process Engineering * Design for Manufacturability (DFM) * Design for Assembly (DFA) * Kaizen * PLC Programming Experience * Programming Machine Vision Systems * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Lean Manufacturing Principles * Six Sigma Experience * Pneumatics Troubleshooting * Maintenance and Repair Skills * Electrical Schematic Reading * Equipment Repair \& Maintenance * Plastic Extrusion Experience * Experience in a Manufacturing Environment * Blow Molding Experience * PPAP Process Experience * Root Cause Analysis Machines \& technologies you'll use: * Industrial Controls (Omron, Allen Bradley, ABB) * Power Tools * CAD Software (Solidworks, Catia) * Industrial Robot (ABB)

jobs.title: Mechanical Field Engineer

assists with subcontractor contract language * Participates and leads in Trade partner meetings Procurement Management * Demonstrates knowledge of procurement needs to maintain the schedule and notifies the team of potential impacts * Prepares, manages, and maintains procurement reports * Assists with scheduling and expediting materials, purchases, and delivery * Ensures materials arrive on time and meet Quality expectations and design documents * Collaborates with team members to define coordination priorities and establish a sequence to support the schedule Quality * Performs constructability reviews and communicate and communicates issues effectively and immediately * Supports the management of design documents and the BIM process * Ensure compliance with codes, standards, and safety regulations * Ensures that installations are performed in accordance with master specifications, standard installation details, state and local codes 3\.10 * Assists with the development, review, and monitoring of quality assurance programs throughout the entire process; * Ensures that all trades have a clear understanding of quality expectations * Develops and manages lists of quality issues and tracks completions of items * Performs and facilitates first inspections, reviews materials received, and facilitates inspection processes * Ensure compliance with relevant codes and standards, including AWS, ASME, DVS and OSHA regulations. * Interpret and review blueprints, schematics, and specifications to verify project requirements. * Ensure projects meet stringent quality and safety standards * Preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly reports for clients and regular reporting. **Education** * High School Diploma or GED required. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Quality, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering or related fields preferred **Specific Roles and Responsibilites** * Responsible for reviewing/ overseeing the construction of the UPW system in its entirety, ensuring compliance with engineering principles, safety regulations, and project specifications. * Assist the supervisor and monitor onsite construction activities to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. * Work closely, collaborating with engineers, subcontractors, and construction managers to resolve any design or implementation issues that arise during the project. * Conduct regular inspections of construction work to ensure compliance with project specifications and safety regulations. * Maintain accurate records and reports related to the project, including documentation of progress, changes in scope, and any issues that arise during construction. * Provide technical assistance and support to construction crews, ensuring that engineering principles are applied correctly on\-site. * The role is office and field\-based, requiring most of the working hours on site. Time management of office work will be necessary for project meetings, planning, and reporting. * Ensure compliance with local and federal regulations and safety standards, often conduct regular safety inspections and implement corrective measures as necessary. * Strong problem\-solving skills, effective communication abilities, and proficiency in CAD software for reviewing blueprints and technical documents. * Attend meetings with subcontractors and reports to the Construction manager/ Deputy Construction manager * Compare planned versus actual progress for each work scope at the site. **Job Requirements** * Willingness to work 10 hour a day, 5 days a week during peak times. * During non\-peak times, the schedule requires 8 hours per day, 5 days a week. * Flexibility requires working weekends and holidays as needed. * Possible out\-of\-state travel (for factory inspections, etc.) approximately 30 days per year. * This position is classified as Exempt, meaning employees are eligible for overtime pay for any hours worked over 40 hours in a week. * Overtime may be required during peak and non\-peak times and will be compensated in accordance with applicable labor laws. **Skills and Qualifications** * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills required. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills required. * Ability to create documents using Microsoft Excel and Word. * Proficient in interpreting blueprints, welding symbols, and industry standards; strong attention to detail and documentation skills * Team\-oriented, safety\-conscious, and proactive in identifying and solving issues * Experience working as a QC technician for a construction contractor at TSMC's Arizona factory, as plus. * Speaking Chinese or Japanese a plus. **Physical Requirements** * Climbing, balancing, kneeling, crouching, reaching, walking, grasping, talking, hearing, and standing for sustained periods of time * Strong visual acuity is required, with the ability to see small print, symbols, and measurements. * Ability to perform detailed work with high attention to visual accuracy, and the ability to identify potential quality issues. * Perform work at heights from ladders, scaffolds, aerial lifts, catwalks, roofs, or other areas occasionally or as the job requires *Organo USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/Disabled/Veterans*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff – Product Engineering
jobs.description: We find and fix every vulnerability in our customers' applications. When a new AI model is released, we run it against their applications before attackers do, and close what it finds. **About Wakefield** ------------------- Wakefield is an applied research lab working on AI\-native security services. We build security agents and publish how they work. Our methods, benchmark and raw data are public so anyone can check them. * Source code optional: blackbox agents sign in as every role and test the running app. Whitebox agents read the code on every pull request. * If Wakefield can't prove it, the customer never sees it: agents replay each finding in a real browser and record it. Then Wakefield writes the fix, ready to open as a pull request, and retests it. We have SLAs for zero false positives. * One service that replaces DAST, SAST, SCA, SBOM, and the tests companies run in\-house or buy in. **The role** ------------ Our customers range from security engineers to leaders who have never read an HTTP request. They need to trust what an agent found, see the proof, and get it fixed. You'll own the Wakefield console end to end, from schema to UI: findings and their proof, fixes, scans, chat, and the integrations and MCP server that bring Wakefield into the tools people already use. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- * The finding page: the recording, the requests, the steps to reproduce and the fix, clear enough for someone who isn't a security expert. * Adding an application and a test login for each role, and following the agents while they work. * Fixes: patches with a confidence level, pull requests a person opens, and retests that confirm the fix. * Chat and the MCP server, so people can ask Wakefield what to fix first from wherever they work. * Integrations with GitHub, Jira, Linear, Slack and the rest. * Reports a CISO can hand to a board or an auditor. **Requirements** ---------------- * 2\+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent depth from open source or your own projects * Time at a fast\-growing startup * You've built products from scratch and shipped them to real users * You've owned polished features end to end, from backend to UI * Strong product and design judgment: what to cut, what to polish, when to ship * Strong full\-stack fundamentals: Python, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, debugging unfamiliar code * You use coding agents every day and still understand every line you ship * You build and tinker for fun because you genuinely care about how products are made and used **Nice to have** ---------------- * You've founded a company or shipped security or developer tools * You work where design and engineering overlap: you prototype in code and sweat spacing, motion and copy **How we hire** --------------- * Meet the co\-founders. * A one\-week paid trial with us in the office. * Offer. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: San Francisco, in person. Most of the team is in the office every day. * Compensation: Competitive salary and meaningful equity. * Visa: We sponsor visas and support you through the immigration process.

jobs.description: **About Us:**Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. Network Engineers **Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV. **Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects. **Schedule:** Monday \- Friday 8:00\-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on\-call rotation. **Benefits:** * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401K \+ employer match * Paid time off and holidays * Opportunities for career growth and development * Training and certification support **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** ### Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies. * Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis. * Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments. * Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency. * Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates. ### **Proactive Client Improvement** * Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues. * Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work. * Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements. firmware end\-of\-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation. * Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business windows, and rollback plans. * Manages the team's 24/7 on\-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after\-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards. * Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value. ### **Operations and Compliance** * Defines, tra lex networks (required) * 2\+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring * MSP or multi\-client environment experience strongly preferred ### **Specialized Knowledge and Skills** * Expert enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex switching and routing, high availability system design, advanced network security design, Internet services and protocols, and advanced network diagnostics. * Demonstrated expert proficiency in at least three of the following, with advanced skills in the balance: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing. * Top expert level analysis and design skills: gathering data on systems issues, defining alternative approaches, assessing business impact, and recommending, developing, and implementing cost\-effective solutions. * A track record of proactively finding and fixing problems in environments you support, with examples you can walk us through. * Proven ability to lead, coach, and hold engineers accountable while staying hands\-on. * Excellent oral and written communication, including explaining technical risk and recommendations to non\-technical customers and executives. * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, incidents, and people concurrently. * Advanced knowledge of current technologies, tools, applications, and vendors. ### **Certifications (preferred)** * CCNP Enterprise or Security, or equivalent experience; CCIE a strong plus * Fortinet NSE, Meraki (CMNA/ECMS), or jobs.title: RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEER
jobs.description: **About Us** Sounder was founded by a team of like\-minded engineers from the renewable industry that shared a desire and drive to build a company that operates in a way they could be proud of. Additionally, Sounder partners with some of the best individual contractors we know of in the business to provide true value to our customers. We hold ourselves to a high standard and hope that in leading by example we can influence others in the industry and beyond to do the same. At Sounder our focus, passion and greatest value involves solving our customer’s hardest technical challenges. We do this by providing consulting to IPP’s, developers, utilities, manufacturers, investors and others needing technical assistance in the renewable energy space. These services include advanced troubleshooting, product testing, root\-cause analysis, energy modeling, engineering, design, and QA/QC services. We make investing in renewable energy predictable and easy. We do this by providing sensible, intelligent and creative solutions to our client’s most difficult technical challenges. In all our interactions we strive to be responsive, conscientious, and honest. **Job Title** RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEER – Full\-time **Position Overview** We are seeking a well\-rounded Renewable Energy Engineer with hands\-on SCADA and controls experience to support solar PV, battery energy storage (BESS), and other power generation projects throughout the asset lifecycle. This is a renewable energy engineering and consulting role first; SCADA and controls expertise is an important supporting capability, not the sole focus. The successful candidate will work across technical troubleshooting, commissioning, performance analysis, engineering studies, QA/QC, project support, and client consulting, while also supporting SCADA, DAS, RTAC, controls, communications, and data\-validation activities when needed. **Key Responsibilities** – Provide technical engineering and consulting support for utility\-scale and commercial solar PV, BESS, and other renewable energy projects. – Troubleshoot complex electrical, controls, communications, performance, and equipment issues; perform root\-cause analysis. – Support commissioning, startup, FAT/SAT, field validation, inspections, component testing, and system assessments. – Perform or support engineering studies, feasibility reviews, performance investigations, and technical evaluations. – Support QA/QC activities to verify installations, documentation, equipment, and system performance against project requirements. – Analyze operational and performance data to identify underperformance, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities. – Support SCADA, DAS, RTAC, and plant control system configuration, validation, and troubleshooting as part of broader engineering assignments. – Validate communications, telemetry, alarms, point mapping, and data integrity between field devices, plant systems, and monitoring platforms. – Assist with targeted RTAC, PLC, relay, or plant controller logic/configuration changes where appropriate. – Develop technical reports, commissioning documentation, test procedures, findings, recommendations, and client deliverables. – Collaborate with clients, EPCs, O\&M providers, manufacturers, vendors, and internal teams to resolve technical issues. – Support proposals, scopes of work, project management, and other renewable energy consulting engagements; travel to sites as required. **Example Projects** These are some typical tasks or projects we expect this engineer to have skills and experience to perform. This is not an exhaustive list of the types of projects the successful candidate will be assigned. · Create settings for a SEL 651R\-2 recloser control based on drawings and other documentation (such as Interconnect Agreement) for a 5 MW PV plant. · Perform an in\-depth evaluation of an operational PV plant, analyzing 1 year of data to enumerate suspected or known causes of underperformance. For possible or hypothesized causes, develop a test plan for onsite technicians to execute to determine if the suspected cause is real. Estimate costs or effort to remediate actionable causes. Prepare a report for PV plant ownership with a recommended action plan, including the estimated ROI or justification for each proposed action. · Remotely modify an existing Beckwith 7670 series recloser control’s programming to add automatic reclosing functionality. · Remotely perform a capacity test of a new PV plant following ASTM 2848\. · Determine and apply appropriate settings for string inverters such as SMA Peak3, Solectria XGI, or CPS SCH series to comply with specific utility requirements. Prepare documentation in a format acceptable to the utility, listing the exact settings applied. · Review 30% drawings for a 10 MW PV project for the purpose of evaluating the long\-term serviceability of the proposed design. Prepare a report for a non\-technical audience which delineates how certain design choices will  ams. · Visit a 10 MW PV \+ BESS project under construction and perform an Independent Engineering Review inspection. Write a report of findings including all meaningful errors or issues found along with guidance for the owner or investor which describes the issue, the importance, and suggested remediation approaches. · Create a new weekly report for the owner of a small fleet of PV plants, which reports performance of the portfolio. In consultation with the customer, determine which KPIs to include, download data from a portal, and prepare report. Fine tune the report to meet the customer’s requests. Fully document the preparation steps and calculations. Automate the report generation. **Location** *Day to day*: Remote. Office attendance will be hybrid as needed when office location is established. *Travel*: Expected to be up to 35% on average depending on business needs and availability of the employee. Weekend travel will be optional, and the typical travel duration will be 3\-5 days. Travel is currently limited to within the United States, but international travel may become available and necessary in the future. **Type** Full\-time, salary, with an expectation of 40 hours per week. Additional hours may be worked as business needs and as employee availability allows.
