jobs.title: Senior QA Lead (Player-Coach)
jobs.description: **Please note:** We are not working with recruiters at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. **About Handtevy** Handtevy is a healthcare SaaS company whose platform is used by hospitals, EMS agencies, and healthcare organizations to deliver evidence\-based medication dosing, standardized clinical protocols, and real\-time coordination tools for emergency medical services. Our technology supports first responders and clinicians in high\-stakes environments where clarity, speed, and reliability are critical. Our applications are used in ambulances, emergency departments, and healthcare systems every day. When a paramedic calculates a pediatric dose in our app, it has to be right. Quality here is a patient safety function, not a checkbox. **The Role** We are looking for a Senior QA Lead who leads from the front. This is a player\-coach role: you will spend most of your week hands\-on, building automation, writing tests, and breaking things before our customers can. The rest goes to coaching QA engineers, setting standards, and deciding when a release is actually ready. You’ll join an established QA team with an existing automation practice and help it grow as the company scales. You will own test strategy across our web, mobile, and backend systems, and you will raise the bar on how the team uses AI tools to test faster and deeper. We want someone who shows the team what good looks like by doing it first. **What You’ll Do** *Lead by Example* * Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for our Angular web platform, Ionic Capacitor mobile app, and NestJS APIs. * Write automation in TypeScript alongside the engineering team, in the same repo and pipeline. * Own test architecture: framework choices, test data strategy, environments, and how tests run in CI. * Use AI\-assisted tools daily to generate test cases, expand coverage, maintain suites, and triage failures, then teach the team to do the same well. * Keep the suite trustworthy by tracking flaky tests and fixing root causes quickly. *Protect Clinical Accuracy* * Own and extend automated coverage of the logic that matters most: weight\- and age\-based medication dosing, clinical protocols, and edge cases where a wrong value could reach a patient. * Partner with our clinical team to turn clinical rules into verifiable test cases. * Validate integrations with third\-party ePCR partners (such as ESO and ImageTrend), including NEMSIS data exchange. * Help test AI\-powered features in our SaaS platform, including how outputs are evaluated before they reach clinical users. *Coach and Set Standards* * Mentor QA engineers on automation, test design, and effective AI tool usage through pairing and code review. * Define a risk\-based test strategy for each release so effort goes where the risk is. * Establish clear release readiness criteria and give engineering leadership an honest go/no\-go call. * Deepen QA’s role in refinement so acceptance criteria and test expectations are clear before development starts. * Track and improve quality metrics: automated coverage of critical paths, escaped defects, regression cycle time, and flaky test rate. *Partner Across the Team* * Work closely with our Engineers, DevOps, and Product teams. * Support production monitoring and incident response with fast, well\-documented reproduction. * Contribute audit\-ready test evidence to support our SOC 2 program. **Our Engineering Culture** * We build with Angular, Tailwind, NestJS, Ionic Capacitor, Aurora MySQL, DocumentDB, and AWS. * We use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot across engineering and QA. * We have active initiatives using Generative AI within our product ecosystem. * We invest in observability and testing frameworks that give us real confidence in production. * Engineers and QA have meaningful input into tooling and technical direction. **What We’re Looking For** * 7\+ years in QA or SDET roles, including 2\+ years leading or mentoring QA engineers while staying hands\-on. * Strong automation skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with at least one framework you built or substantially shaped (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO). * Experience automating mobile app testing (e.g., Appium, Detox, or similar), ideally for hybrid apps. * Solid API testing experience with REST services. * Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions). * Real, current experience using AI tools in your QA work. You can explain specifically what you use them for, where they help, and where they fall short. * Strong test design skills: risk\-based prioritization, boundary analysis, and knowing what not to automate. * Clear communication with engineers, product, and leadership, including the ability to make and defend a release call. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience in healthcare, medical devices, or other safety\-critical or regulated environments. * Experience testing clinical calculations, dosing logic, or similar high\-consequence rules. * Familiarity with NEMSIS, FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards. * Experience evaluating or testing LLM\-powered features. * Performance, load, or accessibility (WCAG) testing experience. * Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog. * Experience working in a SOC 2 or similarly compliance\-driven environment. **What Success Looks Like in 6 to 12 Months** * Automated coverage of critical clinical paths keeps pace as the platform and release cadence grow. * Regression cycles get faster as we ship more often, with escaped defects trending down. * Suite reliability stays high as coverage expands. * AI\-assisted testing practices are consistent and effective across the QA team. * Release readiness criteria scale with our growth and remain trusted by engineering and product leadership. **Benefits** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience. * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. * Investment in professional development and modern engineering tools. * Direct impact on a platform used in life\-saving emergency care. * Collaborative, mission\-driven environment. **How to Apply** Submit your resume and a few sentences on two things: a test automation framework you built or rebuilt and what changed because of it, and one specific way you use AI tools in your testing work today. *Handtevy is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineering Manager — Heavy Equipment Manufacturing
jobs.description: **Senior Quality Engineering Manager — Heavy Equipment Manufacturing** ====================================================================== **Barbco, Inc. \| East Canton, Ohio** **Our culture** --------------- Family\-owned. American\-made. Trenchless industry innovators. We are expanding our product lines, modernizing our manufacturing systems, and developing our people to fuel Barbco’s next stage of growth. **The mission (bullet\-first)** ------------------------------- * Own Barbco’s internal quality management system—design it for real\-world use, implement it, and continuously improve it. * Keep quality upstream: define inspection points, quality gates, documentation, standards, and accountability. * Lead root\-cause analysis and CAPA; drive continuous improvement across the value stream. * Administer nonconforming material, holds, rework, corrective actions, and final disposition with speed and rigor. * Strengthen incoming, in\-process, final inspection, and product\-release processes, using metrics to highlight trends. * Investigate field complaints, warranty issues, supplier performance, and internal manufacturing concerns. * Set clear expectations for supplier quality and incoming materials in partnership with Purchasing. * Support welding, fabrication, machining, assembly, hydraulic, electrical, and finished\-equipment quality. * Ensure drawings, specifications, work instructions, inspection criteria, and engineering changes are correctly applied. * Create simple, practical documentation; train and coach teams to problem\-solve effectively. * Promote a company\-wide quality culture; exercise stop\-the\-line authority when a significant issue exists. * Enable new\-product introduction and expansion into new equipment and markets. **Structure and scope** ----------------------- * Report directly to senior management; operate with high visibility and cross\-functional influence. * Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Dealer Support, and senior management. * This is not an ISO certification\-driven position—focus on sustainable, floor\-ready systems that improve outcomes. **What you bring** ------------------ * Hands\-on manufacturing quality leadership; experience creating or significantly upgrading a QMS. * Proven root\-cause analysis and corrective\-action leadership. * Ability to read prints and interpret specifications, tolerances, and inspection requirements. * Working knowledge of measurement, inspection, and calibration processes. * Experience partnering directly with production teams, supervisors, engineers, suppliers, and customers. * Disciplined organization and documentation; sound judgment for tough calls. * Change leadership that aligns quality with production, not against it. * Action bias and continuous improvement mindset. * Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, 8D, FMEA, CAPA, APQP, and supplier quality is a plus; outcomes matter most. * Four\-year degree is helpful but not required; significant manufacturing experience, technical education, quality credentials, and proven leadership are valued. **Why you’ll thrive here** -------------------------- * Direct impact—work closely with leadership, engineers, skilled craftsmen, dealers, and customers. * See your systems come to life on the floor and in the field. * Barbco is investing in: new products and equipment platforms; manufacturing capabilities; technology and business systems; training and employee development; dealer and customer support; continuous improvement; the next generation of Barbco. At Barbco, quality means how we design it, build it, document it, improve it, and stand behind it. If you want to architect the system—not just maintain someone else’s—this is your stage. **Industry signal** ------------------- Market analysis highlights the importance of QMS ownership, CAPA/root\-cause depth, audit leadership, print/fabrication literacy, and the ability to influence production. **Proficiencies** ----------------- * Quality Inspection Experience * Continuous Improvement * 5 Why (Root Cause Analysis Method) * Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) * Quality Control Experience * Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) * Precision Measurement \& Inspection * Blueprint Reading **How we’ll work together** --------------------------- We’re looking for a leader who can walk the floor, quickly grasp what’s happening, ask incisive questions, guide the team to a solution, and implement a system so the issue doesn’t recur. Firm, not adversarial. Builder, not custodian. One team—production and quality.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About PlayerZero** -------------------- Building great software takes more than writing code. It takes teams working together and too often, the information they need is scattered across tools, conversations, and systems. PlayerZero is an AI platform that connects work across enterprise Support, Engineering, Product, QA, and SRE teams, helping them resolve issues faster, improve software quality, and plan what to build next. At its core is our Engineering World Model: a living understanding of a company’s software, how it runs, and the people and decisions behind it. By connecting codebases, tickets, production telemetry, and the conversations that shape the work, our model links what software is intended to do with how it actually behaves in production. and learns from where the two diverge. Our agents (we call them Players:) use that context to take on work across the software lifecycle. They learn from each outcome, earning trust and taking on more responsibility over time. We’re building a future where AI plays an active role in how teams plan, build, and run software. We’re looking for people across disciplines to help shape **About the role** ------------------ As a Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll improve the reliability, security, and visibility of PlayerZero’s production systems. You’ll combine hands\-on AWS infrastructure operations with automation, monitoring, and application instrumentation to help engineers understand system behavior and resolve problems at their source. You’ll partner closely with our existing SRE and engineering teams to operate distributed services and stateful data systems, reduce operational toil, and strengthen incident response. We’re looking for someone who can independently investigate complex issues, safely change production infrastructure, and follow improvements through to completion. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Operate production infrastructure and data systems.** Maintain AWS environments and systems such as Kafka, Pulsar, and Valkey, including upgrades, replication health, rolling restarts, and failover. * **Automate operational work.** Build tools and workflows that eliminate repetitive tasks, reduce manual intervention, and make production operations more consistent. * **Improve monitoring and instrumentation.** Work with engineers to instrument application code and strengthen metrics, logs, distributed tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts. * **Troubleshoot and respond to incidents.** Investigate problems across applications, infrastructure, networking, and data systems. Help restore service and turn findings into lasting fixes and useful runbooks. * **Make infrastructure changes and deployments safer.** Partner with Platform and application engineers on infrastructure as code, CI/CD, configuration management, rollback practices, and production readiness. * **Keep production systems secure and current.** Perform OS and kernel patching, remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities within agreed timelines, and execute safe rolling maintenance. * **Improve performance and resilience.** Identify bottlenecks and failure modes, assess capacity needs, and help establish practical service health indicators and reliability targets. **What you bring** ------------------ * Experience independently operating, troubleshooting, and improving production services in an SRE, production engineering, or similar role. * Hands\-on AWS production experience, including EC2, VPC networking, IAM, Auto Scaling Groups, and Systems Manager, ideally across multiple accounts. * Strong fundamentals in Linux, networking, and distributed systems. * Experience operating distributed data systems such as Kafka, Pulsar, or Redis/Valkey, including upgrades, rolling restarts, replication, and failover. * Strong programming or scripting skills, with experience building operational automation and improving application instrumentation. * Experience with metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting, including OpenTelemetry or comparable instrumentation. * Production experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, including safely modifying existing infrastructure and state, alongside CI/CD, containers, and repeatable deployment practices. * Experience responding to production incidents, performing maintenance, and following through on corrective actions. * Clear communication, sound judgment under pressure, and a collaborative approach to solving problems across teams. * Experience supporting compliance programs such as SOC 2 or HIPAA, including maintaining technical controls and producing evidence, is also valuable. **What success looks like** --------------------------- Production services and data systems remain healthy through growth, releases, and maintenance. Engineers detect and diagnose problems faster, recurring issues and manual tasks decrease, and infrastructure changes are predictable and recoverable. Incidents lead to lasting improvements, and security maintenance stays current. **Why PlayerZero** ------------------ PlayerZero is an early leader in AI\-powered production engineering, defining how enterprises use AI to understand, improve, and operate their software. We’re a small team with meaningful problems to solve and room for each person to make their mark. Whether you’re building the technology, working with customers, or growing the business, you’ll help shape the product, the company, and what customers expect from this emerging category. If you’re excited by work where the answers aren’t all written yet, and want a hand in writing them, you’ll fit right in. Compensation Range: $190K \- $240K

As needs evolve, your work will extend into shared capabilities such as identity and access, LLM gateways, API\-key management, training and inference platform maintenance, usage metering, and internal applications. You’ll work directly with the people using these systems, turning recurring friction into reliable, self\-serve tools. We’re looking for someone who treats internal tools as products: useful, understandable, well\-maintained, and built around the workflows of the people who depend on them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Improve how software gets built and deployed.** Develop repeatable local environments, automated tests, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows. Help make configuration, secrets, releases, and rollbacks easier to manage safely. * **Build tools for the AI development lifecycle.** Create workflows for running experiments and evaluations, versioning datasets and configurations, tracking results and artifacts, and deploying or integrating model services. Make runs easier to reproduce, compare, and investigate. Help researchers get from a recipe to a running job, and from a failed job to the cause.. * **Create full\-stack, self\-serve applications.** Build interfaces and APIs that let teams launch jobs, manage configurations, inspect results, and troubleshoot failures without relying on repeated manual assistance. * **Make systems observable and costs understandable.** Connect logs, metrics, traces, and usage data so teams can diagnose issues, identify bottlenecks, and understand where time and compute are being spent. * **Contribute to shared platform services.** Help build and integrate identity, access controls, LLM routing, API keys, budgets, and usage metering across Pramaana’s products and internal workflows. * **Use existing tools thoughtfully.** Evaluate and extend open\-source or managed solutions where they fit. Build custom software where it solves a real gap, rather than recreating infrastructure unnecessarily. * **Improve tools through direct feedback.** Work alongside engineers and researchers to identify recurring problems, prioritize improvements, and measure whether tools reduce setup time, manual work, and failed runs. Maintain tests, documentation, and operational guidance for what you ship. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * **Minimum 2\-3 years of software engineering experience**, including hands\-on work with backend services, full\-stack applications, internal tools, or deployment automation. * **A solid foundation in building software across the stack.** You can develop services and automation in Python or TypeScript, work with APIs and databases, and build usable interfaces with React or a similar framework. * **Practical cloud and deployment experience.** You’ve deployed applications using containers and a cloud platform such as AWS, worked with CI/CD, and used logs or metrics to investigate problems. * **Some hands\-on exposure to AI or ML workflows.** This could include integrating model APIs, running evaluations, tracking experiments, or operating model\-backed applications through work or substantial projects. You don’t need to be an ML researcher. * **A product mindset for internal users.** You care about clear interfaces, sensible defaults, useful documentation, and reducing the number of steps it takes someone to get their work done. * **Good engineering judgment and a collaborative approach.** You write maintainable code, test important behavior, ask for review, and communicate trade\-offs. You can take ownership of a scoped problem while recognizing when to seek help. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Experience with experiment tracking, evaluation pipelines, workflow orchestration, or model observability using tools such as MLflow, Langfuse, or Temporal. * Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, or telemetry tooling, such as Terraform, Kubernetes, or OpenTelemetry. * Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes: job queueing and preemption multi\-node training with NCCL over EFA or InfiniBand, GPU node health and driver management, or serving models with vLLM or SGLang. * Experience implementing authentication, role\-based access, API\-key management, image provenance, LLM gateways, usage and cost tracking or hardening public endpoints. * Experience adapting open\-source software or building developer tools that other engineers or researchers use regularly. You don’t need experience with every system listed above. Strong software engineering fundamentals, practical problem\-solving, and an interest in DevOps and MLOps matter more than matching every tool.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About PlayerZero** ==================== Building great software takes more than writing code. It takes teams working together and too often, the information they need is scattered across tools, conversations, and systems. PlayerZero is an AI platform that connects work across enterprise Support, Engineering, Product, QA, and SRE teams, helping them resolve issues faster, improve software quality, and plan what to build next. At its core is our Engineering World Model: a living understanding of a company’s software, how it runs, and the people and decisions behind it. By connecting codebases, tickets, production telemetry, and the conversations that shape the work, our model links what software is intended to do with how it actually behaves in production. and learns from where the two diverge. Our agents (we call them Players:) use that context to take on work across the software lifecycle. They learn from each outcome, earning trust and taking on more responsibility over time. We’re building a future where AI plays an active role in how teams plan, build, and run software. We’re looking for people across disciplines to help shape **About the role** ------------------ As a Solutions Engineer, you’ll help customers evaluate, implement, and expand their use of PlayerZero. You’ll partner with an Account Executive to understand customer needs, prove the platform’s technical and business value, and win the sale. Then you’ll stay involved through implementation, go\-live, and adoption. You’ll serve as the customer’s technical owner from evaluation onward, connecting PlayerZero to their software environment and turning defined use cases into measurable outcomes. This role combines technical depth, sales judgment, and hands\-on delivery, with responsibility for managing multiple engagements and identifying new opportunities as customers see results. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Lead technical discovery and demonstrations.** Understand customer needs across the CTO organization including Engineering, Support, and Product, and demonstrate PlayerZero using their code, tickets, systems and workflows. * **Drive evaluations to a decision**. Establish clear success criteria for proofs of concept and trials, connect technical capabilities to business outcomes, and handle objections alongside your Account Executive. * **Support the buying process**. Explain PlayerZero’s differentiation, address technical and security questions, and contribute to RFPs and procurement reviews. * **Lead implementation and go\-live.** Configure integrations across repositories, CI/CD, ticketing, and observability systems; build customer workflows; and coordinate Forward Deployed Engineer support when needed. * **Drive adoption and demonstrate results.** Train customer teams, remove blockers, and measure outcomes against the success criteria established during evaluation. * **Develop expansion opportunities.** Identify additional teams and use cases that benefit from PlayerZero’s understanding of the customer’s software, and prove their value with your Account Executive. * **Strengthen the team and product**. Partner with Support and Customer Success, communicate technical risks, bring customer insights to Product and Engineering, and build reusable technical assets. **What you bring** ------------------ * Experience selling technical products to engineering teams, ideally in developer tools, DevOps, observability, security, or cloud infrastructure. * Strong technical fundamentals across Git, CI/CD, APIs, containers, and cloud environments, with the ability to read unfamiliar code and engage credibly with senior engineers. * Experience leading discovery, delivering live demonstrations, managing technical evaluations, and handling buyer objections alongside an Account Executive. * The ability to connect technical capabilities to business value for technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Comfort troubleshooting in front of customers and adapting when a demonstration or deployment doesn’t go as planned. * A track record of ownership through implementation and customer outcomes, with strong organization and follow\-through across multiple engagements. * Relevant backgrounds include sales engineering, solutions architecture, or software, platform, and DevOps engineering with meaningful customer\-facing sales\-oriented experience. **What success looks like** --------------------------- Your evaluations lead to clear buying decisions, implementations reach production on agreed timelines, and customers achieve measurable results. Customer teams trust your technical judgment and leadership, and you and your Account Executive build on that foundation to grow the relationship. **Why PlayerZero** ------------------ PlayerZero is an early leader in AI\-powered production engineering, defining how enterprises use AI to understand, improve, and operate their software. We’re a small team with meaningful problems to solve and room for each person to make their mark. Whether you’re building the technology, working with customers, or growing the business, you’ll help shape the product, the company, and what customers expect from this emerging category. If you’re excited by work where the answers aren’t all written yet, and want a hand in writing them, you’ll fit right in. Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Ruxlo** LinkedIn is your professional network. Facebook and Instagram are your social networks. Ruxlo is your home's network. *Your**home**.**Your**neighborhood**.**Your**town**.* Ruxlo benefits everyone involved in real estate. Builders, architects, contractors and realtors do work that is quickly forgotten. A lawn sign stays up for a month or two, and after that no one knows who did the work. We're replacing that with one durable digital record attached to the parcel itself. Work is recorded by the professional who did it and confirmed by the owner who paid for it. When the house sells, the record stays. Think Carfax for homes. Around the property is your neighborhood, where you can comfortably connect and communicate with neighbors through the Ruxlo app, see other property profiles and ask about the contractors your neighbors used. Further out is your town, where you choose the notifications you want, such as recycling, bulk waste pickup, farmers markets or any other event the town sponsors. Underneath all of it, is our database of 150 million properties, users can leverage AI natural language search to get the information they are looking for quickly. We're backed by an experienced SaaS founder and CEO who bootstrapped and exited a GovTech SaaS company in early 2026\. We've assembled a fantastic team and have a unique opportunity to help define a category at the intersection of AI, data and real estate, the largest asset class in the country. **The Role** We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI. You'll set the technical strategy for how Ruxlo builds AI into the product, from a single well\-designed LLM call to long\-running autonomous agents, and you'll be the technical anchor for applied AI across teams. The range is the point. One week you're tuning natural language search over property records or extracting structured data from a scanned receipt. The next you're designing an agent that runs in the background for hours, calls dozens of tools, pauses for a human approval, and resumes exactly where it left off after a failure. Some of these agents act on a user's behalf. A homeowner might ask an agent to request quotes from contractors their neighbors used, file a receipt and warranty, or follow up until a contractor confirms a job. A contractor might hand an agent the import of their work history. These agents carry a user's authority, so they ask before anything consequential, stay inside what that user is allowed to do, and leave a record the user can review. You know when a prompt is enough, when retrieval is needed, and when only an agent will do. The engineer who succeeds here ships all three to production, measures them honestly, keeps their cost in check, and leaves behind a platform other engineers build on. **What's hard:** The patterns for production agents are still being invented, and you'll be setting direction without a playbook to lean on. If that sounds like the appeal rather than the warning, we should talk. What You'll Own * Own the architecture of Ruxlo's AI systems end to end: model access and routing, retrieval, prompt and tool layers, agent runtime, evaluation and cost * Ship LLM\-powered product features, including natural language search, summarization, structured extraction and classification over property, ownership and contractor records. * Ship autonomous background agents that verify, reconcile and enrich records and keep them fresh. * Ship agents that act on a user's behalf, such as requesting quotes, following up with contractors, importing work history and filing documents, with the user's consent at each consequential step. * Design durable, long\-running agent workflows on a durable\-execution engine such as Temporal, with retries, timeouts, idempotent tool calls and safe resume after failure. * Stand up evaluation for every AI feature: golden datasets, offline evaluation, regression gates in continuous integration and production sampling. * Set the standards for safe AI use, including prompt\-injection defense, least\-privilege tool access, delegated authority scoped to what the user could do themselves, and audit trails the user can review. * Make sound build\-versus\-buy calls across model providers, frameworks and vector stores, and treat cost and latency as first\-class constraints alongside * Build shared AI tooling, skills and Model Context Protocol servers, and mentor engineers on building with AI. **What You Bring** *Core Competencies* * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work well independently or as part of a team * Adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguity * Strong ownership and follow\-through * Effective use of AI tools in daily work * Sound decision\-making and prioritization * Open to feedback, and able to give it well * Collaborative across functions **Position Specific Requirements** * 8\+ years of engineering experience, including a technical lead role on systems other engineers built on. * LLM\-powered features you shipped to real users, such as retrieval\-augmented search, extraction or classification. You can walk us through what worked, what failed and how you measured it. * At least one autonomous, non\-conversational agent you took to production: triggered by events, schedules or data, and completing multi\-step work without a person in a chat window. * Agents you built that act for a user in other systems, including delegated permissions, consent and confirmation flows, and undo. * Hands\-on experience with durable execution or workflow Temporal is strongly preferred; Restate, Inngest, AWS Step Functions or similar also count. * Deep command of prompt design, structured outputs, tool use, Model Context Protocol, embeddings and vector search, and context\-window management. * A track record of evaluation and observability for AI in production: tracing, cost metering and quality measurement without a human grading every * Strong backend fundamentals in Python or TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and distributed systems on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. **Preferred Experience** * Agent frameworks and runtimes such as the OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or OpenClaw. * Classic machine learning for entity resolution or record matching over large structured or geospatial datasets. * Fine\-tuning or distilling smaller models for high\-volume, narrow * Cost engineering at scale: model selection per task, prompt caching, batching and token budgets. * Open\-source contributions to agent runtimes, workflow engines or Model Context Protocol servers. * Experience at a founder\-led or bootstrapped startup This is a dedicated, in\-house role, we are not considering fractional, part\-time or consulting arrangements. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States, we do not offer visa sponsorship. We do not accept candidate submissions from agencies or third\-party recruiters for this role. Unsolicited resumes sent to Ruxlo or any of our employees will be treated as direct applications and no fee will be paid for any resulting hire. **Ruxlo** **LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** AI disclosure: As part of our recruiting process, Ruxlo may use AI\-assisted tools to help screen, review, and organize applications, as well as to support scheduling and communication. These tools assist our team and all final hiring decisions are made by humans. We work to ensure these tools are used fairly and without unlawful bias. If you have questions about how AI is used in your application, would like to request a reasonable accommodation or an alternative review process, please contact us at (848\) 321\-5588\.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale. We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life. If you want to work on hard problems with real\-world impact, join us. **What you'll do** * Act as the primary finance partner to one of the business units, owning forecasting, planning, and performance management. * Work closely with business leaders and the CFO, you'll translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform growth, drive efficiency, and guide capital allocation. * Lead budgeting and long\-range planning, build and own best\-in\-class financial models, and evaluate critical initiatives across revenue, margin, and cost structure. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what's known and building what doesn't yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it's grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow. **What else you need to know** This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office\-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The base salary range for this role is **$250,000 – $300,000 per year.** Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis. **Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?** *\#LI\-Onsite*

jobs.title: Data Engineer (Streaming & Sensor Data)
jobs.description: **Data Engineer: Streaming \& Sensor Data** **Location: Primarily Colorado Springs, CO; Denver, CO, also considered** We are seeking a Data Engineer to build the data foundation for our machine learning applications. You will integrate time\-series measurements, including radar and OPIR data, from real\-time streams, application databases, and systems with varying extraction capabilities. You will collaborate with senior technical staff and the ML team to characterize available data, establish reliable pipelines, and deliver cleaned, standardized datasets. You will help select technologies and develop an architecture based on measured workloads, application needs, and operational requirements. Our development environment is primarily Python, with AWS as the preferred cloud platform. **In this role, you will:** * **Understand our data sources**. Investigate available interfaces, message formats, historical coverage, data volumes, arrival rates, and quality limitations. Document findings to guide implementation and capacity planning. * **Build ingestion pipelines.** Develop maintainable workflows for streaming and historical data across databases, APIs, files, and application\-specific interfaces. Implement configurable filtering to capture the messages and measurements needed downstream. * **Shape the data architecture.** Evaluate processing, storage, and access options against representative workloads, reliability needs, interoperability, operational complexity, and cost. Document decisions and support the architecture’s evolution as requirements become clearer. * **Deliver trusted datasets.** Establish consistent schemas, timestamps, units, identifiers, and source metadata while preserving measurement meaning. Implement validation and traceability, and define dependable access methods with the ML team. Support future feature, labeling, and training\-data workflows. * **Operate reliable systems.** Build tested, documented pipelines with repeatable deployment, monitoring, and appropriate access controls. Handle duplicate, missing, delayed, and out\-of\-order data, and implement recovery and reprocessing procedures. **We’re looking for someone with:** * Experience designing, implementing, and operating production streaming and batch data pipelines and their supporting storage systems. * Strong software engineering skills, including maintainable code, automated testing, version control, and deployment. * Practical understanding of streaming behavior, including filtering, consumer progress, buffering, failure recovery, and replay. * Experience organizing time\-series, telemetry, sensor, or similarly complex data, with an understanding of schema evolution, partitioning, and efficient access patterns. * Demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and communicate recommendations while balancing reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost. **Additional experience that would be valuable:** * Python\-based data processing and AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Radar, OPIR, or other sensor measurement data. * Workflow orchestration, containers, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery. * Dataset versioning, feature generation, labeling, or training\-data preparation.

You’ll have the freedom to shape strategy, implement best practices, and introduce new tools and technologies—all while helping us scale to the next level. This includes setting up users, roles and groups with proper permissions (permissions management), providing employees and contractors secure access to limited resources, and performing updates or maintenance to various resources and components ● Manage operating system updates and operations for VMs typically managed in Azure ● Onboard and offboard employees while ensuring conformance with security conformance requirements using tools like Sprinto. jobs.title: Director of Data Management & Analytics
jobs.description: **Overview** The Advanced Regenerative Manufacturing Institute (ARMl)IBioFabUSA is a Member\-based non\-profit, member\-driven, public\-private partnership with a mission to advance the bioeconomy and transform the future of human health. ARMI provides technical and wrap\-around commercialization services to companies seeking to advance technologies that will contribute to this impact. **The Impact That You Will Make** The Director will serve as a strategic and technical leader responsible for defining and executing the company's technical data strategy. The Director will bridge the gap between scientific research and scaled, automated manufacturing by overseeing the data infrastructure (ingestion, governance, architecture) and advanced analytical execution (predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and machine learning) needed to support scientific discovery, autologous/allogeneic cell therapy production, real\-time chain\-of\-custody/chain\-of\-identity tracking, and regulatory submissions. This role is uniquely critical in cell therapy, where success depends on integrating complex, high\-dimensional data across R\&D, preclinical development, manufacturing (CMC), supply chain/logistics, and commercial operations. The ideal candidate combines deep data strategy and technology leadership with an understanding of the unique data challenges associated with cell therapies, including integration of multi\-omic and other characterization data, biomanufacturing data, product tracking, and has a working knowledge with stringent regulatory/compliance requirements (FDA, EMA, GMP, GCP, GxP). **Your Role** **StrategyLeadership** * Define and drive the technical data strategy and roadmap, aligning data and analytics investments with R\&D, manufacturing, and commercial priorities * Advise the Executive Team on data\-driven opportunities and risks * Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of data engineers, data scientists, bioinformaticians, and data governance/quality specialists * Establish the company's data culture, championing data literacy and evidence\-based decision\-making across all functions **Data InfrastructureArchitecture** * Oversee design and implementation of a unified data platform/data lake integrating data from R\&D, preclinical development, manufacturing (MES, LIMS), supply chain (chain\-of\-identity/chain\-of\-custody systems), and commercial operations * Partner with IT/Digital leadership on cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, interoperability standards (e.g., HL7 FHIR, CDISC), and system integrations (ERP, MES, LIMS, and as needed, QMS) **Data Governance, QualityCompliance** * Establish enterprise data governance policies, standards, and stewardship models to ensure data integrity, quality, security, and phase\-appropriate regulatory compliance * Lead data privacy and security initiatives in partnership with IT Security and Legal **AnalyticsAdvanced Technology** * Champion the application of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI to accelerate scientific discovery, optimize manufacturing yield/process parameters, and predict supply chain risk * Enable predictive and prescriptive analytics for manufacturing process optimization and capacity planning * Evaluate and implement emerging technologies (AI/ML platforms, digital twins, real\-world data/evidence tools) to maintain competitive advantage **Cross\-Functional Partnership** * Collaborate closely with R\&D, Manufacturing/CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to understand data needs and deliver fit\-for\-purpose solutions * Partner with the Executive Team (if applicable) on technology infrastructure decisions and IT roadmap alignment * Manage relationships with external vendors, data platform providers, and technology partners **Your Skills and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree (MS, PhD) strongly preferred * 5\-8\+ years of progressive experience in data architecture, data engineering, advanced analytics, with at least 4\+ years in life sciences, biotech, pharma, or cell/gene therapy industry ecosystems. * 3\-5\+ years of direct management experience leading cross\-functional data teams. * Demonstrated experience building enterprise data governance, architecture, and analytics capabilities from the ground up * Advanced command of statistical tools and programming (Python, R, SQL, SAS) * Deep experience with modern cloud data systems (Azure, Snowflake, AWS) * Familiarity with R\&D and manufacturing/biomanufacturing data systems (ELN, MES, LIMS, ERP) * Track record of leading and scaling high\-performing data and analytics teams * High level communication and presentation skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership **Additional Experience We Value** * Direct cell therapy or advanced therapy medicinal product (ATMP) experience strongly preferred * Experience with autologous or allogeneic cell therapy manufacturing and chain\-of\-identity/chain\-of\-custody data systems * Familiarity with mass spectrometry\-based multi\-omics, single\-cell genomics, flow cytometry, and other cell characterization data types * Experience implementing AI/ML solutions in a regulated life sciences environment * Experience in a high\-growth, fast\-paced biotech environment (clinical\-to\-commercial transition)

jobs.title: AI Software Developer
jobs.description: At **Advantive**, we don’t just make software—we build careers and power the manufacturing and distribution backbone of the global economy. We are building the next generation of intelligent enterprise software—platforms that think, adapt, and automate alongside the people who use them. Our AI \& Business Intelligence team delivers conversational assistants, intelligent search, data\-driven agents, predictive analytics, and workflow automation that transform how businesses operate. As a Mid\-Level AI Software Developer, you will own and deliver production\-ready AI features end\-to\-end. You will work across LLM integrations, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and AI\-driven workflows, building reliable backend services and applications that directly impact enterprise customers. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who has shipped AI\-powered features in production and is ready to take full ownership of feature delivery, including performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. We are looking for candidates who are practical, collaborative, and comfortable making sound engineering trade\-offs in real production environments. **Responsibilities:** * Design and deliver AI\-powered product features end\-to\-end, from requirements and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-release optimization. * Build and maintain retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) workflows that ground LLM responses in enterprise data, including application\-side retrieval design, response grounding, and retrieval tuning. * Implement application and backend services that integrate large language models and AI services into enterprise products through well\-designed APIs and service boundaries. * Develop AI\-assisted workflows and agent\-style automations that interact safely with enterprise data, product capabilities, and external systems. * Create and maintain automated tests, evaluation practices, monitoring, and operational runbooks for AI\-enabled features so reliability is designed in from the start. * Analyze production behavior, user feedback, and telemetry to improve answer quality, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency. Make and communicate trade\-offs between model quality, latency, and cost. * Collaborate with product, UX, data, QA, and platform teams to define use cases, acceptance criteria, evaluation methods, and rollout plans. * Contribute to engineering standards through code reviews, technical design discussions, and shared best practices focused on testing, observability, security, and performance. **What Success Looks Like** * Owns AI\-powered features end\-to\-end in production, from implementation through post\-release improvement. * Uses telemetry, user feedback, and evidence to improve answer quality, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Makes sound trade\-offs between quality, latency, and cost, and can clearly explain those decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Delivers reliable, well\-tested features with appropriate monitoring, evaluation, and operational readiness. * Collaborates effectively across engineering, product, UX, data, QA, and platform partners to ship high\-quality releases. **Qualifications \& Experience** **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience. **Why Advantive?** * Culture of Growth: We don’t hire to fill seats—we hire to develop talent. You’ll be supported like an athlete, coached like a leader, and challenged like a builder. * Career Acceleration: Many of our best leaders started in frontline roles like this one. We believe in moving fast and promoting from within. * Real Impact: You’re not a cog in the machine here. Your work helps real businesses that keep supply chains, manufacturing lines, and entire industries running. Artificial intelligence (AI) technology may be used during the hiring process to record, transcribe, analyze, and rank interview responses. By submitting your application and participating in the interview process, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in the hiring process. **Interview Process:** We believe in identifying a strong fit between our company and our employees and supporting a culture of creative problem solving and innovation. To that extent, if selected for next steps, you will be invited to complete a series of assessments that focus on aptitude and personality prior to a recruiter interview. Everyone at the company from early career all the way to CEO has taken these assessments. The assessment email will be coming from a no\-reply email address via our ATS (Hirebridge), so please be on the lookout! *Advantive is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry,* *religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity or expression), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and to ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process.* **Warning!** Advantive does not make job offers without conducting face\-to\-face (including virtual) interviews and will never ask you for money and/or personal information such as Social Security or bank information during the interview process. Job scams have been reported against many companies. For more information, please visit: FTC Job Scams. **Technical Skills** * Proficiency in one or more backend languages and frameworks such as C\#/.NET, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping AI\-powered features in production, such as LLM integrations, retrieval\-based search, conversational assistants, intelligent agents, or workflow automation. * Experience designing APIs and service integrations in distributed or service\-oriented systems. * Working knowledge of relational databases, including schema design, query fundamentals, and indexing concepts. * Familiarity with cloud\-hosted AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Bot Service, Microsoft Agent Framework, or comparable platforms. * Understanding of evaluation, monitoring, and reliability considerations for AI systems in production. * Understanding of cost\-quality trade\-offs in LLM systems, including examples such as model selection, token efficiency, caching, or reducing unnecessary API calls. * Proficiency with Git, code review, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices. **Experience** * 3\+ years of professional software development experience, including production experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring applications end\-to\-end. * Experience shipping at least one production\-deployed AI\-powered feature with measurable customer impact within the past 18–24 months. This can be part of the 3\+ years of total experience. * Experience working with real production constraints such as operational reliability, data governance, and cost\-performance trade\-offs in AI\-enabled systems. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum and collaborative cross\-functional development environments. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a 30\-minute online assessment as a part of your application.

The controller software runs within a Linux based or Windows based real\-time operating system and uses an embedded DSP, ARM, or Intel processor. jobs.title: ZScaler Network SME
jobs.description: Serve as a ZScaler Network SME enabling the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) mission and enterprise network infrastructure. The applicant will serve as the primary technical authority for designing, deploying, administering, upgrading and optimizing enterprise\-wide Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solutions using the Zscaler cloud security platform. This role leads the operational architecture across Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX), driving modern Zero Trust initiatives * The Zscaler Network SME will be the technical lead performing the following: Architecture \& Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Zscaler deployments (ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and Zscaler Client Connector) across multi\-cloud and hybrid corporate environments. * Policy \& Governance: Create, audit, and tune security policies, including URL filtering, Cloud Application Control, SSL/TLS deep packet inspection, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and sandbox policies. * Zero Trust Deployment: Formulate and execute access policies within ZPA to enable least\-privilege direct access to internal applications in private clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premises data centers without traditional VPN overhead. * Operational Troubleshooting: Serve as Tier\-3/Tier\-4 escalation support for complex proxy routing, PAC (Proxy Auto\-Configuration) file debugging, identity integration, authentication drops, and application latency issues. * Agent Lifecycle Management: Manage enterprise distribution, health checks, profile tuning, and version upgrades of Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android platforms. * Observability \& Analytics: Leverage ZDX and cloud analytics to isolate user experience degradation across endpoint, network ISP, and application levels; configure automated alerting and SIEM log integration (Splunk, Cribl). * Cross\-Functional Integration: Partner with Identity and Access Management (IAM) teams to configure SAML/SCIM attributes with IdPs such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), or Ping Identity. * Troubleshooting \& Incident Management: Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation support for network outages, circuit degradations, and performance issues; conduct root cause analyses (RCA) and coordinate vendor support. * Documentation \& Asset Management: Maintain accurate network diagrams (Visio), topology maps, inventory databases, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and change control tickets (ServiceNow/Remedy). * Support On\-Call \& Escalation Management: support 24/7/365 on\-call rotation readiness to respond to Tier 3 critical network incidents within SLA limits and coordinating cross\-functional escalation pathways. When needed to restore services, the Senior Network Engineer will provide a solution and implement an Emergency Change Request (ECR), Emergency Break Fix (EBF), or Change Request. * Root Cause Analysis (RCA) or Post Incident Reporting: Participate in the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) or post incident analysis of problems for mission critical applications, mission essential applications, and mission essential network infrastructure as well as recurring issues on the enterprise IT infrastructure. * Project Support: Partner with program and project managers to align network engineering deliverables, milestone schedules, and resource planning with enterprise project objectives. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues. * Scheduled and Adhoc Travel: Ability to travel within the United States either on short notice or scheduled, up to 20% of the time. ### **Required** **1\. Must have a minimum of 5\+ years of relevant experience** The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with: * **Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA):** Security policies, URL filtering, SSL inspection, traffic forwarding, authentication, and advanced troubleshooting. * **Zscaler Private Access (ZPA):** App Connectors, application segments, access policies, private application connectivity, and troubleshooting. * **Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC):** Deployment, configuration, forwarding profiles, upgrades, endpoint compatibility, and troubleshooting. * **Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX):** Application performance monitoring, network path analysis, latency investigation, and troubleshooting. * **PAC Files:** Advanced knowledge of JavaScript\-based PAC files, proxy configurations, routing logic, and application\-specific bypass requirements. * **PowerShell:** Scripting and automation for troubleshooting and operational support. **2\. Enterprise Networking and Advanced Troubleshooting** The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, TLS/SSL, proxy architecture, and network traffic analysis. The SME should be able to independently diagnose complex connectivity, authentication, application performance, and security policy issues; coordinate with other technical teams; and document root causes and corrective actions. **Certifications** * Zscaler ZIA administration certification or equivalent official training. * Zscaler ZPA administration certification or equivalent official training. * Zscaler ZDX training or relevant certification, where available. * Cisco CCNA or CCNP. * CompTIA Security\+. * Relevant Zscaler Zero Trust or advanced security training. ***MUST BE ABLE TO PASS A CBP BI*** ### **Nice to Have** **Enterprise Applications and Technology Integration – Highly Desirable** Our environment includes a wide range of enterprise technologies and specialized applications. The SME should be comfortable investigating Zscaler\-related connectivity, authentication, performance, and security policy issues involving: * **Security and monitoring:** Splunk, Cribl, CrowdStrike, and Okta. * **Cloud platforms:** AWS and Microsoft Azure. * **Developer tools:** GitHub, Docker, Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, development repositories, APIs, and other enterprise development platforms. * **Mobile technologies:** Mobile devices, mobile applications, wireless connectivity, VPN interactions, and mobile device management solutions. * **ZSIM:** Connectivity and security troubleshooting involving ZSIM\-related applications and infrastructure. * **WCTTV camera systems:** Network connectivity, remote access, streaming, and security policy compatibility for camera\-related services. * **Drone technologies:** Connectivity and application access requirements associated with drone\-related platforms, management software, and supporting services. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. ***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.*** AHEAD is on the hunt for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build Hatch, our flagship platform. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security. Hatch is an advanced platform for IT lifecycle management, renewal, procurement, and logistics, giving enterprises real\-time visibility and control over their IT assets, orders, contracts, and inventory across thousands of sites. Unity, its sibling platform, extends those capabilities to streamline our own operations and service delivery. You’ll join a progressive engineering team that lives on the forefront of technology. We build real products, adopt new tools early, sweat the details, and trade ideas constantly. You will learn here, and you’ll have the autonomy to make a visible impact fast. We’re far less interested in the languages on your résumé than in how you think. You’ll own meaningful problems end to end, starting from the user and the business outcome. You’ll design, build, and ship full\-stack solutions, make sound architectural calls, and stay accountable for quality from first commit to production. Our stack today is Elixir and Phoenix, but we care far more that you can pick up whatever a problem demands and bring strong engineering judgment to it. ### **Building in the Age of AI** AI has changed what great engineering looks like, and we’ve leaned in. We expect engineers to use AI tools and coding agents fluently to prototype, explore, and accelerate the routine, so that human time goes to what matters: framing the right problem, designing the system, exercising judgment, and verifying that what ships is correct and secure. We’re not looking for people who fear the tools, or who trust them blindly. We’re looking for engineers who wield them with taste. * Reach for AI to move faster on scaffolding, refactors, tests, and research, then review every line like you own it, because you do. * Spend your judgment where it counts: architecture, product decisions, edge cases, security, and correctness. * Help push the practice forward with better tooling, prompts, and workflows that make the whole team more effective. ### **What will you be doing?** * Own features and problems end to end, from understanding the user’s need through design, delivery, and support. * Design and build full\-stack solutions for internal and public web applications, making pragmatic architectural decisions along the way. * Work at high leverage with AI tools and agents, then review, test, and harden everything you ship. * Engage across the full development life cycle: analysis, implementation, integration, testing, debugging, and support. * Lead code reviews and raise the bar on quality, mentoring other engineers as you go. * Work directly with end users and stakeholders to understand the business problem behind each request. * Help set estimates and milestones, balance technical risk against cost and deadlines, and keep work on track. * Help drive the future roadmap of the engineering team and AHEAD. ### **What does the ideal candidate look like?** * 5\+ years building and shipping software (7\+ preferred), with a track record of owning significant work end to end. * Strong engineering judgment. You know what “good” looks like and can tell solid solutions from shaky ones, including code an AI wrote. * A product mindset: you start from the user and the outcome, and you sweat the details that make software useful. * Fluency with modern AI development tools and coding agents, paired with the discipline to verify, test, and own everything you ship. * Stack\-agnostic adaptability, so you pick up new languages and frameworks quickly. (Our stack today is Elixir and Phoenix; prior experience is welcome but not required.) * A strong foundation in software design, architecture, and the practices that keep systems reliable, including testing, continuous integration, code review, and containerization. * Clear, direct communication, so you can express intent precisely to both teammates and the tools you work with. * The instincts of a senior engineer: you lead projects, mentor others, and raise the level of the people around you. * A drive to keep learning and to help shape how the team builds. ### **Why you'll love it here** * Join a progressive team that lives on the forefront of technology, where innovation and curiosity are the norm. * We invest seriously in modern tooling, including the best AI tools, and we’re always looking for the next approach that makes the team better. * Competitive salary, benefits, and an environment where work\-life balance is more than just a catchphrase. * You’ll play a crucial role in a platform that enterprises rely on to manage their IT, working alongside a talented and motivated team. ### **Make your voice heard** AHEAD recognizes the value of diverse perspectives. In our ever\-evolving tech landscape, the insights you bring from your own journey can reshape our collective experience. If you’ve had experiences, both good and challenging, with other platforms, technologies, or ways of working, they’ll become an asset here. Your voice will help refine our products and the way we build them, keeping both innovative, intuitive, and industry\-leading. *Please include links to anything that shows how you build, whether that’s repositories, projects you led, or pull requests that reflect the breadth of your work. jobs.title: Engineering Manager (AI)
jobs.description: **About AiPrise** ----------------- AiPrise is a YC\-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross\-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world. Through a single integration, we connect 800\+ data sources and 80\+ verification partners across 200\+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge. Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount. We're \~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day. Borders shouldn't be blockers. Compliance is hard. AiPrise shouldn't be. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead and grow the team that builds AiPrise's AI agents. This is a player\-coach role: you will manage, hire and develop engineers, and you will also stay close enough to the code to design agent architectures, review prompts and tool definitions, and debug a failing eval yourself. You will own how our agents are built, measured and shipped: the skills and tools they call, how they remember context across a case, and the evals that tell us whether a change made them better or worse. In a regulated domain like KYC and KYB, an agent that is confidently wrong costs our customers real money and audit risk, so quality and observability matter as much as speed. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Lead the team** * Manage a team of 5\-6 AI and backend engineers: weekly 1:1s, clear goals, honest feedback and career growth plans. * Hire the next wave of AI engineers. You will own the interview loop for agent\-engineering roles and raise the bar on it. * Run planning and delivery for the AI roadmap with product, so the team ships on predictable cycles without burning out. * Build a culture where engineers write evals before they claim a win, and where incidents lead to fixes, not blame. **Build the agents, hands on** * Design and review our compliance agents, from single document checks to multi\-step investigations that hand off to human reviewers. * Build the reusable skills, tools and memory our agents rely on to call registries and data vendors and carry context across a case. * Own the eval stack: golden datasets built with compliance experts, regression tests in CI and production monitoring. * Write and review code about 50% of the time, and choose models based on accuracy, cost and latency. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **People leadership** * 2\+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring, performance reviews and at least one hard conversation you handled well. * A track record of growing engineers: someone you managed got promoted or took on a bigger scope because of your support. * Experience running planning and delivery for a team in a fast\-moving startup or scale\-up. **Hands\-on agent engineering** * 6\+ years as a software engineer, with strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript. * You have built and shipped LLM agents to production, not just prototypes, and can explain what broke and how you fixed it. * Practical experience with each of these: designing tool and function\-calling interfaces; packaging reusable skills or prompt modules; implementing agent memory (short\-term context, long\-term stores, retrieval); and building evals that gate releases. * Comfort with at least one major model API (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar) and the trade\-offs between agent frameworks and plain code. * A habit of measuring: you can show an eval you built, the metric it tracked and a decision it changed. **How you work** * Clear written communication. You can explain an agent failure to a compliance lead and to an engineer. * Good judgment on when to build, when to buy and when to keep a human in the loop. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in fintech, regtech, fraud, identity verification or another regulated domain where AI decisions need an audit trail. * Document AI experience: OCR, document classification or extraction across many languages and formats. * Experience with LLM observability and tracing tools, and with cost and latency optimization at scale. * Contributions to open\-source agent, eval or retrieval projects, or public writing on the topic. Compensation Range: $185K \- $230K

Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI\-powered edge applications. Our cross\-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. Achieve.** If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here. **This role will be on\-site 5 days a week in NW Austin.** ### **Scope** As the Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Power Management at Ambiq, you will drive the software architecture, requirements, development, testing, and performance optimization of the SDK power management software for our latest family of low\-power Edge AI MCUs. In this role, you will work closely with SoC hardware power architects, product marketing, validation, and our IP vendors to define the software architecture, functional partitioning, and requirements for the platform's power management infrastructure. You will provide technical leadership and architectural direction to the software development and system test teams, ensuring the delivery of robust, production\-quality software on schedule. The successful candidate will have extensive experience in early\-stage software architecture and hands\-on embedded software development. They must have a proven track record of designing, implementing, debugging, profiling, and optimizing embedded software for ARM Cortex\-M processors using an RTOS. Experience developing low\-level firmware, power management software, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers is essential. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems while remaining actively involved in software design, implementation, code reviews, and debugging. **Responsibilities** * Define software requirements and functional allocations based on evolving input from SoC hardware architects, product marketing, software architects, validation and software development teams. * Design, develop, debug, profile, and optimize the AmbiqSuite SDK power management software, including power modeling and characterization under a wide range of operating conditions. * Own the SoC software architecture, performance, and power optimization, identifying opportunities to reduce power consumption while maintaining system performance and functionality. *
