jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. #### **JOB SUMMARY** Apptronik builds humanoid robots. Our engineers depend on infrastructure we run ourselves: Kubernetes clusters on bare metal and in the public cloud, plus the CI/CD and observability systems behind every robot software release. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will manage and scale the Devops platform. Your job is to make it more resilient, faster to build on and safer to change as the robot fleet and the engineering team grow. You own your work end to end, from architecture decisions down to the Linux kernel, the network and the disk when something misbehaves. We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who builds systems that are reliable by design and keeps digging until they understand why something broke. #### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Manage and scale our Kubernetes platform on bare metal, virtual machines and public cloud, including cluster provisioning, networking, storage and upgrades. * Build the CI/CD infrastructure our robotics engineers ship with: build runners, remote build execution and caching, container registries, and autoscaling that adds capacity on\-prem or in the cloud as demand changes. * Design for failure: backups, multi\-site recovery, and recovery drills that prove the company keeps working when a data center goes down. * Make change safe with GitOps delivery, progressive rollouts, and automatic rollback when a release fails its health checks. * Decide what to measure. Define SLIs and SLOs for the platform, and build the monitoring and alerting around them. * Debug production issues across the stack, from Kubernetes down to the Linux kernel, the network and the disk, and fix the root cause so they do not come back. * Manage infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Helm and Ansible, and write tooling in Go or Python to remove manual work. * Build security into the platform: single sign\-on and role\-based access, certificate and secret management, and minimal, patched operating systems. * Partner with robotics software teams on architecture and production readiness, and set the standards other teams build on. * Plan capacity and cost across on\-prem and cloud as the robot fleet and the engineering team grow. #### **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * **Linux**: deep knowledge of operating system internals, the networking stack, file systems, process and resource management, and performance tuning. * **Kubernetes in production**: you have built clusters, upgraded them, and debugged them when networking, storage or scheduling broke. * **Hands\-on debugging**: you work in a shell and reach for tools such as strace, tcpdump, ss and perf. * **Infrastructure as code and GitOps** with tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm and Argo CD. * **Software skills** in Go or Python. You build tools and services, not only scripts. * **Networking**: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, VLANs and BGP. * **Observability**: you know what to measure, how to alert on it, and how to set SLOs. * You design for failure, and ask how a system will break before you build it. * You keep digging until you can explain the root cause, and you stay clear\-headed during an outage. * You prioritize well, work independently, and finish what you start. #### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Hybrid infrastructure: on\-prem bare metal, virtualization and SAN or NAS storage, and at least one public cloud. * Experience building and operating CI/CD and build infrastructure at scale, such as remote build execution and caching, container build optimization and runner autoscaling. * Experience with immutable, API\-managed operating systems for Kubernetes nodes, and with eBPF\-based networking. * Experience operating container registries with replication and caching across sites. * Experience planning disaster recovery and running recovery drills. * Experience running infrastructure on both x86\_64 and ARM. * Experience with infrastructure for robotics, embedded systems or IoT device fleets. #### **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of relevant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering with a focus on hybrid cloud environments. * A record of building infrastructure from scratch and running it reliably in production. #### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times. * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen. * Hearing and speech to communicate. * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This team's mandate is to rebuild P\&C's processes and technology from the ground up: not just make today's processes faster, but decide, process by process, what should be fully automated, what should be enhanced with AI, and what should remain human\-led. This role owns that end to end: you dig into how a process actually works today, document it clearly, decide what belongs on each side of that automate / augment / human line, and then build or oversee the build of the solution, partnering closely with Avalara's People Technology (engineering) team where needed. This role calls for someone who has genuinely done architecture work for process before: not just documented how something works today, but designed what it should become, end to end. Paired with deep, hands\-on AI fluency: the ability to dig into a messy, real\-world process, understand it fully, document it clearly, and see exactly where AI can fully automate a step, where it should augment a person doing the work, and where the work should stay human, and then design for it. The impact of this role is to completely reimagine how People \& Culture's processes work: building a genuinely strong operating model underneath P\&C, and envisioning what the experience should be for each persona who touches it, including employees, people managers, candidates, the business, and P\&C itself. This role owns the process architecture, the operating model, and the vision for each solution. From there, the actual AI tool build can go either way: hand it to the People Technology (engineering) team to build, or build it yourself, including building AI agents directly, depending on the complexity of the tool and where capacity sits at the time. You'll operate with significant autonomy on ambiguous, cross\-functional problems, and be a trusted partner to P\&C leadership and to Avalara's People Technology (engineering) leadership alike. \#LI\-Remote What Your Responsibilities Will Be: **Dig Into \& Document Current State*** Get into the details of how a process actually works today, not just what's documented, through direct observation, data review, and conversations with the people doing the work. * Build clear, step\-by\-step process maps and a prioritized list of pain points and gaps that others can act on. * Gather baseline data on existing processes, such as cycle time, volume, and error rates, to ground redesign decisions in evidence, not assumptions. **Envision the Future Experience by Persona*** Reimagine what the process should look and feel like for each persona it touches (employee, people manager, candidate, business, and P\&C itself), rather than incrementally improving the current experience. * Turn that persona\-based vision into a clear target state: what changes for the person going through it, and what has to be true of the process and technology to deliver it. * Use that target\-state vision as the basis for the automate, augment, or human\-led decisions that follow. **Decide What's Automated, Augmented, or Human*** For each step of a process, make the call: fully automate with AI, augment a person with AI, or keep it human\-led, and be able to explain why. * Translate that judgment into concrete technical requirements and specifications an engineering team can build against. * Assess build\-vs\-buy for each opportunity: build in\-house, buy a vendor solution, or integrate with an existing platform (e.g., Workday), and sequence the work into phases that deliver value quickly. **Design \& Build the Solution*** Design the target\-state solution architecture for each process, not just the requirements, but how the pieces fit together, and decide whether to hand the AI tool build to People Technology or build it yourself, based on complexity and where capacity sits. * Where you build it yourself, build the AI agents and automations directly. Where People Technology builds it, partner closely with their engineers on requirements, testing, and QA throughout. * Identify upstream and downstream impacts on other processes, systems, and teams before committing to a build. **Own the Operating Model \& Roadmap*** Own and maintain the AI \& automation roadmap for the processes you're responsible for, aligning priorities with P\&C leadership and People Technology. * Build a strong, durable operating model underneath each redesigned process: one that holds up after the initial build, not just at launch. * Build ROI models and success measures for each tool or automation, track performance against t lds. * Experience partnering with software engineers through implementation: testing, deploying, and iterating, not just handing off a spec. * Experience sequencing large initiatives into phases that deliver value quickly and can be adjusted along the way. * Strong communication skills: credible with engineers, understandable to business and operations stakeholders. **Nice to Have*** Experience in HR, People Operations, or a comparable operations function (recruiting, employee lifecycle, service delivery). Helpful context, not a prerequisite. * Hands\-on Workday experience (configuration, reporting, or implementation). * Background in solutions architecture, technical product management, or a similar hybrid business/technical role. * Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or RPA tools beyond agentic AI. * Experience defining org structure or governance models for AI agents or automated systems. **Pay Range Details** The base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may different in other locations. Colorado $153,300\-$252,900 (annually) Washington $153,300\-$279,600 (annually) California $153,300\-$306,300 (annually) NYC $169,400\-$306,300 (annually) The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business consideration This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending on the terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role. Avalara is an AI\-first Company: AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here. * You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers. * You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too. How We'll Take Care of You: Total Rewards In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high\-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200\-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right. Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent\-dense team where everyone is enabled to do the best work of their careers. No one can predict the future of insurance, so we're building it. **The Role** ============ We're looking for an exceptional Product Engineer. You'll build the platform that lets insurance teams put AI to work on real operations, and trust it when it matters. Your job is to find what the platform needs next and build it. Our forward\-deployed engineers run customer deployments on top of the platform. You build the platform itself. Working closely with them, design, and customers, you'll spot the hard problems that keep coming up and turn them into product: the smallest version that creates value now and extends cleanly later. **What You'll Work On** ======================= * **Shape the product from the start.** You come in early, working with customers, design, and product strategy to decide what gets built and why, not picking up tickets after the decisions are made. * **Build the rails insurance will run on.** From public chat interfaces where claimants report and follow their claims, to branded portals our largest carrier customers host on Avallon, you build the surfaces the industry will soon run on. * **Help teams confidently automate more.** Build clear, auditable claim context and the experiences that let people review and approve agent work, giving teams control where it matters and letting them expand automation with confidence. * **Own it end to end, in production.** Build the whole flow yourself, from data model to backend to interface, then own how it performs: instrument it, watch how real users move through it in Datadog RUM, and keep pushing it as more teams rely on it. The work is broad, and your impact will grow wherever the platform needs you most. You will take on a meaningful challenge, ship it quickly, watch what changes in production, and go again. **You** ======= * You have 3\+ years building and owning meaningful software in production. You can point to a difficult challenge you solved or a system you built that changed what was possible, explain the judgment behind it, and answer for the outcome once it was live. * You are a full\-stack product engineer who builds whole flows yourself. TypeScript and SQL are your working tools; you design the data model and backend as readily as the interface on top of it. You work closely with design and product strategy, have opinions about what to build, and can explain them clearly. This is not a frontend\-only role. * You have built and operated LLM\- or agent\-powered products in production, and understand the challenges of making them reliable at scale. * You want to be in the room. This role is in person in New York. **Nice to Have** ================ * You know insurance, claims, or another regulated operational domain where reliability and traceability matter. * You have worked as a product manager, or owned product decisions and roadmap in a similar role. * You have worked at an early\-stage company. * You have been a founder or founding engineer. **A Few Things We Believe In** ============================== * **Eating well:** We provide lunch and dinner every workday from local restaurants. * **Health \& Wellness:** Your health is on us. We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, offer up to $17,000 toward fertility and family\-forming through Carrot, and give you a monthly gym stipend to stay active. * **Getting out of the office together to recharge:** quarterly offsites somewhere you actually want to go. * **And our favorite:** unlimited token budget. No caps, no rationing. Build with whatever makes you fastest. Compensation Range: $165K \- $270K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** At Avenue Z, we are a dynamic media and technology company with a powerful influence across all channels. Our leadership has been at the forefront of digital marketing and communications for over 30 years, pioneering innovative strategies that drive meaningful change in brand performance and business growth. When you join Avenue Z, you become part of a team that doesn’t just adapt to change but leads it, guiding some of the world’s most influential leaders and brands to new heights. We are driven by a deep passion for our craft and an unwavering commitment to integrity in everything we do. If you share our passion and values, explore our current job openings to see how you can make an impact with us.**The role** ------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to build and ship the agent systems that run social commerce for our brands and for our own platform. You will embed with the teams doing the work, performance media, creator and influencer, ecommerce, and analytics, find the process where throughput is lost or money is left on the table, and build a production agent that owns it. Then you move to the next one. Concretely, this is work like: agents that detect and re\-authorize expiring TikTok Shop affiliate codes and Meta partnership permissions before spend stalls, systems that reallocate ad budget toward top\-performing creators automatically, pipelines that launch new creator content across every platform daily without a human touching it, and reporting infrastructure that tells a brand what actually drove GMV. You own the problem end to end: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, evals, adoption, and what breaks at 2am. If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary \+ equity package * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Business Operations
jobs.description: **About Backstory** Backstory (formerly People.ai) is the leading AI answers platform for sales teams. With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like OpenAI, IBM, Red Hat, Verizon, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue. By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue. Recognized by Gartner and Forrester, the Inc. 5000, Y Combinator Top Companies, and the Forbes AI 50, Backstory is based in San Francisco and backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures and Mubadala Capital. **The Role** We are hiring a Sr. Director of GTM Operations to build the operating system behind Backstory’s growth. You will own the metrics, systems, cadences, and commercial operations that let a small, AI\-leveraged team run what once took a much larger ops function. The role reports to the SVP of Customer Value. This role brings GTM operations together in one place. Comp design, territory and quota planning, pricing approvals, lead routing, and CRM administration consolidate here instead of sitting in separate functions. Sales, CS, and Partnerships should run on one integrated operating system. You will present quarterly results and forward guidance to the Executive Leadership Team, and be the authority on how confident leadership should be in the numbers. You will also run our GTM on Backstory itself, turning our own operating model into a proof point for customers. ### **Responsibilities** **Measurement and data foundation** * Instrument the full customer journey, from pre\-funnel and partner activity through credit consumption and expansion. At our scale, this is a weeks\-not\-months deliverable. * Define the GTM data model, funnel stages, and metric definitions so numbers reconcile across Sales, CS, Partnerships, and Finance. * Connect product usage and billing data to the revenue stack so every customer is represented completely and consistently. * Govern CRM fields and data quality through automation and clear standards, not manual cleanup. **Forecasting and executive reporting** * Design and run a forecasting rhythm built for a consumption\-based, land\-and\-expand model: channel and marketing activity into pipeline, new\-logo velocity, consumption trajectories, and expansion revenue. * Present completed\-quarter results and forward guidance to the ELT at each quarter\-end. * Give ELT members the analysis, forecasts, and materials they need to run their functions and report upward. * Run forecast reviews, pipeline inspections, and business reviews as forums for decisions, not status updates. * Use the data to pressure\-test plans and flag risk early, even when the conclusion is unwelcome. **Intelligence layer and AI** * Build AI\-driven reporting and analysis across solution presentation, adoption, credit consumption, and customer outcomes, with Backstory as the primary source of truth. * Deliver automated briefings, pipeline intelligence, and self\-serve analytics to the whole GTM organization, not just leadership. * Make build, buy, or connect decisions for the GTM data and tooling that power instrumentation and the intelligence layer. **Retention and expansion signals** * Re\-anchor our early warning system around solution adoption: credit consumption, feature activation, workflow integration depth, CS engagement, and conversation signals. * Turn those signals into a review cadence and save and expand plays triggered by what customers are actually doing. * Feed adoption\-based churn and expansion signals into the forecast, so save and expand plays show up in projected revenue. **Commercial operations** * Comp plan design for Sales, CS, and Partnerships, in partnership with Finance and People. * Territory, quota, and capacity planning, including clear rules of engagement and handoffs across direct, CS, and partner teams. * CPQ and pricing approvals, from quote to close. * Lead routing across marketing, sales, CS, and partners, with defined service levels. * Day\-to\-day CRM administration and the health of revenue\-critical systems. **Be Our Best Customer** * Run Backstory's GTM on Backstory, learning from our strongest adopters and trying uses customers that have not yet tried. * Document the results so they can be referenced in customer and prospect conversations. * Engage with customers and the market as a practitioner of the platform. ### **Qualifications** * **Build ve built functions, systems, or processes from scratch rather than inheriting mature ones. You reach for leverage before headcount and lead a small team while staying close to the work. * **Applied AI.** Deep understanding of the AI tooling landscape and the ability to make informed tooling decisions and understand where Backstory fits. You have deployed LLMs and AI tools in operational workflows, not just evaluated them. You know where AI outperforms traditional automation and where it adds risk. You have experience building the right AI infrastructure and supporting the change management required. * **GTM operating model fluency.** You have run GTM operations through a real business model change, ideally consumption\-based, land\-and\-expand, or channel\-augmented. You can set the right metrics framework and put it in place without a long assessment phase. * **Data architecture literacy.** You understand how GTM data is structured and flows across CRM, warehouse, and AI layers well enough to design instrumentation and make build, buy, or connect decisions. You don't need to be an engineer, but you don't depend on one to understand the data model. * **Forecasting authority.** You know ARR forecasting deeply: where each input comes from, how it is calculated, and where it may be wrong. You can reconcile sources and tell executives how confident to be and why. * **Commercial operations depth.** You have hands\-on experience with comp design, territory and quota planning, CPQ and pricing approvals, lead routing, and CRM administration. * **SaaS metrics fluency.** You can connect ARR, GRR, NDR, CAC, pipeline coverage, capacity, and productivity to how the business actually performs. * **Modern data tooling:** working knowledge of SQL, dbt, or BI tools. * **Executive presence.** You can present a difficult conclusion to the ELT without hiding behind the analysis, and push back constructively when the data calls for it. * **Experience.** Typically 10\+ years in revenue operations, GTM operations, or GTM strategy at a growth\-stage B2B SaaS company, including leading a team. **Nice to have** * **Chief of Staff or CEO\-adjacent experience:** translating strategic intent into operating plans, preparing board materials, and managing cross\-functional work without formal authority. * **Channel and partnership operations:** tracking, attribution, and handoffs between partner\-sourced and direct pipeline. * **Usage\- or consumption\-based pricing:** structuring and governing credit\-based deals. Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, Backstory is backed by Y Combinator and Silicon Valley’s top investors, including ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures, and Mubadala Capital. Backstory is listed in the top 20 percent of Inc 5000 companies, is a regular leader in our key categories on G2, and is on the Forbes list of America’s Best Startup Employers. For more information, please visit www.Backstory.ai. \- Regular employees may be eligible for commissions or bonus programs (target included in OTE), equity, and benefits. The range is subject to change. Backstory takes into wide range of factors when determining an individual’s pay. These factors can include, skill set, training and experience, licensure and certifications, and location and metropolitan area. We are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage, please contact askHR@Backstory.ai We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead, Evals and Systems Integration
jobs.description: What Makes Us a Great Place to Work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Who You’ll Work With You will be part of a team building Bain’s integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always\-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top\-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI. You will work inside Bain’s standing product team, building software that helps the world’s largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release. **The platform has two layers working together:** an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient. This is a startup inside an established company. This leader will oversee the Agent Factory, which builds the firm’s AI agents, agentic experiences, and evaluation capabilities, as well as Data \& Intelligence, which builds Compass, the BT Intelligence Platform, including the ontology, knowledge and judgment graphs, and product data estate that power the firm’s agentic solutions. This leader will build and develop the next phase of engineering teams, including forward\-deployed AI engineers, data and knowledge\-graph engineers, machine\-learning engineers, and AI evaluation talent across the U.S. and India. A key responsibility of this role will be leading the deliberate transition of engineering capabilities from expert partners to Baker Tilly teams, establishing the processes, standards, patterns, and internal expertise necessary for the firm to own and scale its AI capabilities over time. This is a player\-coach leadership role requiring both executive\-level engineering leadership and current technical credibility. The VP of AI Engineering will remain close enough to the work to evaluate agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, engineering estimates, and delivery decisions while building the organization and operating model needed to scale. The role will partner closely with Platform \& Production Engineering, Architecture, AI Product Management, Design, subject matter experts, and the India engineering organization to operate as one engineering system. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build and lead an integrated engineering organization across the Agent Factory and Data \& Intelligence, establishing engineering standards, delivery systems, culture, and a consistent talent bar. * Hire, develop, and retain high\-performing engineering teams across the U.S. and India, including forward\-deployed AI engineers, data and knowledge\-graph engineers, machine\-learning engineers, and AI evaluation talent. * Establish and maintain engineering hiring standards and structured selection practices across the organization. * Design and lead a product pod model that brings together U.S. and India engineers, product managers, subject matter experts, and other partners as integrated teams. * Partner with the VP, Engineering – India to grow the India engineering  nition and acceptance criteria into engineering execution, with evaluation results informing product and release decisions. * Partner with Design and subject matter experts to ensure agentic products reflect high\-quality user experiences and practitioner expertise. * Provide leadership and mentorship to the Head of Agent Engineering and Head of Data \& AI Platform and ensure alignment across both engineering pillars. * Serve as a senior engineering and delivery advisor to the CAITO, providing clear visibility into delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and organizational needs. * Represent APG engineering with executive stakeholders and communicate complex engineering topics, trade\-offs, risks, and delivery status clearly and effectively. * Engage in special projects and perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. * 15\+ years of software and product engineering experience, including significant senior leadership experience within product engineering organizations. * Demonstrated experience building an engineering organization from an early or founding stage and successfully delivering AI products through that organization. * Recent hands\-on technical credibility with LLM\-based and agentic systems, with the ability to effectively evaluate agent architectures, evaluation suites, technical approaches, engineering estimates, and trade\-offs. * Strong knowledge of agentic AI product engineering, including LLM systems, evaluation\-gated delivery, context and memory management, and tool use. * Experience with data and knowledge systems, including lakehouse environments, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and evaluation\-driven approaches to retrieval quality. * Deep engineering management expertise, including establishing technical standards, hiring practices, delivery systems, and dependency\-management processes. * Experience leading engineering organizations that build products and services on platforms owned by separate teams, with demonstrated ability to establish effective interfaces and operating models across organizational boundaries. * Experience leading distributed U.S. and India engineering organizations as an integrated engineering system. * Experience leading complex engineering programs across vendors, product teams, partners, and multiple time zones. * Experience working within forward\-deployed, client\-embedded, or partner\-supported engineering models, including transitioning engineering capabilities from external partners to internal teams. * Demonstrated ability to develop internal engineering capabilities, practices, and talent while reducing long\-term reliance on external delivery partners. * Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, and technical considerations clearly and proactively. * Demonstrated ability to use AI and agentic development tools as a force multiplier in engineering and leadership work. * Ability to balance hands\-on technical depth with organizational leadership, talent development, delivery accountability, and executive stakeholder management. * No certifications or licenses required. them more deeply with internal systems. * Architect and build internal API layers and shared services that allow AI workflows and internal applications to publish, version, and retrieve outputs across the engineering ecosystem. * Identify and build AI\-powered tooling that creates leverage across the Corporate IT Engineering stack, including infrastructure, identity, monitoring, and automation platforms. * Develop and iterate on proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how AI can augment or automate internal workflows; from anomaly detection in infrastructure logs to AI\-assisted documentation and IT troubleshooting. * Containerize and orchestrate AI workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring reliable and reproducible deployments across environments. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Ansible, following infrastructure\-as\-code best practices. * Establish AI development patterns and best practices across the Corporate IT Engineering organization, helping teams adopt AI capabilities effectively and responsibly. * Stay current with the evolving AI and MLOps landscape and bring relevant advancements back to the team. **What You Need:** ### **AI \& Application Development** * Hands\-on experience owning or extending LLM\-powered platforms, including RAG pipeline development, prompt engineering, and integrating LLM APIs into production internal systems. * Expert\-level knowledge of AI infrastructure, including model serving, inference optimization, GPU/CPU resource management, and MLOps pipelines. * Experience designing and building internal API layers or shared platform services that multiple teams and systems publish to and consume from. * Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript for building integrations, scripts, and lightweight internal services. * Experience working with REST APIs and building integrations across a diverse internal tooling ecosystem. ### **Cloud \& Infrastructure** * Strong AWS experience: required proficiency in core services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC) and experience architecting and operating production workloads on AWS. * Deep Docker and Kubernetes expertise: required hands\-on experience containerizing applications, writing Dockerfiles, managing multi\-container deployments, and orchestrating workloads with Kubernetes (EKS or self\-managed). * Deep Terraform and Ansible expertise: required experience writing and maintaining Terraform modules for cloud infrastructure, and using Ansible for configuration management and automation. * Experience with GitHub for version control, pull request workflows, branching strategies, and CI/CD integration. * Experience with Artifactory for artifact management, including publishing and consuming build artifacts, Docker images, and package registries. ### **Mindset \& Collaboration** * An experimental mindset: comfortable inheriting imperfect systems, iterating quickly, and improving as you go. * Ability to evaluate AI capabilities through a business lens, understanding not just what's possible but what creates real value for internal teams and the organization. * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain AI concepts and tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. * A collaborative, team\-first approach with a genuine curiosity about where AI is headed. * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. **Bonus Points:** * Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. * Familiarity with corporate IT or infrastructure engineering environments, understanding how enterprise platforms around identity, monitoring, and automation operate. * Background building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or tools that extend AI agent capabilities. * Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) and semantic search. * Experience building or maintaining internal developer platforms, artifact registries, or shared API services. **The Whole Person Promise:** At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well… * 100% company\-paid Medical, Vision, \& Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out\-of\-pocket expenses. * All new hires receive four weeks of PTO. * PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email. * Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges. * "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild. * 90\-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist. Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND. Applicant Privacy Notice

We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future. **Overview** The **Lead AI Engineer, Agentic AI Solutions** will design, build, and deploy AI\-powered solutions that support commercial decision\-making across brand strategy, customer engagement, market access, and analytics. This highly technical individual contributor role combines AI engineering, software development, and business collaboration to create intelligent systems that drive measurable business outcomes while meeting enterprise standards for governance, reliability, and compliance. You will help shape the future of AI within a global healthcare organization, building enterprise\-scale solutions that directly influence business decisions and customer engagement while working with modern AI technologies, cloud platforms, and large\-scale data ecosystems. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate production Applied agents across the commercial process \- brand strategy, customer insights, personalized engagement, and closed\-loop feedback composing foundational agents rather than rebuilding them. * Build performance investigation agents that autonomously decompose brand performance shifts across geography, channel, payer, and eye care professional (ECP) segment, returning sourced, reproducible narratives to brand and insights teams. * Build pre\-call, post\-call, and next\-best\-action / next\-best\-engagement agents that assemble ECP briefs from *Glimpse* (Next Best Action) platform / CRM attach explainable reasoning to every recommendation and write structured data back to CRM. * Build measurement and feedback agents supporting A/B and multivariate test design, readout, and write\-back into the planning loop. * Ground all agents in the enterprise semantic layer and commercial knowledge graph so metric definitions, joins, grain, and row\- and role\-level access are resolved before query generation rather than corrected afterward. * Implement determinism and reproducibility controls, including validate\-then\-lock specification patterns, so any number that drives a targeting, content, or investment decision returns the same result across runs and is fully auditable. * Integrate agents with enterprise systems; *Glimpse* (NBA platform) /Veeva or Salesforce, Adobe and internal commercial platforms using Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent\-to\-agent (A2A) patterns, tool discovery, scoped authentication, and structured outputs. * Build and maintain evaluation harnesses per agent, including golden datasets, calibrated LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression testing, and track agent KPIs covering task completion, grounding, reproducibility, human\-override rate, latency, and cost per task. * Design for bounded autonomy: agents prepare, propose, investigate, summarize, and route, while humans in loop approve claims, privacy\-sensitive actions, and validated\-record changes. * Operate agents in This highly technical individual contributor role focuses on creating trusted semantic models, knowledge graphs, metadata frameworks, and retrieval capabilities that enable accurate, scalable, and compliant AI\-driven insights across the organization. You will help shape the data and knowledge foundation supporting enterprise AI capabilities while collaborating across data engineering, AI, analytics, and business teams to deliver innovative solutions that improve decision\-making and business performance. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain the governed semantic layer for commercial; canonical metric definitions, dimensions, hierarchies, joins, grain, and row\- and role\-level access policy so that agents and BI consume one certified definition rather than reconstructing business logic per query. * Codify commercial metric definitions including TRx, NRx, NBRx, NC TRx, market share and market basket, decile and segment assignment, and projected versus captured volume, capturing source system, calculation, refresh cadence, and known limitations for each, and arbitrate conflicting definitions across brand, field, market access, and finance. * Build constraints that prevent semantically meaningless queries; combinations that are technically joinable but produce misleading results, such as blending projected and actual volumes, mixing incompatible grains, or computing share across non\-comparable sources and enforce them in the layer rather than documenting them and hoping. * Design and extend the commercial ontology and knowledge graph, covering ECP, account, affiliation and parent\-child hierarchy, payer and plan, formulary status, product, territory and alignment, content asset, and engagement, modeling the relationships agents traverse rather than leaving them to be inferred. * Work with enterprise team and apply entity resolution to Semantic definitions across sources used for Agents, reconciling prescriber and account identity across prescription, claims, specialty pharmacy, and CRM feeds, maintaining group practice and affiliation structures, and handling the reality that an eye care professional may be prescriber, account contact, and point of dispense simultaneously. * Maintain taxonomies, controlled vocabularies and synonym and alias mappings so that varied business phrasings resolve onto the same governed concept, and so agents disambiguate consistently across users and brands. * Encode temporal validity for territory realignments, formulary changes, affiliation changes, and segment refreshes, so historical questions return upstream dependency, operating on a shared sprint cadence and being measured in part on the answer accur e model and run enablement so analysts and engineers adopt governed definitions instead of governance, cataloging, lineage, and data observability tools. * Knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements, including HIPAA and FDA promotional regulations. * Experience working in regulated jobs.title: Quality Engineer, AI & Test Automation
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** --------------- * The Quality Engineer, AI \& Test Automation helps modernize BSWH’s quality approach by moving beyond traditional manual testing toward automation\-first, engineering\-integrated, and AI\-enabled quality practices. * This role designs, builds, executes, and maintains automated test suites, validation utilities, evaluation assets, and quality reporting that improve release confidence and speed of delivery across digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled use cases. * The role partners closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data \& Analytics, AI Foundation, Ontology, Security, Privacy, Clinical, Operations, and other delivery teams to define quality expectations early and embed quality practices throughout the development lifecycle. * This role is expected to combine strong testing discipline with technical skills, including automation, API validation, data validation, CI/CD integration, quality metrics, defect triage, and emerging AI\-enabled testing practices. * The Quality Engineer, AI \& Test Automation reports to the Director of Quality Engineering and helps establish reusable practices that support safe, reliable, efficient, and scalable delivery. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE** ----------------------------------- ### **Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy** * Develop test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and quality approaches for software and AI\-enabled capabilities in partnership with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders. * Translate requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, data dependencies, and operational expectations into clear test scenarios and quality validation plans. * Identify quality risks early in the delivery lifecycle and recommend appropriate validation approaches, including automated, manual, exploratory, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, or AI\-specific evaluation methods. * Provide clear release\-readiness input based on test evidence, defect trends, quality metrics, risk assessment, and stakeholder expectations. ### **Test Automation \& Engineering Practices** * Design, build, maintain, and improve automated test suites for API, UI, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, data, and workflow validation. * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows so quality signals are available earlier and more consistently throughout the development lifecycle. * Create reusable test data, utilities, fixtures, scripts, and automation patterns that can be used across multiple teams and products. * Improve test reliability, maintainability, execution time, coverage, and signal\-to\-noise ratio by reducing brittle scripts and eliminating repetitive manual validation where practical. ### **AI\-Enabled Testing \& Evaluation** * Support testing and evaluation of AI\-enabled experiences, including agent workflows, generated responses, retrieval behavior, tool/API calls, escalation paths, guardrail behavior, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Help define evaluation datasets, expected behaviors, failure modes, scoring rubrics, regression scenarios, and quality thresholds for AI\-enabled capabilities. * Use AI\-enabled testing tools where appropriate to generate test cases, analyze logs, triage defects, identify coverage gaps, summarize results, and accelerate quality workflows. * Partner with AI Quality, Architecture, Engineering, and Product teams to validate that AI\-enabled capabilities are useful, reliable, explainable enough for the use case, and aligned to defined quality expectations. ### **Defect Management, Root Cause \& Continuous Improvement** * Identify, document, reproduce, triage, and communicate defects with sufficient technical detail to support efficient resolution by engineering teams. * Analyze defect patterns, escaped defects, quality trends, release issues, and production feedback to identify root causes and improvement opportunities. * Collaborate with engineering teams to improve testability, observability, logging, error handling, and diagnostic capabilities across applications and AI\-enabled workflows. * Contribute to retrospectives, quality reviews, and process improvements that reduce rework, improve release confidence, and increase delivery velocity. ### **Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Release Readiness** * Work closely with Product Managers, Senior AI Product Managers, Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Product Owners, Architects, Designers, Clinical and Operational stakeholders, and vendors/partners to align on quality expectations and release readiness. * Ensure quality criteria are embedded in requirements, design reviews, backlog refinement, development, testing, implementation, and post\-release monitoring. * Support production validation, monitoring handoffs, post\-release assessment, incident follow\-up, and quality reporting for assigned products and use cases. * Communicate quality status, risks, defects, test r pect quality at the end. * Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, evidence, tradeoffs, and release recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort operating in a regulated or high\-trust environment where safety, privacy, security, compliance, auditability, and customer trust are critical. **BENEFITS** Our competitive benefits package includes the following* Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits * 401(k) savings plan with dollar\-for\-dollar match up to 5% * Tuition Reimbursement * PTO accrual beginning Day 1 Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** ------------------------ ### **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related technical field. * Equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience may be considered. ### **Experience** * 5–8\+ years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, SDET, software engineering, AI quality, or related technology delivery roles. * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing automated tests for APIs, web or mobile applications, workflows, data validation, integrations, or end\-to\-end product experiences. * Experience working with engineering teams in agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, or modern product\-delivery environments. * Experience with defect triage, root\-cause analysis, test evidence documentation, release readiness, and quality metrics. * Exposure to AI\-enabled products, machine learning systems, large language models, conversational experiences, agentic workflows, automation, or decision\-support technologies preferred. * Healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated\-industry experience preferred but not required. ### **Required Technical Expertise** * Strong understanding of software testing concepts, including test design, test coverage, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, data validation, exploratory testing, and release validation. * Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, scripting, test data, CI/CD integration, and defect management tools. * Ability to validate APIs, backend services, user interfaces, data flows, workflows, and enterprise integrations. * Programming, scripting, or data analysis skills, preferably Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, SQL, or comparable languages used to build or maintain automated test assets. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled testing and evaluation concepts, including prompt/response validation, model\-output evaluation, RAG or retrieval testing, agent workflow testing, hallucination risk, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Ability to use logs, traces, telemetry, monitoring, dashboards, test artifacts, and production feedback to investigate quality issues. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), Quality Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, Software Quality Engineer, AI Quality Engineer, or similar technically oriented quality role. * Experience building or maintaining automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, PyTest, Postman/Newman, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable frameworks. * Experience testing AI agents, copilots, chatbots, LLM\-powered applications, workflow automation, RAG systems, tool\-calling workflows, or other AI\-enabled capabilities. * Experience creating evaluation suites, golden datasets, scoring rubrics, regression tests, synthetic test data, or quality dashboards for AI\-enabled systems. * Experience with cloud, APIs, microservices, event\-driven systems, data platforms, analytics, observability tools, or modern application architectures. * Experience supporting quality engineering transformation, reducing manual testing dependence, or introducing AI\-enabled testing practices into product teams.
