jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description: **About BizzyCar** BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines. We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. BizzyCar is a fast\-paced, results\-driven company with an experienced leadership team skilled in building high\-value businesses. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture. **About the role** We're hiring a hands\-on Engineering Lead to own one of BizzyCar's engineering pods (spanning areas like API, Web, Mobile, Data, or AI depending on team need) and drive it from daily execution through long\-term roadmap delivery. This is a builder\-manager role: you'll be in Jira and Confluence every day keeping work scoped, linked, and visible; you'll carry direct technical ownership of a core product or feature area end\-to\-end; and you'll represent your team's priorities, risks, and progress to the VP of Engineering and other stakeholders.**This Engineering Lead will run the API, Web, and Mobile business units**, leading the product\-aligned engineering teams across those three areas and owning delivery, priorities, and technical direction for each. You'll work closely with peer Engineering Leads across the org, with Product and Customer Success, and with BizzyCar's VP of Engineering to keep cross\-team dependencies visible and sprint priorities aligned — particularly during team transitions, ownership handoffs, or shifting capacity. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable writing code, running a sprint, and documenting a release. **Responsibilities*** Lead API, Web, and Mobile engineers across four business units, setting technical direction and keeping priorities aligned across all three. * Own your team's day\-to\-day execution: run sprint planning, backlog grooming, and standups, and keep tickets properly scoped, estimated, and unblocked. * Maintain your team's Jira board and keep it correctly linked to the org\-wide Engineering Priorities (EP) board so leadership has accurate, real\-time visibility into status. * Take direct, hands\-on technical ownership of a core product or feature area — from requirements and architecture decisions through code review and deployment. * Partner with the VP of Engineering on team capacity planning, reprioritization, and ownership transfers when scope shifts across teams or team composition changes. * Write and maintain clear release notes and technical documentation in Confluence for every release cycle, and keep runbooks current for your team's systems. * Coordinate cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to surface dependencies early and keep initiatives moving. * Conduct code reviews, move change sets through the deployment pipeline, and participate in on\-call and incident response — including root\-cause analysis and postmortems. * Mentor and develop engineers on your team: give regular feedback, support career growth, and help build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. * Represent your team in engineering leadership syncs and deliver clear, concise status updates to the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other executives. * Identify and drive process or tooling improvements — reporting automation, sprint dashboards, documentation standards — that improve team efficiency and cross\-org visibility. **Must\-Have Qualifications*** Strong, hands\-on production experience with **Ruby** and **Ruby on Rails**. * Strong, hands\-on production experience with **Angular**. * Experience leading engineers across multiple teams or product areas, ideally spanning API, Web, and Mobile. **Preferred Qualifications*** Proven experience leading engineers in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment — as a lead, manager, or senior IC with informal leadership responsibility. * Strong hands\-on technical ability; comfortable writing and reviewing production code, not just managing a roadmap. * Power user of Jira and Confluence: sprint boards, epics, cross\-board linking, and living documentation are second nature to you. * Track record of owning a feature area or product surface end\-to\-end, from scoping through production support. * Excellent written and verbal communication — able to translate technical detail for executives and translate business priorities into engineering tasks. * Experience managing ambiguity: reprioritizing work, absorbing scope from a departing teammate, or realigning a team after a change in leadership or structure. * Comfortable owning incident response and writing clear postmortems that lead to real process change. **Technology*** **Ruby and Ruby on Rails (must\-have)** * **Angular (must\-have)** * JIRA/Confluence power user — experienced managing tickets, sprints, epics, and cross\-team roadmaps. * Solid understanding of Node.js and modern web/API development. * AWS (or equivalent cloud) experience, with the ability to evaluate and recommend technology solutions. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and GitHub\-based code review workflows. * Bonus: experience with AI/LLM\-integrated features or data pipelines is a plus given BizzyCar's growing AI surface area. **Benefits** We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by our competitive compensation and benefits package including paid time off, medical, dental, 401k, vision and equity benefits and future growth opportunities within the company. Plus, we work to maintain the best possible environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where each person feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning and culture. To learn more about our company please visit: www.BizzyCar.com. What We Offer: * Competitive salary $170,000 \+Equity \+ bonus potential * Benefits (medical, dental, vision, PTO) * Opportunities for growth and professional development * Collaborative, innovative work environment with a passionate team * The chance to make an impact in a high\-growth, cutting\-edge company at the forefront of automotive technology *BizzyCar, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits.* *At this time, the company does not provide sponsorship for U.S. visas or immigration benefits, and does not provide financial, legal, or administrative support for employment\-based U.S. immigration benefits. In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, all employees must complete Form I\-9 and present unexpired documents showing they are legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States.*

jobs.title: Aruba Network Engineer
jobs.description: The Network Engineer (Aruba) is responsible for supporting, maintaining, monitoring, documenting, troubleshooting, and optimizing a large\-scale Aruba wireless network infrastructure that provides critical Wi\-Fi services throughout Miami International Airport. This role supports Aruba wireless controllers, 1,000\+ access points, wireless authentication services, management platforms, and related network infrastructure. The Network Engineer serves as a primary technical resource for wireless operations, incident response, problem management, performance optimization, and lifecycle management of the airport's enterprise wireless environment. This role coordinates with network engineering team, service desk, client delivery teams, airport stakeholders, vendors, and third\-party service providers to resolve incidents, implement changes, support projects, and maintain service levels within a 24x7x365 mission\-critical environment. The Technical Support Engineer works closely with leadership and technical teams to ensure wireless network availability, performance, security, and customer satisfaction. **Primary Roles \& Responsibilities** * Provide operational support for a large\-scale Aruba wireless environment consisting of multiple Aruba controllers and more than 1,000 wireless access points deployed throughout Miami International Airport. * Monitor wireless infrastructure, management platforms, alarms, logs, and performance metrics to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or business operations. * Serve as a primary technical resource for troubleshooting wireless connectivity, authentication, roaming, performance, interference, and coverage\-related issues. * Utilize wireless management and monitoring platforms to proactively manage network health, capacity, utilization, and service availability. * Support a 24x7x365 operational environment and effectively communicate ongoing activities, outstanding issues, and maintenance updates during shift transitions and escalation events. * Perform root cause analysis of wireless incidents and develop corrective actions to prevent recurrence. * Coordinate with network engineering teams, airport stakeholders, vendors, and third\-party providers to resolve complex technical issues. * Support configuration, implementation, testing, and validation of wireless infrastructure changes in accordance with established change management procedures. * Assist with the deployment, replacement, expansion, and optimization of Aruba wireless access points, controllers, and related infrastructure. * Analyze wireless network performance, RF utilization, client density, coverage patterns, interference sources, and capacity requirements to recommend improvements. * Support wireless security initiatives, including authentication services, role\-based access controls, encryption standards, guest access solutions, and compliance requirements. * Maintain and update technical documentation including network diagrams, wireless configurations, operating procedures, knowledge articles, and support documentation. * Utilize escalation processes and vendor support resources to resolve critical operational issues and service outages. * Continuously expand knowledge of wireless technologies, networking standards, Aruba product offerings, and industry best practices applicable to large public venue environments. * Support operational readiness activities associated with airport expansion projects, infrastructure upgrades, technology refreshes, and modernization initiatives. * Develop and maintain strong working relationships with airport operational departments, tenants, airlines, and business partners to ensure service expectations are met. * Provide timely communication of incidents, outages, maintenance activities, service impacts, and resolution status to internal and external stakeholders. * Achieve performance objectives and service level commitments established by leadership and customer agreements. * Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, automation, monitoring capabilities, and overall service delivery. * Perform other duties as assigned by management. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities** **Accountability** – Demonstrates ownership of wireless infrastructure performance, availability, and reliability. Takes responsibility for issue resolution and proactively identifies opportunities to improve system stability and operational effectiveness. **Customer Focus** – Maintains a strong service\-oriented approach while supporting business\-critical wireless services for airport personnel, airlines, tenants, operational systems, and public users. Focuses on delivering outstanding customer experiences and service excellence. **Decision Making** – Utilizes technical expertise, operational data, and sound judgment to diagnose issues, prioritize incidents, and implement corrective actions in a fast\-paced environment. **Interpersonal Relationships** – Builds collaborative relationships with internal teams, airport stakeholders, vendor support organizations, and business partners. Communicates effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Problem Solving and Critical Thinking** – Demonstrates advanced troubleshooting skills in identifying and diagnosing wireless network issues involving RF performance, authentication, mobility, client connectivity, network services, and infrastructure dependencies. **Technical Expertise** – Possesses a strong understanding of wireless networking concepts including: * Aruba Wireless LAN solutions * Aruba Controllers and Access Points * Aruba AirWave and/or Aruba Central (preferred) * Aruba ClearPass * 802\.11 Wireless Standards * RF Fundamentals and Spectrum Analysis * WPA2/WPA3 Security * 802\.1X Authentication * DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP * VLANs and Network Segmentation * Routing and Switching Fundamentals * Network Monitoring and Management Systems * Packet Capture and Troubleshooting Tools * Enterprise Network Operations **Education / Experience Requirements** * Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related field preferred. Equivalent work experience may be considered. * Minimum 3\-5 years of experience supporting enterprise wireless and network environments. * Experience supporting Aruba wireless infrastructure, including controllers and large\-scale access point deployments. * Experience troubleshooting enterprise wireless connectivity, authentication, roaming, and RF\-related issues. * Experience supporting mission\-critical or highly available network environments. * Experience utilizing network management, monitoring, and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow or equivalent platforms. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, routing, and switching concepts. * Demonstrated success performing root cause analysis and resolving complex technical issues. * Experience supporting large public venues, transportation facilities, airports, healthcare systems, higher education campuses, or similar enterprise environments preferred. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, Outlook, SharePoint, service management platforms, and cloud\-based technology systems. * Aruba certifications such as ACMA, ACMP, ACSA, or related industry certifications preferred. * CCNP, CCNA, CWNA, Network\+, Security\+, or equivalent networking certifications preferred. **Supervisory Responsibility** This position has no direct reports.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Description:** If you describe yourself as inquisitive, curious, analytical, passionate… And your approach is to work independently, be accurate, adapt to change \& meet deadlines…. And you are “that” person, whose friends and family members say you analyze everything… …then this job could be the right fit for you, so read on… What it is: We're looking for a candidate who has very strong analytical skills, a high attention to detail and is able to manage multiple projects in an ever changing small business environment. This individual must be self\-motivated and driven to excel. The majority of the time your job functions will include implementing and maintaining the day to day data collection processes. These data processes include the systems that load client files as well as the systems that produce reports for our clients. Furthermore, you will execute data analysis projects and prepare written \& graphical summaries and presentations for internal team and clients. Good verbal and written communication skills required. Reports to: Sr. Data Engineer **Technical Skills Required** * Advanced knowledge of Excel; Beginner to Intermediate knowledge of SQL or equivalent multi\-dimensional databases. * Experience using or calling APIs with tools such as Postman * Familiarity with Power BI or any other Business Intelligence tool (MicroStrategy, Looker, Tableau) is a plus * Experience with AWS or Microsoft Azure or other cloud services (S3, Redshift) is a plus * Familiarity with non\-relational databases (MongoDB) is a plus * Familiarity with Snowflake and/or DBT is a plus * Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Gemini) is a plus **Character Qualities You'll Need** * Love numbers, math, formulas and have a basic understanding of statistics. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Able to manage multiple projects and adapt to change * Isolating and resolving all data errors and inconsistencies through root cause analysis and conducting data analysis. * Strong attention to detail * Must be comfortable interacting with persons of diverse backgrounds. * Good verbal and written communication skills * Enjoy collaboration, with a preference for face\-to\-face communication * Be self\-directed and self\-motivated * Have an ability to thrive in a team\-oriented environment * Be a good active listener and communicator **Job requirements:** * Education: Four year bachelor's degree * Experience: 0\-2 years * Travel: None * Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas at this time What to expect in your first year: The first 60 days, you are immersed in an intense learning stage. So, take advantage of one\-on\-one training before you have to fly semi\-solo. You will work closely with three lead Analysts \- first to shadow and learn, and then you will have your own client base. Our products run on a very consistent cycle so once you get past your initial learning curve you will have deadlines to meet as well as ad hoc projects that always surface. Often deadlines are almost on top of each other so you must be able to multi\-task. Your growth opportunities: You’ll learn a lot about our clients’ businesses, best people practices, financial performance metrics, and how to think strategically about business from some very smart and experienced people. We are a fast\-growing company and your contributions as Associate Analyst will empower the growth of the company as well as help you achieve personal success. The ability to discover \& develop your personal niche is available \& encouraged. Training: You’ll be trained primarily by two lead analysts and work closely with them on a day to day basis. You will also learn about our clients’ business and proprietary software, as well as our high level of standards and the company mission. Additional training on our data analytics tool set is available and encouraged. Training around Git, Snowflake, dbt, and how to leverage AI for efficiency will also be provided. Your Team: Our staff has as a committed work ethic and loves to crunch numbers and have fun together; they chat, joke \& tell stories. Relationships are strong. Your co\-workers will probably ask you about your favorite music group, favorite food (In and Out or Whataburger?), pet names, you know, the important things in life! Hours: This position is a salaried, full\-time position. Project/implementation deadlines will dictate your schedule to a large extent. It may take long hours and/or weekends to meet some deadlines. As we mentioned up front, you need to be passionate about what you do. Our Approach: We approach our clients’ businesses from an integrated perspective; their success means our success. And, we’re passionate about our business and our clients’ businesses – really passionate. We keep our clients for a long time and a part of the reason is because we learn the multiple aspects of their business from the inside out, as if it were our own. We are proud of the fact that we move the needle, building best practices and loyalty for our clients, but we know we couldn’t do that if we didn’t get in there and make sure our clients truly “get” it. We strive for zero\-defect in all our work as data integrity, security and quality is the cornerstone of our business. Your Working Environment: Fun and casual. Your team is hard working and focused upon doing great work for the client – but we never forget to have fun in the process. It will be fast paced, and deadline filled, and we all enjoy coming to work… most days. Our Values: Black Box Intelligence™ is a small group of professionals who consider each other family. Our CEO gets a rush out of seeing our employees blossom and grow. We are guided by a set of core values that are more than just a poster on the wall. * One Team \- I am more than my department and will behave as such * Do Good – I will leave it better than I found it * Dream Big – Big visions lead to big results; take risks * Ignite Fire – I am passionate about the restaurant industry and the people in it * Own It – I take ownership and am relentless in my pursuit of excellence * Inspire Trust – Every interaction inspires trust

jobs.title: Principal Applications & Systems Engineer- .NET, PHP & AI
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Black Diamond Pest Control is seeking an experienced, hands\-on **Principal Applications \& Systems Engineer** to develop, maintain, and modernize our internal business applications and supporting technology infrastructure. This is a highly technical position for someone who enjoys writing code, designing applications, managing databases, troubleshooting complex systems, and implementing emerging technologies. Our environment includes custom applications developed in **C\#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Blazor, and PHP**, along with PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, Linux and Windows servers, virtualization, and enterprise networking. We are also actively exploring how artificial intelligence and automation can improve our business operations, customer interactions, reporting, and internal workflows. The successful candidate will help evaluate and integrate these technologies into our existing applications and infrastructure. **This is a hands\-on engineering and development position, not a traditional IT management role.** We want someone who enjoys building and improving technology directly rather than managing teams or delegating technical work. **Key Responsibilities** **Application Development \& Modernization** * Design, develop, maintain, and enhance business\-critical applications using C\#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, and PHP. * Contribute directly to the continued modernization of our internal CRM and operational applications. * Develop modern web applications using Blazor and related .NET technologies. * Maintain and enhance existing PHP applications, including Linux\-hosted web applications. * Design and develop REST APIs, background services, and integrations between internal and third\-party systems. * Refactor and improve existing application code to increase performance, security, reliability, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot complex application issues across frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure layers. * Participate in application architecture, code reviews, testing, and deployment processes. * Develop scripts, utilities, and automated processes to reduce repetitive work. **Database Engineering \& Optimization** * Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database\-driven application functionality. * Work extensively with PostgreSQL and MySQL databases. * Diagnose and resolve database performance, indexing, locking, and connectivity issues. * Support database architecture, maintenance, backup, recovery, and reliability. * Improve application and database performance through effective design and troubleshooting. **Infrastructure \& Systems Engineering** * Administer and troubleshoot Linux and Windows server environments. * Support virtualized infrastructure, preferably using KVM or comparable technologies. * Maintain application hosting environments, including web servers, reverse proxies, and associated services. * Troubleshoot networking, firewalls, routing, DNS, storage, and system security issues. * Maintain and improve backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, and business continuity systems. * Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting and other appropriate technologies. * Ensure reliable and secure operation of production applications and supporting systems. **Artificial Intelligence \& Automation** * Identify practical opportunities to integrate AI into existing business applications and processes. * Develop and implement AI\-powered features using commercial or locally hosted large language models (LLMs). * Integrate AI services and APIs with .NET and PHP applications. * Explore applications involving conversational AI, speech\-to\-text, intelligent search, document processing, and workflow automation. * Evaluate AI solutions for customer service, contact center operations, scheduling, reporting, and operational efficiency. * Investigate AI\-assisted infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting capabilities. * Evaluate new AI technologies for performance, security, reliability, and measurable business value. * Prior professional AI experience is preferred but not required. Strong programming skills, technical curiosity, and the ability to learn and implement emerging technologies are more important. **Technical Ownership \& Problem Solving** * Take ownership of technical projects from initial concept through development, deployment, and ongoing support. * Independently diagnose and resolve complex issues spanning applications, databases, and infrastructure. * Work directly with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and develop effective solutions. * Recommend improvements to application architecture, system reliability, and development practices. * Evaluate new technologies and determine their suitability for our business environment. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional, hands\-on software development and/or systems engineering experience, including substantial application development experience. * Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET Core / ASP.NET Core development. * Practical experience developing, maintaining, or enhancing PHP applications. * Experience designing and developing web applications, REST APIs, and database\-driven business systems. * Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or comparable relational databases. * Experience with Linux server administration and troubleshooting. * Understanding of web application hosting, networking, security, and production environments. * Experience with Git or comparable source control systems. * Ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and troubleshoot production applications. * Strong analytical skills and a demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Blazor Server or other modern .NET web frameworks. * Experience with modern .NET application architecture and legacy application modernization. * Strong PHP and LAMP stack development experience. * Experience with Dapper or other .NET data access technologies. * Experience with PostgreSQL and MySQL database administration and performance tuning. * Experience with KVM, VMware, Hyper\-V, or other virtualization platforms. * Familiarity with Nginx, Apache, IIS, Docker, and reverse proxies. * Experience with Linux scripting, infrastructure automation, and monitoring. * Experience integrating third\-party APIs, telephony systems, or contact center platforms. * Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, or other cloud\-based and locally hosted AI technologies. * Experience building AI integrations, intelligent automation, or LLM\-powered applications. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

**evaluation, monitoring, and feedback systems** to continuously improve AI quality, reliability, and performance * Work across models, prompts, tools, retrieval systems, and application infrastructure to solve real\-world product problems * Move quickly from emerging AI capabilities to **production\-ready experiences that deliver measurable value** * Collaborate closely with clinicians and engineers to understand complex healthcare workflows and determine where AI can have the greatest impact **You'll thrive here if you:** ============================== * Have a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field * Have **2\+ years of professional software engineering experience** outperforming in high\-quality environments * comfortable moving across the stack and quickly experimenting with new models, frameworks, and techniques * Love autonomy, ambiguity, experimentation, and ownership * Are **authorized to work in the U.S.** and excited to be **in\-person in NYC** 5 days a week **Benefits:** ============= * Competitive salary, equity, growth opportunities * Best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision insurance * A focus on outcomes, not hours, with unlimited PTO * Team outings, offsites, and a sunny NYC office stocked with snacks Compensation Range: $150K \- $220K

jobs.description: Location: Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29312 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: October 20th 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. conversion, deployment, and integration workflows. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with quantization\-aware training, post\-training quantization, mixed\-precision inference, structured or unstructured pruning, operator replacement, or hardware\-aware model optimization. * vendor\-specific SDKs. * Understanding of deployment and performance metrics such as latency, memory footprint, model size, MACs, memory bandwidth, and power consumption. * Experience with audio ML, documentation analysis, structured data extraction, failure diagnosis, benchmark analysis, or optimization recommendations. * Experience building or evaluating AI\-assisted tools that improve ML development, deployment, debugging, or engineering productivity. * Curiosity about the interaction between machine learning models, software toolchains, and hardware platforms. \#LI\-Hybrid At Bose, jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. Shield's mission is to secure enterprise content while delivering a seamless user experience, ensuring Box remains the platform of choice for secure Intelligent Content Management. Shield keeps customer content safe by surfacing malware, compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior early, giving administrators the context they need to take proactive action before incidents escalate. The Shield team is hiring Machine Learning engineers to build and scale ML systems that safeguard millions of users and billions of files from ransomware, data exfiltration, insider threats, and emerging AI\-based attacks. As part of a fast\-paced backend/core team, you'll collaborate across Box to ship future\-proof security capabilities for high\-demand use cases. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Build Threat Detection Models: Design, train, and deploy ML models for ransomware detection, suspicious session identification, and user behavior analytics * Scale Data Pipelines: Own end\-to\-end ML pipelines that process high\-volume security event streams using Apache Spark, GCP Dataflow, and Vertex AI * Feature Engineering: Create and maintain feature stores that power real\-time and batch anomaly detection systems * Production ML Systems: Deploy, monitor, and iterate on ML models in production, serving enterprise customers at scale * Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with Platform, Application Engineering, and Product teams to translate security requirements into ML solutions * Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. **Must Have Experience** * 3\+ years of experience in applied machine learning * Strong programming skills in Python * Deployed and maintained ML models serving real traffic * Experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow) or equivalent (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML) * Deep understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and MLOps * Strong communication skills with ability to explain complex ML concepts to non\-technical stakeholders **Nice To Have Experience** * Experience in security/threat detection, anomaly detection, or fraud detection * Experience with sequential data, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling (time\-series forecasting, LSTM, Transformers, or similar) * Knowledge of LLMs and AI safety (prompt injection, guardrails, red\-teaming) * Experience with streaming/real\-time ML systems * Familiarity with Java for service integrations * Publications or contributions in ML security **Tech Stack You'll Work With** * Languages: Python, Scala, Java * ML/Data: Apache Spark, Vertex AI, BigQuery, TensorFlow/PyTorch * Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes * Domains: User Behavior Analytics, Time\-Series Anomaly Detection, AI Security, Content classification, Ransomware Detection Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Hybrid Austin, TX:** *The role requires a mix of days in CDK's Austin, TX office and can be worked remotely on the remaining days. The Company’s cloud\-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end\-to\-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance. ***Modern AI\-Based Product Development*** **About the Role** : We're hiring early\-career engineers to build the next generation of automotive retail software — the platforms dealerships use to sell, finance, and service vehicles, and consumers use to shop for and buy their cars. You'll develop software the way the industry is heading: partnering with advanced AI systems to design, build, test, and ship production code, with you as the engineer of record. You'll start with AI\-accelerated coding and progress toward delegating substantial development tasks to AI under your direction — specifying problems precisely, decomposing work, and rigorously verifying the output. We believe engineers who learn this way from day one will become the strongest AI\-era engineers in the industry, and we're investing accordingly: structured mentorship, a defined progression path, and real production ownership early. Because our software runs dealership businesses and consumer purchases, the bar is high: velocity and quality, security designed in, lean code rather than AI\-generated bloat, and disciplined AI cost management. This role is for someone with strong fundamentals, high curiosity, and the discipline to verify everything. **Responsibilities \& Essential Functions:** * Build and ship production software using modern AI\-based development workflows, progressing from AI\-accelerated coding to delegating well\-scoped tasks to advanced AI systems * Write precise specifications, technical plans, and acceptance criteria that humans and AI systems can execute against * Own the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship — rigorously review, test, and validate all AI\-generated code, and never expose credentials, customer data, or proprietary code to unapproved tools * Keep codebases lean: resist AI\-generated bloat, unnecessary dependencies, and over\-engineering so today's velocity doesn't become tomorrow's technical debt * Use AI development resources cost\-effectively, treating compute and tooling spend as an engineering constraint to optimize * Develop deep expertise in automotive retail — how dealerships operate and how consumers buy — the domain context that makes your direction of AI systems effective * Solve problems of moderate scope with increasing independence and sound technical judgment * Experiment with and share new AI development techniques and workflow improvements with your team * Plan and prioritize your own work with decreasing need for day\-to\-day direction; jobs.description: ***Title:*** Cybersecurity and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer ***Location:*** The position will be based in Princeton, N.J. (currently hybrid) 2\-3 days per week in the office with occasional travel to CHDI’s other offices. **Must be local to Princeton NJ to be considered.** ***Reports To:*** Director, Information Technology ***Salary Range:*** $120,000 – $180,000\. Exact compensation will vary based on experience ***Other:*** Vaccination against COVID\-19 is a prerequisite for employment at CHDI Management ***About CHDI Foundation, Inc.*** CHDI Foundation, Inc. is a privately funded nonprofit biomedical research organization exclusively dedicated to collaboratively developing therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease (HD). Our scientists work closely with a network of more than 700 researchers in academic and industrial laboratories around the world in the pursuit of these novel therapies, providing strategic scientific direction to ensure that our common goals remain in focus. This helps bridge the translational gap that often exists between academic and industrial research pursuits and that adds costly delays to therapy development. In its role as a collaborative enabler, CHDI seeks to bring the right partners together to identify and address critical scientific issues and move drug candidates to clinical evaluation as rapidly as possible. Our activities extend from exploratory biology to the identification and validation of therapeutic targets, and from drug discovery and development to clinical studies and trials. More information about CHDI can be found at www.chdifoundation.org. ***Job Description:*** CHDI Management is seeking an experienced and proactive Cybersecurity and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to manage and protect the organization’s data assets, cloud infrastructure, and technology systems. This individual will serve as the internal subject matter expert on cybersecurity, responsible for identifying and remediating vulnerabilities, governing identity and access across cloud platforms, and ensuring that CHDI’s security posture keeps pace with an evolving threat landscape. This role carries both operational and strategic responsibilities. Day\-to\-day, the individual will monitor and respond to security events, manage vulnerability and penetration testing programs, and administer cloud security controls across platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365\. Looking forward, this individual will play a key role in securing emerging AI infrastructure, including AWS Bedrock and related services as CHDI expands its use of artificial intelligence in research and operations. Reporting to the Director, Information Technology, the Cybersecurity and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will collaborate closely with IT, researchers, the Data Protection Officer (DPO), Data Manager, and end users to embed security best practices across the organization and ensure that all systems, accounts, and data remain protected. The successful candidate will: **Organization Cybersecurity*** Lead the organization’s vulnerability management program, including continuous scanning, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of identified vulnerabilities across endpoints, servers, cloud workloads, and applications. * Manage scheduled penetration testing engagements, including vendor selection and scoping, coordinating testing activities, reviewing findings, and driving remediation efforts to completion. * Develop and maintain a formal remediation tracking process and develop appropriate SOPs, working cross\-functionally with IT and application owners to ensure timely resolution of critical and high\-severity findings. * Produce clear, actionable reports on vulnerability status and remediation progress for IT leadership and organizational stakeholders. * Stay current on emerging threats, CVEs (Common Vulnerability and Exposures), and security advisories; assess organizational exposure and initiate appropriate response actions. * Manage security posture management (SPM), including Data and Cloud, tooling and ensuring findings are reviewed and addressed on a timely basis. * Monitor and respond to security events, alerts, and incidents across endpoints, cloud services, email, and network systems, maintaining documentation of investigations and remediation actions. * Manage data loss prevention (DLP) policies, information protection labels, and data classification frameworks to safeguard sensitive organizational and research data. * Administer email security controls including anti\-phishing, anti\-malware, and DMARC/DKIM/SPF configurations; investigate and respond to phishing reports and suspicious account activity. * Maintain and test the organization’s incident response plan; lead or support incident response activities in the event of a security breach or data loss event. * Develop and deliver security awareness content and communications to help staff recognize DPO and Data Manager providing appropriate access to cloud\-based assets. * Manage multi\-factor authentication (MFA), conditional access policies, and privileged identity management (PIM) configurations to protect against unauthorized access. * Conduct periodic access reviews and entitlement certifications, working with department heads to validate that user permissions remain appropriate and aligned with job function. * Oversee the join/move/leave process from a security perspective, ensuring timely provisioning and de\-provisioning of access across all systems and platforms. ***Qualifications:**** Minimum 5 years of experience in an information security or cloud security engineering role. * Demonstrated experience managing vulnerability management programs, including scanning tools (e.g., Tenable, Qualys) and remediation workflows. * Hands\-on experience managing and securing cloud environments in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including IAM, security groups, logging, and monitoring configurations. * Experience managing identity and access management platforms including AWS IAM and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including conditional access and privileged identity management. * Familiarity with AI platform security considerations, including access governance and data handling for services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent. * Experience coordinating penetration testing engagements with third\-party vendors and driving remediation of findings. * Strong understanding of security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, or SOC 2\. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex security concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the organization. * Ability to self\-initiate, manage competing priorities, and respond decisively under pressure. ***Preferred Qualifications:**** Experience implementing or operating a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or equivalent). * Familiarity with zero\-trust architecture principles and implementation. * Experience with Microsoft Purview for data governance, compliance, and information protection. * Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to support security operations and tooling. * Knowledge of data privacy regulations and compliance frameworks relevant to research organizations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, FISMA). * Experience in a non\-profit, research, or life sciences organization. * Familiarity with ITIL best practices and IT service management frameworks. ***Education / Certifications:**** A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required. One or more of the following certifications are strongly preferred: * Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) * Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) * AWS Certified Security – Specialty * Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\) * Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\) * CompTIA Security\+ or CySA\+ * Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN) (preferred, not required) ***About CHDI Foundation, Inc.*** CHDI Foundation is a private nonprofit biomedical research organization exclusively dedicated to collaboratively developing therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease (HD). ***About CHDI Management, Inc.*** Our staff works for CHDI Management, Inc., which was established in 2002 to provide administrative and management services to CHDI Foundation, Inc. ***About our Donors*** CHDI’s activities focus solely on the collaborative development of therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease. We are indebted to our donors, whose generosity and guidance have made possible this exclusive focus on science. QZRV0j64hV

Approximately two\-thirds of the position focuses on applied data science, machine learning, Generative AI, experimentation, and AI evaluation, while one\-third focuses on software engineering, platform integration, API development, and production implementation. jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e\-STORAGE!** ------------------------------------------------- **Who We Are** -------------- Welcome to e\-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility\-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone. With our innovative SolBank lithium\-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide. **Position Title:** Technical Solutions Engineer **Department:** Technical Solutions **Compensation:** $85,000 \- $135,000 \+ annual bonus (range varies depending on location; paid in local currency) **Reports To:** Technical Solutions Manager **Location:** Remote – Canada or USA **About the Role:** The Technical Solutions Engineer will play a key role in supporting the development, evaluation, and integration of utility\-scale energy storage systems (ESS) with a focus on battery technology and performance in integrated systems. This role supports both internal product development and external solution customization, ensuring seamless operation and coordination between the Battery Product, Inverters, EMS and grid interface. This position requires deep fluency in battery cell and pack\-level degradation mechanisms, the ability to translate degradation curve behavior into commercial and contractual strategy (warranties, guarantees, storage/charging requirements), and the judgment to drive design and process improvements back into the product roadmap. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building degradation models in Excel/Python, defending assumptions in front of an Independent Engineer, and sitting across the table from R\&D to push for a design change. This role supports both internal product development and external solution customization. For internally developed solutions, the engineer will work closely with R\&D, global engineering to provide direct input on design features, validation strategies, and system sizing requirements. For externally procured products, the focus will be on leading technical due diligence, ensuring standards compliance, and transferring product knowledge to internal engineering, applications, and execution teams. **Responsibilities:** **Technical Due Diligence and Product Development** * Lead the technical review of new battery cells and sub\-components being evaluated for integration into our solutions, including specs, drawings, sizing, certifications, and test results. * Work closely with procurement, product management, and R\&D teams to support alignment between product design, supplier capabilities, and commercial rollout. * For internally developed products: collaborate with R\&D and technical teams to support design development, interface definition, validation testing, and product roadmap alignment. * For externally sourced products: lead evaluation of technical specifications, certifications, and performance claims; ensure alignment with internal architecture and support cross\-functional knowledge transfer. * Maintain traceability of vendor/product documentation, internal evaluations, and solutions status through internal tools and documentation systems. * Oversee the development and enhancement of internal engineering tools to support system modeling, product validation, and solution optimization efforts. * Support Independent Engineer (IE) reviews and customer\-led technical due diligence by preparing documentation packages, addressing compliance concerns, and representing internal design rationale. * Monitor and interpret evolving product standards, test requirements, and performance expectations relevant to battery and energy solutions — including UL, IEEE, IEC, and other applicable regional or application\-specific standards — and ensure alignment across internal designs and documentation. **Battery Performance \& Degradation Strategy** * Own and evolve degradation modeling methodology and strategy in externally facing degradation curves for product and system warranties. * Maintain and improve internal degradation and throughput tools (capacity models, throughput analysis, duty cycle tools etc.) ensuring accuracy across models, chemistries, and climate conditions. * Serve as the primary technical liaison between project and performance engineering and R\&D, feeding field/factory degradation insights and failure trends back into cell selection, thermal management, and DC Block design decisions. * Monitor and interpret emerging battery chemistries and design (e.g., winding/stacking, blade cells, sodium\-ion) for their degradation, safety, and warranty implications, and assess their fit against existing performance guarantee structures. **Cross\-functional Support and Customization** alifications and Skills:** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, materials science, electrochemistry, or a related discipline; preference given to candidates with a postgraduate degree in engineering. * Minimum 5 years of experience in engineering, R\&D, or product management within battery storage, battery cell development, or related industries. * **Direct experience in battery product development, cell testing, or energy storage applications is strongly preferred.** * **Strong knowledge of LFP battery cells, DC Blocks, and Energy Storage Systems** * Familiarity with key standards and certifications related to batteries and ESS products, including UL 9540, UL9540A, UL 1973, UN 38\.3, IEC 62933, IEC 62619, and other applicable codes or testing standards. * Experience collaborating with international partners, particularly engineering or manufacturing teams across global time zones. * Demonstrated ability to lead or contribute to the development of internal engineering tools, system models, or automation processes. * Strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, with a hands\-on approach to product validation and integration. * Proficiency in Mandarin is a plus but not required. **Key Competencies** * Ability to collaborate effectively across diverse, cross\-functional teams and international time zones. * Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions across internal teams and represent engineering topics in customer or Independent Engineer (IE) reviews — particularly in coordination with R\&D counterparts across Asia, North America, and Europe. * Experience with product onboarding, technical documentation review, and vendor qualification processes is highly desirable. * Excellent organizational skills, and clear written and verbal communication across global teams. * Flexibility to travel, including international travel as required (up to 15%) for vendor assessments, integration testing, and industry events. *e\-STORAGE is Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.* *e\-STORAGE uses AI\-assisted tools during parts of the hiring process, including screening and workflow automation. All final hiring decisions are made by humans.* *This is a current vacancy, and we are actively hiring for this position.* **What It’s Like to Work Here** ------------------------------- At e\-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find: * Integrity: We do what’s right, always. * Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas. * Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time. * Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver. * Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations. **Why You’ll Love Working With Us** ----------------------------------- * Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience. * Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world. * Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority. * Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package. **Want to join here is what we are looking For** ------------------------------------------------ * The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role. * Great communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving abilities. * A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability. **Your Rewards** ---------------- We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more. \#CSeSTORAGE

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** The next generation of independent cardiology is being built here. CardioOne is a physician\-led, technology\-driven cardiology platform built to empower independent practices to compete, and win, in a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape. Our mission is to provide cardiologists with the tools, infrastructure, and expertise they need to thrive while maintaining full clinical independence. We believe the best care is delivered by physicians who are empowered \- not constrained \- by the systems around them. We combine a deep bench of healthcare operators with purpose\-built technology and AI\-enabled solutions across operations, revenue cycle, imaging, and practice development. From real estate and advanced imaging to clinical workflows and data infrastructure, CardioOne delivers a fully integrated platform designed to drive growth, efficiency, and superior patient outcomes. Backed by WindRose Health Investors and leading healthcare executives, CardioOne is building one of the most sophisticated and scalable cardiology MSOs in the country \- designed to reimagine what is possible for independent cardiology. **About the Role** CardioOne is seeking a hands\-on Systems Engineer to implement and support the technology foundation for our cardiology practices. This role works with internal teams, practice leaders, construction and low\-voltage vendors, application teams, and remote MSP partners to complete infrastructure deployments from site preparation through go\-live and ongoing support. The ideal candidate is an organized, service\-oriented technical professional who follows defined standards, communicates clearly, documents work thoroughly, and resolves issues efficiently. The Systems Engineer will execute the setup, deployment, and operational support of IT infrastructure for new and existing cardiology practices. Beginning during the site\-build phase, this role will work from established standards and project plans to coordinate network drops; install and configure network equipment, firewalls, hardware, and endpoints; and establish secure connectivity across on\-premises and cloud environments. The engineer will support VPNs, virtual desktops, servers, and application connections; troubleshoot network, endpoint, software installation, and connectivity issues onsite and remotely; collaborate closely with remote managed service providers (MSPs) and other vendors; and help transition each practice to sustainable self\-service through clear playbooks, knowledge articles, and user documentation. **What you'll do:** * **Site implementation support:** Participate during the site\-build stage, confirm network\-drop and equipment\-room requirements against approved plans, track implementation dependencies, and coordinate onsite work with construction and low\-voltage partners. * **Network deployment:** Install, configure, test, and document wired and wireless networks, switches, access points, firewalls, circuits, racks, power protection, and related infrastructure using CardioOne standards. * **Hardware and endpoint setup:** Coordinate approved equipment orders and image, configure, deploy, and maintain workstations, laptops, monitors, printers, scanners, and other practice devices. * **Server and cloud connectivity:** Install, configure, test, and support on\-premises and cloud\-hosted servers and services to enable secure data exchange and reliable application access. * **Secure access support:** Configure and support firewalls, network segmentation, VPNs, virtual desktop environments, identity and access controls, endpoint security, and secure remote access according to approved designs and policies. * **MSP and vendor coordination:** Work effectively with remote managed service providers and technology vendors to open and manage tickets, provide access and diagnostic information, coordinate work across time zones, validate completed changes, escalate unresolved issues, and maintain clear ownership through resolution. * **Application troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve software installation, connectivity, interface, authentication, and data\-transfer issues across clinical, business, and third\-party applications. * **Go\-live execution:** Complete assigned readiness tasks, test configurations, document issues, coordinate dependencies, and provide onsite technical support during installations and practice launches. * **Operational support:** Provide responsive onsite and remote support for network, endpoint, server, peripheral, and application issues; document troubleshooting steps and escalate complex incidents appropriately. * **Routine administration:** Maintain inventories, configurations, patching, backups, monitoring alerts, access records, and other assigned operational controls. * **Documentation and self\-service:** Create and maintain build checklists, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and end\-user instructions that support consistent deployments and practice self\-service after the initial support period. **What you'll need:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in systems, network, infrastructure, or IT support roles, preferably supporting multiple locations. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, wireless networking, network segmentation, and structured troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience configuring or supporting firewalls, VPNs, virtual desktop technologies, servers, cloud services, endpoint platforms, and remote\-management tools. * Experience deploying and supporting Windows\-based environments, identity and access solutions, endpoint security, patching, backup, and monitoring tools. * Demonstrated ability to follow technical designs and implementation standards, execute deployment checklists, test completed work, and maintain accurate documentation. * Experience collaborating with remote MSPs or outsourced service providers, including ticket management, troubleshooting coordination, escalation, follow\-through, and validation of completed work. * Strong customer service, troubleshooting, documentation, organization, and communication skills. * Ability to manage assigned priorities, respond effectively during incidents, and travel to practice locations as needed. **Preferred:** * Experience supporting healthcare delivery organizations, physician practices, ambulatory clinics, or other regulated environments. * Familiarity with healthcare applications, medical devices, imaging workflows, secure interfaces, and data exchange between clinical systems. * Working knowledge of HIPAA\-aligned security practices, risk management, least\-privilege access, auditability, and protection of sensitive health information. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, virtualization platforms, and common enterprise networking and security technologies. * Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, Fortinet, CompTIA, VMware, or equivalent. **What Success Looks Like** * Assigned site\-readiness and deployment tasks are completed accurately and on schedule. * Installations follow approved standards, checklists, and security requirements. * Network, endpoint, and application issues are documented, resolved promptly, or escalated with complete diagnostic information. * Remote MSPs and vendors receive clear information, remain accountable for assigned work, and complete changes that are tested and validated. * Practice teams have current instructions and clear escalation paths following go\-live. **Work Expectations** This role requires a combination of remote engineering and onsite implementation and support. Travel to CardioOne practice locations and occasional work outside standard business hours may be required for site launches, maintenance windows, or critical incidents. Office locations: Naperville, Hinsdale, Elmhurst, Yorkville, Plainfield, and others. **Additional Information** This is a full time position with a salary range of $95,000–$115,000 annually, plus a comprehensive benefits package (12 days paid time off, 8 paid federal holidays) that includes health insurance and a matching 401K.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: **Looking for a job to get you out of bed?** We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our Quality Engineering team and own functional and end‑to‑end testing across our systems. We want someone genuinely passionate about testing \- eager to hunt down the bug nobody else found, think outside the box, and take real ownership and accountability for the quality of what ships. You'll report directly to the QA Manager and help ensure consistent, reliable quality across our systems. Casper (Casper.com) believes everyone should sleep better. That’s why we obsess over designing sleep products that actually make a difference—from the littlest dreamers and beyond. Including mattresses, pillows, and bedding, our entire collection is dreamed up and engineered in\-house by our product and design teams. Sleepers can shop online, visit one of our 40\+ retail locations across the United States, or find us through a growing network of trusted retail partners. This is a **hybrid** role, requiring that you work 4 days per week from our **Richmond, VA** office. **When youʼre not catching zzzʼs, this is what youʼll do...** * **Design and execute functional and end‑to‑end test cases** across web and back‑end systems, covering happy paths, edge cases, and negative scenarios * **Own test planning** for features and releases \- clear, traceable test plans and test cases tied to requirements * **Perform exploratory testing** to surface issues that scripted cases miss * **Validate complex, cross‑system workflows** across multiple interconnected platforms * **Test and validate workflows across SaaS applications** commonly used in e‑commerce, Shopify, OMS, Salesforce, and ERP environments * **Detect, isolate, reproduce, and document defects** with clarity and insight * **Contribute to our existing Playwright \+ TypeScript automation framework**, starting with the most repetitive or highest‑risk manual cases * **Write and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and TypeScript**, following our existing Page Object Model patterns * **Get hands\-on with our automation suite** — running, debugging, and extending existing Playwright tests as you build up your automation skill set * **Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and stakeholders** to understand requirements and ensure proper test coverage * **Write documentation** for test cases and workflows to support long‑term scalability * **Provide regular updates to the QA Manager** on progress, risks, and opportunities for improvement **Our dream candidate is/has…** * Strong in functional and end‑to‑end testing, with some hands‑on exposure to automation using Playwright and TypeScript * Experience testing an e‑commerce or SaaS product \- you understand order lifecycles, payment or fulfillment flows, and how integrations between systems break in non‑obvious ways * Strong test case design and bug reporting skills \- clear repro steps, good judgment on severity and priority * A creative problem‑solver who thinks outside the box \- not satisfied testing only what's written in the ticket * Organized \- able to juggle multiple test cycles and keep documentation current without letting anything slip * Passionate about testing \- you find real satisfaction in catching the thing nobody else caught, and it shows * Comfortable with bug/task/test management tools such as JIRA and Coda * Comfortable working across multiple interconnected systems and validating end‑to‑end workflows * A clear communicator who collaborates closely with engineering, product, and DevOps **Nice to have…** * Experience with API testing tools such as Postman * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them * Familiarity with AWS resources * Familiarity with AI‑driven workflows and tools like Copilot, Claude, Kiro, and Amazon Q Developer * B.S. in Computer Science or a related field Targeted Annual Base Salary Range: $90,000\-110,000 USD Casper’s compensation philosophy ensures that the actual base salary is based on factors including but not limited to skills, education, experience, special training, time in position, and/or years of service. We recognize that annual base salary is just one part of a total rewards package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, wellbeing resources, and other perks including: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance to help you with those coughs or cavities (too many waffles)... * Paid Time Off. We believe in the power of rest so take the time you need to recharge. * Employee Discount to use on whatever you like (with a few exceptions) and product discounts for friends and family! * Dreaming of your next degree? After one year of service, we’ll help make that dream a little easier with tuition reimbursement. * … and more! If you dream about this stuff this job is probably right for you. We look forward to learning more about you! *Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer\-sponsored visa support.* *As part of our hiring process, employment offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, where permitted by law.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/22/2026Meet the Team The Cisco IT AI Infrastructure team delivers high\-performance compute (HPC) and accelerated AI infrastructure as a service across Cisco's global enterprise footprint. We provide foundational supercomputing platforms that empower engineering, research, security, and product teams. Our organization architects, builds, and operates the enterprise\-grade supercomputing infrastructure that powers Cisco’s foundational models, distributed AI training, inference engines, and machine learning platforms. Your Impact As an AI Infrastructure Technical System Engineer and Technical Leader, you will serve as the principal systems architect and technical authority for our enterprise AI platforms. You will establish architectural direction, spearhead complex infrastructure initiatives, mentor engineering talent, and bridge accelerated hardware capabilities with high\-performance software execution. You will collaborate with a global multi\-disciplinary team, interfacing regularly with internal AI Researchers, Cisco Hardware\& Network Architecture Teams, and Industry Ecosystem Partners (NVIDIA, AMD, Red Hat) to engineer and operate a cutting\-edge, large\-scale AI technology stack. Key Responsibilities Architecture, Strategy\& Capacity Engineering * Lead the architectural design, hardware qualification, capacity planning, and maintenance of large\-scale bare\-metal GPU clusters (NVIDIA/AMD). * Architect resilient, multi\-tenant compute and control planes across bare\-metal Kubernetes, enterprise container platforms (Red Hat OpenShift), and HPC cluster managers (NVIDIA BCM). * Collaborate with network engineering to design, benchmark, and optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency backend fabrics (RDMA, RoCEv2, 400G/800G). Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps\& SRE Automation * Champion Site Reliability Engineering to eliminate operational toil, drive autonomous self\-healing, and uphold stringent Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Architect IaC and GitOps deployment pipelines using Ansible, Terraform, Python, Go, and modern CI/CD tooling. * Oversee automated workflows for firmware baselines, BIOS/BMC configuration, kernel driver updates, platform upgrades, and certificate rotations.
