jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, Platform Engineering **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** The CloudBees platform is the foundation everything else is built on. When it works well, engineers ship faster, customers trust us more, and the product compounds. When it doesn't, every team feels it. This is that team — and the future of the platform depends on you. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Platform Engineering team, developing microservices using Go and running in AWS. You will be directing, leading, and contributing to build and operate the platform. You bring deep back\-end engineering expertise and, just as importantly, a product mindset — you understand that “platform is a product”, and that the quality of your work defines what we can build and what our customers will experience. You are excited about the future of software development with coding agents, and you have full\-embraced agentic AI for doing your everyday work. You ship production\-quality code, you design resilient systems that outlast you, and you have the judgment to know when to optimize for speed and when to optimize for correctness. You are fluent in the tradeoffs of distributed systems, curious about how the platform affects the full software delivery lifecycle, and you are committed to leaving things better than you found them. Requirements: **What You'll Do** Own the Platform Foundation: * Understand the existing platform code and architecture, forming a strong, evidence\-based opinion on its strengths, its weaknesses, and what to do about them. * Define the technical roadmap with measurable goals and sequence the work to deliver incremental value. * Write the hardest code yourself. Own the critical\-path refactors, the performance work, and the stability fixes. Bring the Team with You: * Earn the trust of an established team. Listen first, then show your reasoning and let the code make the case. * Guide teams through execution by setting direction, defining standards, and unblocking the hard problems. * Lead design reviews and code reviews with rigor and honesty. Make Quality the Default: * Establish development practices that hold up as the team and platform evolve: testing, interfaces, service boundaries, and release discipline. * Drive observability (metrics, structured logs, tracing) and use it to find root causes. * Write down architecture decisions and the reasoning behind them for the next evolution to learn and improve upon.. **You May Be a Good Fit If** * You have 12\+ years of relevant experience as a founding, principal, or staff engineer. * You have built and operated a complex microservices platform in production, and can explain what broke, why, and what you did about it. * You have extensive distributed\-systems experience, including concurrency, event\-driven architectures, message buses, and their failure modes. * You have taken over a complex codebase and measurably made it better. * You still contribute code that ships to production every week. **Your Mindset** * You think like a technical founder. You own outcomes for the whole system, not just your piece. * You have high emotional intelligence. You can critique a design without making it personal, and you change your mind when the data tells you to. * You prefer simple solutions to clever ones. * **Customer Obsessed** — You treat customer problems as your own and build relationships with the people behind the logo, not just the account. You can point to decisions you changed because of what a customer told you. * **High Agency** — You own problems beyond your job description and move without waiting to be asked. When the path isn't defined, you make the call and bring people with you rather than working around them. * ** esult, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **Strong Candidates May Also** * Have led a simplification or stabilization effort on an existing SaaS platform. * Have built or operated CI/CD systems, workflow engines, or developer platforms. * Have contributed to open source in the Kubernetes, Tekton, NATS, Jenkins, or broader DevOps ecosystem. * Have background in identity and access management, multi\-tenancy, or regulated environments. * Have experience with LLM\-powered features or MCP tooling in production backends. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. Our bonus plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together. * **People who sweat the craft.** A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth. * **A global, collaborative team** that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback. **EEO Statement** CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.description: **Senior Full Stack Engineer** **College Board – Technology** **Location:** This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes. **Role Type**: This is a full\-time position. **About Technology** **at College Board:** We are a mission\-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud\-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large\-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform\-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission\-critical systems are built and evolved. **About the Team** The Deliver team is responsible for building and operating the core products that deliver high\-stakes digital assessments to millions of students each year. Today, this includes supporting flagship programs such as the **SAT** and **AP exams**, while advancing the technology that enables secure, reliable, and scalable test delivery across a wide range of devices and environments. The team focuses on delivering **high\-integrity proctoring and assessment experiences,** ensuring performance, security, and consistency for students and educators at scale. Our responsibilities span two primary domains: We own the end\-to\-end student testing experience, including: * **Bluebook** – the student\-facing desktop application used to take digital exams * **Mission Control** – a large\-scale, AWS\-based backend that supports authentication, test delivery, telemetry, resilience, and security * **Test \& Results Packaging** – systems that ingest, digitize, secure, package, and deliver test content to students through the Bluebook client Together, these systems must operate with extreme reliability, security, and performance at national scale. We also build the tools educators rely on during live testing, a new product consisting of desktop and mobile experiences that allow proctors to: * Monitor student progress in real time * Detect and investigate anomalies * Troubleshoot student issues on test day This work directly impacts test integrity, educator confidence, and student outcomes. **About the Opportunity** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer in Deliver team, you will play a key role in building and delivering web applications and cloud services that power College Board’s next generation digital experiences. You will develop scalable, performant, and reliable solutions, contributing to design, implementation, testing, and technical documentation, while working closely with cross\-functional teams. College Board, a not\-for\-profit organization dedicated to expanding access to education, builds technology that serves students, educators, and institutions at scale. Working within the Technology group and in partnership with product, design, and operations teams, the Senior Full Stack Engineer will develop solutions that are fast, fault\-tolerant, and easy to maintain. This role requires strong expertise in modern full stack development (React, TypeScript, and Node.js), along with experience building serverless and container\-based applications on AWS. You will build user\-facing features and back\-end services that perform consistently as usage grows. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with serverless and event\-driven architectures and enjoys integrating front\-end experiences with cloud services. You will contribute to systems built on modular, scalable architectures, and support delivery through CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevOps practices. **In this role, you have:** **Design and Development (60%)** * Design and deliver high\-quality user\-facing features and back\-end services using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS, with a focus on scalability and reliability * Translate product requirements into well\-structured, testable components, driving features from concept to production * Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using AWS CDK * Prototype and validate new ideas quickly while keeping codebases clean and extensible * Contribute to shared patterns, components, and documentation to improve consistency and reuse * Optimize application performance, reliability, and security **Team Operations \& Success (30 mers’ business processes and operations * Share knowledge and contribute to improving team practices and engineering quality * Mentor junior developers and support growth within the team **About you, you have:** * 7\+ years of experience in full stack development, building, testing, and managing web\-based applications * At least 3 years of recent, hands\-on experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS * Experience building serverless applications on AWS, including services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, Step Functions, IAM, CloudFront, WAF, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and DynamoDB * Experience building applications using modular, component\-driven architectures * Experience with AWS CDK to define infrastructure as code and integrate it into deployment pipelines for environment\-specific deploys * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows shared across services, improving consistency and reducing duplicated pipeline maintenance across teams * Experience with automated testing, ideally Playwright * Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Grafana) including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting to diagnose and resolve production issues * Experience working in Agile environments with strong collaboration skills * Strong problem\-solving ability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies * Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science, systems engineering, information systems, or a similar field (preferred) **All roles at College Board require:** * A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work * Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal * A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input. * A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking. * A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success * Authorization to work in the United States **About Our Process** * Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. * While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks. **What We Offer** At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck\- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self\-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market. **A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation** * The hiring range for this role is $153,000 \- $166,000\. * Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board. * We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data. * We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live. You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more. \#LI\-EA \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: AI Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The AI Engineer II independently develops and supports AI engineering capabilities that enable reusable, secure, and scalable AI\-assisted software delivery. This role builds components of the AI Harness, agent frameworks, evaluation systems, and developer workflow tools, while partnering with engineering teams to translate practical delivery needs into reliable AI\-enabled solutions. The AI Engineer II contributes to production\-quality AI applications and helps improve the consistency, safety, and usefulness of AI\-supported engineering workflows. **Responsibilities:** Develop AI Harness \& Platform Capabilities * Design, build, test, and maintain well\-defined AI platform components, services, connectors, and internal tools. * Implement model routing, prompt execution patterns, API integrations, and reusable utilities aligned to platform standards. * Improve reliability, performance, observability, and usability of AI engineering tools. * Support production operations for AI\-enabled services, including troubleshooting, monitoring, and issue remediation. * May be responsible for on\-call rotation and front\-line incident response for AI\-enabled production services, including triage, escalation, and remediation. Build Reusable Agents, Skills \& Connectors * Develop reusable agents, skills, workflow components, and connectors that can be used across engineering teams. * Implement agent behaviors, tool calls, structured workflows, and integration logic that support AI\-assisted SDLC use cases. * Apply standards for modularity, permissions, traceability, and maintainability. * Partner with more senior engineers to refine shared libraries and reduce duplicate AI engineering work across teams. Implement Evaluation, Testing \& LLMOps Workflows * Build and maintain evaluation workflows for prompts, agents, tools, and AI\-generated outputs. * Develop automated tests, regression checks, quality benchmarks, and validation approaches for AI\-enabled capabilities. * Support versioning, release management, rollback readiness, and lifecycle management for prompts, agents, and AI components. * Analyze model and agent behavior to identify quality, cost, latency, security, or reliability concerns. Apply AI Security \& Governance Controls * Embed approved logging, access control, data classification, and risk controls into AI\-enabled workflows. * Work with security and governance partners to address implementation requirements for responsible AI use. * Validate that AI tools and agents are handling sensitive data appropriately and operating within defined guardrails. * Support remediation of security, compliance, or audit findings related to AI engineering solutions. Partner with Engineering Teams on AI\-Assisted Delivery * Collaborate with software engineering teams to understand delivery pain points and identify AI\-enabled workflow improvements. * Build examples, templates, and golden\-path patterns that accelerate adoption of shared AI engineering capabilities. * Support onboarding, technical guidance, and issue resolution for engineering users of AI platform tools. * Contribute to team standards, documentation, and communities of practice around AI\-assisted development. **Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience, with typically 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, platform engineering, automation, or developer productivity roles. * Strong programming skills are required, preferably in Python and one or more modern application development languages. * Candidates should have experience building APIs, services, integrations, automated tests, and cloud\-based applications. * Experience with LLM application patterns, prompt engineering, RAG, agent frameworks, LLMOps, evaluation techniques, or AI\-assisted development tools is strongly preferred. * Candidates should demonstrate sound engineering judgment, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to independently deliver reliable technical solutions in a secure environment. Building on its 60\-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. jobs.title: Software Engineer 3, Commerce
jobs.description: Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business. **Job Description** =================== Location: New York, NY Condé Nast's commerce team builds the technology behind product discovery, personalized shopping, and checkout experiences across our portfolio of brands. We're looking for a Software Engineer III to help design and scale backend systems that power commerce initiatives, including styling and product recommendations, catalog, inventory, and order infrastructure, built to serve multiple brands, not just one. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers across the org to build systems that are fast, reliable, and designed for reuse and scale across Condé Nast's diverse editorial and commerce properties. **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * 6\+ years building production backend systems, ideally with some exposure to e\-commerce, retail, or content\-commerce platforms * Deep proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript, with a track record of designing services that hold up under real user traffic, including seasonal or campaign\-driven spikes * Experience building and evolving REST and GraphQL APIs that serve both internal teams (editorial, styling, merchandising) and external partners (retail affiliates, payment providers, product data feeds) * Comfort designing event\-driven systems (Kafka, SQS, EventBridge) for things like inventory sync, price updates, order status, and affiliate commerce events * Strong database design instincts across relational and NoSQL systems (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) * Experience designing systems with multi\-tenancy or configurability in mind: building once and adapting across different use cases, teams, or brands, rather than one\-off solutions * Basic fluency in React, enough to collaborate closely with frontend engineers building shoppable articles, styling widgets, and product carousels * Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design, applied pragmatically rather than academically * Comfortable owning the full development lifecycle, from version control and code review to automated testing and CI/CD deployment. * A collaborative streak: you'll be pairing with product, editorial, and design stakeholders across multiple brands, each with its own voice and priorities * AI\-native mindset. Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and look for opportunities to apply AI to solve real engineering and product problems, not just to write code faster. **Description** --------------- As a backend engineer on Condé Nast's commerce team, you'll design and build services spanning multiple commerce initiatives, including product catalog and inventory systems, retail partner integrations, styling and recommendation features, and checkout infrastructure, with an eye toward reusability across our brands. You'll work closely with product managers to translate business goals into technical designs, and with frontend and other backend engineers to ship features end to end. You'll make architectural calls that balance speed of iteration with the reliability commerce demands, while thinking ahead about how a given system might need to flex for a different brand's catalog structure, traffic pattern, or editorial workflow. You'll participate in code reviews and design discussions, and mentor other engineers to help raise the technical bar across the team. Day to day, the specific project might shift: optimizing a product\-matching query for styling recommendations one quarter, hardening a retail partner integration the next. But the core of the work stays the same: partnering closely with product and engineering to build commerce systems that are reliable, well\-designed, and scalable across Condé Nast's portfolio of brands. **Education \& Experience** --------------------------- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6\+ years of professional backend software development experience required. *The expected base salary range for this position is from $175,000\-195,000\. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.* **What happens next?** ====================== If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile. ***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality\-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. **Director, Cloud Infrastructure** We're hiring a Director of Cloud Infrastructure to join Convene Hospitality Group's (CHG) Technology organization. It's a hands\-on role with an AI\-native mindset. There are no direct reports today. You'll lead through the platform, redesigning how we deploy and setting the standards our product and corporate engineering teams build on. You'll also run the cloud, AI, and venue infrastructure under our portfolio of brands, from client\-facing experiences to the systems that keep our nearly 40 venues running. This is a rebuild. You design it *and* you build it. Today, deployments are manual and happen about once a sprint. That's the starting line. You'll rethink how we ship so that deployments are unlocked, safe, secure, and governed. You'll have high autonomy and real decision\-making power over the tools we use and how we build. We're committed to AWS and will build deeply on it. Most of what sits on top is fair game: CI tooling, pipeline design, orchestration patterns, and source control.A decision like Bitbucket versus GitHub is a live call, and it's yours to make. Legacy migration follows the decisions. You make the call, then you do the move. This role will have a lot of influence. This is a wide seat. You'll work across product and corporate engineering, and you're a big part of how we get to AI\-first, spec\-driven development. **What You'll Do:** * **Rebuild the deployment path.** Own CI/CD end to end: build, release, and rollback. Take us from manual deploys to an automated path. * **Make it safe, secure and governed.** Access control, audit trails, secrets management, environment separation, and a rollback path any engineer can execute. * **Make the platform calls.** Source control, CI tooling, orchestration, and infrastructure\-as\-code patterns. Jenkins is what we run today; what we run next is up to you. Decide, document the trade\-off, then go forth and migrate. * **Run the AI gateway.** Build and operate the layer between our engineers, agents and the models they call: provider routing, key management, rate limits, token metering, and usage logging. Every AI call should be visible, governed, and attributable. * **Enable AI\-first, spec\-driven development.** Build the environments, pipelines and guardrails that let engineers and agents ship with confidence: ephemeral environments, fast feedback, and automated verification. * **Model and manage cloud and AI cost.** Forecast what AI systems will cost before we commit and give Finance numbers they can plan against. Keep a standing view of where cloud spend goes and why, and partner with teams to help keep it in check. * **Support in\-venue networking applications.** Each venue relies on network infrastructure for access control, connectivity, and on\-site A/V and production. You'll give our networking team the visibility to monitor and support the applications that keep those venues running. * **Build the observability layer.** Logging, metrics, alerting, and routing on our Loki/Grafana stack, so every failure reaches a named owner. * **Spread what you know and what you do.** Coordinate with the product engineers and ensure a level of backup: documented runbooks, a named second operator on every critical path, and dissemination of knowledge and function across product and corporate engineering. Within six months, you can take two weeks off and we can trudge through an emergency without interrupting you. **What We Look For:** * You have 9\+ years of experience building and running production cloud infrastructure. * You're deep on AWS: multi\-account structure, networking, IAM, and container orchestration on EKS and/or ECS. You've operated production workloads through incidents, upgrades, and growth. * You're fluent in infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and treat infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code: reviewed, versioned, reproducible. * You've built or rebuilt a CI/CD pipeline that teams actually use. You know what it takes to move an organization from manual deploys to automated ones, including the trust and process work that comes with it. * You think about security and governance as design inputs rather than a review gate. Secrets, least privilege, audit trails, environment isolation, and who is allowed to push what, where. * You've run AI systems in production, from the gateway layer (access control, provider routing, cost attribution, observability) to LLM\-backed features, including their evaluation, monitoring, and versioning. Experience with MLOps is a plus as our needs grow. * You can estimate cost and defend the number. You've modeled the spend of an architecture before it was built and adjusted the design when it didn't hold up. * You're high agency. You set direction without waiting for a spec, make platform decisions with real consequences, and then own the migration. You hold positions firmly, change them on evidence, and leave behind a written trail. * You're a problem solver. Application and data teams seek you out for collaboration on architecture, debugging, and trade\-off analysis. * You work in the open and hand things off deliberately. You write the runbook, train the second operator, and measure your success partly by how little depends on you being reachable. * You explain decisions, risks and trade\-offs clearly to engineers, non\-engineers, and executives. You make teammates better through code review, pairing, and mentoring. * You use AI agents for real multi\-step work beyond autocomplete, and you verify what they produce against the real system. **Compensation:** The above job definition information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on changing business needs and conditions. * **Base Salary Range:** $180,000 – $220,000 * **Total Target Compensation:** $198,000 – $242,000 (includes base salary \+ annual incentive performance bonus) This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors. **We're Here For You:** At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect: * **Health \& Wellness:** Day\-one health coverage for you and your family, 24/7 virtual care, emotional well\-being support, and fertility \& family planning benefits. Because your well\-being matters, inside and outside of work. * **Time Off \& Balance:** Generous PTO, your birthday off (because, of course!), paid parental leave, and a year\-end holiday closure to recharge. * **Financial Growth:** 401K with company match and support for education, courses, and certifications. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally. * **Development \& Recognition:** Ongoing career growth opportunities plus recognition programs to celebrate milestones. * **Community \& Impact:** Volunteer and give\-back opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in the work you do. At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team. Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. \#LI\-DK1

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Software Developer within our Corpay Complete division. This position falls under our Corpay Payables line of business and is in Elk Grove, CA. jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** ------------ At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people, “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity. **About the Information Service and Technology (IST) Department****:** Connecting our community and local government through innovative, accessible technology solutions. * **Customers:** Enable departments through partnerships, responsiveness, and innovation; prioritizing their needs and fulfilling their expectations. * **Solutions:** Be Innovative Business Leaders who identify opportunities early and apply technology to drive better, faster public services. **Culture:** Cultivate leadership at all levels to drive IST’s success while advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. In addition to a full benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Pension/Retirement, deferred compensation, and flexible spending accounts, we offer our employees: * Hybrid (telework/onsite) work schedules. * Options for Alternative Work Schedules (such as 4\-5/9’s). * A culture of public service collaboration and work/life balance. * Training and career development opportunities. * County benefits such as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Tuition Assistance Program (TAP). **Remote Work Options:** The IST Department has embraced a hybrid work schedule that recognizes some duties of this position may be performed remotely. Candidates must be able to work**a minimum of** **three (3\) days per week in the office**and report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule. **About the Project Management Office Team:** Our team provides centralized IT project management for technology\-related projects across all County departments. We use standard project management principles, processes, tools, and software to ensure consistent project delivery approach and success. **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- **We currently have one (1\) full\-time vacancy for a Senior IT Project Manager (County Classification: Senior Systems Engineer) in the Project Management Office (PMO) of the Information Services and Technology (IST) department.** The primary function of this assignment is senior\-level IT project management, not hands\-on systems engineering. This is an opportunity for a Senior IT Project Manager to manage and deliver significant IT projects and contribute to how technology projects are delivered across Marin County, while supporting innovation, collaboration, and improved public outcomes. Reporting to the IT Manager of PMO, the Senior IT Project Manager works with a team of IT professionals to manage health and delivery of IT projects across all methodologies (agile, hybrid, waterfall) with varied technology applications. They are responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle, stakeholders, project documentation, serve as technical specialists, operate independently with minimal supervision and provide mentorship to junior team members when needed. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO Program through developing, updating and documenting project management policies, standards and guidelines to align with organizational goals. **ABOUT YOU** ------------- The ideal candidate has senior project management experience and has previously served in a project management office. This individual has managed the implementation of IT projects independently, throughout the project lifecycle, across all project methodologies, with a proven track record of successful implementations. They possess strong knowledge of project management and technical understanding to effectively lead technology projects, collaborate with technical teams, evaluate risks and dependencies, and communicate technical considerations to business stakeholders. They should have experience of mentoring team members, manage customer interactions and engage with diverse groups of stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills are expected for cross functional collaboration with stakeholders across the organization and external parties. Specifically, they are experienced in the following: * All aspects of technology project management lifecycle across project methodologies (waterfall, hybrid and agile) while adhering to departmental policies and standards. * Proficient and have a proven track record in delivering projects on time and on budget. * Mentoring project management professionals in a team environment. * Building collaborative partnerships across business and technical teams. * Experience of technology (including system design gement experience, including independent responsibility for complex technology projects through the full project lifecycle, will be considered most competitive. **SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS** **LiveScan:** Candidates selected may be subject to fingerprinting by the Sheriff's Department and must pass a Department of Justice LiveScan background check prior to appointment. **IMPORTANT INFORMATION** ------------------------- **If you have any questions concerning this position announcement, please contact Molly Ibarra at** **molly.ibarra@marincounty.gov****.** All applicants will receive email notifications regarding their status in the recruitment process. Please be sure to check your spam settings to allow our emails to reach you. You may also log into your governmentjobs.com account to view these emails. **Testing and Eligible List:** Depending on the number of qualified applications received, the examination may consist of a highly qualified review, application screening, online assessment, written examination, oral examination, performance examination, or any combination to determine which candidates' names will be placed on the eligible list. The eligible list established from this recruitment will be used to fill the current vacancy and any future vacancies for open, fixed\-term, full\-time or part\-time positions which may occur while the list remains active. **First Round Interviews will be on Zoom Tuesday, 12/1/2026 and/or Wednesday, 12/2/2026\.** **TENTATIVE: Second Round Interviews** **will be IN PERSON** **Wednesday, 12/9/2026 and/or Thursday, 12/10/2026 (1600 Los Gamos Drive, Suite 370, San Rafael CA 94903\).** **Disaster Service Workers:** All County of Marin employees are designated Disaster Service Workers through state and local law (California Government Code Section 3100\-3109\). Employment with the County requires the affirmation of a loyalty oath to this effect. Employees are required to complete all Disaster Service Worker\-related training as assigned, and to return to work as ordered in the event of an emergency. **Equal Employment Opportunity Employer:** If you have questions regarding equal employment opportunities, please contact Roger Crawford, Equal Employment Opportunity Director at (415\) 473\-2095\. **PLEASE NOTE**: The benefits described herein do not apply to temporary (contingent) or to part\-time employees that work less than 50%. **COUNTY OF MARIN BENEFITS: GENERAL** Below are some of the excellent benefits the County offers. More information about our benefits can be found on the Marin County's Benefits Homepage. **Paid Time Off**: Competitive vacation accrual; 12 holidays per year; and generous sick leave accruals. Additional types of paid leaves are available for some bargaining units. **Health Plan**: Choice of four health plans (two Kaiser HMOs, Western Health Advantage HMO, and an Anthem Blue Cross PPO) along with dental through Delta Dental PPO, and vision through Vision Service Plan (VSP). There is a County contribution toward the premiums (the contribution amount varies depending on coverage tier elected such as employee only, employee \+ 1, employee \+ family). Plus, the County offers excellent Life Insurance, Disability, Flexible Spending Plans, a Dependent Care Assistance Program, professional development and more. **Retirement**: Defined benefit plan under the County Employees Retirement Act of 1937\. More information can be found online at www.mcera.org. **IRS 457 Plan**: Choice of pre\-tax or post\-tax (Roth) employee contribution up to the IRS annual maximum. **Retiree Medical**: The County provides access to group health plan coverage to eligible retirees. For specific questions regarding the employment process, please contact Human Resources at (415\) 473\-6104\. For additional details about the benefits or retirement, please contact the Benefits Division at (415\) 473\-2197\. * IMPORTANT NOTE: Benefits described herein do not represent a contract and may be changed without notice.

jobs.title: Technical Analyst I
jobs.description: **Cox Automotive** is seeking a **Technical Analyst I (TA**) is the primary point of contact for Technology at Revenue Generating Locations (i.e. Manheim Auto Auction). The TA collaborates with members of project teams and business owners to bring forth its technology to the client. The TA assists in design, development, testing, and post\-release. The TA ensures service delivery for all interconnected network devices and workflow processes. The TA is responsible to maintain system integrity and security. The TA manages fixed infrastructure inter\-connectivity and assists or designs expansions after evaluating the business need. The TA is expected to manage, initiate, and/or participate in projects ranging from construction, business changes, and corporate\-wide initiatives. When third parties are introduced, the analyst will be expected to engineer a solution or collaborate with the appropriate parties. The TA advocates and escalates issues. They will assist locations with a client base ranging from 200 to 1000 team members. They will assist with client training, adoption, and satisfaction. The TA's role requires participation in location management team meetings with the expectation to assist business needs and/or changes. They will influence the local management team with operations and technology decisions with a strict adherence to company standards and best practices. TA's are required to have an awareness of operational knowledge specific to the client. This includes a wide scale knowledge of service portfolios to provide guidance and assistance. The TA provides Service Delivery management by providing high uptime, managing local service contracts, and managing high\-pressure issues and conflicts that arise during revenue generating sale\-days. **What You'll Do:** **Hardware/Software Installation** * Hardware procurement, delivery, implementation, and maintenance. * Maintains documentation of physical assets in configuration and asset management records. **Preventive Maintenance** * Monitors the availability, performance, and throughput of supported technology infrastructure to proactively identify issues and remediate. * Manages and maintains all infrastructure hardware and software ensuring they remain available at all required times. Tests and provides recommendations for replacement or upgrade of hardware or software to ensure business continuity. * Maintains technology infrastructure support technical documentation. * Leads location in disaster recovery for technology. **Incident Management** * Performs technology support, troubleshooting and resolving hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile phones, and peripheral devices. * Performs research and develops solutions for hardware and software issues. * Updates incident records and knowledge base with appropriate and timely information **Problem Management** * Recommends and develops solutions, resolve problems associated with incidents, and update problem records. * Conducts root cause analysis. * Submits requests for change records to remove errors. * The role requires a high level of autonomy correlating to workflow. This is a results\-driven position requiring knowledge of all facets of technology such as networking, software, and hardware. * Works with project teams to review and assess impact of new business requirements. * Contributes to technical aspects of key change documentation (e.g. technical requirements, change impact assessments, change implementation plans, change rollout plans). * Ensures the capacity, availability, security, and service support requirements are considered in all technology infrastructure changes. * Implements, tests, and monitors technology infrastructure changes in line with change implementation plans. * Ensures technology infrastructure changes meet agreed service acceptance criteria. * Maintains asset and configuration management records. **Training** * Trains end users for Corporate initiatives such as device or software deployment for teams such as Security, Device Engineering, and Software teams. **Technology Operations** * Provide technical expertise to enable the correct application of operational procedures. * Contribute to the planning and implementation of maintenance and installation work. * Implement agreed changes and maintenance routines. * Identify operational problems and ensuring they are managed in accordance with agreed standards and procedures. * Provide reports and proposals for improvement. **Client Services Management** * Act as the routine contact point. * Assist with the development of and applies solutions to resolve or escalate clients' service problems. * Monitor client services function and collects performance data. * Data retention management is required for this role for the client's legal archive. **Who You Are:** **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as 4 years' experience in a related field. * Working experience supporting end\-user computing devices * Working experience working with incident, problem, and change management * Working experience in an ITIL\-based environment * Working experience as a participant in a change management process * Working experience of Microsoft Office products * Willingness to travel 5 to 10%. * Ability to walk, stand, squat, kneel and climb to perform essential job duties required to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain technology equipment * Excellent customer service skills required. The ability to meet SLAs and update customer with progress. **Preferred Qualifications** * Additional Tech Certification: A\+, Network\+, MCP, MCDST * Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) * Network certificates * Experience in Series/AS400 support * Experience in wireless (Mobile, WiFi, WAP) * Experience in network * Experience in audio/visual * Exposure to Project Management * Experience communicating with stakeholders USD 67,200\.00 \- 100,800\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $67,200\.00 \- $100,800\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. EOE, including disability/vets

jobs.title: Embedded Software Manager
jobs.description: Have you ever used a self\-checkout, played the slots at a casino, grabbed a drink from a vending machine, or paid to park your car? If so, you may have done so with the aid of technology from Crane Payment Innovations (CPI). We make technology that powers everyday transactions, helping keep the world of payments moving through payment validation devices and business management software. Headquartered in Malvern, PA, CPI is supported by: \>2,500 global associates, 7 manufacturing sites, 12 corporate offices and 43 service branches. **WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING** As Manager, Embedded Software Development, you will lead embedded software engineering teams responsible for the software and firmware at the heart of CPI's intelligent products. You will combine people leadership and delivery accountability with a strong technical understanding of embedded systems. The role requires the ability to work effectively across software, electronics, mechanical systems, test and product engineering, where software behavior is closely coupled to physical hardware and real\-time product operation. Initially, you will lead a distributed embedded software team supporting the SC3 product platform, with engineers located in Malvern, Pennsylvania and Buxtehude, Germany. The scope of the role may expand as CPI evolves its embedded software organization. The Manager, Embedded Software Development will have a direct impact on the Engineering organization, responsible for: * Leading a geographically distributed team of embedded software engineers in the United States and Germany. * Translating product and system requirements into executable embedded software development plans and delivery commitments. * Providing technical leadership and direction for embedded software architecture, design, implementation, integration and verification. * Ensuring effective collaboration between embedded software, electronic hardware, systems engineering, test and validation, manufacturing and product management. * Managing development across new products, product enhancements, customer requirements and sustaining engineering. * Establishing and maintaining appropriate engineering practices for embedded software quality, configuration management, code review, testing and release. * Ensuring software designs appropriately address real\-time behavior, hardware constraints, reliability, maintainability and product lifecycle requirements. * Developing engineers through coaching, technical mentoring, career development and clear performance expectations. * Supporting recruitment, workforce planning and development of the embedded software engineering capability. * Managing engineering priorities, resource constraints, technical risks and cross\-functional dependencies. * Driving continuous improvement in embedded development tools, automation, build and test infrastructure, and engineering processes. * Representing Embedded Software Development in engineering reviews, product planning and cross\-functional decision\-making. **WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** You will bring substantial experience developing embedded software for commercial products together with demonstrated engineering leadership experience. This is fundamentally an embedded engineering leadership role. A strong understanding of electronic hardware, microprocessors, real\-time systems and hardware/software interaction is essential. You do not need to be the team's primary developer, but you must have sufficient technical depth to challenge designs, understand failures and risks, and provide meaningful technical direction. **Qualifications and Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. * Typically 8 or more years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience, including technical or people leadership responsibility. * Strong professional experience developing software for embedded products. * Strong knowledge of C and/or C\+\+ in resource\-constrained embedded environments. * Experience with microcontrollers, microprocessors and embedded hardware architectures. * Practical understanding of real\-time systems, including interrupt\-driven designs, concurrency, timing constraints and RTOS\-based software. * Strong understanding of hardware/software interfaces, including device drivers and common embedded communication interfaces and protocols. * Ability to read electronic schematics and work effectively with electronic hardware engineers. * Experience troubleshooting complex hardware/software interactions using appropriate embedded debugging and laboratory tools. * Understanding of embedded software architecture, modular design, source control, configuration management, automated builds, code review and software testing. * Experience delivering embedded software through the complete commercial product lifecycle. * Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop software engineers. * Experience working with geographically distributed engineering teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Experience** * Experience developing embedded software for complex electromechanical products. * Experience with RTOS\-based systems and embedded Linux. * Experience with ARM or other modern microcontroller/microprocessor architectures. * Experience with embedded communications such as CAN, USB, Ethernet, UART, SPI or I²C. * Experience with hardware debugging tools such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. * Experience working with bootloaders, firmware update mechanisms and embedded product diagnostics. * Experience with embedded cybersecurity and secure software development practices. * Experience developing products with long operational lifecycles and significant field\-installed populations. * Experience with payments, currency handling, vending, retail, gaming, industrial automation or other intelligent electromechanical products. * Experience leading technology modernization or migration of mature embedded product platforms. **PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES** * Technically Grounded: You understand both software and the hardware it controls and can engage engineers credibly on architecture, design trade\-offs and difficult technical problems. * People Developer: You create clear expectations, coach engineers effectively and build technical depth within the organization. * Systems Thinker: You consider software, electronics, mechanics, sensors, communications and product behavior as parts of a complete engineered system. * Action Oriented: You make practical decisions, establish priorities and maintain delivery momentum while managing technical risk. * Collaborative Leader: You build strong relationships across sites and across software, hardware, systems, test, manufacturing and product organizations. * Quality Focused: You recognize that embedded software directly controls physical products and place appropriate emphasis on reliability, robustness and disciplined engineering. **CPI is part of Crane NXT** Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company that provides proprietary and trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers. The company is a pioneer in advanced, proprietary micro\-optics technology for securing physical products, and its sophisticated electronic equipment and associated software leverages proprietary core capabilities with detection and sensing technologies. Crane NXT has approximately 4,000 employees with global operations and manufacturing facilities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico, Japan, Switzerland, Germany, Sweden, and Malta. For more information, visit www.cranenxt.com. *Crane Payment Innovations is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. Applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.* \#CPI \#LI\-JL1 \#Remote

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, AI Security Systems (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Lab:** ------------------ AI is changing cyber offense and defense simultaneously. Adversaries use models to inspect code, hunt vulnerabilities, adapt tooling, and conduct longer operations. CrowdStrike built the Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab to ensure defenders stay ahead. The Lab is CrowdStrike’s frontier AI research organization for cyber defense. Its work spans frontier and open\-weight models, CrowdStrike\-trained models, specialized agents, reinforcement learning, evaluation, and secure deployment. The Lab combines trillions of Falcon events each day, more than a decade of adversary intelligence, expert\-validated outcomes, and high\-fidelity environments where offensive and defensive AI can attack, defend, learn, and prove what works in real enterprise environments. **About the Role:** ------------------- We are seeking a Distinguished Engineer who has built AI and security systems that operate in the real world and stop real adversaries. You may have worked on the endpoint, where every millisecond, megabyte, and CPU cycle matters, or at cloud scale, where systems reason over trillions of events and design decisions affect cost, latency, and efficacy across millions of protected assets. Ideally, you understand both. As one of the Lab’s most senior technical leaders, you will architect systems that turn frontier AI into autonomous, trustworthy cyber defense—from the sensor to the cloud. You will write code, design experiments, set technical direction across research and engineering teams, and carry breakthroughs into the Falcon platform. Experience with AI\-assisted development, Microsoft Power Platform, and collaborative development practices such as documentation, QA/QC, and code review will help them succeed in this role. **Who We Are** Founded in 1940 and headquartered in San Francisco, **Degenkolb Engineers** helps make complex, high\-stakes projects real. jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: DESE's engineering teams support the development, integration, and advancement of complex software\-intensive systems that contribute to our nation's defense capabilities. We're seeking a proactive and collaborative Software Integration Engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, coordinating across engineering disciplines, and helping lead successful system integration efforts. This role is well\-suited for an engineer who understands software development and system interfaces but also excels at communication, organization, and technical coordination. You'll serve as a key software integration focal point, bringing together software, hardware, systems engineering, industry partners, and government stakeholders to ensure mission\-critical systems work together effectively. **Core Responsibilities:** * Serve as a primary software integration focal point, coordinating technical activities across software, hardware, systems engineering, and external organizations. * Lead cross\-functional technical meetings, interface discussions, and integration working groups while establishing clear objectives, agendas, action items, and follow\-up activities. * Independently manage technical assignments, schedules, and integration priorities while maintaining communication with program leadership and stakeholders. * Coordinate software integration activities from planning and interface definition through testing, execution, issue resolution, and closure. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define, interpret, and validate software interface requirements across system architectures. * Support software development lifecycle (SDLC) activities and coordinate integration milestones with Agile sprint delivery schedules. * Evaluate software messaging, data exchanges, and system communication interfaces to support reliable subsystem integration. * Support software interface testing and verification using simulation, emulation, and hardware/software integration environments. * Clearly communicate technical findings, integration risks, and recommended solutions to leadership, contractors, and government stakeholders. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Experience supporting software development, software integration, system interfaces, or software\-intensive engineering programs. * Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including Agile development practices and sprint\-based delivery. * Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical activities and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Experience participating in or facilitating technical meetings, integration discussions, or engineering reviews. * Ability to independently organize priorities, track technical actions, and coordinate issue resolution. * Working knowledge of software interfaces, system architectures, and data communication concepts. **Highlighted Skills \& Experience:** * Technical Leadership: Experience serving as a technical focal point, facilitating meetings, coordinating stakeholders, and driving integration activities through completion. * Software Development Lifecycle: Understanding of SDLC processes, Agile methodologies, sprint planning, and software delivery coordination. * Software Interfaces: Experience defining, interpreting, documenting, and validating software interfaces and associated system requirements. * Messaging \& Data Structures: Familiarity with message content, structure, and formats, including bits, bytes, data encoding, and big\-endian/little\-endian representations. * Integration Environments: Experience with software emulation tools, Computer\-in\-the\-Loop (CIL), Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL), and other simulation or integration test environments. * System Communication: Familiarity with transmit, receive, and processing (TRP) rules and their impact on system performance and interface behavior. * Verification \& Validation: Experience supporting software interface testing throughout development, integration, and system\-level verification. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Experience coordinating with software, electrical, mechanical, systems engineering, industry contractors, and government stakeholders. * Defense Experience: Familiarity with Ground\-Based Midcourse Defense (GMD), missile defense systems, or similar aerospace and defense programs is preferred. **Why This Role Matters:** Complex defense systems rely on software that communicates and performs reliably across multiple platforms and subsystems. In this role, you'll help ensure critical software interfaces are defined, integrated, tested, and aligned across engineering teams. Your ability to bring people together, communicate technical challenges, and drive integration efforts forward will directly support the success of mission\-critical defense programs. **About DESE** For the past 44 years, DESE has provided industry\-leading technical and engineering solutions in the fields of Defense, Energy, Space, and Environment. As a small, family\-oriented business, DESE provides a compelling benefits package including a generous profit\-sharing plan, competitive salaries, and perhaps most importantly, the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals leveraging cutting\-edge technologies to solve complex and engaging problems. Why employees love working for DESE: At DESE, we are committed to creating a company that is known for its respect and care for employees. We understand that happy employees are what keeps our business going and we strive to provide the best opportunities for each individual working on our team! Here are a few reasons you will love working here: * Competitive health, dental and vision insurance with affordable premiums * Flexible work schedules * Two different flexible spending account options * Company paid life insurance with options for employee paid additional * Performance bonus program * Education reimbursement program * Company paid personal leave for approved philanthropic activities * Vacation, Sick \& Holiday leave * Robust 401k profit sharing plan * Opportunities for internal promotions * Employee referral incentive program * Rewards and gifts for service anniversaries Disability Accommodation for Applicants \- DESE Research, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in its job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system and you need an accommodation due to a disability, you may use the following alternative email address or phone number to contact us about your interest in employment with us: hrandsecurity@dese.com or 256\-837\-8004x123\.

Darley \& Co.** Founded in 1908, W.S. Darley \& Co. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Runtime
jobs.description: P\-1096 At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain\-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general\-purpose models alone. That's why we built AI Runtime, a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post\-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters. It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable, make training fault\-tolerant, and speed up fine\-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving the hardest technical problems and shaping where AI Runtime goes next. **The impact you will have:** * Drive AI Runtime's architecture and lead Databricks' long\-term technical direction in AI training infrastructure. * Define the reliability and observability strategy for a fleet that keeps growing in scale and complexity. * Shape AI Runtime's developer experience for people and agents, so even the largest training jobs feel as simple as a first experiment. * Anticipate industry trends and choose the technical bets that prepare AI Runtime for new GPU generations and workload types. * Take on the hardest multi\-node training problems yourself, from orchestration and GPU scheduling to data loading and checkpointing. * Make training faster and cheaper by raising efficiency across model architectures and GPU accelerators. * Work with research, product, and customers to decide what we build next and align teams on hard technical calls. * Champion engineering excellence, raise the bar, and help us hire and grow great engineers. **What we look for:** * 15\+ years in large\-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in GPU training, high\-performance computing, or ML systems. * Hands\-on experience training large models with FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron, and fluency in parallelism strategies. * Expertise in GPU performance, including accelerator architecture, high\-speed interconnects, and kernels. * Strong understanding of training resilience patterns, such as checkpointing, failure detection, and automatic recovery. * A background in building and running multi\-tenant cloud platforms as products. * A track record of setting technical direction across teams and seeing it through to business impact. * The credibility to bring teams to agreement on difficult trade\-offs, and a reputation as a mentor senior engineers seek out. * BS in Computer Science or a related field (MS or PhD preferred). **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. Local Pay Range $228,600—$342,800 USD **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Applied AI Engineer, Agent Harness
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a pre\-seed AI startup in San Francisco building AI coworkers for IT teams: a security\-focused product where an agent registers as a governed identity in a customer's directory, requests scoped access per task, escalates for human approval, and drives systems it was never given an API for. ### **About the Role** This role builds the layer that turns model capability into systems that actually work for users. You'll develop the core agent harness (the execution loop, tool\-use strategies, context construction, and model\-facing experimentation) and iterate on agent behaviors across real customer workflows and long\-horizon tasks. A defining stance: the creative step happens once, at authoring, and what executes afterward is deterministic, compiled, type\-checked code rather than stochastic tool\-chaining. You'll own that boundary between what the model decides at runtime and what ships as code. You'll build and run evals against replicas of real customer environments rather than synthetic tasks, reliable enough to gate a release; analyze production failures and attribute them to the right layer (model, prompt, tool contract, environment state, or retry logic); and extend the computer\-use agent to systems with no API, owning the guarantees that let it run in production at all: a fresh microVM per task, credentials injected at session start and never seen by the model, every action recorded, and any session killable mid\-run. ### **What You'll Own** * The core agent harness: execution loop, tool\-use strategies, context construction, and model\-facing experimentation * Agent behaviors across real customer workflows and long\-horizon tasks * The boundary between runtime model decisions and deterministic, compiled, type\-checked execution * Evals against replicas of real customer environments, reliable enough to gate releases * Production failure analysis and jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** Position is responsible for analyzing blueprints and specifications to prepare time, cost, and labor estimates, applying knowledge of specialized methodologies, techniques, or processes.
