Duties include: reviewing data to determine material and labor requirements; computing cost factors and prepares estimates for bids or negotiated work; consults with clients, vendors or other individuals to formulate estimates and resolve issues; and, provides engineering support, contract preparation, and project management. The Project Engineer is a classification which is distinguished from other classes by its responsibility for preparing project estimates and performing administrative duties relative to design and project management. This position will start in the field to gain hands\-on experience in estimating labor and material requirements, then transition to the office with a career path to project manager. **Supervisory Responsibilities:*** None **Duties/Responsibilities:*** Computes cost factors and prepares estimates for bids or negotiated work; conducts special studies to establish standard hour and related cost data or effect cost reductions; consults with clients, vendors, or other individuals to formulate estimates and resolve issues; and provides engineering support, contract preparation, and project management. * Preparing project estimates and performing administrative duties relative to design and project management * Assists in analyzing blueprints, specifications, proposals, and other documentation to prepare time, cost, and labor estimates for projects, applying knowledge of specialized methodologies, techniques, principles, or processes * Work may be performed in the field under the direct supervision of the Job Superintendent or in the office under the direct supervision of the Project Manager. * Completes shop drawing review and layout work * Computes cost factors and prepares estimates used for management purposes, such as planning, organizing, and scheduling work, preparing bid packages, proposing negotiated work, selecting vendors or subcontractors, and determining cost effectiveness * Conducts special studies to develop and establish standard hour and related cost data or effect cost reductions * Reviewing data to determine material and labor requirements. * Consults with clients, vendors, subcontractors, or other individuals to discuss and formulate estimates and resolve issues. Assist with three week look\-aheads and developing submittal logs * Responsible for managing a wide variety of construction projects; studies specifications and estimates worker\-hour requirements to develop project schedules and phases based on knowledge of available tools, equipment, subcontractor’s scope of work and various building methods * Provides necessary project information to job superintendent and discusses project scope of work with job project manager \& Superintendent before project begin; works closely with job superintendent to solve construction\-related problems and technical details; and assists job superintendent in communicating issues to the owner and responding to concerns and complaints. * Confers with project manager, subcontractors, and owners engaged in planning and executing work procedures, interpreting specifications, and coordinating various phases of construction to resolve construction problems and prevent delays; and serves as liaison between the owner and contractor on assigned projects * Performs additional duties as assigned to support project and organizational success. **Required Skills/Abilities/Knowledge of:*** Principles and practices of construction, civil or structural engineering and project design * Basic construction concepts, procedures, methodologies, and processes * Project management and scheduling techniques * Contract administration * Subcontractor’s scope of work * Computer systems, estimating software, and information technology * Occupational hazards and safety precautions in construction sites; including 10 Hour OSHA certification * City, state, and federal building codes as they relate to company projects and design\-build applications * Company personnel policies * Performing technical research and solving difficult engineering/design problems * Performing advanced and complex mathematical computations and analyses * Preparing and interpreting engineering plans and specifications * Analyzing and interpreting data * Maintaining records and preparing reports * Inspecting projects for compliance to plan specifications * Identifying and solving problems quickly and efficiently * Developing and delegating tasks and projects * Communication, interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, owner, and clients, etc. sufficient to exchange or effectively convey information; promote new business, resolve problems, and to receive or give work direction * Ability to perform 3D scans and use Total Station * Possess a valid driver’s license and meet the company’s Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) standards. **Education/Experience:*** Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or related field * Or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties such as those listed above * Suggested 2 years of field experience as a PE. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer - Manager
jobs.description: Location: New York Other locations: Anywhere in Country Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 21, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1754575 Location: Anywhere in Country At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity** Build AI agents that carry meaningful work from intent to a verified outcome, not merely produce an impressive response. You will engineer the execution loops, tools, context, permissions, evaluations, and runtime controls that let agents operate across complex workflows while remaining understandable, steerable, and safe when systems or assumptions fail. This role sits where applied AI, distributed systems, and product engineering meet. You will work on long\-running behavior, real enterprise integrations, and difficult production failures, deciding when a deterministic workflow is enough, when autonomy adds value, and whether each added degree of freedom earns its operational and user\-experience cost. **About Challenger** Challenger is a new EY program focused on building the firm’s next generation of services. It pursues opportunities where AI enables a fundamentally different service and way of delivering it, including rethinking existing offerings and developing new ones. Small, dedicated teams build and test ideas in real conditions. Solutions that demonstrate clear business value and operational readiness transition to the business for adoption and scale. Challenger Core develops and maintains the shared technology, methods, and risk and quality guardrails that support this work. Each team contributes reusable tools and practices, helping make the next service faster and less costly to build. **Your key responsibilities** * **Choose the right execution model.** Design agent architectures that use deterministic steps, a single\-agent loop, or coordinated agents only when measured performance justifies the complexity. * **Build dependable tools.** Create connectors and interfaces with clear contracts, validated outcomes, narrow authorization, and errors that help the agent recover or escalate. * **Engineer agent behavior.** Shape planning, routing, delegation, stopping, retry, and handoff behavior across complete workflows. * **Create durable context.** Combine instructions, user state, retrieval, memory, and environment feedback while preserving relevance, provenance, freshness, and permitted access. * **Bound agent authority.** Implement scoped identities, credentials, budgets, approval points, and emergency containment so agents act within explicit limits. * **Evaluate complete trajectories.** Build representative tests that measure verified task success, tool use, recovery, human takeover, and prohibited actions rather than isolated responses. * **Operate long\-running execution.** Use durable state, checkpointing, safe retries, versioned releases, rollback, and graceful degradation to keep work recoverable. * **Make behavior observable.** Instrument end\-to\-end traces and replay so teams can understand failures, diagnose patterns, and turn production evidence into improvements. * **Protect user control.** Design clear intervention points so people can inspect, interrupt, redirect, and safely resume agent work. * **Build shared capability.** Partner across product, platform, knowledge, security, and evaluation teams and publish reusable agent patterns and operational lessons. **Skills and attributes for success** * **Production engineering:** Strong software engineering and distributed\-systems judgment, with practical experience building services that remain dependable under failure. * **Agent architecture:** Ability to reason about planning, tools, state, handoffs, and coordination while choosing a simpler workflow when it performs better. * **AI application depth:** Practical knowledge of model APIs, structured outputs, context, retrieval, memory, experimentation, and tool use. * **Evaluation discipline:** Experience measuring complete trajectories and verified outcomes for systems whose behavior is variable. * **Security and operability:** Strong instincts for least privilege, tool boundaries, observability, resilience, recovery, and accountable human intervention. * **Product judgment:** Ability to balance quality, latency, cost, and user control and explain technical trade\-offs clearly across disciplines. **To qualify you must have** * Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field of study. * **Relevant experience:** 7\-9 years of experience in software or applied machine\-learning engineering, with ownership of production systems and their live behavior. * **Agent delivery:** Hands\-on evidence of shipping large\-language\-model applications, agents, or complex model\-driven workflows used for real work. * **Programming depth:** Strong capability in Python, TypeSc ontrol. * **Ecosystem contribution:** Practical contributions to agent, evaluation, developer tooling, applied AI, or open\-source communities We welcome exceptional candidates from product, service design, operations, transformation, policy, domain, and entrepreneurial backgrounds; no particular degree or certification is required. **What we offer you** At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join EarthOptics as a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)! At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting\-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost\-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have \~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world *see soil differently.* Our **Senior Software Engineer** will join our **Software Engineering** team to impact our mission through individual contributor responsibilities to design, build and maintain the technology that powers EarthOptics’ products and operations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role requiring strong full\-stack engineering capabilities, experience with modern cloud infrastructure, and the ability to independently own complex software systems. You'll work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure while helping shape technical decisions and improve engineering practices. **The digs:** * **Job Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime) * **Work Location:** This remote position is open to candidates authorized to work in the United States who reside in the contiguous 48 states, with a preference for those who can consistently align their working hours with US Central Time. * **Travel:** 5% of the time * **Target Start Date:** December 2026 * **Application Deadline:** Applications will be accepted through November 30, 2026\. * **Compensation:** $125,000 to $165,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below). + - This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job\-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay. **What you’ll cultivate as a** **Senior Software Engineer****:** *(Your responsibilities)* * Own the end\-to\-end design, development, deployment, and maintenance of full\-stack applications, spanning user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data integrations. * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable cloud\-based systems, including infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability, security, and production operations. * Take technical ownership of existing applications and services, developing a deep understanding of their architecture, identifying risks, addressing technical debt, and improving long\-term maintainability. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership through architectural decisions, code reviews, mentorship, and close collaboration with Product and other engineering teams. * Evaluate, develop, and integrate AI\-powered solutions across engineering workflows, internal applications, and customer\-facing products, identifying opportunities to improve productivity and deliver new capabilities while maintaining strong standards for security, correctness, and maintainability. * Collaborate directly with internal stakeholders and external customers to understand their needs, translate requirements into effective technical solutions, and support the successful delivery and adoption of software capabilities. **What you can expect to accomplish within your first 60\-120 days** * **System Ownership \& Knowledge Transfer:** Develop a strong understanding of EarthOptics' applications, architecture, and cloud infrastructure. Successfully transition ownership of critical systems and identify key technical risks. * **Full\-Stack Feature Delivery:** Independently design, implement, and deploy a meaningful full\-stack feature or enhancement, demonstrating proficiency across frontend, backend, and cloud services. * **Technical Debt \& Reliability:** Identify and begin addressing high\-priority technical debt, performance bottlenecks, or reliability issues, with actionable recommendations for improving system maintainability. * **AI\-Assisted Engineering:** Evaluate AI development tools, demonstrate practical applications, and recommend approaches that improve engineering productivity without compromising quality. **Are you our soil\-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in:** *(Your qualifications)* * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and maintaining production software. * Strong full\-stack engineering experience, including mode g, and maintaining applications using modern cloud infrastructure, including cloud\-native architecture, deployment automation, and production operations. * Proficiency with modern frontend and backend programming languages, with the ability to quickly learn and contribute to new technologies. * Experience designing and working with relational databases, SQL, REST APIs, and common application integration patterns. * Practical experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools, containerization, and modern deployment technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent solutions. * Strong engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, observability, secure software development, debugging, and production incident response. * Experience making architectural decisions, independently owning complex systems, and helping other engineers improve through technical guidance and mentorship. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software development tools and the ability to use them effectively while critically evaluating generated code for accuracy, security, and maintainability. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering, product, and other business functions. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *\*\*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor or transfer visas at this time.* **Although not required, we’d love to see roots in:** * Production experience with **Python and TypeScript**, ideally including frameworks such as FastAPI, React, or similar technologies. * Experience developing geospatial or data\-intensive applications, including GIS, spatial databases such as PostGIS, mapping technologies, or large\-scale scientific data pipelines. * Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities, large language models, or agentic workflows into production software applications. * Experience thriving in a small, fast\-moving engineering team where individuals take broad ownership, adapt to changing priorities, and work closely with stakeholders to solve technical and business challenges. **Aside from “the green”, we can offer you:** * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance \- 90% funded by EarthOptics for benefit\-eligible employees and 55% for dependents * Company\-paid LTD, STD, and Life Insurance * Meaningful equity option grants * 401k Plan \+ Employer Match up to 4% * Tenured PTO Accrual Policy starting with 17 days of paid time off per year, * 11 Paid Company Holidays **Equal Opportunity and Inclusion at EarthOptics:** EarthOptics is an equal opportunity employer, and we stand against any form of discrimination or harassment. We base all hiring and promotion decisions on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or family status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are deeply committed to welcoming and including every qualified individual. As part of this commitment, we provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs. If you require assistance during the job application or interview process, need support to perform essential job functions, or seek other benefits and privileges of employment, please reach out to us at accommodations@earthoptics.com. Your assignments are more than tasks and busy work; they're your chance to drive innovation in intelligent power management and shape the future of our company. You'll team up with seasoned leaders, gaining diverse experiences that'll drive you forward to define and reach your career goals. **What sets our Early Career Programs apart:** * **Personalized Program Experience:** We’re committed to energizing your career and empowering your impact. No two participants share the same experience or set of responsibilities. * **Broad Exposure:** Diverse work locations and comprehensive customer portfolios are a required part of the adventure, enhancing your learning and maximizing program benefits. * **Role Exploration:** Gain insight into various careers within Eaton through extensive services that ensure safe, efficient, and reliable power systems at every stage. * **Strategic Networking:** Benefit from networking and mentorship opportunities within one of North America's largest and most experienced power distribution service organizations. * **Tangible Learning:** See firsthand how Eaton is powering the future of Power Distribution through real world application and customer service. * **In a Switchgear Modernization role,** you’ll build hands\-on technical expertise by testing, troubleshooting, analyzing, and improving real\-world power systems while collaborating with engineers, manufacturing teams, and customers to solve complex electrical challenges. **It’s time to make connections, get energized, and power ahead.** Eaton provides a competitive total rewards package commensurate with applicable skills, knowledge, and experience and consistent with internal and external market practices. jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **We are designing the grid of the future!**Electric Power Engineers, Inc. (EPE) is seeking a Senior Fullstack Software Developer to be part of the FAST product team. In this role, you will work alongside senior developers and engineers to help develop, maintain, and deploy cutting\-edge cloud\-based solutions for scaling transmission power systems engineering processes for both EPE and our clients. You will have opportunities to work with the latest technologies and contribute to a growing portfolio of products that are helping shape the future of power systems. Responsibilities: **How you can make an impact****:*** Collaborate with the software team to design, develop, test, and deploy cloud\-based software solutions for the energy sector. * Assist in maintaining and enhancing existing applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. * Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, coding, testing, and deployment. * Work with cutting\-edge technologies like Python, React, Typescript, Docker, and Kubernetes. * Contribute to code reviews, bug fixes, and performance tuning to ensure high\-quality deliverables. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, data science, and business teams, to ensure seamless integration and delivery of products. * Contribute to the design and build of agentic skills and processes that speed time to market and improve code contribution, safely. * Continuously learn new technologies and approaches to software development. Qualifications: **Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:*** Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or a similar technical field or Bachelor of Power System Engineering and 4\+ years working in a software engineering capacity. * Minimum 5\+ years of experience developing software or SaaS product. * Minimum 3\+ years of Python experience specifically in the design on FastAPI based REST services, and the python ecosystem * Minimum 4\+ years of React experience specifically in a fullstack capacity for the development of SaaS / CloudBased applications. * Demonstrated contribution to at least one enterprise client facing application * Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control (e.g., Git). * Strong understanding of software development principles, algorithms, and data structures. * Good problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Proven capability to mentor and provide support to Junior Developers. * Ability to dive into new codebases, generate data\-driven decisions for refactoring opportunities, and contribute code. * Knowledge of cloud\-based solutions, specifically AWS. * Power Systems Engineering experience preferred. **Lead the Change!** Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy. **How we support you:*** Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you * Generous PTO and paid holidays * MyShare Employee Ownership Program * Work with industry leaders * 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1\) ***Location***: This position will be remote US or Canada***Travel***: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less) *EPE is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Systems & Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the Role** This is a software role focused on data systems at EMA. You'll help build the infrastructure software that stores and organizes synthetic data from our physics solvers, make five decades of engineering reports searchable and useful, and help build an internal knowledge AI that captures engineering know\-how and connects it to our software. Most of your time will go to software development. You'll also play a real part in a major infrastructure project: moving our storage and core IT services into our new data center space. You'll work alongside our infrastructure team and learn as you go, which is a great chance to see how data systems work from the hardware up to the application. **What You'll Do** *Data systems and software (about 70–80%)* * Help build and maintain the data infrastructure software behind our synthetic solver data for Physics AI. * Help build the data foundation for an internal knowledge AI tool. This means capturing and structuring engineering insights, indexing them for retrieval, and managing access controls so the tool only reaches the data and EMA software it's permitted to. * Digitize, index, and improve search across about 50 years of technical reports and engineering files. *Infrastructure* * Help plan and carry out the migration of file storage to Dell PowerScale OneFS. This includes data moves, share and permission mapping, and checking that everything arrived intact. * Support moving IT services into our new data center space. * Serve as backup to the infrastructure team for issues with the systems behind the data warehouse. * Document systems and procedures as you go. **What We're Looking For** * A BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, and C\+\+. * SQL, graph databases, and basic data modeling. * Exposure to LLM tooling: retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, or MCP. * Git and general software engineering practices: testing, code review, writing things down. * Working comfort with Linux and Windows environments and basic networking concepts (DNS, subnets, VPNs). * Curiosity, and the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems on your own.

jobs.title: Principal AI Architect
jobs.description: **Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting opportunity open for a **Principal AI Architect.** **Job Summary** The Principal AI Architect is a hands\-on individual contributor who owns the AI technical function at ElevatePFS, including the technical vision, the architecture, and the quality and cost of the solutions the company builds with AI. The role serves as the company's deepest AI technical authority and reports to the VP, AI \& Automation. ElevatePFS is building its AI, automation, and intelligence capabilities in\-house on a centralized Databricks data platform. Business and product leaders define the problems worth solving. The Principal AI Architect determines whether AI is the right tool for each problem and, if so, designs the solution, builds it, and runs it in production. Training foundation models from scratch is the only work outside the scope of the role. The position is expected to grow into Head of AI Engineering as the team develops. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Set the technical vision and roadmap for AI with the VP, AI \& Automation, giving leadership a clear view of feasibility, value, cost, and risk. * Partner with the Product delivery team to turn workflow problems and improvement opportunities identified in the field into scoped, feasible AI and application opportunities. * Decide which parts of each solution should be deterministic (rules, parsers, schema validation, SQL, classical ML) and which should be dynamic (LLM reasoning, agentic tool use), using LLMs where inputs are ambiguous and plain code elsewhere. * Recommend build versus buy and closed versus open models for each solution, and track new models and tooling. * Design single\-agent and multi\-agent systems, including routing, planner/executor patterns, tool calling and MCP, state and memory, durable execution, retries, idempotency, human approval gates, and tool permission scoping. * Define with Product what the application needs to support AI in daily use, such as changed screens, wizards, intelligent interfaces, and approval steps. * Build and tune retrieval\-augmented generation end to end, including parsing, chunking, embedding selection and fine\-tuning, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, vector search with Delta index sync, and grounded citations. * Build knowledge graphs and ontology\-driven retrieval, including entity resolution and GraphRAG\-style hybrids, in partnership with the Data organization. * Develop document intelligence for contracts, payment files, and correspondence, including OCR, layout\-aware parsing, table and field extraction, and multimodal models. * Design the Databricks data layout that AI depends on, including medallion architecture, Delta table design, liquid clustering, Change Data Feed, Unity Catalog governance and lineage, and feature and serving tables. * Select models by task, accuracy, latency, cost, and data\-handling constraints, fine\-tune where it pays off (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference tuning), and distill into smaller, lower\-cost models. * Deploy and serve models on Databricks Model Serving and self\-hosted inference such as vLLM, and manage the lifecycle in MLflow, including tracking, tracing, registry, release management, and CI/CD for models, prompts, and agents with shadow, canary, and A/B rollouts. * Build evaluation and monitoring tied to business outcomes, including golden datasets, field\-level precision, recall, and F1, retrieval metrics, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge calibrated to human labels, release\-gating regression suites, and production drift and agent\-trace monitoring. * Own token and compute spend through routing and cascading, prompt and semantic caching, context compression, batch inference, smaller models, an AI gateway, and cost attribution per agent and workflow. * Measure ROI and adoption for every AI initiative and recommend whether to scale, rework, or retire it. * Defend against prompt injection, tool\-based data exfiltration, and over\-permissioned agents through least privilege, guardrails, PII/PHI redaction, and full audit logging. * Work with the AI Center of Excellence, Information Security, Compliance, and Legal on model approval and data\-handling standards, including standards for PHI. * Lead the technical build from design through production, write the specs, patterns, and standards for everyone building AI at ElevatePFS, and review code, prompts, and evaluations from employees, contractors, and vendors. * Hand off completed designs to the Product delivery team, who own implementation and adoption, and provide the specs and guidance they need. * Keep the intelligence the company builds documented, understood, and owned internally. * Mentor engineers, help recruit the AI engineering team that forms around the role, and explain technical tradeoffs clearly to executives. * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications and Requirements** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities. * 10\+ years of experience in software, data, or ML engineering, including 7\+ years in machine learning with increasing scope. * Strong current Python and SQL skills, with the ability to build, test, and debug AI systems personally. * Production experience with LLM agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, closed and open\-weight models, fine\-tuning, and model deployment. * Record of proving ROI, controlling AI cost, and choosing well between deterministic and LLM\-driven design. * Experience securing AI systems in regulated or sensitive\-data environments. * Record of setting technical direction that others executed, including across employees, contractors, and vendors. * Preferred: Healthcare, healthcare IT, or revenue cycle management background, including HIPAA and PHI\-compliant AI deployment. * Preferred: Knowledge graph or ontology experience, and document intelligence or claims and contract extraction experience. * Preferred: Deep Databricks and MLflow experience, including Delta, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, and Vector Search. * Preferred: Azure, event\-driven architecture, and workflow automation or RPA experience. * Preferred: Experience standing up an AI Center of Excellence or internal AI platform. **Benefits** ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees – the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well\-being of our employees and their families. * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * 401K (100% match for the first 3% \& 50% match for the next 2%) * 15 days of PTO * 7 paid Holidays * 2 Floating holidays * 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday) * Pet Insurance * Employee referral bonus program * Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together * Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage. The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and Employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change. **ElevatePFS is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Associate Director - Technical Product Owner, HCP Customer Master Data Platforms
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Come be a part of being a team that is at critical to the launch of lifesaving medicines! The Customer Technology Innovation team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, to raise awareness and to gain access to medicines for appropriate patients. With a deep technical and business understanding, working across all therapeutic areas/disease states, we design and implement digital solutions to power our business, creating world\-class customer experiences that improve patient outcomes and deliver business results. Key to creating those experiences is the data we collect, analyze, and translate into insights. We’re on an exciting journey to transform our customer data foundation and ‘change the game’ for our business through innovation such as artificial intelligence\- both in data and in experiences. The ideal candidate will have a passion for the customer data technology landscape and will be ready to thrive in an organization with a “start\-up” mentality. What You'll Be Doing! As Technical Product Owner for HCP Customer Master Data Platforms, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating ideation, design \& development of solutions supporting Lilly's HCP Customer Master Data with a focus on leading data onboarding and modernization, data quality \& customer data transformation workstreams (including entity resolution, matching and survivorship rules, and data stewardship). You will be accountable for ensuring that our products are powering our HCP customer data strategy and embedding key technology breakthroughs such as automation \& AI, while leading the charge in security\-by\-design, privacy\-by\-design, and DevOps (CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and automated testing). To do that, you will need to flex skills in understanding and analyzing business processes, consulting and advising on technical options, constantly researching new technologies, and effectively partnering with our software engineers and architects on best practices and how to leverage exciting new technology such as GenAI. * Accountable for the prioritization of product backlogs / new items across Customer Master Data products in alignment with our key business owners, Lead Team, and Governance, balancing business value against technical dependencies, platform capacity, and technical debt * Understand business requirements and effectively translate business needs and process into detailed product technical requirements and user stories, including data models, source\-to\-target mappings, matching rules, and acceptance criteria * Partner with technical subject matter experts on complex solutions; drive technical design review and ensure all relevant technical tasks are completed end\-to\-end for data integrations \& data products (batch, API, and event\-based), including architecture, security, and privacy reviews * Plan, analyze, configure (hands\-on), and test business solutions in response to business needs, using SQL, Python, and Databricks notebooks for data profiling, validation, and troubleshooting * Define and lead the future state customer data strategy and provide technical guidance and coaching to developers and engineers on the team * Accountable to drive digital innovation, continuous improvement, and automation, at scale, and serve as a change agent throughout the organization * Influence external vendors (including MDM, data quality, and data platform vendors), work alongside many other internal IT teams (e.g., EI\&P, other Solution Services teams and Dedicated groups) and partner with our business colleagues (e.g., Global Customer Operations, US Commercial Operations, Computer Systems Quality Assurance, Global Transparency). * Define and enforce data quality standards, metrics, and monitoring (for example completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and match rates), and drive root\-cause remediation with source system owners * Ensure data governance alignment, including lineage, cataloging, access controls, and secure handling of PII/HCP data in line with GDPR, CCPA, and Lilly privacy and cybersecurity standards * Partner with Computer Systems Quality Assurance to ensure solutions are validated and compliant with GxP and computer system validation requirements * Evaluate and pilot AI/GenAI capabilities (for example ML\-based entity matchin ior business stakeholders * Hands\-on experience designing, building, or owning ETL/ELT data pipelines on a cloud platform (AWS or Azure), with working knowledge of Databricks and Apache Spark and of integrating them with varied data sources and storage * Strong SQL and data modeling skills; working knowledge of Python for data profiling, validation, and automation * Working knowledge of database and analytics architecture, including integration patterns (batch, API, event streaming) and warehouse/lakehouse concepts * Working knowledge of data quality, data governance, and master data management concepts (matching, survivorship, stewardship, lineage) * Experience working in Agile methodologies such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and applying DevOps practices (CI/CD, version control) * Experience working in a regulated industry \- pharmaceutical preferred * Experience working with Marketing, data and/or Market Research solutions * Experience with business intelligence / data visualization solutions such as Tableau or PowerBI * Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts such as LLMs, NLP/NLG and predictive/prescriptive modeling, including applying GenAI and ML to data quality, entity matching, and stewardship use cases * Able to act as change agent and to take ownership of issues or opportunities until a proper solution is implemented * Experience with MDM platforms (for example Reltio, Informatica, or Veeva Network) and HCP/HCO reference data sources * Experience with data governance, catalog, and lineage tools, and with data quality frameworks * Familiarity with GxP and computer system validation in a regulated environment Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $129,000 \- $189,200 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company\-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well\-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees. \#WeAreLilly

jobs.title: Associate AI Deployment Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **Job Summary** =============== The Associate AI Deployment Manager executes scoped work inside client AI engagements, helping turn discovery into useful product delivery or client adoption. We’re interested in candidates with depth in either of two areas: Build, helping organize product definition and delivery with engineering teams; or Enablement, helping client teams learn and apply AI through training, workshops, and workflow development. You’ll work with an AI Deployment Manager or other workstream owner who sets direction and priorities. You’ll own assigned tasks and delivery artifacts, keep progress visible, and raise questions and blockers early. You are not expected to arrive with expertise in both Build and Enablement; you’ll have opportunities to learn across the full AI Deployment craft. Eliza is AI\-native: you will use AI tools across discovery, requirements, workshop preparation, workflow building, and client communication, and explain where they help and where they fall short. Client work moves quickly and can change as new information emerges; we value sound judgment, clear communication, and reliable follow\-through. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. Turn discovery into clear plans and artifacts** ----------------------------------------------------- * Participate in stakeholder and user discovery; document workflows, needs, constraints, and desired outcomes. * Translate conversation and research into clear requirements, user stories, workshop plans, decision logs, product roadmaps, and next steps for the workstream owner. * Maintain current use\-case and action trackers so priorities, dependencies, and open questions stay visible. **2\. Build: keep product and delivery work moving** ---------------------------------------------------- * Maintain backlogs, requirements, roadmaps, and delivery artifacts as client needs and priorities change. * Coordinate practical dependencies with client partners, designers, and engineers, such as data, access, calendars, and decisions. * Run test sets or evaluation steps when needed; log failure modes and summarize evidence for review. **3\. Enablement: prepare and deliver practical learning** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Prepare and help facilitate trainings, persona\-specific workshops, and office hours for client teams. * Build and refine exercises, prompts, skills, and workflows with client champions; document how to use them, known limitations, and review needs. * Gather participant feedback and update learning materials and follow\-up actions based on what users need. **4\. Make progress and outcomes visible** ------------------------------------------ * Track delivery progress and adoption signals such as usage, realized business outcomes, and time savings; distinguish measured results from early indications. * Prepare concise client readouts on progress, decisions, risks, and next steps. * Keep notes, action items, workshop materials, and assigned engagement artifacts current. **5\. Work well across the delivery team** ------------------------------------------ * Coordinate with client stakeholders and Eliza delivery partners to keep assigned work on track. * Raise blockers, feasibility concerns, and risks early so the workstream owner can respond. * Use feedback and evidence to improve the work and contribute reusable delivery or learning assets. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ You should bring meaningful experience in at least one of the following areas. Experience across both is welcome but not required. **Build background** -------------------- * Experience in product, consulting, technical program management, customer success, or a related setting, with examples of turning conversations into requirements, plans, or delivery artifacts. * Strong organization and follow\-through across tasks, backlogs, dependencies, testing, or client workstreams. **Enablement background** ------------------------- * Experience in client\-facing delivery, training, facilitation, learning and development, adoption, or a related setting. * Ability to prepare clear learning materials, explain AI in practical terms, and help users apply new tools in their workflows. **Shared strengths** -------------------- * Strong AI fluency: practical use of current AI tools and a working understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and safeguards. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work with business stakeholders and technical teams without jargon or overselling. * Human\-centered design mindset: translate user needs into intuitive AI experiences, apply sound UX judgment, and use research and testing to refine solutions. * Sound organization, reliable follow\-through, comfort with changing needs, and a habit of asking sharp questions and escalating early. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience across both Build and Enablement. * Hands\-on experience with prompts, skills, or lightweight automations; or experience designing training content or facilitating workshops. * Exposure to enterprise software delivery, including requirements, backlogs, sprints, QA, or evaluation work. **How we’ll know it’s working** =============================== * Competitive compensation (base salary \+ performance incentives tied to client outcomes). * Equity options in a growing AI services company. * Exposure to a wide range of industries and high\-impact AI problems. * Travel opportunities for on\-site client engagements (if desired). * Deliver inside real client engagements and build the full AI Deployment craft through hands\-on work. * Work with client teams on practical AI products, workflows, and adoption. * Partner with AI Deployment Managers, engineers, client champions, and leaders. * Contribute to reusable playbooks, workshop materials, and delivery assets.

jobs.title: Associate Systems Engineer (Union College of Union County, NJ)
jobs.description: Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes. **\*\*\*onsite at Union College of Union County, NJ\*\*\*** We’re looking for an **Associate Systems Engineer** to build and maintain the automations that move data between the University’s core systems. Much of the work involves connecting cloud services to one another and to our on\-premises environment, replacing manual processes with reliable, monitored, and documented automation. The role requires hands\-on experience with JavaScript, JSON, APIs, and web services, as well as strong PostgreSQL/SQL skills for report writing, data analysis, querying, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will be expected to develop and maintain integrations, transform and validate data, create and maintain SQL\-based reports, and ensure reliable communication between systems. **Where you will make an impact** * Build and maintain integrations between cloud and on\-premises systems using APIs, web services, and integration platforms. * Meet with staff across the College to understand existing business processes and requirements before designing and automating solutions. * Design and create forms and automated workflows using Ellucian Intelligent Processes and Integration Management. * Write SQL/PostgreSQL queries and develop reports using College data sources to support operational and business needs. * Monitor running integrations and automations, troubleshoot errors, and resolve failures to ensure reliable data processing. * Document integrations, workflows, data mappings, and processes to support ongoing maintenance and operational continuity. **What you will bring** * Experience in a business analytics role including: process definition, management and monitoring, release management, web experience, database, SAP Business Objects. * Experienced in creating Business Requirement Documents, User Requirement Specification, and Functional Requirement Specifications. Experienced in creating Data Flow Diagrams, Use Cases, State Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, Component Diagrams, Use Case Diagrams \& Activity diagrams. * Experience with Data Governance, Data Standards, or other data management business processes * Design and delivering reporting capabilities to end\-users. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Teamwork focused/collaborative work style. * Ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. **Nice to have** * The ability to present ideas to both technical and functional staff. * The ability to quickly learn new software applications. * Experience in using Ellucian Colleague or other Student Information Systems. * Experience in using SAP Business Objects or other Business Intelligence tools. * Experience in managing large and complex projects. **About the team** Ellucian is the leading technology provider for higher education. Through our Strategic Consulting \& Managed Services division, we operate as the full IT organization for institutions across the country. This role is with our dedicated team at Union College of Union County, NJ, a two\-year community college in Cranford, NJ. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: **LiveX AI · Senior Product Manager** Palo Alto, CA · Full\-time, in\-person · Department: Product · Reports to: CEO Source: https://livex.ai/careers/senior\-product\-manager (posted Oct 17, 2026\) ### **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI builds human\-AI interfaces for physical spaces (stores, hotels, hospitals, airports, stadiums). Its 4K full\-body AI agents speak 140 languages, show products in 3D, and run on\-prem or in the cloud. Developed with NVIDIA on the AI City initiative; live with Walmart, PUMA, and the NFL Super Bowl. LiveX builds every layer in\-house (IP design, hardware, interaction, enterprise AI agent, deployment) with two form factors: Gateway (freestanding, life\-size) and Portal (wall\-mounted, shelf edge). Early\-stage startup in Palo Alto. ### **About the Role** Own the end\-to\-end customer experience across LiveX's hardware and software, from a passerby noticing a device to the customer leaving with their question answered. Set quality standards, find gaps between what ships and what should ship, prioritize fixes, and drive design and engineering to polished launches. The product is already live with customers; the job is to improve it and make each launch succeed. Works directly with the CEO (who owns product) and the founders leading AI and engineering. ### **Responsibilities** * Own the end\-to\-end experience across hardware (screen, camera, microphones, speakers, mounting, installation) and software (character, conversation, touch/voice interface, 3D content, enterprise AI agent, admin portal) as one product. * Set experience quality standards for each journey step (approach, greeting, conversation, product display, handoff, error recovery) with measurable targets: response latency, recognition accuracy, conversation completion, uptime, time to install. * Identify gaps by visiting live deployments, running walk\-up tests, reviewing conversation logs and customer feedback, auditing new builds; maintain a ranked list of what is broken, rough, or missing. * Prioritize fixes: build a sequenced roadmap and decide between fixes, polish, and new features, backed by field evidence. * Drive design and engineering to delivery: write specs and acceptance criteria, run the product review cadence, remove blockers, hold the team to a high bar. * Drive launch readiness for every release and customer go\-live: readiness checklists, go/no\-go decisions, on\-site or remote acceptance, day\-one monitoring, fast post\-launch fixes. No release reaches a customer floor without your sign\-off. * Close the loop with customers: work with sales, deployment, and customer success to turn field issues into product fixes and fixes into customer updates. * Represent the user across all five layers of the stack. ### **Requirements** * 4–8 years of product management experience, including several years on hardware\-plus\-software products (devices, kiosks, robotics, consumer electronics, in\-venue technology). * Early\-stage startup experience (seed to Series B, under \~50 people), owning a product end to end without a product team behind you. * Track record of taking products from working to polished, where quality rather than scope was the deliverable. * Product judgment for walk\-up physical experiences using touch, voice, and large screens in public spaces. * Experience with AI or conversational products and a clear method for measuring quality in probabilistic systems. * Writes clear specs, acceptance criteria, and readiness checklists; works from logs, metrics, and dashboards. * Field orientation: has personally run site acceptance in stores, lobbies, or stadiums. * Credibility with engineers and designers: technical enough to debate tradeoffs, design\-literate enough to judge finished work. * Required: hands\-on use of AI tools in your own work (analysis, prototyping, writing). * Required: proactive — spots gaps before others report them, proposes fixes, drives them forward unasked. * Ownership and a clear point of view on what the product should be. * Able to work on\-site in Palo Alto; lives in or will relocate to the SF Bay Area. *Product judgment and a high quality bar are the most important hiring criteria.* ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * **Strongly preferred:** launch or quality ownership for a hardware\-plus\-software product deployed at scale in retail, hospitality, healthcare, or venues, especially across many sites. * Digital human, avatar, voice assistant, or conversational AI products. * Hardware programs: build validation, manufacturing partners, installation, field service. * End\-to\-end product ownership in a startup or small team. ### **Compensation** Not listed. ### **How to Apply (original posting)** Email resume and a short note to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application \- Senior Product Manager".
