You will work closely with the System Engineers assigned to your project, and also cross\-functionally with the Sales, Product and Engineering teams (to name a few). You should be a self starter who is proud to strive for excellence in all you do. ### **What you'll do** * Accountable for the successful execution, management, and delivery of customer projects, ensuring adherence to scope and schedule. * Create, maintain and update project plans, tracking all tasks, milestones, risks, and issues throughout the delivery process. * Managing and owning all projects for three customers. * Take full ownership of a number of customer projects, managing all aspects of these projects from initiation to completion. * Lead all customer communication, fostering a close working relationship. * Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and concerns. * Track customer\-facing tasks to ensure visibility and accountability. * Provide innovative and effective solutions to address challenges encountered during project execution * Collaborate cross\-functionally to deliver projects within agreed scope and timelines, engaging with internal teams such as product development, implementation, and customer support * Work closely with the Sales team and senior members of the delivery team to manage customer expectations regarding project delivery, providing regular updates on project progress. * Coordinate all reporting with sales, customer success and data teams. * Access historical project data to facilitate accurate forecasting and decision\-making. * Assist with coordinating system performance analysis with technical and data teams, ensuring the successful integration and functionality of customer systems. * Create and coordinate Jira tickets to track project tasks internally across delivery and other departments, maintaining project updates in Salesforce. * Utilize technical expertise to translate customer requirements into actionable features for technical teams. * Assist with the management ongoing deployments and upgrades, integrating them seamlessly into existing projects. Ensure deployments are completed on time and within scope. * Collaborate with customers to test and validate new features, gathering feedback for improvement. * Work closely with Product Teams to incorporate customer feedback into product development. ### **Collaborating with** * Everseen’s Sales Team, Product team, and Engineering Team, our customers and our employees ### **Profile and Skills** * You have 2 to 3 years experience in a similar role working with projects in a global matrixed organisation. * Demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple complex customer projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and meeting project objectives. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum tools like JIRA, providing an advantage in managing projects within dynamic and iterative environments. * Proactive self\-starter with the capacity to engage in multiple initiatives concurrently. Adaptable to changing project requirements and able to anticipate and address potential issues promptly. * Keen interest in Everseen's technology solutions, comfortable discussing solutions at a high level, and staying updated with the latest developments. * Demonstrates initiative, drive, and self\-motivation in taking full ownership of projects and the customer ensuring accountability for project outcomes, and fostering a no\-blame culture conducive to continuous improvement. * Possesses in\-depth problem\-solving skills and exercises good judgment, capable of navigating and resolving complex situations effectively. * Highly organized with excellent organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision in project execution and documentation. * Travel Readiness: Willingness to travel as needed for client meetings, project kick\-offs, or other project\-related activities. * A relevant degree qualification is preferred. * A Project Management qualification (Prince2, PMP etc.) is preferred. **About****Everseen** ===================== Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience. Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily. Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world \- including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths \- we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain. We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver. Our Culture Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer\-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions. We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact. Our Values We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses. We ARE CUSTOMER\-FIRST. They guide our decisions. We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit. We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality. We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact. **Our Commitment** ------------------ Everseen is committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. We treat each other with dignity, and respect, and require all employees, officers, and directors to seek to understand the importance and value to Everseen of diversity, and inclusion. Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature. Everseen will not tolerate prejudice or discrimination of any kind including without limitation, where based on aspects such as, race, colour, sex, gender, religion, age, family status, disability of any kind, sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Network DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Evolver is seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer who has transitioned into network automation development. In this role, you will engineer and operate our hybrid on\-premises and Microsoft Azure network environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in enterprise Cisco routing and switching and will now deliver the majority of their work through code, automating software upgrades, configuration changes, and validation using Python, Terraform, Azure DevOps pipelines, and AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code. This role requires deep technical fluency across on\-premises and cloud networking, a developer's approach to operational work, and sound judgment in applying AI tooling. Success in this role depends on close collaboration with our existing network engineers to understand, translate, and automate their current workflows. The position is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and includes participation in an after\-hours on\-call rotation. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and build automation that performs network software upgrades, configuration changes, compliance checks, and remediation across on\-premises and Azure environments. * Develop and maintain Python and Terraform codebases that provision, validate, and standardize network configurations, with all code version\-controlled in Azure DevOps Repos. * Build and operate CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps that test, validate, and deploy network changes, including automated pre\- and post\-change checks and rollback workflows. * Leverage AI development tools, including Claude Code, to generate, refactor, test, and document automation code and operational runbooks. * Partner with existing network engineers to understand current operational workflows, translate them into automated, code\-based processes, and support the team's adoption of new tooling. * Automate against vendor platforms and APIs, including Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco SD\-WAN vManage, Azure Resource Manager, F5, ThousandEyes, and Forward Networks. * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco routing, switching, SD\-WAN, firewall (Firepower/FTD), wireless, and F5 load balancing infrastructure across branch and data center sites. * Design and operate Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, and Azure Firewall, delivered through Terraform wherever possible. * Deploy and manage ThousandEyes agents and tests to provide end\-to\-end visibility into WAN, internet, and third\-party connectivity, and integrate results into alerting and automation workflows. * Integrate Forward Networks verification into change workflows for pre\-change validation, path analysis, and post\-change compliance checks. * Serve as a tier\-2 escalation point for network incidents, performing root cause analysis and driving issues to resolution. * Execute changes through established change management processes and maintain network documentation, diagrams, and IPAM records. **Basic Qualifications** * 8 years of hands\-on enterprise DevOps Engineering experience, including recent experience in a network automation or NetDevOps role. * 8 years of experience engineering and automating networks in large enterprise environments. * 5 years of production experience with Versa or Cisco SD\-WAN, Cisco firewalls (Firepower or FTD), and Cisco wireless (Catalyst 9800 or AireOS controllers). * 5 years of production experience delivering infrastructure as code with Terraform, using Git\-based pull request and code review workflows. * 5 years of experience with Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, and Azure Firewall. * 5 years of Python development skills, including automating network operations through REST APIs on vendor controllers such as Catalyst Center, Nexus Dashboard, vManage, Azure Resource Manager, and F5\. * 5 years of experience working with Cisco switching and routing, including VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, HSRP/VRRP, and QoS. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Cisco Certified DevNet Expert or CCIE Automation (Written and Lab) **Preferred Qualifications** * Background in financial services technology environments, including exposure to Bloomberg, CRD, Eagle, or similar platforms. * Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps, including Repos and YAML Pipelines, to build and run CI/CD for infrastructure changes. * Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate productivity, including regular use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, with sound judgment about when output requires verification. * Experience with monitoring and assurance platforms such as ThousandEyes, Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, and Forward Networks. * Working knowledge of Forescout or a comparable network access control platform (Cisco ISE, Aruba ClearPass). * Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with network engineers to translate established workflows into code and build support for automation across the team. * Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills. * Experience building AIOps pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, or LLM\-assisted workflows for network or infrastructure operations. * Exposure to data center technologies, including VXLAN/EVPN and Nexus 9000 fabrics, or experience supporting Zero Trust and micro\-segmentation initiatives. * Experience working in ITIL\-aligned environments with formal change and incident management. Evolver is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Actual salary will depend on factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, market and work location. Evolver offers benefits, including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending account, and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave) in accordance with our applicable plans and policies. The annual salary for this position in the San Francisco Bay Area is $185,000 \- $190,000\.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Software Development Engineer II** **Introduction to the team** Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Software Development Engineer II position is part of the Servicing team, which builds the agentic AI systems that power traveler self\-service experiences across all Expedia brands and partners. In this role, you will design, build, and operate the agents and supporting infrastructure that enable travelers to resolve complex servicing needs end\-to\-end — without human intervention. This includes working on agent orchestration, tool integration, LLM\-powered reasoning pipelines, and the backend services that make these experiences reliable at scale. You will collaborate closely with Product, XD, and Program Management to shape both the technical direction and the traveler experience. As an SDE II, you will own features end\-to\-end, contribute to technical design, and help raise the bar for engineering quality through rigorous testing, observability, and operational excellence. **In this role, you will:** * Design, implement, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure services and components using Expedia Group's standard technologies, including clean APIs, robust data models, and well\-factored low\-level designs. * Deliver high\-quality production code through test automation, code reviews, and continuous integration practices, contributing to services that operate reliably at scale across multiple products or domains. * Collaborate with peers, product managers, technical program managers, and other partners to refine requirements, break down complex problems, and deliver incremental value in an Agile environment. * Instrument services to monitor performance, reliability, and availability; triage and resolve production issues; and participate in on\-call or support activities to improve system stability and operational excellence. * Apply secure coding practices, follow engineering standards and patterns, and contribute to improving shared libraries, tooling, or platforms that accelerate development for multiple teams. Work with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows to enhance developer productivity and product capabilities, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes. * **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience in software development. * Professional experience in software engineering building, testing, and operating backend, frontend, or full\-stack services or applications, including ownership of at least one significant service or feature in production. * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language used at Expedia Group and familiarity with service\-oriented or microservices architectures, including API design, data modeling, and low\-level system design. * Experience with standard software engineering practices such as version control, automated testing, code review, debugging, and monitoring in a collaborative, Agile team environment. Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products. * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing and evolving services or components that support multiple use cases or products, including effective API contracts, data models, and integration patterns across teams. * Track record of improving performance, reliability, or cost efficiency of production systems through data\-driven analysis, observability, and systematic incident prevention and resolution. * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and configuration management to confidently build, release, and operate services at scale. * Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-assisted development tools, code generation, or intelligent automation to improve engineering velocity while maintaining code quality and safety. * Experience incorporating or consuming AI/ML‑enabled capabilities within applications or services, including safely integrating and operating these solutions in production environments. \#LI\-DNI The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $119,000\.00 to $166,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $190,500\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer (Remote in CA)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of the First American family of companies, First American Trust is a federal savings bank that has provided banking, wealth management, and trust solutions on a national, full\-service basis for more than five decades. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to design and implement secure, scalable, cloud\-native software solutions that power next\-generation financial applications. In this role, you will contribute hands\-on development while supporting architecture and design decisions across modern web applications, APIs, and distributed services. If you are passionate about exploring new technologies and have a demonstrated track record of delivering innovative features and products, we would like to hear from you. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Product, Architecture, UX, DevOps, and Security, to design, develop, and integrate AI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent automation, LLM\-powered services, RAG\-based solutions, and API\-driven AI integrations. You will help translate emerging ideas into reliable, production\-ready systems that deliver measurable business value. This position offers the opportunity to work with a talented team while operating autonomously with minimal supervision. A strong background in modern software development, cloud platforms, and agile methodologies is essential. Experience building, integrating, or operating AI\-powered applications, and using AI\-assisted development tools to improve delivery, is highly valued.**What You'll Do:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable applications in an Azure cloud environment. * Build full\-stack solutions using Python, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, and microservice architectures. * Modify and enhance existing applications; contribute to product delivery through coding and pull request reviews. * Design, develop, and integrate AI\-powered capabilities, including LLM integrations, RAG, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation, using platforms such as Azure OpenAI. * Implement and maintain AI orchestration and inference pipelines, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, observability, and responsible usage. * Apply software engineering best practices (testing, monitoring, CI/CD, observability, secure SDLC) to production systems, including AI\-driven applications. * Evaluate and prototype emerging AI tools and frameworks; leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and code review. * Ensure data privacy, security, governance, and compliance when building and deploying AI\-enabled functionality. * Independently define and prioritize goals and tasks in a fast\-paced agile product environment with small, focused teams. * Collaborate with Solution Architects and stakeholders to align on design plans, troubleshoot production issues, and drive durable solutions. * Mentor engineers on software engineering best practices, cloud\-native architecture, and AI integration patterns. * Propose solutions to complex problems, build consensus among the team, and influence technical direction. **What You'll Bring:** * 5\+ years of software development experience using Python and building cloud\-native applications in Azure (AWS experience also considered). * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Experience developing modern web applications with React and JavaScript/TypeScript. * Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, software design patterns, and application architecture. * Experience designing and consuming REST APIs. * Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL). * Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring other engineers. * Experience working in Agile development environments. * Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern software development best practices. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications, including Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG, or vector databases. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes preferred. * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and business teams. * Familiar with Ruby on Rails or willing to learn it. * Experience with event\-driven architecture and messaging platforms. * Experience with application observability leveraging OpenTelemetry. **TECHNOLOGY:** Python, Azure (App Services, Functions, Azure OpenAI, AI Services), React, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API, Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server), NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, Cosmos DB), LLMs, RAG, AI APIs. **DEVELOPMENT TOOLS:** Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Windows, Azure, Git, GitLab, GitHub, Azure DevOps, NPM Package Management, CI/CD Pipelines. Pay Range: $129,300\.00 \- $172,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Fluxx is looking for a highly motivated Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our Engineering team. As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure and pipelines behind the leading grants management software for philanthropy—the platform that connects Donors and Doers. Collaborating closely with Engineering, you'll build, deploy, and secure our infrastructure while playing a key role in setting technical direction. You'll lead projects across CI/CD, our delivery and orchestration platform, and monitoring and logging. You'll also be responsible for infrastructure resilience and cloud costs as part of the team. We are looking for people who are curious, tenacious, intellectually honest, and have a bias toward action. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you think you can bring value to our team—even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. **This is a full\-time, exempt, and remote position. Candidates must be located in the United States.** **Who we are looking for:** * You debug systems and the processes around them. You are capable of resolving an incident and fixing the conditions that allowed it * You work in both software engineering and operations, understanding what runs where and how to configure the infrastructure to smoothly deliver great service to our clients * You're pragmatic. You know the vision, and deliver in steady increments toward that vision rather than waiting for perfect * You teach and guide teams to better practices. You understand Rome wasn't built in a day * You love resolving issues related to latency, scalability, and performance of core infrastructure * The thing that really floats your boat is making systems better, not just building new stuff * You bring a collaborative educational mindset * You want to work with others, learn from them, and teach your experiences * You own outcomes, not just tickets. A task is finished when the system is more reliable, not when the PR merges * You are a curious, proactive learner who explores emerging technologies and evaluates their practical application within our infrastructure **What you'll do:** * Automate our infrastructure and operational processes with infrastructure as code and standard tooling * Own our CI/CD pipelines, image builds, and GitOps deployments with ArgoCD * Keep our fleet patched and current, from OS updates to Kubernetes and managed\-service upgrades * Build monitoring and alerting that catches problems before customers do * Partner with our security team to protect our systems and customer data, support SOC 2 compliance, and work security findings through to their remediation * Build self\-serve tools for Engineering to reduce bottlenecks and dependencies * Work with engineering teams to make our services reliable, secure, and scalable * Take part in our on\-call rotation for production systems as needed **What you will bring to the team:** * 4\+ years of professional software development and infrastructure operations experience * Deep professional experience managing Kubernetes in production, including creating manifest templates for services, deployments, and other application components * Significant experience writing and using Terraform code to deploy production infrastructure on AWS * Significant experience managing the full lifecycle of AWS services such as EKS, RDS, Elasticsearch, and WAF, including version upgrades, scaling, and failover * Familiarity with Azure and cross\-cloud infrastructure * Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to streamline development workflows and use them as a force multiplier **Salary:** Fluxx is committed to fair, transparent, and equitable compensation practices. We use a market\-based approach that considers cost of labor by geographic region, along with company size and industry benchmarks. This role is categorized into three compensation tiers based on location, with the following expected annual on\-target earnings (base salary \+ commission): **San Francisco Bay Area, New York City** $185,000 \- $200,000 (SF/NY) **All other locations** $165,000 \- $180,000 The successful candidate's starting salary will be determined based on, but not limited to, (a) location; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. Fluxx is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We take a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. Locations are categorized into one of three zones based on a cost\-of\-labor index for that geographic location and our compensation philosophy. **Benefits:** Fluxx offers the following benefits for the position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; Flexible time off; Paid sick leave; 12 weeks of fully\-paid parental leave; Annual learning and development stipend; Internet stipend; One\-time home office set\-up stipend; 401(k) retirement plan with company match. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Fluxx's applicable stock plans. **More About Fluxx:** We are a people\-first and inclusive workplace committed to continuous learning. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce, and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We respect the gender, gender identity, and gender expression of our applicants and employees. It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Facilities Management eXpress** is looking for an **Engineer Manager** to join our team! At FMX, our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high\-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high\-performing, inclusive engineering culture. This is a player\-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non\-mission\-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI\-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality. **What You’ll Do:** * **Lead and grow your team:** Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth. * **Build a strong culture:** Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work. * **Clear the path:** Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction. * **Stay technical:** Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness. * **Drive AI\-first development:** Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI\-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools. * **Shape the bigger picture:** Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long\-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent. **Requirements** What we're looking for: * 2\-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS. * A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission\-critical. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others. * This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time. * A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication. * Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross\-functional collaboration. * The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day\-to\-day execution. * A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience. * Enthusiasm for FMX’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity. **Nice to Have:** * Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin) * Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) * Infrastructure as code with Terraform * Containerization with Docker * CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance * Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience **Our Tech Stack:** * .NET / C\# * React and TypeScript * React Native * Azure **The Hiring Process:** * **1\. Apply!** Submit your resume and brief application questions directly through our Workable portal to get started. * **2\. PeopleOps Phone Screen (30 min)** A introductory conversation to dive into your background, introduce you to FMX culture, and clarify core role expectations. This is also your chance to ask about compensation, benefits, and life at FMX. * **3\. Hiring Manager Conversation (60 min)** An in\-depth chat with our Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Come ready to discuss your experience, career goals, and ideal next steps, as well as to ask detailed questions about team dynamics and role expectations. * **4\. Final Interview (60 min)** A panel and peer interview designed to introduce you to key team members and explore technical alignment and collaborative fit. * **5\. Offer \& Onboarding** Once an offer is extended, we’ll initiate a standard background check to complete your onboarding process. **Benefits** **FMX Benefits** **\& Life at FMX:** * **Make a big impact:** You’ll have significant influence over the direction and future of our engineering teams, flagship product and company. We are scaling rapidly and there is a lot of room for advancement. * **Enjoy a collaborative culture and a close\-knit team:** We're a team of hard\-working, high\-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously. * **Get to hire and work with the best:** We believe in building high\-quality, well\-designed products and that requires the best talent. You’ll have the opportunity to work with and grow a highly\-talented team. * **Learn and grow in your role and outside it:** At FMX, we’re committed to improving our professional and personal selves. We bring in industry\-experts as our advisors, provide leadership training, invest in team\-building activities, and have a training budget and incentive program. Our Engineering team also dedicates 10% of their time to learning or working on projects that interest them. * **Enjoy flexible working hours:** Have a dentist appointment at 8:30 AM? Need to tack on an extra 15 minutes at lunch to squeeze in that workout? As long as you're getting your work done then our working hours are flexible. * **Work from home:** At FMX we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have two all\-company events a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high\-trust relationships with your teammates and co\-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator. **Company:** While FMX is formally founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, on the day\-to\-day, we like to think of ourselves as headquartered “in the cloud”. We develop a cloud\-based, software\-as\-a\-service facility maintenance and management product. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest\-growing companies in its space. Check us out at: https://www.gofmx.com/ *Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Employee Handbook.* FMX is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Internal Apps & AI
jobs.description: **Important:** Please use this link to apply. https://ats.rippling.com/falcon\-wealth\-planning\-careers/jobs/05b4d783\-69c4\-486c\-a27a\-ff8bfd91ad24 **About Falcon Wealth Planning, Inc.** Falcon Wealth Planning is an award\-winning, fee\-only Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) headquartered in Ontario, California, serving clients nationwide. With approximately $2 billion in assets under management and an ambitious growth strategy, Falcon is on a path to become one of the premier independent wealth management firms in the country. Our mission is simple: Help clients keep more, worry less. We believe exceptional financial planning starts with comprehensive, tax\-focused advice delivered through a true fiduciary standard. Unlike traditional brokerage firms, we do not sell products or earn commissions. Every recommendation is made solely in our clients' best interests, providing objective guidance and complete transparency. Falcon specializes in comprehensive wealth management, investment management, retirement planning, tax planning, estate planning, and financial planning for successful individuals, families, business owners, and retirees. Our advisors work collaboratively to deliver an exceptional client experience built on expertise, trust, accountability, and long\-term relationships. As we continue scaling toward $5 billion\+ in assets under management, we are investing heavily in our people, technology, leadership, and operational excellence. We are building a high\-performance culture where collaboration, continuous improvement, innovation, and client service are at the center of everything we do. Our team members have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while helping shape the future of one of the fastest\-growing independent RIAs in the industry. If you're looking to join an organization that values excellence, embraces innovation, and is committed to delivering an unmatched client experience, Falcon Wealth Planning offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping clients achieve lasting financial success. **About the Role** Instead of buying more software, we build our own internal apps, quickly, with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Replit. We already run a growing set of them: a help desk with an AI Salesforce admin agent, a partner management hub, a forms platform replacing JotForm, an account\-opening bridge from intake to Salesforce to Fidelity, advisor tools that fill client questionnaires from meeting transcripts and documents, and BD call scorecards built on Zoom Contact Center data. You will take these from fast prototypes to secure, tested, production apps the firm can rely on, and build the next ones, starting with a Falcon data warehouse that brings custodian, CRM and planning data together in one place. This is a builder role in a regulated firm. You move fast with AI, and every app still ships with sign\-in, access control, logging, tests and a way to roll back. **What you'll do** **Build and ship internal apps (about 80% of the role, with the next two areas)** * Build full\-stack web apps and automations with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Replit Agent), from a short spec or wireframe to production. * Own a growing set of internal apps, for example: an AI\-assisted help desk, a tool for managing partner relationships, digital forms that feed our CRM, a workflow that automates new\-account paperwork, planning tools that turn meeting notes and documents into client data, and dashboards that score sales calls. * Develop a CRM platform that ties into the data warehouse, so every team works from one view of each client. * Develop custom apps at the direction of management, from requirements through build, release and support. * Test and QA every release: automated tests, user acceptance testing with the requesting team, and regression checks before production. * Turn prototypes into maintainable code: clean data models, tests, code review, version control and documented deploys. * Build AI features with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude and others): document and transcript extraction, scoring, drafting and agents that propose changes for human approval. **Data warehouse, mapping and consolidation** * Design and build Falcon's data warehouse: one source of truth for custodian, Salesforce, eMoney, Zoom and document data. * Map data across systems: field\-by\-field mappings, household and account matching, and shared definitions so reports match across teams. * Build and run data pipelines from custodian feeds and APIs, with checks that catch bad, late or missing data. * Consolidate systems: retire overlapping tools, migrate their data into Falcon's own systems, and merge duplicate records. * Integrate with Salesforce, Zoom (Phone, Contact Center, Team Chat), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar) and custodian platforms such as Fidelity, Schwab, TradePMR and Interactive Brokers (IBKR). * Keep Salesforce data clean and in sync across apps. **Security, compliance and reliability** * Put every app behind company sign\-in (Google or Okta SSO) with role\-based access. * Protect client data: encryption, redaction before data reaches AI services, least\-privilege API keys and secret management. * Build in audit logs, approval steps and rollback for any app that changes production systems, to meet SEC books\-and\-records and Regulation S\-P expectations. * Monitor uptime, errors and AI usage cost, and fix issues fast. **IT systems support (about 20%)** * Support identity and access in Okta and Google Workspace, including automated onboarding and offboarding with Okta groups and Workflows. * Back up the technology team on Zoom, network and endpoint issues when needed. **Qualifications** * 4\+ years building and shipping full\-stack web apps (TypeScript or JavaScript, React or Next.js, Node or Python). * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Replit Agent, with judgment about when to trust and when to rewrite their output. * Strong SQL and data modeling in Postgres or a cloud data warehouse, including building data pipelines and mapping data between systems. * Experience consolidating systems or migrating data between platforms, including de\-duplicating and reconciling records. * Experience building on REST APIs and webhooks, and with OAuth and SSO (OIDC or SAML). * Experience shipping features on LLM APIs: prompts, structured output, evaluation and cost control. * Security habits: secret management, access control, input validation and safe handling of personal data. * Git, code review, automated tests and repeatable deploys. * Clear written communication: short specs, change notes and plain\-English updates for non\-technical staff. * Ability to pass a background check, as required for financial services employees. **Nice to have** * Snowflake, BigQuery or a similar cloud warehouse, and transformation tools such as dbt. * Google Cloud (GCP) or AWS experience: hosting apps, managed databases, storage, identity and access, and keeping cloud costs in check. * Wealth management data feeds or platforms such as BridgeFT, Milemarker or Addepar. * Salesforce development or admin experience (Apex, Flows, REST and Metadata APIs), especially Financial Services Cloud. * Zoom API experience (Phone, Contact Center, Team Chat apps). * Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Drive, Calendar). * Experience at an RIA, broker\-dealer or other SEC\-regulated firm. * Building AI agents with human approval steps, or retrieval over company documents. * Okta administration and Okta Workflows. * Familiarity with custodian platforms such as Fidelity, Schwab, TradePMR and * Interactive Brokers (IBKR). **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Competitive Base Salary:** $115,000\-130,000 * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. * **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with company match. * **Paid Time Off:** Generous PTO, paid firm holidays. * **Professional Development:** Support for continuing education, licensing, and industry conferences. Pay: $115,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it As a Staff AI Solutions Engineer at FanDuel, you will help us own the AI technical vision across the portfolio. Additionally, hold and evolve the technical vision across our governed agent layer, our strategy\-optimization engine, and our simulation environment. In this role you will make the architectural calls that set the team's direction and write the design docs and decision records that make those calls legible to everyone else. As well as, be the technical voice product that other teams trust. You will be expected to translate tradeoffs into decisions that they can act on and push back with evidence when a direction is wrong. If this describes you, read on – we want to hear from you! **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play Drive AI Into the Engineering Lifecycle * Drive the integration of our agent layer into the data engineering SDLC: requests arriving from Slack, Jira, GitHub, and PagerDuty, routed into a planning phase that produces scoped, reviewable tickets and a build phase that carries each ticket through spec, plan, build, test, PR, and documentation. * Build the environment that makes agentic engineering actually work: skills, specs, context scaffolding, shared memory, and progressive disclosure. * Extend governed, audited data access so agents operate under each user's own permissions against our data platform, with a limited blast radius by design. * Define the outer loop: continual learning, post\-run review, and agent self\-improvement that lands as reviewable pull requests rather than uncontrolled drift. Make Optimization a Product Capability * Advance our strategy\-optimization engine from proof of concept to a capability product teams request by name, and land it against real business metrics. * Partner with product to turn ambiguous business problems into optimizable ones: define the action space, the objective and utility weights that encode the tradeoffs we actually care about, and the guardrails and risk tolerance that keep the search honest. * Own the deterministic scoring backbone: versioned scorers, shared and immutable experiment definitions, blind holdout discipline. Ensure results are comparable, auditable, and cumulative across the team rather than trapped in one person's working directory. * Expand the engine to new scoring and optimization domains across the business, including generosity and promotional spend, module placement and ranking, and search relevance. * Bias toward interpretable strategies product partners can reason about, argue with, and implement without an external serving dependency. Prove Ideas Before They Ship * Mature our offline simulation environment so product hypotheses can be pre\-screened against synthetic personas built from real behavioral data, before committing scarce live A/B capacity. * Establish directional agreement between simulated and live outcomes as the credibility bar, and be honest with partners about where the simulation is and is not trustworthy. * Drive adoption of simulation as a standard input to experiment prioritization with our product partners. Turn Vision Into Work the Team Can Own * Act as the Team's technical lead: take strategic direction and decompose it into specs, skills, and tickets that individual engineers can own end to end without waiting on you. * Set the working model for an AI\-driven team. You define what a human specifies, what an agent builds, what a human reviews and raise the bar through code review, reusable patterns, and design review. * Mentor engineers across the US and Romania pods, and write clearly, since not all collaboration is synchronous. * Represent the team technically with partner engineering organizations, vendors, and external delivery partners on joint work. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * 8\+ years of software, machine learning, or AI engineering experience, including technical leadership of a system other engineers built on. * A track record of turning ambiguous business problems into measurable ones. Defining objectives, metrics, and guardrails alongside product partners rather than waiting to be handed a spec. * Demonstrated breadth: credible in a technical design review, in a product prioritization conversation, and in front of senior stakeholders. * Proven ability to decompose a vague strategic direction into workstreams that individual engineers can own autonomously. * Expert\-level Python in production settings: typing, testing, packaging, and performance awareness. * Hands\-on experience using agentic coding harnesses as real engineering tools, and designing the skills, context, tool access, and memory that make them effective. * Production LLM application experience. Agent orchestration, tool and function calling, structured output handling, and retrieval. * Strong optimization and experimentation background: search over strategy spaces, deterministic scoring, offline/online metric alignment, holdout discipline, and A/B design and interpretation. * Cloud\-native engineering on AWS, plus hands\-on work in a modern data platform such as Databricks. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience. * Knowledge of sports and/or experience working within a heavily regulated industry is a plus. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included. FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $159,000 \- $208,950 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short\-term or long\-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.*** ***It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*** \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Team** Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world\-class investors, operators, and sports \& entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next\-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. **Role Summary** Fanatics Live is building the future of live commerce for sports fans and collectors, bringing together content, community, and commerce in highly interactive digital experiences. We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to help shape and build the web and software platforms behind Fanatics Live. You'll tackle some of our most challenging technical problems while helping establish the architecture, engineering practices, and technical direction that enable our teams to move quickly and build reliably at scale. This is a highly technical individual contributor role for an engineer who enjoys being hands\-on while also creating leverage across teams. You'll partner with engineers, Product, Design, Data, and other stakeholders to turn ambitious product ideas into scalable, reliable customer experiences. **What You'll Do** * Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, high\-impact initiatives across Fanatics Live. * Design and evolve scalable architectures supporting live commerce, discovery, community interaction, and transactional experiences. * Solve complex and ambiguous engineering problems that span multiple systems, services, and teams. * Establish technical direction, reusable patterns, and engineering standards that enable teams to build faster and more reliably. * Partner with Product and Design to translate customer and business opportunities into thoughtful technical solutions. * Remain hands\-on through architecture, prototyping, implementation, code review, debugging, and solving particularly challenging engineering problems. * Identify and address scalability, reliability, security, performance, and operational risks. * Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, customer experience, technical quality, operational complexity, and long\-term platform health. * Improve observability, testing, deployment safety, performance, and resilience across critical Fanatics Live experiences. * Lead technical response to significant production issues and translate learnings into durable platform improvements. * Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and day\-to\-day technical leadership. * Build alignment across engineering teams and communicate complex technical decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical partners. **What We're Looking For** * **8\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, including experience building and operating production software at scale. * Deep expertise in modern web and software engineering, with significant experience in frontend, backend, API, distributed systems, or full\-stack development. * Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex systems involving multiple services, components, or engineering teams. * Experience leading significant technical initiatives without relying on formal people\-management authority. * Strong understanding of scalable web architectures, APIs, caching, asynchronous processing, cloud infrastructure, performance, and system reliability. * Proven ability to navigate ambiguous problems, identify the most important technical challenges, and create a clear path forward. * Strong architectural judgment and an ability to balance near\-term delivery with long\-term technical health. * Experience influencing engineering standards, architecture, or development practices beyond your immediate projects. * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical decisions and tradeoffs to a variety of audiences. * A track record of mentoring engineers and making the engineers around you more effective. **Nice to Have** * Experience building high\-scale consumer marketplaces, e\-commerce, live streaming, social/community, payments, auctions, or other real\-time digital products. * Experience building software supporting high\-profile live events or rapidly changing traffic patterns. * Experience with real\-time communication technologies and event\-driven architectures. * Experience optimizing consumer web applications for performance, reliability, and conversion. Fanatics Live brings together creators, fans, interactive live experiences, commerce, and community, making experience with real\-time and high\-scale consumer platforms particularly relevant to the role. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Senior Data Engineer \- Schaumburg** ====================================== **MISUMI** \| Data Platform **Own the data platform that MISUMI runs on** --------------------------------------------- MISUMI is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to be the go\-to owner of our Snowflake warehouse, dbt project, and data pipelines. You will be the primary data engineer, with real ownership and real influence: the models you build and the pipelines you run are what Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, and Customer Support rely on to make decisions every day. You will work hands\-on with a modern stack (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Git/GitHub) and with AI coding agents in your daily engineering work. You will also have the autonomy to take requests from intake to production, propose what we should build next, and shape safe team practices for agentic development. If you want a role where your judgment directly determines whether the business can trust its data, this is it. **Impact in this Role** ----------------------- The Senior Data Engineer is the go\-to owner of MISUMI's Snowflake warehouse, dbt project, and data pipelines. This person turns data from business and production systems into trusted, analytics\-ready models that Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, and Customer Support use to make decisions. Because this is the primary data engineering role, the accuracy, security, and reliability of the data platform, including regulated data such as CUI, depend on this person's judgment and execution. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Administer Snowflake: manage users, roles, grants, warehouses, resource monitors and security policies, and keep the environment secure, fast and cost\-efficient. * Design, build, and own dbt models (staging, intermediate, marts, and the semantic layer) that turn replicated source data into trusted, analytics\-ready tables with tests and documentation. * Build, operate, and monitor ELT pipelines from production and business systems into Snowflake, using Fivetran and related tools. Resolve connector failures, schema changes, backfills, and data\-quality issues. * Act as the team's primary technical resource for modeling and pipeline work. Take requests from intake to production independently, including scoping, estimating, and reporting status. * Translate business requirements into technical requirements and data models, and bridge the gap between business teams and technology. Ask clarifying questions, agree on metric definitions and acceptance criteria with stakeholders, and turn them into specifications the team can build and test. * Proactively identify opportunities where data, modeling, or automation can help the business get closer to its goals, and propose and prioritize them with stakeholders instead of waiting for requests. * Run an impact analysis before changing, deprecating, or removing any shared table, model, or connector. Use dbt lineage, Snowflake dependency and access metadata, and stakeholder review, and document a rollback plan. * Own the Git and GitHub workflow for the dbt project: branching standards, pull\-request review, automated tests, and deployment. * Use AI assistants and agentic workflows in daily engineering work to speed up SQL and dbt development, testing, documentation, code review, and debugging, and help set safe team practices for using them. * Find the root cause of data\-quality, performance, and pipeline problems and fix them at the source. * Tune queries, models, and warehouse usage, and advise engineers and analysts on efficient query patterns and table design. * Maintain data dictionaries, data\-flow diagrams, and schema documentation. * Lead data design sessions and technical reviews, and explain design trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Evaluate new Snowflake and dbt features and tools, and recommend improvements to the data platform. * Mentor analysts and engineers on SQL and dbt best practices. * Work with remote, cross\-functional teams across time zones. * Maintain and contribute to the Quality Management System (QMS). **Desired Traits** ------------------ **Five core skills. Candidates must show direct, hands\-on production experience in each:** * Snowflake administration and engineering: access control, warehouse sizing and cost control, query tuning, clustering, security controls, cloning, time travel, and data sharing. * dbt expert model and CI/CD. * 5\+ years working with ETL/ELT tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, Matillion, Informatica, or Talend, plus experience with pipeline orchestration. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience using agentic coding tools that work directly in the codebase (not chat\-only AI use) in daily data engineering work. This includes building agentic workflows or tool integrations for data work, such as MCP servers, custom agents, or automated dbt and pipeline checks, with concrete examples of the workflows and results. * Expert SQL, including CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning. * Daily use of Git and GitHub pull\-request workflows. * Experience being the primary or sole owner of a data platform, or the technical lead for one. * Experience administering data platforms that hold regulated data (such as CUI under NIST SP 800\-171\), including access control, audit logging, encryption, and data classification. Must be able to pass a background check and complete required CUI and security training. ### **Preferred** * Direct Fivetran experience, including connector management. * Experience with Sigma Computing, or with Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI tool. * Experience modeling ERP and CRM data, such as NetSuite or Salesforce. * Python for data tooling and automation. * Snowflake SnowPro certification or dbt certification. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience for Snowflake, such as Terraform. * Background in manufacturing, supply chain, or marketplace businesses. ### **Abilities** * Write advanced SQL on large, complex datasets, including semi\-structured data such as JSON in Snowflake VARIANT columns. * Apply data warehousing and dimensional modeling principles to turn business requirements into well\-structured, maintainable models. * Work independently: take an open\-ended problem, define the approach, deliver it, and raise risks early instead of stalling. * Use sound production judgment: verify before changing shared systems, plan for failure, and know how to roll back. * Use AI tools with discipline: give clear context and constraints, review and test every AI\-generated change, and stay accountable for the result. * Solve hard problems methodically: break an unclear problem into testable hypotheses, gather evidence from logs, lineage, and query history, confirm the cause before changing anything, and verify the fix worked. * Communicate clearly in writing and in person, giving business context to engineers and technical context to non\-engineers. **Physical Demands** -------------------- The employee routinely sits, talks, hears, and uses hands and fingers to operate a keyboard. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Travel** ---------- Ability to travel 5% annually in the US for team meetings, offsites, and conferences. **Ready to own the platform?** ------------------------------ If you have run production Snowflake, dbt, and ELT at scale, you work daily with agentic coding tools, and you want to be the person the business trusts with its data, we would like to hear from you. Apply today. **Salary range:** **$167,000 \- $202,300 base salary per year, depending on experience** **Benefits include, but are not limited to:** * **Comprehensive medical and dental coverage** * **401(k) plan** * **Generous PTO and leave programs** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.
