jobs.title: PLM Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We are seeking an experienced PLM Engineering Manager to lead 3DEXPERIENCE customization, development, and high level escalation support. This pivotal leadership role will guide a team of 3DX developers, platform engineers, and release engineers. It will also connect Ford's business and engineering stakeholders with the hosting and infrastructure teams and with Dassault Systèmes. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who understands the full 3DX architecture, from 3DPassport and 3DSpace through 3DSearch and FCS down to the database. You are equally comfortable reviewing a developer's trigger logic, analyzing a JVM thread dump during an outage, pushing a Dassault Systèmes Service Request up to R\&D, and explaining the root cause to senior leadership in plain business terms. You set the engineering standards that keep Ford's heavily customized platform stable and upgrade\-ready. A natural collaborator, you build trust across development, hosting, and business teams, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where both delivery and accountability matter. This role is a people leader position but also highly technical. **Platform Customization \& Development** * **Customization Ownership:** Lead the design, development, and delivery of all 3DX customizations, including data model extensions (type and attribute specialization, Unified Typing, policies, lifecycles), triggers, JPOs, MQL/TCL scripts, and EKL logic, using Dassault\-supported methods. * **UI \& Widget Development:** Guide the development of 3DDashboard widgets (JavaScript/UWA), web forms, tables, commands, and menus that improve the engineering user experience. * **Integrations \& Web Services:** Own the technical design and support of integrations between 3DX and Ford enterprise systems, using 3DSpace REST APIs, custom web services, and middleware. * **Security Model:** Oversee People \& Organization (P\&O) configuration, including collaborative spaces, organizations, roles, security contexts, and access rules. * **Engineering Standards:** Define and enforce coding standards, code review practices, and source control for all 3DX development, so customizations stay upgrade\-safe and technical debt stays low. * **Requirements Intake:** Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams to turn business requirements into sound technical designs. Advise on "out\-of\-the\-box vs. customize" decisions. **Level 3 Escalation \& Incident Resolution** * **Final Escalation Point:** Serve as the highest internal escalation point for critical (P1/P2\) and complex incidents across the 3DX suite, including 3DSpace, 3DPassport, 3DDashboard, 3DSearch/3DIndex, FCS, 3DSwym, and native app (CATIA/DELMIA) platform interactions. * **Root Cause Analysis:** Lead deep diagnostics using application logs, MQL traces, JVM thread and heap dumps, database query analysis, and HTTP/network tracing to find the true root cause of failures across components. * **Vendor Escalation:** Own the relationship with Dassault Systèmes Support and R\&D. Drive Service Requests to resolution, make sure reproducible test cases are provided, and validate the hotfixes Dassault delivers. * **Incident Leadership:** Serve as technical lead on incident bridges during 3DX platform outages. Coordinate rapid response across hosting, development, and supplier teams, and give clear, timely status to business stakeholders. * **Problem Management:** Own root cause reports and problem records, and drive permanent corrective actions so the same issues do not come back. * **Shift\-Left Enablement:** Turn recurring L3 issues into knowledge articles, runbooks, and automated fixes so L1/L2 can resolve more issues and fewer reach L3\. **Platform Stability \& Lifecycle Management** * **Performance Optimization:** Oversee platform performance tuning across JVM/TomEE configuration, database (Oracle/SQL Server), indexing, caching, and FCS file throughput. * **Upgrade Readiness:** Own the technical impact analysis of customizations for full upgrades, Functional Deliveries (FDs), and hotfixes. Lead regression testing and support cutover execution. * **Change Management:** Make sure all customizations and platform changes follow ITIL\-aligned change management processes, are properly documented, and carry appropriate approvals before promotion through Dev, Test, QA, and Prod. * **Automation:** Drive the adoption of automation for deployments, bulk data operations, and platform health checks, fitting into the team's Ansible and CI/CD pipelines. **Capacity Planning \& Team Leadership** * **People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3DX developers and escalation engineers, including hiring, performance manage hread and heap dump analysis, and SQL performance analysis (Oracle and/or SQL Server). * **Infrastructure Proficiency:** Strong understanding of server operations (Linux/Windows), OS patching cycles, and network security (SSL/Firewalls). * **Project Management Tools:** Expert\-level proficiency in Jira for backlog management, capacity planning, and reporting. Working knowledge of ServiceNow for incident, problem, and change management. * **Preferred:** CAA (C\+\+/Java) development, SSO/SAML identity integration, and knowledge of automotive product development processes (BOM, engineering change, variant/configuration management). **Leadership Skills:** * **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to set engineering standards, guide design decisions, and raise the technical capability of a development and support team. * **Strategic Communication:** Proven ability to translate technical root causes and constraints into business impacts for senior leadership. * **Process Rigor:** Deep understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change management principles and audit compliance (GRC/SOX). * **Problem Solving:** Excellent troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and preventative measures. * **Composure Under Pressure:** Demonstrated ability to lead calmly and decisively during production outages and high\-visibility escalations. * **Collaboration:** Demonstrated success building relationships across Development, Infrastructure, Hosting, Business, and vendor teams to deliver under aggressive timelines. **Licenses and Certifications:** * Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE Certification (Preferred) * ITIL Certification (Preferred) * SAFe / Agile Certification (Preferred) You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! * As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is leadership level 6 and ranges from $132,800\-$250,800\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. jobs.title: Materials Manufacturing Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: **About Formlabs:** Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we're building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting\-edge products to life\-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we're helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We're a team of hands\-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you're ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. **Why this role** Most specialty materials are still made the way they have been for decades: weigh, mix in a tank, filter, fill. We think there's a better way to make them, and we want you to invent it. Our R\&D team creates innovative materials that push the limits of 3D printing, and we need proven manufacturing processes to produce our materials at scale and bring them to market. This isn't a traditional process engineering role. You won't be tuning existing equipment or running scale\-up checklists. You'll invent what materials manufacturing looks like next: set up proof of concept pilot processes for new manufacturing technologies, design new mixing and dispersion approaches, and smart control systems that catch a bad lot before it happens. You'll prototype it, prove it, and put it on the plant floor. If you've ever looked at a production line, thought "there has to be a better way", and then built it, this is your job. **No 3D printing experience required.** We need someone who understands how materials behave at scale and can't stop thinking of better ways to make them. **You might currently be called:** Manufacturing Technology Engineer, Advanced Manufacturing Engineer, R\&D Engineer, Innovation Engineer, Research Engineer, Technology Development Engineer, or Process Development Engineer. **What you'll own** * An innovation roadmap for how Formlabs makes materials: where new technology could raise quality, cut cost, or let us make materials we can't make today * New manufacturing approaches from idea to plant floor: concept, bench experiments, prototype equipment, pilot runs, and the business case to deploy * Co\-invention with R\&D, so new materials and the methods that make them are designed together from day one * Scouting existing technologies that will improve cost throughput quality and bringing the best ideas into Formlabs * Handing proven innovations to the plant team, with the documentation and training to run them * Proving out at least one new manufacturing technology at bench or pilot scale, with a clear case for production **About you** * 4\+ years building new manufacturing technology in chemicals, coatings, adhesives, inks, pharma, advanced materials, or a similar field, in industry * A track record of introducing new manufacturing methods that has impacted product quality, cost or throughput * Strong grounding in the science of making materials: mixing, heat and mass transfer, and rheology of viscous or filled fluids * You move comfortably from first\-principles thinking to a bench prototype to a pilot run * You use designed experiments and data to tell good ideas from great ones, and you can build the business case for the one worth deploying * Strong communication with cross\-functional stakeholders * BS, MS, or PhD in chemical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, polymer science, or a related field **Bonus skills** * Continuous manufacturing or process intensification * Inline sensors, process analytical technology (PAT), or chemometrics * Machine learning or AI applied to manufacturing data * UV\-curable or other photoreactive materials * Polymer powder handling, for future SLS materials work * Modeling, automation, or data tools (Python, COMSOL, PLC/DCS) **Our Benefits \& Perks:** * Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs * Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) * 401K matching and access to financial advisors * Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) * Tenure\-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) * Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it * Ample on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Healthy on\-site lunches, snacks, beverages, \& treats * Regular sponsored professional development opportunities * Many opt\-in culture events across our diverse community * And of course… unlimited 3D prints *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* **Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.** Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available **here**. Please give them a read.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron\-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That's what we do. At Formlabs, we're building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they're building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. If you're energized by the idea of making the impossible happen, come join us as a Mechanical Engineer. **Include a portfolio with your application to show us what you can do.** **The Job:** The job is to ship the best desktop 3D printers on the market: * Prototype new mechanisms, from precision latches to revolutionary pumps and valves to surfaces measured in microns * Test materials that push the boundaries of what 3D printing can do * Research 3D printing challenges and rethink every subprocess to push technology forward * Analyze, validate, and iterate on electro\-mechanical systems * Model everything from brackets to hinges to complex parts in CAD, creating well\-specified, accurate drawings * Partner with Global Sourcing and Manufacturing Teams to bring designs from prototype to mass production * Flex your global savvy by working with teams around the world, virtually and in\-person * Apply your knowledge of manufacturing techniques like injection molding and sheet metal fabrication to the world of 3D printing * Solve customer problems by using your engineering skills to eliminate friction at every stage of their workflow **You:** * You can't wait to build a precision tool that combines the power of injection molding with the beauty of the iPhone. * You want to build a precision tool that is beautiful inside and out (but don't take our word for it) * You know how to partner with people in any role with the genuine goal of getting work done and doing it well * You love the gritty details of part design, material selection, and manufacturing techniques, because you know it's important to commit to a vision and fail fast * You craft elegant designs that function with efficiency and simplicity * You work confidently in 3D CAD software (Solidworks/Onshape) to design components, produce drawings, and build assemblies * You deeply understand the full product development cycle *If you have Python skills, experience with contract manufacturers, know PLM or document control systems, or have a passion for industrial design, we want you to apply!* **Our Perks \& Benefits:** * Unlimited 3D printing with any Formlabs material on any Formlabs printer * An equity program that will let you build wealth through RSUs * Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) that includes a totally free employee\-only plan, effective starting on your first day on the job * 401K matching with no vesting or tenure requirement * Generous parental leave (fully paid up to 16 weeks) * Flexible time off so you can take time when you need it * Six\-week fully paid sabbatical after hitting tenure milestones (with the option to take an additional six weeks after that) * Free on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Free on\-site lunch, snacks, beverages, treats, beer kegs, and employee\-favorite local coffee and espresso * Self\-driven professional development opportunities like conferences, trade shows, and hackathons * One\-of\-a\-kind activities and events like monthly socials, the annual weekend summer camp, a can't\-miss company hackathon, and lots of other social opportunities **You don't need to check every box to apply for a role. jobs.title: GNC Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: You will develop the guidance and control software that carries a flight vehicle from ascent through atmospheric entry and an autonomous runway landing. Your algorithms and C\+\+ code will be exercised in high\-fidelity simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments, and ultimately in flight. You will help maintain the six\-degree\-of\-freedom simulation that the broader program depends on for design decisions and mission confidence. If you value simple, testable software and want your work connected directly to vehicle performance, this role offers meaningful end\-to\-end ownership. **WORKSITE**: Onsite in Titusville, Florida **WORK SCHEDULE:** Full\-time; schedule based on program needs **PAY RATE:** Salary determined based upon experience **WHAT WE OFFER:** Paid sick leave based on state regulations after 90 days of employment Medical, dental, and vision coverage after a waiting period (60% paid by Fortuna) Free TeleMedicine and Mental Health support for all employees and their families. Additional voluntary benefits: Group Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Critical Care, Short\-Term Disability **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** Develop, integrate, test, and maintain flight GNC algorithms in C\+\+ for ascent, entry, terminal\-area energy management, approach, and autonomous landing. Build and maintain a high\-fidelity six\-degree\-of\-freedom vehicle simulation used for algorithm development, verification, and program decision\-making. Model vehicle dynamics, sensors, actuators, atmosphere, navigation inputs, and failure cases with appropriate fidelity for each phase of flight. Design and execute software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, analyze results, and resolve discrepancies between models, hardware, and expected performance. Collaborate with flight software, avionics, aerodynamics, propulsion, systems, test, and operations teams to define interfaces and verify integrated behavior. Support mission rehearsals, flight\-readiness activities, console operations, and post\-flight data review for test and flight events. Requirements: **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** At least five years of experience in guidance, navigation and control, flight controls, vehicle dynamics, robotics controls, or flight\-critical embedded software. Strong C\+\+ development skills and a solid foundation in control theory, numerical methods, rigid\-body dynamics, and state\-space modeling. Experience developing or maintaining six\-degree\-of\-freedom simulations and validating algorithms through software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. Experience with flight\-critical software, autonomous vehicles, launch vehicles, reentry vehicles, missiles, aircraft, or spacecraft is strongly preferred. Bachelor's degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, computer engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience. Ability to work onsite in Titusville, Florida, communicate technical results clearly, and develop straightforward, testable, maintainable code. Fortuna is a certified veteran\-owned IT consulting and staffing company, comprised of practicing professionals all of whom are committed to excellence in providing the most efficient and innovative information technology solutions customized to our clients' specifications. Career Site: www.gofortuna.com.

jobs.description: Coach, drive and lead lean behaviors, principles, and tools across a operational or functional area. This is a program architect role for someone who can hold strategy and execution simultaneously to leverage the existing talent ecosystem to build engineering\-specific solutions and drive adoption across businesses to build capabilities. The Senior Manager \- \- Engineering Capability \& Transformation Leader is the engineer behind the Talent \& Skills workstream, one of five workstreams of Engineer 2030\. This role is part of the Engineering \& Technology Excellence function within GE Vernova EDGE, reporting to the Engineering Operations and Lean Leader. This leader will also own stakeholder alignment with the executive sponsors of the Workstream. This role operates with direct visibility to the CTO and all five\-business unit Engineering leaders and will partner with the Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Learning and Development, and HR communities. **The Work You Will Lead** GE Vernova's engineering talent model was built for a prior era and does not help us scale to meet the moment. It is reactive and optimized for single\-business execution. The Talent \& Skills workstream is the engineering systems layer for building the skills taxonomy, workforce analytics capability, and talent mobility infrastructure that allows GE Vernova to direct its best engineers to its hardest problems across teams and businesses, at scale, and ahead of demand. **Key Responsibilities** * **Engineering Workforce Capability Transformation:** Ensure engineering workforce strategy is forward\-looking and calibrated to where GE Vernova's engineering needs are heading, not where they have been. Recommend where GE Vernova should build, buy, or deploy technology to close skills gaps, translating business demand signals, attrition risk, and pipeline data into actionable workforce decisions in partnership with talent management, talent acquisition, HR business partners, and business leaders. * **Enterprise Engineering Capability Review:** Design and deploy a modernized GEV\-level review to be facilitated by the CTO that brings engineering teams together with talent management and HR to connect skills gap analyses, succession planning, and internal mobility in a single, repeatable process. Apply enterprise standards and facilitate talent discussions that enable strategic skill sharing across businesses. jobs.title: IAM AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction** Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. **Overview** The Identity and Access Management AI Engineer is responsible for designing, engineering, and operationalizing AI\-enabled identity security capabilities across the enterprise. This role combines deep IAM engineering expertise with artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation, and analytics to strengthen identity controls, reduce access risk, improve operational efficiency, and detect emerging identity\-based threats. The engineer will help modernize identity services by applying AI to access governance, privileged access, authentication risk, identity lifecycle management, entitlement analysis, anomaly detection, and automated decision support. This includes helping deploy and operationalize the built\-in AI capabilities expected in the next version of Identity Manager. This position partners closely with IAM, the Corporate AI Team, cyber defense, security architecture, infrastructure, cloud, data science, risk, compliance, and application teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant identity solutions. **How you'll make an impact** * Design, build, and support AI\-driven IAM capabilities that improve identity governance, access management, privileged access management, and authentication risk controls. * Develop models, analytics, and automation that identify excessive access, toxic entitlement combinations, segregation of duties conflicts, dormant accounts, orphaned identities, risky privileged access, and abnormal authentication behavior. * Apply machine learning, rules\-based analytics, and graph\-based identity intelligence to detect access anomalies and recommend remediation actions. * Engineer AI\-assisted workflows that support access request reviews, entitlement certification, role mining, policy recommendations, and identity lifecycle decisions. * Partner with IAM platform owners to integrate AI capabilities into identity governance, access management, PAM, directory, and cloud identity tools. * Lead or support deployment, configuration, governance, and adoption of built\-in AI capabilities delivered in the next version of Identity Manager. ### **Identity Governance and Access Intelligence** * Enhance identity governance processes through automated access insights, risk scoring, peer\-group analysis, and entitlement usage analytics. * Support role\-based access control, attribute\-based access control, policy\-based access control, and least\-privilege access models using data\-driven recommendations. * Design and tune access risk models that prioritize remediation based on business criticality, privilege level, account type, data sensitivity, and user behavior. * Improve access certification campaigns by reducing reviewer fatigue, identifying low\-risk approvals, and surfacing high\-risk exceptions for focused review. * Develop reporting and dashboards that provide IAM leadership, risk teams, auditors, and application owners with actionable identity risk insights. ### **AI Security and Responsible AI Controls** * Embed security, privacy, and responsible AI principles into IAM AI solutions from design through production operations. * Assess AI\-enabled identity use cases for risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, model misuse, biased recommendations, excessive automation, and unauthorized access to sensitive identity data. * Implement controls for model access, prompt governance, data minimization, audit logging, approval workflows, and human\-in\-the\-loop decision\-making. * Collaborate with legal, privacy, compliance, and risk stakeholders to ensure IAM AI solutions align with internal policies, regulatory obligations, and industry frameworks. * Work closely with the Corporate AI Team to ensure IAM AI solutions align with enterprise AI strategy, approved AI architecture patterns, model governance, responsible AI standards, and shared AI platform capabilities. * Document AI decision logic, data sources, assumptions, limitations, and control requirements to support auditability and transparency. ### **Platform Integration and Automation** * Integrate IAM AI capabilities with enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint, S , network, cloud, application, and threat intelligence data. * Contribute to incident response playbooks for identity compromise, credential misuse, privileged access abuse, and AI\-assisted attacks against identity systems. * Evaluate emerging AI\-enabled identity threats and recommend improvements to authentication, authorization, governance, and monitoring controls. * Support continuous improvement of zero trust, phishing\-resistant authentication, conditional access, privileged access, and identity detection and response capabilities. **About You** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, data science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Five or more years of experience in identity and access management, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, cloud security, or related technology roles. * Hands\-on experience with IAM platforms, identity governance, access management, privileged access management, directory services, SSO, MFA, federation, and lifecycle management. * Practical experience applying automation, analytics, AI, machine learning, or data science techniques to security, risk, identity, or operational use cases. * Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols such as SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, and modern API security patterns. * Experience with scripting or software development using Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, Java, C\#, Go, or similar languages. * Knowledge of cloud identity and security services across Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data, query languages, data pipelines, log analytics, and visualization tools. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Entra ID Governance, Entra Permissions Management, Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Purview, Azure Key Vault, or related Microsoft security capabilities. * Experience with IGA, PAM, and access management platforms such as SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, One Identity, Okta, Ping Identity, ForgeRock, or similar technologies. * Experience with AI or ML frameworks, large language model platforms, vector databases, graph analytics, feature engineering, model evaluation, or MLOps and LLMOps practices. * Familiarity with identity threat detection and response, user and entity behavior analytics, security orchestration, SIEM, SOAR, and threat hunting. * Knowledge of responsible AI, model risk management, privacy engineering, data protection, and AI governance frameworks. * Experience supporting regulated environments such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, government, or other compliance\-driven industries. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Microsoft Security certifications, Azure certifications, AWS Security Specialty, GIAC, Certified Identity and Access Manager, or AI/security\-related certifications **Compensation and benefits** At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being * Career development opportunities and ongoing learning * A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership * The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact **At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day. **Role Overview:** Shape how customers interact directly with AI across voice and digital experiences at Genesys. efits. **Working at Genesys** * **AI at enterprise scale** – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in jobs.title: AI Engineer - Quality and Post-Training
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** The bottleneck in building reliable and useful AI agents isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what good looks like, measuring it, and steadily closing the gap. Glean is building the next generation of enterprise AI assistants and autonomous agents that reason, plan, and act across complex, multi\-step workflows. This role works at the intersection of applied research, quality, and product engineering to make those systems better. The focus is on quality improvements across Glean's models and agent harnesses. That means hill\-climbing with evals, evolving evalsets and agentic verifiers, post\-training models for use cases like model routing, and training task\-specific models for enterprise workflows. It also means bringing emerging research into the product and working closely with product teams and customers, turning learnings from evals and production usage into better outcomes through quality improvements. **You will:** * Use eval results and production traces to improve the entire stack, including the agent harness, model routing, prompts, and retrieval, while weighing quality against latency and cost. * Work on post\-training models with supervised fine\-tuning (SFT) and preference\- or reward\-based optimization (e.g., DPO, PPO, GRPO), including generating the data for training. * Build RL environments for simulating enterprise workflows, including relevant evalsets, harness support, and LLM\-based verifiers for hill\-climbing and for internal and external benchmarking. * Improve the quality of representative evalsets, LLM judges and agentic verifiers, and calibrate them against human graders so the scores can be trusted in release decisions and model training. * Work with product, platform, and research teams across Glean to land quality improvements in production. **About you:** * 5\+ years of industry experience in AI or Machine Learning Engineering. * Hands\-on experience post\-training LLMs including adapting open\-weight models to specialized tasks. * Experience building evals for AI assistant and agent systems, including generating evalsets, LLM\-as\-a\-judge verifiers, calibrating offline and online signals coupled with good judgment about when a metric reflects quality improvements. * Strong coding skills in Python and/or Go (TypeScript is a plus), proficiency in your ML framework of choice, and a track record of shipping production ML systems. * Product\-minded, able to turn a vague problem into a concrete experiment, and thrive in a tight\-knit, cross\-functional team. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 \- $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

Benefits for this role include:* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Washington D.C., DC, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD. * Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation and visualization/dashboards. * Experience working with Chemical, Biological, Radiological, or Nuclear (CBRN) and Cyber threat risks in GenAI. * Experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g., Python) and machine learning. * Experience working with engineering and product teams to create tools, solutions, or automation to improve user safety. * Excellent presentation and communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to influence cross\-functionally at various levels. **About the job** ----------------- Trust \& Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. The Content Adversarial Red Team (CART) in Trust and Safety conducts adversarial testing of Google’s Generative AI models, product surfaces, and autonomous agents to uncover vulnerabilities, jailbreaks, and emerging catastrophic risks not identified in standard evaluations. In this Lead Trust and Safety Analyst role, you will serve as the Senior Dual\-Domain Frontier Safety (FS) Analytic Expert (CBRN and Cyber) and evaluation lead. Bringing deep subject\-matter expertise in Frontier Safety threats, you will design, direct, and conduct complex red\-teaming assessments to evaluate high\-consequence capability uplift risks across Google's AI products. Operating with high autonomy across multi\-quarter strategic horizons, you will anchor CART's Frontier Safety red\-teaming program (\~70%) while partnering with sibling RAIT teams (SCALE and Novel) (\~30%). In this collaboration, you will calibrate automated product\-surface evaluators (autoraters), evolve dynamic attack trees, define threat personas for multi\-turn/agentic simulators, and lead Tier\-1 product loss triage. At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust \& Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $171000 \- $247000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and execute complex red\-teaming assessments to identify critical CBRN and cyber capability uplift risks across generative AI products. * Partner with Engineering, Research, and Policy teams to translate red\-teaming findings into robust product mitigations and safety guardrails. * Collaborate with sibling RAIT teams to develop autoraters, dynamic attack trees, and threat personas for agentic simulators. * Direct specialized external vendors and subject\-matter experts to scale testing and ensure high\-signal threat intelligence. * Present frontier safety findings, risk assessments, and evaluation frameworks to executive leadership and external stakeholders. Work with sensitive content or situations and may be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting topics or content. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The Agents and TrustGraph (ATG) team is a broad, cross\-cutting horizontal organization spanning Ads Privacy and Safety, Consumer Trust and Safety, and partner Product Areas across Google. We build the foundational AI platforms, relational intelligence infrastructure, and adversarial crawling systems that protect Google’s users, advertisers, and publishers from bad actors. As online abuse and fraud grow in volume and sophistication—increasingly powered by generative AI—static rules and reactive manual workflows are no longer enough. Because ATG operates as a horizontal pillar with Google\-wide fan\-out, engineers on our team are not siloed into a single narrow product. Instead, you will have the flexibility to work across projects and pivot to where the highest leverage lies. Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting\-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi\-billion dollar global business. Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return\-on\-investment. Join us to work on AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology. jobs.description: InnoPhase Inc., DBA GreenWave Radios™, is at the forefront of innovation in Open RAN digital radios. You'll translate real\-world RF and protocol requirements into silicon\-level specs, working at the intersection of RF, baseband, and massive MIMO — all the way from architecture to lab validation. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role at a company that ships. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define and own system\-level architecture for cellular SoCs, including link budgets, system partitioning, mMIMO beamforming chain design, and performance trade\-off analysis * Architect and specify O\-RAN compliant subsystems — define split options (7\.2x, 6, 8\), fronthaul interface requirements, and RU/DU functional partitioning in coordination with protocol and firmware teams * Develop and maintain detailed system specifications covering RF front\-end, baseband, clocking, power, and RF/digital interfaces, serving as the authoritative reference for IC design teams * Build and run system simulations (RF link, mMIMO beamforming gain, interference, EVM, sensitivity, dynamic range) to validate architecture decisions before tape\-out * Lead lab bring\-up and characterization of prototype hardware, including hands\-on use of spectrum analyzers, signal generators, VNAs, oscilloscopes, and protocol analyzers to validate RF and system performance * Define test plans and acceptance criteria for system\-level performance, and work closely with test engineers to implement automated measurement flows in the lab * Partner with RF, analog, digital, and firmware teams to resolve cross\-domain issues discovered in simulation or lab — own the path from root cause to silicon fix * Drive system\-level compliance verification against 3GPP 5G NR and O\-RAN Alliance specifications, and represent GreenWave in standards and alliance working group discussions where applicable * Produce clear architecture documents, design review materials, and technical trade\-off memos that inform product and executive decisions * Assist in mentoring junior systems engineers; establish best practices for system modeling, specification, and lab methodology **What You Bring** ------------------ * 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in wireless systems development (LTE, 5G NR) * PhD in Electrical Engineering required * Proficient in signal processing analysis/modeling skills with Matlab, Python or C/C\+\+ * Strong understanding of communication theory \& signal processing related algorithms design (such as timing recovery, signal estimation and detection, MIMO signal estimation and detection, automatic gain control, channel estimation, equalization, coding theory, beamforming, etc.) * Familiar in 5G NR system architecture — PHY layer, numerology, beamforming, and massive MIMO (mMIMO) antenna system design * Experience with O\-RAN architecture: functional split options, O\-RU/O\-DU/O\-CU definitions, fronthaul (eCPRI/CPRI) specifications, and O\-RAN Alliance WG4/WG7 compliance * Proven lab experience — comfortable operating and interpreting data from spectrum analyzers, signal generators, VNAs, oscilloscopes, and RF test equipment in a prototype bring\-up environment * Hands\-on experience with Cadence tools (Virtuoso, Spectre, or AWR Microwave Office) for schematic capture, simulation, or system\-level modeling * Experience authoring system\-level specifications and architecture documents that drive IC design decisions * Strong fundamentals in RF system analysis: noise figure, linearity (IIP3, P1dB), dynamic range, phase noise, spurious, and link budget methodology * Familiarity with 3GPP 5G NR standards testing and compliance methodology (TR 38\.803, TS 38\.104, etc.) **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with MATLAB or Python for system\-level simulation, mMIMO beamforming modeling, or automated test scripting * Exposure to mixed\-signal or RFIC design in advanced CMOS nodes (28nm, 22nm, 16nm FD\-SOI or FinFET) * Familiarity with O\-RAN open\-source platforms or test tools (e.g., OSC, OpenAirInterface, ORAN\-SC) for integration and conformance testing * Familiarity with AI\-assisted test data analysis and ML\-based signal/power integrity prediction tools to catch issues earlier in the design cycle * Experience using Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants to accelerate design scripting, simulation automation, or documentation — familiarity with agentic AI tools for engineering workflows is a genuine differentiator * Experience applying AI to technical documentation workflows — LLM\-assisted datasheet parsing, specification drafting, or design review summarization * General comfort adopting AI\-augmented workflows to boost design productivity — this is a plus, not a requirement, for the right hands\-on cellular systems expert **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- At InnoPhase, dba GreenWave Radios, our total rewards package includes both a competitive base salary and pre\-IPO stock options. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $180,000 to $200,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including market conditions, interview performance, skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. For detailed information on our benefits programs, please visit our website.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer

We believe in building meaningful relationships, pursuing excellence with humility, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do their best work while continuing to grow professionally and personally.** **Our commitment to our people has earned recognition as one of the nation's best workplaces, including:** * Inc. Best Places to Work (2025, 2026\) * Great Place to Work Certified (2024\) * Fortune Best Workplaces for Women (2024\) * Fortune Best Medium Workplaces (2024\) * Fortune Best Consulting \& Professional Services Workplaces (2024\) * Business Intelligence Group Best Places to Work (2023\) **Our Values** * **Integrity** – Doing what is right in all things * **Relationship** – Pursuing depth, trust, and collaboration * **Service** – Laboring for others with humility and care * **Excellence** – Delivering extraordinary performance and results with humility * **Journey** – Embracing our past and planning for our future with faith **Description** The Forward Deployed Engineer exists to rethink how Harvest Group’s Client Services work gets done, using AI to amplify the expertise and experience of the people doing the work. That starts with working alongside the account managers, analysts, and client leads to understand how the work really happens, then asking what those workflows would look like if they were designed with AI from the start. The role goes deep rather than wide. Starting with one or two high\-value processes, the Forward Deployed Engineer finds where friction, gaps, and manual effort slow teams down, designs a better way of working with the people who own each process, and builds and ships the systems behind it, from quick automations to LLM\-powered and agentic workflows. They own the path through adoption, drawing on Harvest Group’s AI fluency efforts to help teams take up new tools and ways of working. The Forward Deployed Engineer partners closely with Client Services leadership and with Product and Technology teammates and helps shape the repeatable approaches that future Forward Deployed Engineers will build on. **Our approach to servicing our employees is grounded in our values. To deliver excellence for our Harvest Group employees, we do require that this role is based in Rogers, AR. If you are applying but do not currently reside in Northwest Arkansas, please note that relocation will not be covered by Harvest Group.** **Responsibilities** * Embed with Client Services teams to understand their work, tools, and pain points, including the parts of the process nobody has written down. * Map current\-state processes clearly enough that the teams who own them can review, challenge, and improve them. * Partner with Client Services leaders and end users to design future\-state workflows built with AI from the start, focusing on outcomes like time returned, faster turnaround, and fewer errors and handoffs. * Build and ship AI\-enabled solutions on Harvest Group’s platforms, including LLM\-powered and agentic workflows, integrations, and data pipelines, moving quickly from proof of concept to something teams use every day. * Partner with Technology teammates to harden, deploy, and support solutions in production, building to Harvest Group's architecture and security standards. * Make sound decisions on where AI fits and where it doesn't, including build vs. buy, model and tool selection, human review of outputs, cost, and reliability. * Handle client data responsibly, designing in appropriate privacy, security, and quality checks for AI outputs. * Drive adoption through training, enablement, and hands\-on support during rollout, drawing on Harvest Group’s AI fluency efforts and staying with the team until new ways of working stick. * Help generate technical and process documentation where none exists so solutions can be maintained, reused, and extended by others. * Define and track success measures for each engagement and communicate results to leadership. * Codify what works into repeatable discovery and deployment approaches and reusable components that future Forward Deployed Engineers can build on. * Share field learnings with Product and Technology leadership to inform Harvest Group's broader platform and product direction. **Requirements** * 7\+ years building and shipping software in product, solutions engineering, internal tooling, or similar roles focused on solving business problems. * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-based solutions that people rely on, including prompt and system design, retrieval over structured and unstructured data, agentic workflows, and evaluating output quality. * Full\-stack ability to build working solutions end to end. Experience with React, TypeScript, .NET/C\#, Python, and SQL experience is helpful, but not all required. * Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of how you build (Claude Code, Codex, etc.). * Experience leading discovery with business teams: interviewing users, observing how work really gets done, mapping processes, and running working sessions to design improvements or fully new workflows. * A track record of taking solutions from prototype to everyday use, with attention to reliability, cost, maintainability, and adoption. * Sound judgment on where AI creates real value and where it doesn't, with the ability to make the case for what to build, change, or stop. * Ability to work effectively without direct authority, influencing business leaders and engineers through the quality of your thinking and your follow\-through. * Strong written and verbal communication with both business and technical audiences. * Work samples to discuss during the interview, such as solutions shipped, processes redesigned, or case studies with measurable results. **Preferred** * Experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or embedded engineering role. * Background in agencies, consulting, or other client\-services businesses. * Familiarity with retail, CPG, e\-commerce, retail media, digital shelf, or similar integrated commerce domains. * + Experience with MCP, agent frameworks, evaluation tooling, or workflow automation platforms. * Experience with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery. * Experience working near production systems, including APIs, source control, CI/CD, and observability. ***Our heart at Harvest is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters diversity, inclusivity, authenticity, mutual respect, professionalism, and growth. Harvest Group is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, age, marital status, familial status, national origin, ancestry, disability or handicap, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*** **We encourage all interested candidates to apply.**

Once you’re eligible, you’ll become an Owner in the company, so we’re looking for commitment, hard work, and focus on quality and Customer service. “Partner\-owned” means our most important resources—People—drive the innovation, growth, and success that make H\-E\-B The Greatest Omnichannel Retailing Company. *Do you have a*: **HEART FOR PEOPLE…** skills to organize multiple engineers, negotiate solutions, and provide upward communication? **HEAD FOR BUSINESS…** consistency in demonstrating / upholding standards of coding, infrastructure, and process? **PASSION FOR RESULTS…** capable of high\-velocity contributions? **About the Team and Role** --------------------------- The Cost XP team owns **CCR (Cost Change Request)**, H\-E\-B's strategic cost management application. This team is responsible for modernizing legacy cost management processes and building the future of cost management at H\-E\-B. Engineers on the team work closely with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and other engineering teams to deliver capabilities that improve visibility into cost drivers, simplify workflows, and support major modernization initiatives, including legacy platform retirement and adoption of H\-E\-B's modern cost management ecosystem. **What is your background?** ---------------------------- * A Computer Science degree or comparable formal training, certification, or work experience * 5\+ years of experience in software development * Proficient in multiple programming languages, technologies, * Proficient knowledge of data storage technologies, data modeling, performance optimization, and troubleshooting. * Experience with software delivery practices including source control, automated jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Construction
jobs.description: *Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.* Robotics Software Engineer \- Construction**Job Description:** ==================== The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real\-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof\-of\-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature\-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites. This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full\-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer who has a deep system\-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof\-of\-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field\-ready solution. We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed. **RESPONSIBILITIES** Robotics Software \& Systems Integration * Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications. * Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack. * Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems. * Develop field\-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning. * Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities. * Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution. * Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk. * Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks. * Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected. Collaboration \& Partnerships * Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders. * Integrate and extend third\-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces. * Contribute to co\-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions. Field Testing \& Deployment * Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects. * Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities. * Design for difficult real\-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change. * Support deployed systems through remote and on\-site troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. * Master’s degree or 2\+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems. * Proficiency in C\+\+, Python, and Linux\-based robotics development. * Proficiency in modern software\-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker). * Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open\-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution. * Fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor). * Strong system\-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations. * Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast\-moving environments and take ownership of open\-ended technical problems. * Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences. * Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects. * Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real\-world environments. * Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2\) or comparable robotics middleware. * Experience in mobile robot perception, SLAM, and navigation for ground and/or aerial robots. * Experience developing or integrating mobile manipulation systems, including perception, motion planning, controls, end\-effector integration, and task execution. * Experience integrating robotic sensing and compute such as cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, IMUs, embedded computers, and GPU\-accelerated perception. * Experience writing and working with software drivers to interface with sensors, actuators, and embedded systems, including familiarity with communications protocols and peripherals (e.g., RS232/422/485, CAN, TCP/IP). * Experience developing low\-latency teleoperation systems for real\-time video, command, and telemetry streams, with graceful degradation amid intermittent connectivity. * Experience developing cloud\-connected robotics software workflows (e.g., Azure, Azure DevOps, AWS), web\-based operator interfaces (e.g., React, JavaScript/TypeScript), and real\-time video\-streaming pipelines (e.g., GStreamer). * Experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unity) and/or developing software for NVIDIA Jetson devices. * Familiarity with IP networking (e.g., subnetting, routing, DNS, DHCP) and mesh\-network radios, including diagnosing latency, packet loss, and connectivity issues in RF\-constrained field environments. In accordance with Virginia Senate Bill 215 (SB 215\), the base salary range for this position is: $82,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 Compensation in other cities and states may vary. HITT Contracting offers a competitive total benefits and compensation package including performance\-based bonuses, premium health care coverage including vision and dental, employer\-matched 401(k), wellness reimbursement program, paid holidays and time\-off, and other voluntary benefits and leave types. The determination of salary is based on the candidate’s individual professional experience, qualifications, education, skills, and training. ***HITT Contracting is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to hiring and developing the most qualified individuals based on job\-related experience, skills, and merit. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We value a respectful, inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. HITT Contracting maintains a drug\-free workplace, consistent with applicable local, state, and federal laws.***

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Agentic SOC
jobs.description: **What We Do:** Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote\-first team working to make enterprise\-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That's why we build our technology in\-house and back it with a 24/7 human\-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. **Reports to: Director, Engineering** **Location: Remote US, Only** **Compensation:** **$215,000 to $240,000 base plus bonus and equity** **What You'll Do:** Huntress is building an Agentic SOC. When our detection pipeline raises a signal, an LLM\-based agent picks it up and investigates it end\-to\-end. It gathers telemetry across our products, reconstructs what happened, and makes a well\-documented determination about whether the activity is malicious. Over time, it will take on more of the work itself, growing from resolving routine cases to acting fast when it finds an attack and handing analysts cases with the evidence already assembled. We're hiring a Principal Software Engineer to head this effort. This system is meant to augment our analysts, not replace them. It takes the high\-volume, repetitive work off their plates so they can focus on complex cases and hands\-on keyboard intrusions where human expertise matters most. It also reduces toil in the rest of their day by using LLMs to pre\-process the output of the tools analysts use constantly, so they start from a clear picture instead of raw telemetry. This isn't a chatbot bolted onto a dashboard. The system investigates a large volume of signals a day across thousands of customer organizations. Many signals are benign, but some are live intrusions where minutes matter. The telemetry the system reads comes from environments in which attackers are actively operating. Because the system makes real decisions, like closing an investigation or isolating a host, it has to be right, it has to show its work, and it has to know when to hand off to a person. As the technical lead, you'll own the system's architecture and direction. That means deciding how an investigation is structured, where deterministic code ends and model reasoning begins, what the agent can and can't touch, how we know it's working, and which decisions it makes on its own as it proves itself. You'll work closely with SOC analysts, detection engineers, product, and other engineering teams. You'll go deep in the code and help the engineers around you grow. Your work will directly shape how Huntress scales protection for the 99%. We make full use of AI coding tools to enable you to accelerate your development. We don't cap token usage. We expect you to use AI and all tools responsibly. **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture of agentic investigation. You help define how signals move from detection into investigation, how investigation state is managed, how tools are designed and exposed to agents, and what a finished investigation contains: the verdict, the timeline, the scope, and the evidence behind every claim. When the team is stuck between options, you make the call, and the foundations you set are what others build on for years. * Build agents that investigate like a strong analyst. You work alongside our SOC and product researchers to learn how experienced analysts actually triage and investigate, then turn that into agent behavior: which questions to ask, which evidence to gather, when to dig deeper, and when to stop and hand off to a human. * Take toil off analysts' plates. Beyond full investigations, you build LLM\-powered pre\-processing for the tools and data sources analysts rely on every day. It summarizes, correlates, and highlights what matters, so analysts spend their time on judgment instead of assembly. * Bring a security mindset to the agent itself. The agent reads attacker\-influenced data, runs across thousands of customer tenants, and can take action in customer environments. You design as if someone is trying to manipulate it, because someone will. Trust boundaries, tenant isolation, and auditability are part of the architecture from the start. * Treat evaluation as a core part of the product. You define how we measure whether an investigation is correct, we ant time as the technical lead on production systems * Hands\-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM\-based agents in production, covering tool use, context management, structured output, guardrails, and evaluation, along with a clear\-eyed understanding of how they fail * A track record of building evaluation for non\-deterministic systems, such as labeled datasets, offline evals, and regression gates, and of measuring quality over time rather than at launch * A security mindset: experience building systems that handle untrusted input, enforce multi\-tenant isolation, and produce an audit trail that holds up under scrutiny * Experience building systems that make automated decisions with real consequences, and the judgment to know what to automate and what to leave to people * Curiosity about how security analysts think and work, and a willingness to spend real time learning from them * Deep backend expertise in distributed systems, queues, and durable workflows, and concurrency, with a track record of designing for throughput and correctness under load * Strong skills in one or more backend languages and the ability to pick up new ones quickly. Our primary stack is Ruby on Rails, and we expect you to become fluent in it * Experience with AWS, Azure, or other public cloud environments, and with data stores such as Postgres and Redis * Experience with AI coding tools, such as Claude Code * BS or MS in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience **Bonus Points:** * Experience working in or building for a SOC, incident response, threat hunting, or detection engineering. It isn't required, but it helps a lot, because we build these workflows around how our analysts actually investigate * Familiarity with endpoint and identity telemetry and with attacker tradecraft * Experience attacking or adversarially testing ML or LLM systems * Experience with Ruby on Rails **What We Offer:** * 100% remote work environment \- since our founding in 2015 * Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays * 12 weeks of paid parental leave * Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans * 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution * Life and Disability insurance plans * Stock options for **all** full\-time employees * One\-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office * Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance * $75 USD/month digital reimbursement * Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth *Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.* *We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.* *We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.* **Accommodations:** *If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre\-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to* *accommodations@huntresslabs.com**. Please note that non\-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.* *Huntress uses artificial intelligence tools to assist in reviewing and evaluating job applications, including resume screening, skills assessment, and candidate matching and comparisons. These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. Please review our* *Candidate Privacy Notice* *for more details on our practices and your data privacy rights.* **\#BI\-Remote**
