jobs.description: Posted Date 7/19/2026 Description **About Accenture:** Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end\-to\-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. **We Are:** Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries reimagine the digital core for an AI\-native operating model. Through partnerships with frontier AI labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and the leading cloud providers, Accenture delivers end\-to\-end services that drive innovation and business agility. The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds the enterprise ontology — the semantic layer that turns raw data into contextualized enterprise knowledge, and the knowledge agents that maintain, evolve, and query it. Where our problem\-scoped ontology work wields meaning against a single problem, this discipline builds the meaning the whole enterprise stands on. **You Are:** A senior knowledge engineer ready to own the discipline: scaled ontology creation, the semantic layer, and the public technical argument for why AI without engineered meaning is guesswork. This is the senior technical track at Accenture: we hire people here who would rather own a methodology than carry a number. **The Work:** As an Associate Director in this family you are the technical owner of our enterprise knowledge engineering services. Concretely, that means three things at once: #### **You own the methodology.** * Scaled ontology creation, semantic\-layer design, knowledge\-agent patterns — yours to defend, evolve, and sign off on, including the boundary with problem\-scoped ontology work (build the ontology here; wield it there). #### **You own the asset portfolio.** * Ontology templates, entity\-resolution patterns, semantic serving reference architectures — every engagement consumes or produces one. #### **You own the technical point of view.** * You can explain the value of the semantic layer to a CFO and defend an OWL modeling decision to an architect in the same meeting — and the market hears the argument from you. experience coding in commonly used languages like Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C\#, Scala * 10\+ years of experience with database and database management systems * 12\+ years of jobs.title: Principal AI Operations Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Principal AI Operations Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department. This role defines how AI systems at Inspira Financial are instrumented, measured, monitored, and evidenced, and drives adoption of those standards across the enterprise, spanning both vendor\-provided and internally built AI capabilities. Primary duties include building the enterprise telemetry and observability standard for AI systems; designing evaluation, drift detection, and agent guardrail frameworks; translating AI risk and compliance frameworks into operational controls and audit evidence; maintaining the enterprise AI system inventory; and teaching other engineering teams to adopt these standards independently. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Define the enterprise telemetry standard for AI systems, covering traces, prompts, tool calls, retrieval, tokens, latency, and cost, built on a vendor\-neutral schema such as OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. * Build the logging and observability layer that provides the AI Center of Excellence, business units, and the AI Governance Committee with a single view of AI activity across custom applications, agent platforms, and vendor\-embedded AI. * Integrate AI telemetry with enterprise log aggregation, application performance monitoring, security monitoring, alerting, and incident response platforms to support operational visibility, investigation, and audit retention. * Establish retention, redaction, masking, and access patterns for AI conversation and trace data that satisfy privacy, records retention, and legal hold obligations. * Publish reference implementations and starter kits so teams adopting the telemetry standard inherit a working path. * Design the evaluation framework for AI systems, including golden datasets, offline evaluation harnesses, automated and LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression gates in CI. * Define drift criteria for each class of AI system and build detection for output quality degradation, retrieval decay, input distribution shift, and silent model updates from providers or vendors. * Build runtime guardrails and boundary enforcement for agents, including tool and action authorization, scope and spend limits, escalation paths, human\-in\-the\-loop triggers, and hard\-stop conditions. * Establish the AI incident model, including severity taxonomy, detection, alerting, rollback, postmortem process, and conversion of incidents into new test cases. * Translate NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, model risk management practice, and applicable privacy and recordkeeping obligations into operational controls engineers can implement. * Build the evidence layer that automates capture of artifacts needed for internal audit, external examination, and client due diligence. * Integrate AI operational data with governance, risk, and compliance platforms to support continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, risk reporting, and audit readiness. * Maintain the operational AI inventory across custom builds, agents, integrations, and vendor AI features, including an owner, risk classification, and control coverage for each entry. * Define the assurance pattern for vendor AI, including required telemetry, attestations, detection of vendor model changes, and compensating monitoring. * Build metric frameworks connecting AI usage, quality, cost, and risk posture to business outcomes, and report these to CoE leadership, business unit leaders, and the AI Governance Committee. * Own token and platform cost visibility and attribution by team and use case and lead resulting optimization work. * Run working sessions, document patterns, review designs, and jobs.title: Senior Principal iOS Architect
jobs.description: Job Summary This is a senior, hands\-on architecture role responsible for defining the technical vision and architecture of Insulet's iOS mobile application, which serves as the patient\-facing controller for a connected insulin delivery system. The role focuses on designing secure, reliable, and FDA\-compliant mobile software that communicates with insulin pumps and CGMs through Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), manages therapy data, and synchronizes information to the cloud. The architect partners closely with firmware, cloud, cybersecurity, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure the mobile platform is safe, scalable, and compliant. Responsibilities include setting iOS technical strategy, establishing engineering standards, mentoring senior engineers, driving BLE connectivity architecture, ensuring data integrity and security, and mitigating technical risks related to connectivity, battery life, performance, and patient safety. Key focus areas: iOS architecture, BLE connectivity, medical device software, cloud integration, cybersecurity, FDA\-regulated development, and technical leadership.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; The Senior Principal iOS Architect defines the vision, architecture, and engineering strategy for the iOS mobile app in an FDA\-regulated insulin delivery system. The mobile app is the patient\-facing controller in an IoT\-style system: it discovers and maintains a secure Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connection to the pump, issues therapy commands, receives pump and continuous glucose monitor (CGM) data, and securely synchronizes that data to the cloud. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor architecture role. You will set the long\-term technical direction, establish the standards other iOS engineers build to, mentor senior engineers, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard design decisions yourself. You will partner with firmware, cloud, quality, cybersecurity, and regulatory colleagues so the mobile architecture supports a safe, reliable, and maintainable medical device. This is a hybrid role, with 1–2 days per week in the office. Responsibilities: * Define and evolve the iOS architecture for pump control, CGM and pump data capture, local persistence, and cloud upload, including how the app behaves across connection loss, background execution, and app lifecycle events. * Own the BLE strategy for the mobile app: connection models, pairing and bonding, reconnection, command and data reliability, and how the app coexists with pump firmware constraints. * Set the technical vision for the iOS platform and translate it into roadmaps, architecture decision records, interface contracts, and implementation standards. * Design for a regulated medical device: traceable requirements, risk controls, verification and validation, and a software lifecycle that supports FDA design controls. * Establish security and privacy architecture for therapy commands and protected health information in transit and at rest, aligned with HIPAA, FDA cybersecurity expectations, and healthcare privacy obligations. * Define data integrity rules for glucose, insulin delivery, and device\-state data from capture on the phone through upload and reconciliation in the cloud. * Review designs and critical code paths, and mentor senior engineers so architectural intent survives implementation. * Partner with firmware, cloud, quality, human factors, and regulatory teams on interface contracts, hazard mitigations, and submission\-ready technical evidence. * Evaluate cross\-platform options for shared non\-UI logic, such as Flutter or Kotlin Multiplatform, while keeping the therapy user interface native iOS. Identify technical risk early and drive mitigation for connectivity, battery, latency, data loss, and upgrade compatibility. * Basic Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering. * At least 10 years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial recent work architecting and shipping production iOS mobile apps. * Deep experience with Swift and Apple platform APIs, including application lifecycle, background execution, networking, and local storage. * Demonstrated Bluetooth Low Energy experience on iOS using Core Bluetooth, including connection management, pairing, and reliable command and notification handling. * Experience defining architecture for a connected system in which a mobile app is a controller or gateway for a physical device and a cloud backend. * Working knowledge of HIPAA and how it applies to collection, storage, and transmission of protected health information from a mobile medical app. * Experience operating inside a regulated quality system, such as medical device, aerospace, or another design\-control environment, including requirements traceability and verification. * Ability to write and defend architecture decisions that balance safety, security, reliability, and delivery speed. Clear written and verbal communication with engineers and with quality, regulatory, and clinical partners. * Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with insulin delivery, CGM, or other Class II or Class III connected medical devices. * Working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366, FDA design controls, and FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance. * Security architecture for mobile medical software: secure storage, certificate pinning, authenticated cloud APIs, and BLE security modes. * Experience with Android mobile apps, so the iOS and Android controllers stay aligned across all capabilities. * Cross\-platform experience with Flutter or Kotlin Multiplatform limited to shared non\-UI logic, with the therapy user interface remaining native iOS. * Experience with offline\-first sync, conflict handling, and auditability of device data uploaded to the cloud. * SwiftUI and UIKit at production scale, modularization, and dependency boundaries that keep safety\-critical paths isolated. * Experience contributing technical content to regulatory submissions or design history files. * A graduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering. * Experience mentoring senior and principal\-level engineers and setting engineering standards across teams, as an individual contributor. Additional Information: \&\#xa;\&\#xa;Compensation \& Benefits:\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For U.S.\-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $226,400\.00 \- $339,650\.00\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:\&\#xa;• Medical, dental, and vision insurance\&\#xa;• 401(k) with company match\&\#xa;• Paid time off (PTO)\&\#xa;• And additional employee wellness programs\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Application Details:\&\#xa;This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.\&\#xa;To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education. Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non\-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non\-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com. We are looking for highly motivated, performance\-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it! At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description: The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day\-to\-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final\-stage activity. The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk. **Key Responsibilities** Quality Leadership \& Accountability* Own the day\-to\-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness. * Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately. * Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness. * Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow\-through. * Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk\-based thinking, root\-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes. Test Strategy, Planning \& Execution* Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes. * Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete. * Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end\-to\-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk. * Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution. * Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end\-to\-end before work is considered ready for business UAT. * Use risk\-based testing to prioritize the highest\-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs. Defect Management \& Release Readiness* Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear. * Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions. * Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability. * Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk. * Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing. Automation \& Continuous Improvement* Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high\-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business\-critical scenarios. * Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low\-value automation. * Use modern AI\-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test\-case creation, test\-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability. * Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability. * Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible. Cross\-Functional Partnership* Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes. * Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root\-cause analysis. * Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk. * Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non\-blocking follow\-up work. * Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions. Metrics \& Reporting* Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone. * Track measures such as test execution progress, es integration workflows. * Experience with automated API, UI, regression, and integration testing. * Experience using AI\-assisted development or testing tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools. * Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, test\-management tools, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and cloud\-based application environments. * Experience helping a QA organization mature from primarily manual testing toward a balanced automation and risk\-based quality model. **Success Measures** Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvement in the reliability, transparency, and efficiency of the QA function, including:* QA execution starts on time, with blockers surfaced immediately rather than discovered later. * Leaders and delivery teams have clear visibility into test progress and release risk. * Critical defects are identified earlier in the lifecycle, and fewer defects escape into UAT or production. * UAT rework and repeated defect patterns decline over time. * Regression coverage becomes increasingly reliable, repeatable, and automated. * QA team members demonstrate stronger ownership, consistency, technical capability, and accountability. * Release decisions are supported by objective test evidence and clearly documented risk. **Leadership Expectations** The QA Lead is expected to model transparency, ownership, and proactive communication. Problems do not need to be perfectly solved before they are raised. When quality, timing, environment stability, or test readiness is at risk, the expectation is to surface the issue early, explain the impact, and drive the appropriate next action with the delivery team. Salary: $115,000/Annually **Benefits Offered** * Competitive compensation and annual bonus program * 401(k) retirement program with company match * Company\-paid life insurance * Company\-paid short term disability coverage (location restrictions may apply) * Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid Parental Leave * Sick Time * Paid company holidays and floating holidays * Quarterly company\-sponsored events * Health and wellness programs * Career development opportunities **Remote Opportunities** We are actively seeking new colleagues in: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington. **Our Story** Founded in 2005, Integra Partners is a leading national durable medical equipment, prosthetic, and orthotic supplies (DMEPOS) network administrator. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities we serve by reimagining access to in\-home healthcare. We connect Payers, Providers, and Members through innovative technology and streamlined workflows affording Members access to top local Providers and culturally competent care. By focusing on transparency, accountability, and adaptability, we help deliver better health outcomes and more efficient management of complex healthcare benefits. With a location in Michigan plus a remote workforce across the United States, Integra has a culture focused on collaboration, teamwork, and our values: One Team, Drive Results, Push the Boundaries, Value Others, and Build Community. We’re looking for energetic, talented, and dedicated individuals to join our team. See what opportunities we have available; there may be a role for you to engage in a challenging yet rewarding career in healthcare. We look forward to learning more about you. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives. SfQYTGebWY

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems & Infrastructure Engineer (Cloud, Security & AI)
jobs.description: About the Role ITCS is a South Florida managed services provider that designs and supports custom IT solutions for our clients rather than a one\-size\-fits\-all menu. We are looking for a Senior Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer we can point at any project or client environment and trust to own it end to end: networking, on\-premise and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365/Azure, and AI. Our clients are increasingly asking us for AI solutions, and we want this engineer to help lead that practice alongside traditional infrastructure work. This is a true generalist\-at\-a\-senior\-level position. One week you may be redesigning a client's network and firewall stack, the next migrating on\-premise servers to Azure, then leading a security hardening project, then scoping and rolling out Microsoft Copilot or a custom AI workflow for a client, then building an automation that saves the team hours. You will take projects from scoping and design through implementation and documentation, while also serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for our support team. **Location requirement:** This position is primarily work\-from\-home with onsite visits to clients throughout Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, and West Palm Beach. Candidates must already reside in our service area and have reliable transportation. **What You Will Do** * Lead client infrastructure projects from planning and design through implementation, cutover, and documentation. * Design, deploy, and support network environments: firewalls, Layer 3 switching, routing, VLANs, VPN (site\-to\-site and remote access), Wi\-Fi, and SD\-WAN. * Build and manage Windows Server environments (2019 through 2025\), Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, certificate services, clustering, and virtualization. * Architect and execute cloud projects in Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, including on\-prem\-to\-Azure migrations, Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, and email migrations from other platforms to Microsoft 365\. * Implement and maintain security controls across client environments: EDR/MDR, SIEM, Zero Trust access (e.g., Zscaler), MFA/SSO (SAML/OIDC), vulnerability remediation, email security, and backup and disaster recovery. * Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for the support desk, resolving complex issues and mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 technicians. * Help build and deliver our AI services practice: meet with clients to identify practical AI use cases, assess data readiness and governance, and scope, pilot, and deploy solutions such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, AI\-powered automation and workflow tools, and secure use of ChatGPT/Claude\-type assistants. * Advise clients on responsible AI adoption: data access and permissions, information protection and DLP, acceptable\-use policies, and keeping client data out of unmanaged AI tools. * Automate recurring work with PowerShell and AI\-assisted tooling; use AI tools daily for scripting, log and data analysis, documentation, and proactive maintenance. * Communicate directly with client stakeholders, from end users to executives, via phone, email, and in person. Explain issues and resolutions clearly and provide professional recommendations. * Document everything: tickets, resolutions, runbooks, network diagrams, and client inventory records in our PSA/RMM and documentation platforms. * Contribute to standards, process improvements, and the technology roadmap for both ITCS and our clients. * Participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation; occasional evening or weekend work for maintenance windows and project cutovers. **Required Skills and Experience** We expect a strong, hands\-on foundation in each of the five areas below. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every one, but you must be able to take ownership of a project in any of them. * **Experience:** 7\+ years in IT infrastructure/systems engineering, with at least 3 years at a Tier 3 or project\-lead level. MSP experience strongly preferred. * **Networking:** Proven hands\-on experience designing, configuring, and troubleshooting firewalls, Layer 3 switches, routing, VLANs, VPNs, and wireless. Comfortable with packet captures and root\-cause network troubleshooting. jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer I
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Iridium is an award\-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission\-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things. Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space\-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real\-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation. Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact. **What We’re Looking For:** --------------------------- Iridium is seeking a talented and motivated Systems Development Engineer I to join our Automation team. As a Systems Development Engineer I, you will write and review code and help maintain framework infrastructure throughout our agile development cycle. In this role, you’ll gain valuable experience designing and developing automation for interdisciplinary projects while receiving support from team members with day\-to\-day activities. You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy software engineering, design, devops, research, deep\-dive troubleshooting, and detail\-oriented tasks in both individual and team\-based settings. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- * Work with industry standard tools and software such as Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana, Amazon Web Services, CI/CD pipelines, event\-driven messaging, containers and more * Participate in an Agile software team to collaborate and coordinate with team members on a variety of tasks including: + Software architecture design + API definition, design, and implementation + Virtualization and containerization + Automation framework infrastructure deployment + Hardware communications + Data transformation and visualization * Support the team in solving problems and developing creative solutions within the automation organization * Assist with translating User Stories into specific actionable tasks * Maintain and expand existing software tools, lab environment, and hardware components * Create documentation that clearly presents information * Learn the details and protocols of the Iridium satellite constellation and ground systems to better assist the internal Iridium teams **What You’ll Need to Succeed:** -------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical degree, or comparable related technical field experience * Entry\-level knowledge of software development * An analytical mindset, with the ability to understand a situation or problem and think critically to make decisions and come up with solutions * Experience developing software in Python and/or other object\-oriented software languages * Familiarity with Git and distributed version control * Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly present information to the team * The desire to work in a collaborative environment and build meaningful relationships with your manager and team * Must be able to prioritize your tasks with guidance, and not be afraid to ask for help when needed * Self\-motivation with the desire to create high\-quality work * Be active in seeking out ways to learn every day, and be interested in new ideas and technologies **Things That Would be Great if You Brought to the Table:** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Experience with: * + Linux and/or Unix via the command line + Integrated Development Environments (e.g. PyCharm, Visual Studio) + Containerization knowledge in docker and/or podman + Structured databases such as MySQL + DevOps and CI/CD tool suites + Basic networking skills * Basic knowledge of the Linux and/or Unix operating systems **We’ll also need you to:** --------------------------- * This position directly performs under, supports, or is exposed to a U.S. government contract. To comply with the requirements of that U.S. government contract, applicants for this position must be U.S. citizens * Be able to work a hybrid schedule that includes at least 80% of your time (4 days per week) in office **Work Environment:** --------------------- This position primarily works in an office setting and is largely sedentary with the majority of the position working with a computer. The role typically requires the use of basic office equipment such as a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse, and printer. We believe in\-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. Under Iridium’s Hybrid Work Policy, employees are expected to work at least four days per week (approximately 80%) in an Iridium office to support collaboration, relationship\-building, and professional growth. **Additional Information** This job description outlines the general nature and level of work for this role and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be assigned additional responsibilities as needed. Base Pay Range: $70,000 \- 87,000 USD Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors and this range represents an estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Base salary is only one part of our compensation package for this role. You may also be eligible for company stock and annual bonus. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks. **Iridium is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.**

jobs.title: Voice/Data Engineer
jobs.description: Iron Bow Technologies is for people who believe trust is paramount, transformation is embraced, and the future is here, because **"What we do matters**!" We are a next generation solutions provider, delivering mission success across government, healthcare, and commercial industries. Iron Bow relies on our **passionate people**, **long standing partnerships**, and **strategic thinking** to solve your most critical challenges. Whether we team with clients, colleagues, or partners, we put each other first. It's **The** **Iron Bow Way.** **THE OPPORTUNITY** Iron Bow Technologies is seeking an experienced **Principal Telecommunications Engineer** to support the design, engineering, implementation, and optimization of complex voice and data telecommunications solutions for our customer. In this role, you will serve as a senior technical expert responsible for evaluating existing telecommunications infrastructure, developing innovative network architectures, and identifying opportunities to improve service delivery, reliability, and cost efficiency. You will work closely with customers, telecommunications carriers, service providers, and technical teams to develop and implement solutions that meet operational and business requirements. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in IP telephony, voice and data network engineering, carrier services, and technical project management, along with a strong understanding of emerging telecommunications technologies. **HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT** * Evaluate existing telecommunications and operations support systems to identify opportunities for modernization, improved performance, and cost efficiencies. * Lead the design, engineering, and implementation of voice and data telecommunications solutions, including network interfaces, system integrations, and supporting infrastructure. * Assess emerging technologies and recommend telecommunications platforms, network architectures, and solutions that align with customer requirements. * Provide Tier 3 engineering support for complex telecommunications and network incidents, including troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and resolution of escalated issues. * Evaluate carrier\-provided network services, telecommunications architectures, and service options to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and cost effectiveness. * Develop detailed engineering designs, network configurations, process flows, and technical documentation supporting system implementation and ongoing operations. * Design and execute voice integration and failover testing plans to validate system functionality, reliability, and performance. * Conduct telecommunications billing audits, identify discrepancies, and work with carriers to resolve billing issues and recover applicable credits. * Collaborate with telecommunications carriers, service providers, and internal stakeholders to coordinate service implementations, monitor delivery timelines, and ensure compliance with contractual requirements. * Develop project management plans, including implementation schedules, resource estimates, cost projections, and risk mitigation strategies. * Identify opportunities to introduce advanced telecommunications capabilities while improving operational efficiency and reducing costs. * Prepare and present technical recommendations, strategic analyses, Statements of Work (SOWs), and management reports to customers and key stakeholders. * Provide technical guidance, training, and customer support throughout the implementation and ongoing management of telecommunications solutions. **SKILLS THAT DRIVE SUCCESS** * Minimum **15 years of experience** in voice and data network engineering, telecommunications architecture, and related business operations. * Minimum **10 years of experience** designing and implementing IP telephony systems. * Minimum **10 years of project management experience**, preferably within a client\-facing technical services environment. * Strong understanding of telecommunications infrastructure, network architecture, and carrier\-provided transport services. * Knowledge of LAN/WAN and VoIP technologies, including MPLS, BGP, SIP, IMS, and related network protocols. * Experience with telecommunications routers, switches, carrier services, and supporting network infrastructure. * Experience evaluating multi\-carrier service architectures, telecommunications pricing models, and operations support systems. * Demonstrated experience conducting telecommunications billing audits, identifying discrepancies, and preparing management reports with findings and recommendations. * Experience developing technical documentation, engineering designs, implementation plans, Statements of Work, and strategic assessments. * Strong project management skills, including resource planning, scheduling, cost estimation, risk management, and stakeholder coordination. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information to both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex telecommunications and network challenges. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively with customers, telecommunications carriers, vendors, and cross\-functional technical teams. **WHAT SETS** ***YOU*** **APART** * Master's degree in Telecommunications or a related technical field. * Experience designing, developing, and implementing telecommunications networks supporting public transit environments. * Advanced knowledge of multi\-carrier telecommunications architectures, service provider offerings, pricing structures, and operational support systems. * Hands\-on experience developing and delivering training and customer support for VoIP implementations. * Experience leading complex telecommunications modernization initiatives involving multiple carriers, technologies, and stakeholders. * Ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable, and cost\-effective telecommunications solutions. * Strong customer relationship management skills and the ability to influence technical decisions at multiple levels of an organization. **WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT!** * At Iron Bow Technologies, **What We Do Matters.** You'll have the opportunity to apply your expertise to meaningful projects, solve complex technology challenges, and help customers build reliable, innovative, and future\-ready solutions. * You'll be part of a collaborative team that values technical expertise, integrity, innovation, and the relationships we build with our customers and each other. We believe in empowering our employees to make an impact, share ideas, and contribute to solutions that make a difference. * Beyond the work itself, Iron Bow offers a comprehensive benefits package, opportunities for professional growth and development, and programs and resources designed to support employees through different stages of life. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFIT INFORMATION** The salary range for this position is **$190,000\-225,000/yr**. This range reflects the anticipated base pay for the position and is not a guarantee of final compensation. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, location, contract requirements, and business needs. Iron Bow Technologies reserves the right to fill this role at a different level, depending on qualifications and organizational priorities. This range represents only one component of Iron Bow's total compensation package. An overview of our benefits is available on our careers page. **OUR EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER COMMITMENT** Iron Bow Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Iron Bow are based on relevant business considerations, such as operational needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or gender expression, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic prohibited by law. Iron Bow will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

jobs.description: Affiliated Office Address Baltimore, MD, United States Requisition ID 122716 Date Created October 09, 2026 Job Function Information Technology Exempt Status Exempt Shift Type Full Time Schedule M\-F 8:30a\-5p Worksite 04\-MD:School of Medicine Campus Work Modality On\-site: 90\-100% of hours worked on\-site We are seeking a ***Sr. Radiomics and AI Engineer*** who will be responsible for developing and implementing algorithms and software that can analyze medical images and extract clinically relevant features using machine learning and deep learning techniques for the Dept. of Radiology’s Diagnostic Imaging Division. **Specific Duties \& Responsibilities** * Develop and implement machine learning and deep learning algorithms to analyze medical images. * Collaborate with radiologists, oncologists, and other healthcare professionals to identify clinically relevant features that can be extracted from medical images. * Design and implement data preprocessing pipelines to ensure high\-quality input data for the algorithms. * Develop and maintain software tools for data analysis, visualization, and reporting. * Test and validate the algorithms and software using clinical data sets and real\-world scenarios. * Continuously monitor and improve the performance of the algorithms and software. * Stay up to date with the latest research and developments in radiomics, medical imaging, and artificial intelligence. * Maintain the cluster, computational, and storage resources in the Felix lab, which are used for training and deploying AI models. **Minimum Qualifications** * Master's in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field. * Two years of experience with machine learning, deep learning, and data analysis. * Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond HS Diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the position:** The Software Engineer is responsible for independently designing, developing, testing, implementing, documenting, troubleshooting, and maintaining software applications, integrated systems, databases, APIs, reports, and automation solutions on a variety of platforms. This mid\-level role translates user and organizational information needs into reliable production solutions, owns assigned systems or components, improves existing software and workflows, and contributes to team standards for development, testing, deployment, documentation, and support. **Essential Job Functions:** * Execute system analysis, software development, application programming, integration support, and database analysis to ensure system integrity, efficiency, reliability, and maintainability. * Design, develop, modify, test, debug, implement, and maintain application code, services, APIs, reports, scripts, jobs, database objects, interfaces, and integrated software solutions. * Design fully integrated systems which may include applications, databases, APIs, interfaces, reports, jobs, networks, cloud services, third\-party systems, and related systems. * Develop specifications and requirements for the optimal integration and implementation of systems, software changes, application enhancements, data flows, interfaces, and platform dependencies. * Install, configure, test, and support new, modified, or third\-party software releases, updates, patches, integrations, and application components. * Evaluate and supplement vendor\-supplied documentation for third\-party software, integrations, and systems to support internal procedures, implementation, testing, and production support. * Write and maintain documentation to provide user support for new or modified programs, technical changes, production procedures, operational procedures, troubleshooting steps, and support runbooks. * Perform application maintenance, systems support, production troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and issue resolution for assigned systems and components. * Evaluate specifications and requirements against available systems, source data, business processes, and technical constraints to identify needed changes, dependencies, risks, and impacts. * Study existing manual and computerized systems to evaluate effectiveness and develop revisions, automation, or new systems to improve production, workflow, user experience, reliability, and operational efficiency. * Review specifications with users and business partners to ensure requirements are met and expected outcomes are clearly understood. * Develop test plans and collaborate with users, peers, vendors, and technical teams to test, debug, validate, and implement software changes. * Utilize approved development environments, source control, CI/CD practices, testing tools, user productivity tools, and deployment processes to develop and modify application software. * Provide guidance to junior engineers, participate in code reviews and design discussions, and act as a team lead on specific projects or assignments when requested. * Evaluate and recommend procedures or improvements to better achieve organizational goals and objectives related to software quality, supportability, productivity, security, automation, and operational reliability. * Responsible for attending on\-site work during scheduled shifts to adhere to company time and attendance policies. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, system integration, database development, DevOps, or related roles preferred. * Bachelors degree in computer science, information systems, information technology, software engineering, or related field preferred; equivalent technical training and/or related experience may be considered. * Working knowledge of software development, relational database design, SQL, web development, APIs, source control, testing practices, deployment practices, and production support. * Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages and frameworks such as C\#, .NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, PowerShell, Python, Blazor, web APIs, or comparable technologies preferred. * Knowledge of or exposure to approved AI\-assisted tools to support software development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, and productivity while following company standards and security requirements. * Familiarity with CI/CD practices, source control such as Git, issue tracking, application monitoring, troubleshooting, and secure development practices preferred. * Knowledge of business systems such as Accounting, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), Warehouse Systems, retail systems, or comparable enterprise systems preferred. * Ability to transform user requirements and technical concepts into reliable production or service\-based software solutions. * Proven ability to work as part of a team to reach a common goal and communicate clearly in group settings to pursue project completion. * Ability to develop or recommend processes to increase productivity, efficiency, software quality, supportability, and operational reliability. * Must have good written and oral communication skills including tact and diplomacy when facing customers and providing exceptional customer service. * Must be well organized, dependable, maintain the strictest confidentiality, and exhibit professional conduct. * Must be detail oriented and possess strong analytical skills. * Ability to multi\-task and recognize work related needs to pursue their successful completion. * Ability to think critically, innovate, and solve challenging technical issues. * Ability to follow verbal and/or written instructions, perform routine and repetitive tasks and have constant contact/interaction with various levels of individuals daily. * Ability to attend on\-site work during normal business hours, in the typical work week, and extra time as needed to fulfill job duties. **Benefits of working for Food City:** jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description: Karman is a fast\-growing NVIDIA\-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid, bringing real\-time visibility and power\-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them. Our team is seeking a talented and experienced Embedded Linux Engineer. As an Embedded Linux Engineer at Utilidata, you will be responsible for automating the infrastructure that improves the flashing and provisioning of IoT devices in the manufacturing process. You will also focus on automating software build and deployment for IoT devices, configuring Linux\-based systems for deployment, and ensuring tight security controls. Your work will directly contribute to configuring and managing over\-the\-air (OTA) systems, communications configurations, and potentially supporting Linux kernel development. We are looking for candidates who are collaborative, adaptable, and committed to driving innovation. This is a remote position based in the United States, and candidates will be expected to work cross\-functionally with remote teams across the country. **Responsibilities*** Design, implement, and maintain Yocto\-based embedded Linux OS projects * Automate the infrastructure to improve the flashing and provisioning of IoT devices in the manufacturing process * Automate software build and deployment processes for use in IoT devices * Configure and manage Linux\-based IoT systems for deployment to the field * Implement and manage over\-the\-air (OTA) software update systems * Configure and manage tight security controls to ensure the integrity and security of devices and data * Configure LTE and wifi subsystems * Write, debug, and maintain high quality software for embedded Linux systems with languages such as C and C\+\+, bash scripting, and Python * Provide Linux kernel and driver adjustments * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including hardware, algorithms, and product to ensure alignment with strategic objectives * Troubleshoot, maintain, and update existing IoT systems and devices as needed * Support possible Linux kernel development and kernel module integration for IoT devices * Monitor and analyze performance metrics of deployed systems and devices * Contribute to documentation for provisioning and deployment processes **Minimum Qualifications*** 8\+ years of professional experience including 5\+ years of experience working with Yocto, BSPs, Linux kernel, device drivers, bootloader configuration, and infrastructure automation * Experience with configuring and deploying IoT systems, including OTA update systems and secure communications configurations * Experience writing and maintaining embedded linux applications with C, C\+\+, or other systems languages * Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or similar * Experience with software build systems and CI/CD pipelines * Strong understanding of security protocols, particularly for IoT environments * Familiarity with Git, version control systems, and Agile methodologies * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, remote work environment * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal **Enhanced Qualifications (Nice to Have)*** Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field * Familiarity with Linux kernel development and kernel module integration * Experience with automation tools like Ansible * Experience with Mender over\-the\-air update manager * Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes) * Familiarity with hardware\-level IoT integration and provisioning processes * Experience working with embedded systems **Salary Range:** $155,000 to $185,000 base compensation depending on experience plus stock options. Salary will be commensurate with an individual’s skills, training, years of experience, and in line with internal compensation bands. **Location:** This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States. **Our Commitments:** Karman values the diversity of our team. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or childbirth, sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, or status as a covered veteran or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. We are committed to:* Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is welcoming, supportive, affirming and respectful * Empowering employees to solve problems and work together to make a difference * Providing mentorship and growth opportunities as part of a collaborative team * A flexible work environment with flexible paid time off * Competitive compensation and benefits, including health, dental, vision, and employer\-match 401k inZiOlT2ND

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Mine-to-Mill Optimization
jobs.description: **The Recruitment Opportunity!** **KGHM International Ltd.**, headquartered in Vaughan, Ontario, is the Canadian subsidiary of KGHM Polska Miedź S.A., one of the world’s largest producers of copper and silver. KGHM International has operations across North America and engages in exploration and development projects to expand its resource base, reinforcing its role as a global leader in mining and metallurgy. With a strong commitment to sustainability and community engagement, KGHM International, integrates environmental stewardship with advanced mining technologies and collaborates closely with Indigenous communities through impact and benefit agreements. These partnerships ensure respect for Indigenous rights and cultural heritage while promoting shared economic benefits. Through investments in infrastructure, exploration, and social responsibility programs, KGHM International continues to strengthen its role as a responsible mining leader committed to innovation, efficiency, and long\-term value creation. Our culture is underpinned by our values \- zero harm, teamwork, results\-driven, accountability, and courage. These values are deeply rooted convictions which guide our day\-to\-day behaviours and form the organisation's DNA. Our values are a lodestar for all our action and facilitate the decision\-making process of today and build long\-term strategies of the future. **Division:** KGHM International **Available Job Opportunity:** Data Scientist, Mine\-to\-Mill Optimization **Location:** Ely, Nevada **The Opportunity** The **Data Scientist, Mine\-to\-Mill Optimization** develops, tests and improves the predictive, prescriptive and machine learning (ML) models that support ore tracking, blending decisions, plant recommendations and impact measurement. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Risk \& Compliance, this full\-time position is responsible for preparing analytical datasets, performing exploratory analysis, building and validating ML models, supporting optimization models, and providing clear analytical documentation. This position plays a key role in ensuring analytical models remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changing ore characteristics and operating conditions. The position is based at our Robinson Mine in Ely, Nevada, We offer a hybrid work arrangement that provides flexibility to work from home, with an expectation of regular on\-site collaboration, particularly during the initial stages of the role. **What You’ll Do** * Prepare analytical datasets and perform exploratory analysis of geological, fleet, stockpile, laboratory and plant\-process data. * Build and validate ML models for throughput, recovery, quality and other agreed operational outcomes. * Develop feature\-engineering logic, segmentation, anomaly treatment and model explanations. * Support optimization models and what\-if scenarios using operational constraints and site priorities. * Run offline tests, passive tests and controlled production trials with operations and metallurgy. * Monitor model accuracy, recommendation acceptance, realized impact and changing process conditions. * Investigate performance deterioration and implement approved model improvements. * Create clear analytical documentation and train KGHMI users and technical support staff. * Other duties as assigned. **What You’ll Bring** * Degree in data science, engineering, statistics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field. * 7\+ years experience working in a similar Data Scientist role * Hands\-on Python and SQL experience, including supervised learning, time\-series analysis and model evaluation. * Experience with industrial process data, sensor data, optimization or operational decision\-support systems is preferred. * Understanding of data leakage, bias, confidence intervals, baselines and causal or quasi\-experimental impact measurement. * Ability to work directly with engineers, metallurgists and operators and convert domain knowledge into model features and constraints. * Practical experience using source control, reproducible pipelines and model\-tracking tools. * Previous experience working in the Mining industry required. At KGHM International, we value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. Skills can be developed, and we believe in supporting growth and potential. Your unique background could be exactly what we need. **What We Offer** We believe that rewarding our employees goes beyond base pay. Our Total Rewards Program is designed to recognize your contributions, support your well\-being, and help you grow professionally and personally. This holistic approach supports your financial security, health, and career aspirations. Competitive Compensation * Market\-aligned base salary * Performance\-based Incentive awards Comprehensive Benefits * Health, dental, and vision coverage * Life and disability insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health and personal support * RRSP matching Work\-Life Balance * Generous paid time off and holidays * Flexible work arrangements (hybrid/remote options) * Free on\-site parking * Casual Dress Professional Development * Tuition reimbursement for continuous learning * On job training and support * Opportunities for global mobility Supportive Work Environment * Respectful and responsible work environment * A culture of safety, integrity, and sustainability * Values that support teamwork and collaboration Compensation for this position is determined by experience and alignment with role requirements and typically ranges from $140,000 to $170,000\. This role is also eligible for performance\-based incentive awards. **How to Apply** * Apply via Indeed or submit your resume and cover letter via email to **corporatehr@ca.kghm.com** * All applications are reviewed by the Human Resources team, and no AI or automated tools are used to screen, assess, or select applicants. * Application deadline: open until filled. **Inclusion, Accessibility \& Accommodations** If you require accommodations during the recruitment or selection process, please let us know. We are happy to provide support \- contact for assistance. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive, people\-first culture where everyone feels valued and respected. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on any protected basis under applicable law. Benefits: * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Life insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Experience: * Data Scientist: 7 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Salt Lake City, UT 84116

jobs.title: QE Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information. Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process. Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com** Kapitus has helped small and midsize businesses access capital for two decades, funding roughly $2 billion to date and building toward $6 billion and beyond. We originate, decision, fund, and service financing every day across a growing set of products and partner channels. As we scale, we are investing in the technology and quality foundation that growth depends on. We are building an automated regression capability that lets us release faster with higher confidence, and we are hiring senior QE engineers to design and build the automated suites that make it real. You will work across the product with cross\-functional teams, writing and maintaining scalable Playwright and TypeScript automation that runs in our pipelines and catches problems before customers do, and you will help convert today's manual regression into reliable, reusable automation. **What You Will Do:** * Partner with the team: Work with developers, product managers, and business analysts to understand requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Automate across layers: Design and implement automated coverage for functional, API, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end scenarios. * Build and maintain the framework: Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automated frameworks and scripts using Playwright with TypeScript. * Validate API:. Develop and execute automated API tests to validate system functionality, integrations, and reliability. * Troubleshoot with developers: Work closely with developers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues, providing timely feedback. * Engage in Agile ceremonies: Take part in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. * Harden regression suites: Build and maintain reliable automated regression suites that validate software stability and release readiness. * Integrate into CI/CD. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitor results, and improve reliability and feedback speed. * Convert manual to automated: Convert existing manual test cases into automated coverage, capturing domain knowledge so nothing is lost as automation grows. * Stay current: Track fintech industry trends, emerging tools, and best practices in QA and the financial domain. **What We're Looking For:** * 5\-7\+ years as a QA or QE engineer, with substantial hands\-on test\-automation experience. * Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and review automated test scripts using Playwright with TypeScript. * Strong understanding of automation framework architecture, test design patterns, maintainability, and quality\-engineering best practices. * Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and Swagger. * Experience testing Salesforce solutions and full\-stack applications across UI, API, integration, and data layers. * Experience with version control including GitHub, Bitbucket, and SourceTree. * Experience with Jira for project and bug tracking, and Confluence and Zephyr Scale for documentation. * Solid understanding of Agile and Scrum and experience working in Agile environments. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, working effectively within a cross\-functional team. * Experience in the financial services industry is a plus. * Test automation: functional, regression, API, integration, and end\-to\-end automated testing. * Automation framework: advanced hands\-on Playwright and TypeScript, or comparable modern automation technologies. * Application platforms: hands\-on testing of Salesforce and full\-stack applications, including front\-end, back\-end, API, integration, and data\-layer validation. * API testing: Postman and Swagger. * Version control: GitHub, Bitbucket, SourceTree. * Project management and bug tracking: Jira. * Documentation: Confluence and Zephyr Scale. * Basic knowledge of security and performance testing. **Nice to Have:** * Additional languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript. * Experience with Selenium, Pytest, and Jenkins. * Familiarity ility** – Up to 10% annually * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer\-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life. * **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre\-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out\-of\-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses. * **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post\-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well\-being. * **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense. * **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short\- and long\-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events. * **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state\-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company\-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones. * **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre\-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work. * **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: + Pet and car insurance discounts. + Financial services such as LegalShield. + Relaxation and stress management tools. * **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life. * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy. * **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work\-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities. * **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.** * **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long\-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary. **About Kapitus:** Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self\-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth. **Company Mission:** At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner's story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity. **Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.**

jobs.description: About Kinaxis: **About Kinaxis** Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest. About the role: **Vacancy Status** This is an existing job vacancy.**What you will do** * Own customer solutions end\-to\-end. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy solutions in live operational environments where the stakes are real and the timeline is short. * Deliver relentless customer value. Build trusted relationships from the IC level to the executive sponsor and become the technical face of our company in the room. * Run multiple threads. Carry several customer engagements in parallel based on customer priorities and pod capacity. Set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when reality shifts, operate without close supervision, and own the outcome. * Operate as a SEAL team. A small, tight, multi\-disciplinary unit with focus and urgency tasks are traded seamlessly to whoever is closest to the skills needed. * Make the product better. Partner with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings into durable platform capabilities not one\-off scripts. * Drive adoption and lead the change. Mentor customer operators and guide their teams through solution transitions, so the new way of working actually sticks. **What we are looking for** * **AI \& Agentic Development** * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering. * Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty. * Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state. * **Software Engineering** * Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts. * Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase. * Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems. * **Data Engineering \& Platforms** * Ability to build and maintain data pipelines ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents. * Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals. * Strong   forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats is a strong signal, though not a requirement. **How to succeed in this role*** You measure your own success in business outcomes efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements not lines of code shipped. * You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities. * You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision. * You are curious and pragmatic you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new. * You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders written, verbal, and in the room. * You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours no waiting for perfect clarity. * You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver without being told. * Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not. * You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed. * Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric and you still ship. * You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working. * Ability to travel as required up to 50% **\#****Intermediate** **\#LI\-CS1** Why join Kinaxis?: **Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. *People matter* at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee: * Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off) * Flexible work options * Physical and mental well\-being programs * Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes * Mentorship programs, training, and career development * Recognition programs and referral rewards * Hackathons For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.
