jobs.description: Job Title Cloud Data Engineering \& AI Tech Lead **Division:** Corporate IT, Data \& AI **Location:** New York, NY **Reports To:** Data \& AI \- Domain Analytics Lead **Who We Are:** For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each and every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity. At L'Oréal, our IT teams design and build solutions to ensure high performance for all our business sectors by imagining new ways of doing things, from designing websites to building algorithms and predicting new trends. They can be found leading teams towards a more connected and digitalized future in IT retail, e\-commerce, CRM, data, AI, cybersecurity, Cloud and E\-Marketing. You never stop learning at L'Oréal IT because things change at the speed of light! Come join our dynamic team! **What You Will Do:** L’Oréal is driving a massive Beauty Tech Transformation roadmap, designing and implementing next\-generation Data Products to accelerate business growth across Commerce and Supply Chain. As a Tech lead, you will design, build, and optimize scalable, secure, and reusable data products on Google Cloud Platform. You will combine strong hands\-on data engineering expertise with practical AI engineering experience to make governed enterprise data available for analytics, reporting, and natural\-language insight experiences. You will work closely with Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and business stakeholders to build reliable data foundations, standardize metric definitions, and enable trusted data access. This role requires strong technical ownership, a hands\-on delivery mindset, and the ability to mentor engineers while driving engineering standards. What You Will Do * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reusable, and cost\-efficient data pipelines and data products on Google Cloud Platform. * Develop resilient ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch, near\-real\-time, and streaming data workloads across a modern Medallion architecture. * Build and optimize enterprise data models, including dimensional models and Star/Snowflake schemas. * Design and implement solutions using BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Workflows, and Terraform. * Optimize BigQuery performance, cost, reliability, and governance, including partitioning, clustering, query optimization, row\-level security, and column\-level security. * Build reusable APIs, services, and engineering utilities using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Run, and CI/CD pipelines. * Partner with Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Support the development and optimization of governed semantic layers and standardized business metrics in Looker and other reporting environments. * Establish and promote best practices for data quality, testing, observability, documentation, metadata, lineage, deployment, and operational support. AI\-Enabled Data Engineering * Turn governed data into clear, natural\-language answers that enable teams to explore insights safely and efficiently. * Design, build, and optimize Skills, AI Agents, and conversational workflows that translate business queries into accurate and understandable insights. * Develop and operationalize AI\-enabled patterns such as Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Text\-to\-SQL, agentic workflows, and tool\-based AI orchestration. * Connect governed BigQuery datasets and the Looker semantic layer to AI\-enabled solutions, ensuring consistent metric definitions and trusted business logic. * Build robust tools, workflows, guardrails, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks to reduce hallucinations, improve answer quality, and help prevent unauthorized data exposure. * Partner with Data Science and AI teams to productionize AI and machine learning use cases by building reliable, governed, and scalable data foundations. Agile Delivery \& Technical Leadership * Translate broad business epics into clear, developer\-ready technical stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria. * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, design reviews, and iterative delivery. * Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, engineering standards, code reviews, and delivery guidance. * Mentor Data Engineers and partner teams, supporting their technical growth and consistent adoption of engineering best practices. **What We Are Looking For:** **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, or related technical roles. * 4\+ years of hands\-on GCP experience, designing and implementing production\-grade data so ience working in Agile delivery environments and translating business needs into actionable technical requirements. * Strong communication, collaboration, and technical problem\-solving skills. * Work authorization on a continuous, ongoing basis. Sponsorship is not offered for this role. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Strongly preferred: Experience working with Commerce data domains, including related data structures, metrics, reporting, and operational processes. * Experience with Power BI, DAX, Tableau, Looker Studio, or other enterprise BI and visualization platforms. * Experience with AI evaluation, prompt engineering, LLM observability, model safety controls, or responsible AI data\-governance patterns. * Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification. * Exposure to ReactJS or development of lightweight internal web applications. As an integral part of our culture at L’Oréal, wellness is at our core. We not only offer a generous Benefits Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K), we also offer flexible time off, work from home days, and a pension plan! Additionally, you will have access to company perks such as Makeup, Skincare, and Fragrance! Employees receive a stipend for L'Oréal products as well as VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, and other perks such as Monthly Mobile Allowance, discounted gym memberships, and ERGs. **Additional Benefits Information As Follows:** **Salary Range:** $138,500 \- $200,800 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job\-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level) * Competitive Benefit Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan) * Hybrid Work Policy (3 Days in Office, 2 Days Work from Home); Being present in the office three days a week is considered an essential function of all office\-based roles for eligible full\-time employees. * Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays \& More!) * Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance) * Learning \& Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E\-learnings, Lunch \& Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, \& More!) * Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads) * Access to Mental Health \& Wellness Programs Don’t meet every single requirement? At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles! We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or disability, or any other legally protected status. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting \[1] USApplicationAccommodation@support.lorealusa.com. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, you may request an accommodation at any time. **Our Safe Together Plan:** Your safety is our highest priority. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE. **Information on Interviews:** LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an **@lplfinancial.com** email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855\) 575\-6947\. EAC 5\.19\.26

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Offboard Python Application
jobs.description: Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in\-house developed hands\-free ADAS platform will debut on the all\-new Ford Fathom in 2027\. When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.*** As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif. **Meet the team:** The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud\-agnostic as well as capable of running on\-prem. The results of these simulations is business\-critical for us \- they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large\-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in\-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end\-to\-end capabilities. **What you'll do:** * We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency. * It's not enough to have a framework that is functional \- it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction \- both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical. * We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well\-documented and as self\-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly. * In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage. * Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low\-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high\-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise. **What you'll need to succeed:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4\+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2\+ years of relevant experience, or PhD) * Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well\-documented, and well\-tested * 2\+ years' experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment * 2\+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services * Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming * Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems **Nice to have (optional):** * C\+\+ development experience * Experience with Kubernetes **What we offer you:** * Competitive compensation packages * High\-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health savings account with available employer match * Employer\-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting * Employer\-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance * Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program * Paid medical leave * Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays * Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations * Pre\-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * Monthly wellness stipend * Backup child and elder care program * Professional development reimbursement * Employee assistance program * Discounted programs that include legal services, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and more * Company and team bonding outlets: employee resource groups, quarterly team activity stipend, and wellness initiatives Learn more about Latitude's team, mission and career opportunities at lat.ai! The expected base salary range for this full\-time position in California is $150,320 \- $225,480 USD. Actual starting pay will be based on job\-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.description: #### **About the Job:** LaunchDarkly is the runtime control plane for the AI software development lifecycle (AI\-SDLC). Thousands of engineering organizations, including more than a quarter of the Fortune 500, use LaunchDarkly to ship, measure, and control every change that reaches production, whether it is written by people or by AI. Feature management built the company. The next chapter is bigger: as the cost of writing code falls and the volume of change outpaces human review, the constraint is moving from writing software to controlling it. LaunchDarkly is building the critical infrastructure for the AI\-SDLC. Customers build their own software factories. We build the rails they run on. We are hiring the leader of Product Management for LaunchDarkly. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the product management organization end to end: the people, operating system, roadmap commitments, and commercial outcomes across every product pillar. You will sit at the technology leadership table as the Product Management peer to the heads of Engineering and Product Design. The CPO sets the company's product vision and strategic direction. You will build and run the product organization that turns that direction into a coherent portfolio, shipped outcomes, customer adoption, and revenue growth. This is a hands\-on operating role for a product leader who knows how to build the machine, make the tradeoffs, and finish the work. #### **Responsibilities:** * **Lead cross\-functional product leadership.** Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. Resolve cross\-functional tradeoffs, establish shared commitments, and ensure LaunchDarkly presents one coherent product strategy to customers and the market. * **Build and lead the product management organization.** Design the organization intentionally, allocate resources effectively, maintain a high talent bar, build succession plans, and establish clear ownership for every product surface a customer or sales representative may ask about. * **Own the product operating system.** Establish the cadence that turns strategy into shipped software and met goals, including quarterly commitments, leadership reviews, squad\-level inspection, launch briefs, new product introduction (NPI), and the product\-to\-field handoff. Make execution predictable enough that the executive team does not have to ask whether something shipped. * **Drive roadmap delivery across every product pillar.** Lead execution across Enterprise, Foundation, Observability, Experimentation, Agent Control, Automation, and the platform beneath them. Build a culture of doing what we say we are going to do. * **Create portfolio discipline without slowing the company down.** Ensure new bets enter the portfolio through explicit decisions rather than hallway conversations, while preserving the flexibility to respond to market changes. Marketing dates should be commitments the product organization can confidently support. * **Drive finishing.** A product is not done when version one ships; it is done when the team has iterated based on learning. A launch is not done when it ships; it is done when the field is amplifying it. A process is not done when it is written; it is done when it creates leverage for the team. * **Own packaging execution and commercial outcomes.** Lead how pricing and packaging land in the product and in the field so every representative can sell the full platform and every pillar contributes to its commercial goals. * **Stay close to customers and the field.** Spend time with the largest customers and most demanding evaluators, translate what you learn into product decisions, and build a process that brings customer and field insight into the roadmap at scale. * **Use AI to increase product and engineering leverage.** Help the organization adopt AI\-assisted development and product practices in ways that increase delivery speed while maintaining quality and judgment. #### **What Success Looks Like in Your First Year:** * The organization is complete. The leadership model is in place, product lines have the right pillar leadership, spans and layers are intentional, decision rights are clear, succession risks are understood, and the organization can continue to scale. * Delivery increases every quarter. Shipped output per team rises quarter over quarter as AI\-assisted development compounds, with quality holding. * The operating system runs without the CPO driving it. Reviews, check\-ins, launch briefs, and NPI happen on cadence and at a consistent bar. * The portfolio is staffed. Every initiative in flight has an explicit staffing decision and plan behind it. * The numbers move. Activation, attach, activity, and expansion targets for each pillar respond to the organization's inputs. * The team is stronger than you found it. Product managers have more leverage, complementary strengths are valued over a uniform mold, and  to product management or software development. You should have clear opinions about how AI changes product management, supported by things you have shipped. * Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions with incomplete information, and improve delivery speed without compromising product quality. **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for Level E1:* * Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* \- *$424,000 \- $583,000*\*\* * Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago \- $381,600 \- $524,700*\* * Zone 3: *All other US locations \- $360,400 \- $495,550*\* * All Zones Inclusive of 25% Bonus Target *LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big\-bang" technology migrations. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by: * Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages * Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts * Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize * Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types * Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com. **Do you need a disability accommodation?** Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts.Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. languages. * Experience developing or integrating AI/ML solutions, conversational AI applications, or LLM\-powered systems. * Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise application integration. * Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agent orchestration, tool calling, context management, and automated workflows. * Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** We're building a talent\-dense, high\-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety\-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer\-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems. We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual\-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats. **What You'll Be Building** * Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances. * Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change. * Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories. * Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert\-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape. * Translate dual\-use judgments into policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that support beneficial materials research. * Work with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and engineering and experimental colleagues to assess capabilities, interpret red\-team findings and evaluate safeguards. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in materials science or a closely related discipline, with a strong grasp of the relationships between structure, properties, processing and applications. Relevant backgrounds include particulate, porous and formulated systems; and structural and functional materials, including thin films, electrochemical materials and metals and alloys. * Substantive experience assessing dual\-use risks in a relevant area, with a strong understanding of harmful applications such as nuclear proliferation, radiological misuse, weapons\-related capabilities (e.g. energetics) or other consequential materials risks. * Sound judgment about physical possibility, practical feasibility and uncertainty, together with the ability to investigate risks beyond your immediate specialism. * The ability to identify appropriate specialists, evaluate technical evidence and synthesize contributions across scientific and security disciplines. * Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy. **Bonus Points For** * Prior experience applying materials or related physical\-science expertise to AI safety through one or more of: threat analysis, evaluations or red teaming, or mitigation design. * Experience commissioning specialist research or assessing emerging technologies across disciplinary boundaries. * Experience with computational materials science, advanced manufacturing or automated synthesis and characterization. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. jobs.description: **Senior Semiconductor Equipment Engineer (Mechanical)** Do you want to be part of an organization on the cutting edge of technology? We're looking for talented people to join our motivated and friendly team. We have an open, collaborative, and flexible environment. You'll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow's electronics to life. Mycronic is a global high\-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. **Overview** We are looking for an experienced Senior Semiconductor Equipment Engineer (Mechanical) to join Mycronic's Global Technologies division working within Surfx Technologies, our Applied Plasma business line. It is an exciting time to join our team! Surfx Technologies is a fast\-growing company that offers atmospheric argon plasmas for the high\-volume manufacturing of integrated circuits, semiconductor packages, printed circuit boards, and other microelectronic devices. These automated plasma machines are an excellent choice for surface cleaning, activation, and metal oxide removal. The Surfx Technologies team delivers this atmospheric argon plasma technology for assembled products that are less likely to corrode, delaminate, or come unglued during their lifetime. Our customers include the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers and technology companies. The Senior Semiconductor Equipment Engineer (Mechanical) is responsible for the design, development, and continuous improvement of automated plasma equipment for the semiconductor industry. This role leads mechanical engineering activities from initial concept and system design through prototyping, testing, validation, and product launch, applying strong expertise in mechatronics to develop high\-precision, reliable equipment. The engineer works closely with electrical, controls, software, and process engineering teams to integrate complex systems and ensure equipment meets performance, quality, and reliability requirements. In collaboration with sales, service, and management, this role also supports troubleshooting, addresses technical challenges, and identifies opportunities to enhance equipment functionality, manufacturability, and overall performance. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead mechanical engineering development for turnkey plasma equipment, from initial concept and feasibility through detailed design, prototyping, testing, and product launch * Design and integrate mechanical and mechatronic systems for high\-precision, automated plasma tools used in front\-end and back\-end semiconductor manufacturing * Develop detailed mechanical designs, assemblies, and engineering documentation using SolidWorks, applying GD\&T principles to ensure dimensional accuracy, manufacturability, and reliable equipment performance * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, contributing to a collaborative engineering environment and the development of innovative equipment solutions * Collaborate with electrical, controls, software, and process engineering teams to integrate subsystems and deliver complete, reliable equipment solutions * Plan and execute equipment testing, troubleshooting, and design validation to ensure tools meet performance, quality, and reliability requirements, including damage\-free and particle\-free surface modification * Apply engineering analysis, FMEA, and structured problem\-solving methods to identify design risks, resolve technical issues, and improve equipment reliability and performance * Manage engineering project schedules, resources, and deliverables, coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders to keep product development activities on track * Work closely with sales, service, and process engineering teams to address customer requirements, incorporate field feedback, and guide continuous product improvement * Support equipment installation, commissioning, and technical troubleshooting at customer sites worldwide **Experience and Qualifications** * Master's or PhD degree in mechatronics (i.e. mechanical, electrical, etc.) * 10 years plus of mechanical tool design experience, preferably in the semiconductor industry or working with high precision equipment applications * Proficiency in SolidWorks, GD\&T, and Microsoft project * Knowledge of equipment cleanliness and safety standards (ISO, CE, UL, SEMI, NFPA, etc.) * Strong verbal and written communication as well as project management skills * Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers; work both independently and effectively within a team * Travel domestically and internationally to customer sites, as needed * Must be currently authorized to work full\-time in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship * Prior experience with providing technical guidance and project management mentorship to team members, fostering knowledge sharing, effective planning, cross\-functional collaboration **Why Join Us?** At Mycronic, we love what we do, but most importantly who we do it with. Because to us the relationships we have with our customers and each other are the keys to success. jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Safety
jobs.description: **About Mytra:** We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry \- moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e\-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. **About the role** ------------------ As an Automation Engineer at Mytra, you will join our Systems Engineering team during a period of rapid product development and scaling. Our team is focused on building the control, safety, and electrical infrastructure that ensures safe operation of the Mytra system. We are looking for a hands\-on, systems\-oriented integration engineer who brings deep experience with traditional industrial automation while also understanding modern embedded systems and software. You will help us deliver robust systems today using proven off\-the\-shelf industrial hardware while contributing to our longer\-term roadmap toward a more modern embedded hardware and software architecture. You will design, integrate, and debug safety\- and mission\-critical systems that must be robust, diagnosable, and maintainable. You will also help determine the right balance between commercial industrial automation components and custom hardware developed internally. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Develop and maintain PLC\-based control and safety systems, including distributed I/O, industrial networks, and interfaces to mobile and stationary automation equipment. * Design high\-voltage and low\-voltage electrical panels and control cabinets using ePLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar tools. * Work closely with **Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Firmware, and Software teams** to define clear interfaces and develop features that integrate mechanical, electrical, and software capabilities. * Develop specialized service and commissioning tools, such as jog pendants, and scalable control and safety architectures for site deployments that push the limits of conventional industrial automation. * Troubleshoot complex electromechanical systems across **electrical, controls, embedded, networking, and software boundaries.** * Support system integration, commissioning, testing, and root\-cause investigations in Mytra facilities and, occasionally, at customer sites. **Ideal Candidates** -------------------- * Significant hands\-on experience designing, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial control systems using Beckhoff TwinCAT/TwinSAFE, Siemens controllers and Siemens Safety, or comparable PLC and safety platforms. * Experience designing electrical control systems and panels using ePLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar tools. * Strong understanding of industrial controls hardware, sensors, actuators, safety devices, distributed I/O, and safety communications across distributed equipment. * Experience developing **safety\- and mission\-critical systems**, with an emphasis on reliability, diagnosability, fault handling, and maintainability. * Clear communication of complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience transitioning products from one to many, including developing training and documentation for manufacturing and commissioning teams. * Ability to navigate ambiguity, recognize when an approach is not working, pivot based on data and engineering evidence, and drive projects to completion. * Ability to travel domestically on occasion, approximately 0–10% annually, to support integration, commissioning, and testing at customer sites. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Familiarity with functional safety principles (e.g., HARA, FMEA, and HAZOP) and safety standards (e.g., ISO 13849, IEC 61508, and ISO 12100\). * Experience designing or integrating embedded control hardware, custom PCBAs, or microcontroller\-based systems, and evaluating when custom hardware is preferable to an off\-the\-shelf industrial controller. * Experience writing and debugging **C\+\+ and/or Python**. * Enthusiasm for **modernizing industrial automation** and replacing legacy approaches with better hardware, software, development, and debugging tools. * Experience integrating controls for **robotics, autonomous systems, material handling, warehouse automation, or similar complex electromechanical equipment.** **A Final Note:** ----------------- If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last **Benefits Include:** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier VCs * Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents * 401(k) plans and employer\-subsidized life insurance * Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table * Generous PTO and company\-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together * Voluntary pet insurance, life insurance, accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage * Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity * Commuter benefits, including up to a $150 monthly commuter benefit * Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases * Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters **Pay Notice** -------------- Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change. ***This role requires on\-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.*** ***The pay range for this role is:*** ***$175,000\- $205,000***

jobs.title: Automotive Digital Key & Vehicle Access SW Engineer ( Mountain View, CA) Onsite
jobs.description: #### **Position Overview:** We are looking for an experienced Automotive Embedded Software Engineer / Technical Lead with strong expertise in Digital Key, BLE, NFC, UWB, vehicle access controllers, Classic AUTOSAR, and FreeRTOS. The role will be responsible for the design, development, integration, and validation of secure and safety\-compliant Automotive Digital Key and Vehicle Access solutions, including BLE/NFC ECUs, Digital Key middleware, communication adapters, and ASIL\-compliant vehicle access controllers. implementation, integration, and certification activities. * Develop and integrate BLE/NFC middleware adapters between connectivity stacks, application software, and vehicle access controllers. * Develop embedded software components running on FreeRTOS and Classic AUTOSAR platforms. * Design software architecture for secure and safetycritical vehicle access controllers. * Implement communication interfaces between Digital Key middleware and vehicle ECUs using automotive communication protocols. * Integrate BLE, NFC, and UWB technology stacks with vehicle access applications and ECU software. * Develop software for secure device discovery, authentication, key exchange, ranging, and vehicle access workflows. * Ensure implementation meets applicable ASIL requirements and functionalsafety processes. * Participate in requirements analysis, architecture/design reviews, coding, integration, debugging, and verification activities. * Perform ECUlevel troubleshooting using logs, traces, debuggers, protocol analyzers, and automotive diagnostic tools. * Collaborate with system, cybersecurity, functionalsafety, hardware, validation, and vehicle integration teams. * Support CCC certification and interoperability testing, including issue analysis and resolution. * Contribute to software design documentation, interface specifications, technical reviews, and development guidelines. * Support HIL/SIL testing, vehiclelevel integration, and production readiness activities. #### **Required Technical Skills** Digital Key \& Vehicle Access * Strong handson experience with Automotive Digital Key systems. * Good understanding of CCC Digital Key architecture and specifications. * Experience with vehicle access functions such as: o Passive Entry / Passive Start * Remote Lock / Unlock o Digital Key provisioning * Device authentication o Secure vehicle access * Key sharing and lifecycle management * Experience working with BLE, NFC and/or UWB technologies in automotive applications. #### **BLE / NFC / UWB** * Strong understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) architecture, profiles, GATT/GAP, pairing/bonding, security, and connection management. * Experience integrating BLE stacks with embedded automotive applications. * Knowledge of NFC communication and secure vehicle access use cases. * Exposure to UWB ranging and localization concepts for Digital Key applications. * Experience developing BLE/UWB middleware adapters and abstraction/interface layers. #### **Embedded Software** * Strong programming skills in C/C\+\+. * Handson experience with FreeRTOS and embedded realtime software development. * Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including tasks, queues, semaphores, interrupts, timers, synchronization, and memory management. * Experience with embedded debugging, performance optimization, and fault analysis. * Good understanding of MCU peripherals, communication interfaces, and lowlevel embedded software. #### **AUTOSAR** * Strong experience with Classic AUTOSAR. * Knowledge of AUTOSAR layers including: o Application Software * RTE o BSW * MCAL o Communication stack * Diagnostics * Experience with configuration, integration, and debugging of AUTOSAR software components. * Understanding of automotive communication protocols such as CAN/CANFD, LIN, and Ethernet. #### **Functional Safety \& Security** * Experience developing ASILcompliant automotive ECUs, preferably ASILB/ASILC/ASILD systems. * Understanding of ISO 26262 functionalsafety concepts and development processes. * Experience with safety mechanisms, diagnostics, fault handling, watchdogs, safestate concepts, and safety monitoring. * Understanding of automotive cybersecurity concepts and secure communication is highly desirable. * Experience with secure boot, cryptographic services, key management, or hardware security modules is an advantage. #### **CCC Certification** Experience with CCC Digital Key certification and compliance activities is highly desirable. The candidate should be familiar with: * CCC Digital Key certification requirements. * CCC interoperability and compliance testing. * Digital Key protocol validation. * BLE/NFC/UWB interoperability. * Analysis of certification failures and protocol traces. * Debugging issues across mobile devices, Digital Key middleware, ECUs, and vehicle systems. * Supporting certification laboratories and resolving certification defects. #### **Development \& Engineering Tools** #### **Experience with several of the following is desirable:** * Vector CANoe / CANalyzer * Lauterbach / TRACE32 * JTAG/SWD debuggers * Wireshark and BLE protocol analyzers * Automotive diagnostic tools * Git / Gerrit * Jenkins / CICD * Staticanalysis and codingquality tools * HIL/SIL testing environments * Requirements and configurationmanagement tools #### **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline. * Typically 512\+ years of experience in automotive embedded software development, depending on seniority. * Proven experience in automotive ECU development and integration. * Strong experience in one or more of Digital Key, BLE, NFC, UWB, vehicle access systems, Classic AUTOSAR, or FreeRTOS. #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with CCC Digital Key certification projects. * Experience with production vehicle access controllers or Body/Access ECUs. * Experience integrating mobiledevice Digital Key solutions with vehicle ECUs. * Knowledge of UWB FiRa ecosystem and ranging technologies. * Experience with automotive cybersecurity standards such as ISO/SAE 21434\. * Knowledge of AUTOSAR security and cryptographic services. * Experience working in safetycritical embedded software development. * Experience with OEM/Tier1 automotive development processes. * Strong troubleshooting and crossfunctional debugging skills. #### **Key Competencies** * Strong embedded software architecture and design skills. * Excellent debugging and problemsolving capability. * Ability to work across application, middleware, RTOS, AUTOSAR BSW, connectivity stacks, and ECU hardware. * Good understanding of automotive software development lifecycle. * Ability to analyze complex issues across multiple ECUs and communication layers. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to work independently while coordinating with system, hardware, cybersecurity, functionalsafety, and validation teams. #### **Role Summary** The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering secure, reliable, safety\-compliant Automotive Digital Key and Vehicle Access solutions, bridging BLE/NFC/UWB connectivity, Digital Key middleware, FreeRTOS, Classic AUTOSAR, and ASIL\-compliant ECU platforms through development, integration, vehicle validation, and CCC certification. #### **Keywords for Recruiting Search** Automotive Digital Key, BLE or NFC connectivity, Classic AUTOSAR, CCC certification

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** ------------ At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people, “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity. **About the Information Service and Technology (IST) Department****:** Connecting our community and local government through innovative, accessible technology solutions. * **Customers:** Enable departments through partnerships, responsiveness, and innovation; prioritizing their needs and fulfilling their expectations. * **Solutions:** Be Innovative Business Leaders who identify opportunities early and apply technology to drive better, faster public services. **Culture:** Cultivate leadership at all levels to drive IST’s success while advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. In addition to a full benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Pension/Retirement, deferred compensation, and flexible spending accounts, we offer our employees: * Hybrid (telework/onsite) work schedules. * Options for Alternative Work Schedules (such as 4\-5/9’s). * A culture of public service collaboration and work/life balance. * Training and career development opportunities. * County benefits such as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Tuition Assistance Program (TAP). **Remote Work Options:** The IST Department has embraced a hybrid work schedule that recognizes some duties of this position may be performed remotely. Candidates must be able to work**a minimum of** **three (3\) days per week in the office**and report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule. **About the Project Management Office Team:** Our team provides centralized IT project management for technology\-related projects across all County departments. We use standard project management principles, processes, tools, and software to ensure consistent project delivery approach and success. **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- **We currently have one (1\) full\-time vacancy for a Senior IT Project Manager (County Classification: Senior Systems Engineer) in the Project Management Office (PMO) of the Information Services and Technology (IST) department.** The primary function of this assignment is senior\-level IT project management, not hands\-on systems engineering. This is an opportunity for a Senior IT Project Manager to manage and deliver significant IT projects and contribute to how technology projects are delivered across Marin County, while supporting innovation, collaboration, and improved public outcomes. Reporting to the IT Manager of PMO, the Senior IT Project Manager works with a team of IT professionals to manage health and delivery of IT projects across all methodologies (agile, hybrid, waterfall) with varied technology applications. They are responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle, stakeholders, project documentation, serve as technical specialists, operate independently with minimal supervision and provide mentorship to junior team members when needed. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO Program through developing, updating and documenting project management policies, standards and guidelines to align with organizational goals. **ABOUT YOU** ------------- The ideal candidate has senior project management experience and has previously served in a project management office. This individual has managed the implementation of IT projects independently, throughout the project lifecycle, across all project methodologies, with a proven track record of successful implementations. They possess strong knowledge of project management and technical understanding to effectively lead technology projects, collaborate with technical teams, evaluate risks and dependencies, and communicate technical considerations to business stakeholders. They should have experience of mentoring team members, manage customer interactions and engage with diverse groups of stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills are expected for cross functional collaboration with stakeholders across the organization and external parties. Specifically, they are experienced in the following: * All aspects of technology project management lifecycle across project methodologies (waterfall, hybrid and agile) while adhering to departmental policies and standards. * Proficient and have a proven track record in delivering projects on time and on budget. * Mentoring project management professionals in a team environment. * Building collaborative partnerships across business and technical teams. * Experience of technology (including system design gement experience, including independent responsibility for complex technology projects through the full project lifecycle, will be considered most competitive. **SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS** **LiveScan:** Candidates selected may be subject to fingerprinting by the Sheriff's Department and must pass a Department of Justice LiveScan background check prior to appointment. **IMPORTANT INFORMATION** ------------------------- **If you have any questions concerning this position announcement, please contact Molly Ibarra at** **molly.ibarra@marincounty.gov****.** All applicants will receive email notifications regarding their status in the recruitment process. Please be sure to check your spam settings to allow our emails to reach you. You may also log into your governmentjobs.com account to view these emails. **Testing and Eligible List:** Depending on the number of qualified applications received, the examination may consist of a highly qualified review, application screening, online assessment, written examination, oral examination, performance examination, or any combination to determine which candidates' names will be placed on the eligible list. The eligible list established from this recruitment will be used to fill the current vacancy and any future vacancies for open, fixed\-term, full\-time or part\-time positions which may occur while the list remains active. **First Round Interviews will be on Zoom Tuesday, 12/1/2026 and/or Wednesday, 12/2/2026\.** **TENTATIVE: Second Round Interviews** **will be IN PERSON** **Wednesday, 12/9/2026 and/or Thursday, 12/10/2026 (1600 Los Gamos Drive, Suite 370, San Rafael CA 94903\).** **Disaster Service Workers:** All County of Marin employees are designated Disaster Service Workers through state and local law (California Government Code Section 3100\-3109\). Employment with the County requires the affirmation of a loyalty oath to this effect. Employees are required to complete all Disaster Service Worker\-related training as assigned, and to return to work as ordered in the event of an emergency. **Equal Employment Opportunity Employer:** If you have questions regarding equal employment opportunities, please contact Roger Crawford, Equal Employment Opportunity Director at (415\) 473\-2095\. **PLEASE NOTE**: The benefits described herein do not apply to temporary (contingent) or to part\-time employees that work less than 50%. **COUNTY OF MARIN BENEFITS: GENERAL** Below are some of the excellent benefits the County offers. More information about our benefits can be found on the Marin County's Benefits Homepage. **Paid Time Off**: Competitive vacation accrual; 12 holidays per year; and generous sick leave accruals. Additional types of paid leaves are available for some bargaining units. **Health Plan**: Choice of four health plans (two Kaiser HMOs, Western Health Advantage HMO, and an Anthem Blue Cross PPO) along with dental through Delta Dental PPO, and vision through Vision Service Plan (VSP). There is a County contribution toward the premiums (the contribution amount varies depending on coverage tier elected such as employee only, employee \+ 1, employee \+ family). Plus, the County offers excellent Life Insurance, Disability, Flexible Spending Plans, a Dependent Care Assistance Program, professional development and more. **Retirement**: Defined benefit plan under the County Employees Retirement Act of 1937\. More information can be found online at www.mcera.org. **IRS 457 Plan**: Choice of pre\-tax or post\-tax (Roth) employee contribution up to the IRS annual maximum. **Retiree Medical**: The County provides access to group health plan coverage to eligible retirees. For specific questions regarding the employment process, please contact Human Resources at (415\) 473\-6104\. For additional details about the benefits or retirement, please contact the Benefits Division at (415\) 473\-2197\. * IMPORTANT NOTE: Benefits described herein do not represent a contract and may be changed without notice.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering | Data & AI Platform

As we work together to put the needs of the patient first, we are also dedicated to our employees, investing in competitive compensation and comprehensive benefit plans – to take care of you and your family, now and in the future. And with continuing education and advancement opportunities at every turn, you can build a long, successful career with Mayo Clinic. **Benefits Highlights** * Medical: Multiple plan options. * Dental: Delta Dental or reimbursement account for flexible coverage. * Vision: Affordable plan with national network. * Pre\-Tax Savings: HSA and FSAs for eligible expenses. * Retirement: Competitive retirement package to secure your future. **Responsibilities** This is an Analytics Engineering role that will join the team as a Senior Data Engineer focused on building Mayo Clinic’s IAM Data Fabric, a single, trusted source of identity data that the rest of our Identity and Access Management system is built upon. The Fabric brings identity, account, entitlement, access, ownership, and risk data from across the enterprise into one place, giving Mayo Clinic a comprehensive view of who has access to what, how it was granted, and where risk is concentrated. Access certifications, audit evidence, lifecycle automation, and executive reporting all depend on it. In this role, your primary focus will be the Fabric’s reporting and analytics layer: designing BigQuery data products and Power BI semantic models that turn identity data into clear, actionable insight for IAM leadership, application owners, Information Security, and Audit. You will partner closely with teams across the Identity Management Program to understand their questions, model the data to answer them, and establish reporting standards the broader program can rely on. Over time, you will expand into the ingestion pipelines and foundational platform components that feed the Fabric, so curiosity about how data moves from source to report and a willingness to learn ETL and platform engineering will be required. You will work hands\-on with Google Cloud, BigQuery, Dataform or dbt, Power BI, Cosmos DB and AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex, on a small, senior team where your work directly shapes how Mayo Clinic understands and secures identity. The position requires maintaining an understanding of the organization's current solutions, coding languages, tools, and regularly requires the application of independent judgment. with governed, documented metric definitions that serve as a single source of truth for key KPIs * Demonstrated experience applying dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, and data quality practices. * Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous analytic and reporting requests into well\-defined data products * Experience leading technical design reviews or establishing engineering and reporting standards for a team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with a metrics or semantic layer tool (Looker/LookML, dbt Semantic Layer/MetricFlow, or Dataform\-based metric definitions), including Looker Studio alongside Power BI * Exposure to identity, security, or compliance datasets and their governance requirements (PHI/PII handling, HIPAA, least\-privilege access), or experience Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP\-600\) * Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** $141,024 \- $204,526 / jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Data & AI
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** -------------------- Engineering \& Intelligence is building a capability\-based organization to support McCarthy’s next stage of growth. The Engineering, Data \& AI pillar provides the technical capabilities required to build, integrate, operate, govern, and scale applications, Foundry, data, AI, and engineering platforms. The Director, Engineering, Data \& AI will lead the combined Engineering, Data \& AI capability within Engineering \& Intelligence. This leader will establish the organization, operating model, talent strategy, technical accountability, and delivery discipline required to build and operate McCarthy’s technology capabilities at enterprise scale. The scope includes Applications \& Integration, Foundry Engineering, Engineering Enablement, Data Engineering, Data Management, AI Engineering, DataOps/MLOps, and the interfaces to platform administration, governance, FinOps, and reporting. The Director will create a coherent engineering system across applications, Foundry, data, AI, and platform capabilities while maintaining clear boundaries with Enterprise Architecture, Digital Products \& Platforms, Cybersecurity, and Technical Program Management \& Delivery. This role is accountable for how the organization builds, delivers, and operates technology. This role owns engineering and operational execution. **RESPONSIBILITIES** -------------------- ### **Pillar strategy and operating model** * Define and execute the Engineering, Data \& AI capability strategy in support of McCarthy’s business and technology priorities. * Establish clear ownership across applications, integrations, Foundry, data, AI, engineering enablement, and platform\-related operations. * Design an operating model that supports shared platforms, cross\-team dependencies, production ownership, and a consistent engineering lifecycle. * Translate enterprise priorities into a practical portfolio of capability investments, workforce needs, technical roadmaps, and delivery outcomes. * Establish decision rights, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and performance measures across the pillar. * Build the organization for scale, including leadership depth, internal talent development, partner strategy, and succession planning. ### **Engineering and platform leadership** * Oversee Applications \& Integration, Foundry Engineering, Engineering Enablement, CI/CD, testing, reliability, production support, and engineering standards. * Ensure application and Foundry engineering operate with shared standards, appropriate technical boundaries, and effective cross\-team collaboration. * Establish practices that improve software quality, delivery predictability, reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness. * Partner with platform administration on governance, FinOps, environment readiness, access, platform health, and operating controls. * Guide the transition from partner\-supported delivery to durable McCarthy\-owned engineering capabilities. * Ensure engineering investments are aligned to business value, enterprise architecture, capacity, and production needs. ### **Data and AI leadership** * Oversee Data Engineering, Data Management, AI Engineering, DataOps, and MLOps through the Senior Manager, Data Engineering \& AI and other leaders. * Establish the data and AI engineering lifecycle from data acquisition and management through production deployment, monitoring, governance, and retirement. * Improve the reliability, quality, discoverability, security, and reuse of enterprise data and AI capabilities. * Ensure AI and data solutions are production\-ready, observable, maintainable, and aligned with responsible\-use and security expectations. * Partner with Enterprise Architecture on data, AI, solution, integration, and platform architecture decisions. * Connect Foundry, data, AI, and application engineering so that shared capabilities are designed for reuse rather than isolated point solutions. ### **Product and enterprise partnership** * Partner with Digital Products \& Platforms to translate business outcomes and product priorities into feasible technical strategies and delivery plans. * Partner with Enterprise Architecture to shape solutions early and resolve architectural tradeoffs with clear accountability. * Partner with Technical Program Management \& Delivery to improve demand shaping, prioritization, sequencing, dependency management, release readiness, and executive visibility. * Partner with Cybersecurity, business stakeholders, vendors, and strategic technology partners to manage risk and enable delivery. * Communicate technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, investment needs, and delivery health to executive stakeholders. ### **Talent, culture, and leadership** * Hire, develop, and retain strong leaders and technical talent across engineering, data, AI, and platform capabilities. * Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and “We, Not I” behavior. * Create career paths for engineers, architects, data professionals, AI engineers, and technical leaders. * Set expectations for inclusive leadership, thoughtful decision\-making, and transparent communication. * Balance near\-term delivery with long\-term capability development and technical sustainability. **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data science, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 12 years senior leadership experience across software engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technology platforms, or a closely related enterprise technology domain. * 5\+ years of technical people leadership and experience leading through managers or senior technical leaders. * Demonstrated success designing and operating technology organizations through growth, transformation, platform modernization, or operating\-model change. * Strong understanding of software engineering, cloud platforms, data platforms, AI/ML engineering, integration, DevOps, reliability, security partnership, and production operations. * Experience translating business strategy into technology strategy, organizational design, investment priorities, and measurable execution. * Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, talent leadership, and change\-leadership skills. * Ability to lead through influence across Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Finance, Operations, vendors, and business stakeholders. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience scaling an enterprise engineering, data, and AI organization in a complex or regulated environment. * Experience with modern data platforms, AI/ML platforms, MLOps, cloud\-native engineering, enterprise integration, or platform engineering. * Experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable platforms is helpful but not required. * Experience transitioning from contractor\- or partner\-led delivery to an internal engineering operating model. *McCarthy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.* ***NOTICE TO EXTERNAL SEARCH FIRMS:*** *McCarthy’s Talent Acquisition Team is the* ***only authorized representative*** *permitted to engage with external search firms, staffing agencies, or other third\-party recruiting partners. McCarthy maintains an Approved Agency List for recruiting partners, which is reviewed and updated annually.* *McCarthy will only consider submissions from agencies with a signed fee agreement in place for the current year. McCarthy does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate submissions, or referrals from agencies that do not meet these requirements.* *If a candidate is submitted without an active agreement, McCarthy will have no obligation to pay any fees and reserves the right to contact, engage, interview, or hire such candidate(s) without any financial or other responsibility to the submitting agency. Unsolicited resumes, including those sent directly to hiring managers or other employees, will be considered the property of McCarthy.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. We are looking for a hands\-on **Software Engineer** to help build, support, and enhance enterprise pricing applications. This role will work across backend services, integrations, production support, and ongoing feature development. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs * Support integrations across enterprise applications and data services * Troubleshoot production issues and perform root\-cause analysis * Improve application performance, reliability, and scalability * Support deployments, testing, and release activities * Deliver enhancements from requirements through production * Maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks * Partner with product, architecture, and business teams on solution design ### **Qualifications** * **Bachelor’s degree required** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field * **4\+ years of software engineering experience** * Strong backend development and object\-oriented programming skills * Experience with microservices and REST APIs * Experience with cloud\-based enterprise applications * Strong SQL and relational database skills * Production troubleshooting and application support experience * Familiarity with CI/CD, source control, monitoring, and logging * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline * Experience with distributed systems and high\-volume applications * Experience integrating with enterprise ERP, CRM, or transactional systems * Experience supporting business\-critical or pricing\-related applications * Familiarity with performance tuning, resiliency, and production operations **About MMS** McKesson Medical\-Surgical (MMS), which is expected to become Wellverse in early 2027, is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical\-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non\-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long\-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers. Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly, and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we collaborate with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 270,000 SKUs of branded and private\-label medical\-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID\-19 tests. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: About Meeru AI Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — **SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises** — across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. The Role We are looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to build the AI and intelligence layer — and help uphold the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data. You'll build the machine\-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural\-language output, and help uphold the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You own significant pieces of the layer end\-to\-end, working closely with our Staff AI Engineer and evaluation engineer, and you build per\-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You turn designs into robust production systems, measure quality rigorously, help turn user feedback into durable improvements, and grow toward staff\-level technical ownership. **Requirements** * Build per\-customer ML models that learn normal vs. anomalous behavior on time\-series and operational data, using statistical baselines and gradient\-boosted models (LightGBM/XGBoost) with strict anti\-leakage discipline. * Build a template\-first natural\-language generation layer that is strictly grounded in verified data, using guardrails and structured output to prevent hallucinated or unsupported statements. * Implement agentic orchestration (LangGraph or equivalent) with verification and human\-confirmation checkpoints. * Integrate managed LLMs running inside customer clouds (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI). * Partner with an evaluation engineer to gate grounding, hallucination, and faithfulness checks in CI. * Turn user feedback into durable model and system improvements. * Ship production Python services with SQL/warehouse access (Snowflake, PostgreSQL) in containerized, customer\-hosted deployments. ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Finance or accounting domain experience (fintech, FP\&A, ERP, audit, financial close). * Feature\-attribution experience (e.g. SHAP), along with an understanding of its limits. * Human\-in\-the\-loop systems and feedback loops. * Hands\-on work with Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Azure OpenAI in VPC or private deployments. * Zero\-inflated or sparse\-event modeling.
