jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN)** is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non\-human pilot to deliver full\-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation. ### **About You:** You are a hands\-on software engineer who enjoys connecting software, simulation models, and physical hardware. You take ownership of well\-defined engineering efforts, troubleshoot methodically, and collaborate with teammates to deliver reliable solutions. You are comfortable writing code, working in Linux, and testing directly with laboratory equipment. As part of Merlin’s Virtual Test Environments (VTE) team, you will help develop and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments and the software that captures, displays, and replays engineering data. Working alongside our Staff Software Integration Engineer, you will help engineers exercise aircraft systems and resolve integration issues before flight. ### **Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain C\+\+ and Python software connecting aircraft avionics, simulation models, test hardware, and engineering tools. * Implement software components and hardware interfaces within the architecture established by the Staff Software Integration Engineer, contributing to design decisions and code reviews. * Integrate UEI PowerDNA equipment through vendor SDKs, low\-level I/O APIs, and hardware abstraction layers. * Configure and validate ARINC 429, CAN, serial, analog, and discrete interfaces using aircraft interface control documents, including signal mapping, message encoding, update rates, and error handling. * Support real\-time execution of aircraft simulation models, including periodic processing, I/O exchange, watchdogs, and performance diagnostics. * Develop and maintain telemetry interfaces and data\-processing components that collect, validate, record, and distribute data over UDP, TCP, and messaging systems. * Contribute to asynchronous Rust services for telemetry ingestion, timestamp alignment, flight\-test displays, and session recording, with technical guidance from senior engineers. * Build operator displays and diagnostic tools using technologies such as GL Studio, React, HTML5, SQL, and web APIs. * Build, deploy, and troubleshoot software on Linux hosts and embedded targets using established cross\-compilation, packaging, systemd, and Docker workflows. * Write unit tests, Python\-based smoke tests, and hardware integration tests; help reproduce defects and add regression coverage. * Collaborate with avionics, aircraft software, flight dynamics, and lab engineers to diagnose issues across software, networks, and connected hardware. * Maintain code and configuration changes in Git, track work in Jira, and document interfaces, deployment steps, and troubleshooting procedures. ### **Qualifications:** * Proficiency developing and debugging modern C\+\+ and Python software. * Strong working familiarity with Linux host systems, including command\-line tools, software builds, dependencies, services, permissions, networking, and diagnostics. * Experience integrating software with physical hardware, external systems, or vendor libraries and APIs. * Understanding of resource management, multithreading, synchronization, and error handling in C\+\+. * Familiarity with UDP/TCP networking and binary data formats, including byte order, message framing, and input validation. * Familiarity with timing\-sensitive software concepts such as periodic execution, buffering, latency, and watchdogs. * Ability to interpret technical documentation and interface definitions and translate them into working software and tests. * Experience using Git for collaborative development, automated testing, and Jira or comparable issue tracking. * Familiarity with Docker\-based application deployment. * Willingness to learn Rust, embedded Linux deployment, and avionics interfaces with support from experienced engineers. * Ability to work independently on assigned components, communicate progress and blockers, and seek guidance when needed. * Ability to work regularly onsite in our Boston lab to integrate and troubleshoot physical equipment. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience with UEI PowerDNA/PDNA SDKs or comparable data acquisition and avionics interface platforms. * Familiarity with ARINC 429, CAN, and RS\-232/RS\-422 serial interfaces. * Experience with embedded Linux, ARM targets, cross\-compilation, CMake, Yocto SDKs, Debian packaging, or systemd services. * Experience with Rust, particularly asynchronous programming using Tokio, serde, or axum. * Experience integrating or troubleshooting low\-level I/O APIs, device drivers, or hardware abstraction layers. * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, aircraft simulation, or integrating generated simulation models into C\+\+ applications. * Familiarity with telemetry systems, timestamp synchronization, IRIG time, or flight\-test displays such as jobs.title: Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy & Data Protection - Applied AI
jobs.description: Meta is seeking Security Engineers with Privacy and Data protection expertise to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. You will apply deep privacy engineering expertise to hard, real\-world problems in how systems collect, use, retain, expose, and delete data. Your work is AI\-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.The problems that matter here are the ones a capable engineer cannot solve by reading the code in front of them: which jurisdiction's deadline applies to a deletion request, whether a derived dataset clears an anonymity threshold, where a deletion has to cascade. Models already handle the privacy obligations that are stated as ordinary good engineering practice, so the work is the obligation they cannot derive.This role is for privacy engineers who want to operate at the intersection of deep privacy expertise and frontier AI, not just applying AI to privacy work but shaping what it is capable of. ### **Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy \& Data Familiarity with industry best practices and relevant regulatory frameworks — plus the ability to translate between those frameworks and deeply technical software engineers.What success looks like in the first year:\-A defensible, company\-wide view of the highest\-risk items across these domains, with named owners and real threat models — not a list.\-At least one shared platform or control adopted broadly enough to measurably change the company's risk posture.\-Security tradeoffs represented credibly at the VP and C\-level, with decisions made rather than deferred. ### **Security security and friction or cost, so the company can keep moving fast securely. * Drive solution design, including technical architecture, and lead implementation as needed. * Build partnerships across security, infrastructure, corporate engineering, and legal — then use those partnerships to translate ambiguous business and regulatory requirements into well\-articulated tradeoffs between "secure Our vision is bold and broad — to build systems that have true artificial intelligence across agents, applications, services, and infrastructure. It’s also inclusive: we aim to make AI accessible to all — consumers, businesses, developers — so that everyone can realize its benefits. **About the Team** **Build the frontier of AI on Windows.** Our organization builds frontier AI experiences, including agentic actions that get real work done on your behalf and autopilot experiences that keep working in the background so you don't have to. We move fast. We take new ideas from prototype to customers quickly and learn from real usage as we go. Everything we build serves one goal: making Windows an AI\-first operating system. That includes computer\-use agents (CUA) that can work across any app the way a person would, and hybrid compute that uses both the device and the cloud to make experiences fast, capable and private. As a manager here, you'd lead a team that ships what's next for a platform used by more than a billion people, and help shape how everyone uses a PC in the AI era. **About the Role** We are seeking an Engineering Manager to help build revolutionary experiences at the intersection of modality and intelligence. The pace is fast. The ambiguity is high. You'll ship things that millions of people use—and you'll ship things that don't exist anywhere else yet. If you want to work on well\-scoped problems with clear answers, this isn't the team. If you want to define the future of how humans and AI live and work together, come build with us. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. *AI Experiences employees who live within a 50\- mile commute of a designated Microsoft Hub in the U.S. are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.* **Responsibilities** * Build and lead a team of fullstack engineers, including driving project planning, prioritization of work, and designing features. * Guides teams and leads identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform. * Make hands\-on contributions to the codebase and infrastructure. * Guide architecture and design efforts by leading discussions, creating proposals and design documents, and ensuring solutions meet business, security, and compliance requirements. * Ship AI powered experiences that will shape how millions of people will interact with AI in the future. * Drive implementation of features and systems, breaking down long\-term goals into clear milestones, aligning with release plans, and ensuring cross\-team coordination. * Embody our culture and values. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 15\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * 8\+ years people management experience. \#AIX Software Engineering M6 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $165,600 \- $296,400 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $220,800 \- $331,200 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Transformation Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ Mosaic Health is seeking a hands\-on engineer with strong applied AI experience and deep knowledge of technology infrastructure and data pipelines. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role, not a people\-management position. You will build applications, integrations and automated workflows across apree, CareMore and Millennium Physician Group. Your work will connect operational needs with dependable technical solutions that improve service, reduce manual effort and support the business. You will take initiative and personally carry solutions from discovery through rapid prototyping, pilot deployment and value validation, then partner with IT, data and security teams to industrialize solutions approved to scale. You will spend a substantial portion of your time designing, writing, testing and troubleshooting code, including the data pipelines that support your applications. Success requires independent execution and close collaboration: you will seek input early, work constructively with operational, IT, data and security partners, and keep stakeholders informed. You will focus on a prioritized set of initiatives, understand differences in workflows and systems across the businesses, and build reusable capabilities that can be adapted to local needs. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Work with operational teams to understand workflows, handoffs, exceptions and sources of data. Turn an agreed business objective into a practical technical plan, identify missing information, and drive the next steps without waiting for fully specified requirements. * Build, collaborate on, and maintain AI\-enabled applications, backend services and integrations. Apply language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling where they solve a defined operational problem. * Design and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating and delivering structured and unstructured data. Handle data quality, schema changes, retries, duplicate records and backfills, and make data lineage and failures traceable. * Prototype and evaluate models, frameworks and software tools. Compare AI\-based approaches with conventional software and existing products, and recommend solutions based on measured quality, latency, cost, maintainability and operational fit. * Build evaluation datasets and automated tests for model outputs, retrieval quality and complete workflows. * Partner with IT, data and security teams across Mosaic Health on approved architecture, access, integrations and deployment. Build pilots within approved environments and, for solutions approved to scale, work with Technology to transition and industrialize them with appropriate identity and access controls, networking, secrets management, auditability and protection of sensitive information. * Collaborate with consultants and vendors while retaining hands\-on ownership of your deliverables. Review designs and code, contribute directly to implementation, and ensure documentation and knowledge transfer allow you to maintain and extend the work. * Work with business owners and Finance partners on pilot rollout, user feedback and value validation. Establish the baseline and track adoption, cycle time, manual effort, error rates, and realized operational and financial value to determine whether the solution should scale. **WHAT YOU BRING** * Typically, 5\-7 years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on experience building and deploying AI\-enabled applications. Demonstrated ownership of production systems and the ability to explain technical decisions, failures and improvements. * Evidence of personally taking a product or workflow from an initial idea through pilot deployment and value validation, with demonstrated ability to partner on industrialization and ongoing improvement, including integrating language models into real applications. Able to explain what you built, how you resolved obstacles, and how you supported the solution after launch. * Strong backend development skills in Python and/or TypeScript, proficiency in SQL, and experience designing APIs, services and database schemas. * Practical understanding of language model APIs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling. Able to design workflows around model limitations and select the appropriate approach for the task. * Experience evaluating AI systems with representative datasets and measurable quality criteria, including retrieval accuracy, unsupported outputs, edge cases and regression testing. Able to balance quality, latency and cost. * Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed applications, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, containers, queues, observability and CI/CD. Experience diagnosing production issues and making reliability, security and cost tradeoffs. * A record of taking initiative and delivering with limited day\-to\-day direction. Able to break ambiguous problems into manageable steps, make sound technical decisions, learn unfamiliar tools, and follow through on implementation and support. Recognizes when to seek input or escalate a dependency, bringing clear options and a recommended next step. * A collaborative working style: listens to frontline users, seeks and incorporates feedback, shares knowledge, and works respectfully across disciplines. Communicates progress and tradeoffs clearly, follows through on commitments, and helps partners resolve shared problems. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating data pipelines, including ETL/ELT, batch and event\-driven processing, orchestration, data validation and monitoring. Understands how source\-system behavior, data freshness, lineage and schema changes affect downstream applications and AI outputs. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. * 5\-7 years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant experience serving as a technical lead, software architect, or principal engineer responsible for enterprise\-scale software platforms. * Expert\-level knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, cloud\-native application development, microservices, API design, engineering automation, CI/CD, secure software development, and enterprise application design. * Demonstrated expertise establishing engineering standards for AI\-assisted software development, including responsible AI adoption, code provenance, data privacy, software quality, and engineering governance. * Deep experience implementing and advancing full\-stack observability capabilities, including application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, telemetry, logging, cloud monitoring, and operational analytics across complex production environments. * Proven ability to influence enterprise technology strategy, lead cross\-functional engineering initiatives, establish technical standards, and build alignment across Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Information Security, and executive technology leadership. * Exceptional analytical, communication, mentoring, and technical leadership skills with demonstrated technical adaptability and experience evaluating, introducing, and operationalizing emerging software engineering technologies and industry best practices. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: Senior IT Cloud and Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ The Senior IT Cloud and Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and optimizing complex Azure and hybrid infrastructure solutions. The role provides advanced support, leads medium to large projects, develops technical standards, and serves as an escalation point. This position requires broad technical expertise, independent decision\-making, mature project execution, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence outcomes across teams. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement scalable, secure, resilient, and supportable Azure infrastructure solutions based on business and technical requirements. * Engineer Azure compute, networking, storage, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, identity integration, and governance capabilities. * Design Azure storage solutions using Blob Storage, Azure Files, managed disks, private connectivity, encryption, lifecycle management, replication, immutability, and appropriate redundancy models. * Lead hybrid integration across Azure, Windows Server, Linux, enterprise storage, backup platforms, VMware, Active Directory, DNS, and network services. * Diagnose complex issues involving performance, availability, storage latency, networking, authentication, replication, backup, and application dependencies. * Design automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Azure CLI, Bicep, Terraform, ARM templates, JSON, YAML, source control, and CI/CD pipelines. * Develop reusable infrastructure\-as\-code modules, deployment patterns, configuration standards, and automated validation controls. * Establish technical standards for availability, resiliency, security, monitoring, patching, backup, disaster recovery, capacity, and lifecycle management. * Analyze Azure utilization, performance, and cost data and recommend rightsizing, reservations, savings plans, storage tiering, and architecture improvements. * Lead medium to large infrastructure projects, including requirements, design, planning, scheduling, resource coordination, risk management, implementation, and operational transition. * Create and review architecture diagrams, design documents, implementation plans, support models, risk assessments, test plans, and recovery procedures. * Communicate complex concepts, options, risks, and recommendations to engineers, architects, project managers, application owners, vendors, and leadership. * Serve as a technical escalation point for major incidents and lead root\-cause analysis, restoration, corrective action, and preventive improvement. * Mentor Level I and II engineers, provide technical reviews, delegate work, and support development of team capabilities. * Proactively identify emerging risks, technical debt, process gaps, and modernization opportunities, then develop and lead improvement plans. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree required. 4\-6 years of systems engineering or enterprise infrastructure experience * Advanced expertise in Windows Server and/or Linux environments and enterprise virtualization platforms * Experience with storage area networks, backup systems, and high\-availability configurations * Proficiency with automation tools and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Ansible) * Strong knowledge of systems performance tuning, capacity planning, and infrastructure security * Microsoft MCSA/MCSE, VMware VCP, or equivalent certification required. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $93,675\.00 to $140,513\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

Basic familiarity with JavaScript, JSON, browser development tools, or web technologies; hands\-on coding experience is helpful but not required. * **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans * Generous 401(k) savings plan * Education assistance * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service * And many more — check out our benefits site HERE *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

The work will focus on technologies and methods that enable improved sensor design and manufacturability. This Senior Biomedical Engineer will partner cross functionally to highlight insights from real\-world sensor performance data, driving continuous sensor improvement initiatives and directly informing next\-generation sensing platform designs. jobs.title: MES & Equipment Integration Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an MES \& Equipment Integration Engineer to provide daily support for MES and related shop\-floor applications and maintain connectivity and data exchange between production equipment, PLCs, SCADA, data collection platforms, and manufacturing applications. This role requires an understanding of manufacturing processes and practical experience with equipment interfaces or industrial data collection. The engineer will troubleshoot common MES issues and work with Automation, Maintenance, Engineering, and vendors to resolve issues between equipment and application systems, supporting production continuity, data accuracy, and product traceability. The role will also support new programs, equipment, and production lines by defining requirements, configuring systems, testing interfaces, and supporting launch activities, translating production, process, quality, and customer requirements into working equipment and system integrations. **Key Responsibilities*** **Daily MES Support and Troubleshooting** Support production order execution, material scanning and consumption, production reporting, quality recording, label printing, product traceability, user access, and operator terminals. Prioritize issues based on production impact, resolve common issues independently, and coordinate complex issues with the appropriate teams. * **Equipment Connectivity and SCADA Data Collection Support** Assist with configuring, testing, and maintaining data connections between equipment, PLCs, SCADA or industrial gateways, and MES. Support the collection of machine status, production counts, downtime, alarms, process parameters, and test results. Validate tag mappings, data types, units, and timestamps, and troubleshoot basic communication and data issues. * **Production Incident Response and Cross\-System Troubleshooting** Use application logs, SQL queries, interface monitoring, and equipment information to identify where issues occur. Work with Automation, Maintenance, Infrastructure, and vendors to restore service. Follow through on data recovery, completeness checks, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to reduce recurring incidents. * **Process Parameters, Quality Data, and Traceability Support** Help associate critical process parameters, measurements, and test results with product serial numbers or batches, operations, and equipment. Where required, support approved parameter or recipe downloads, execution confirmation, and exception handling. Work with Process Engineering, Quality, and Automation to verify parameter accuracy and traceability completeness. * **Project Implementation and On\-Site Launch Support** Participate in requirements analysis, equipment interface definition, system configuration, installation, deployment, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and launch support for new equipment, production lines, and plant projects, including those in Alabama. Help validate normal production, communication interruptions, reconnection, and data recovery scenarios, and track issues through closure. * **Manufacturing and Logistics Systems Coordination** Work with the SAP PP specialist and master data owners to validate MES configurations and mappings for production orders, materials, operations, and work centers. As needed, collaborate with the warehouse systems owner and vendors to support relevant interfaces and workflows connecting MES with SAP, automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS), AGVs, and other shop\-floor systems. * **Documentation, Training, and Continuous Improvement** Maintain interface specifications, equipment tag lists, configuration records, test documentation, and troubleshooting guides. Train shop\-floor users and improve configurations, monitoring, and appropriate automation to increase system reliability and data quality. Changes to equipment control logic and safety interlocks must be reviewed and performed by the responsible specialists. **Required Qualifications*** Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience. * At least 2 years of experience implementing or supporting manufacturing systems, including hands\-on MES implementation or operational support. * Understanding of core manufacturing processes, including production execution, material consumption, production reporting, quality recording, and product traceability, with the ability to troubleshoot common MES issues independently. * **Practical equipment\-related experience is required:** participation in at least one area such as equipment connectivity, PLC data acquisition, SCADA configuration, industrial data collection, or equipment\-to\-MES interface commissioning. Candidates should be able to explain their specific contribution and issues they helped resolve. * Understanding of the basic relationships between PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, and MES, with the ability to use equipment tag lists, communication settings, and system logs to troubleshoot alongside automation or equipment engineers. * Practical exposure to at least one industrial communication protocol or equipment interface, such as OPC UA, Modbus TCP, Siemens S7, or vendor\-specific interfaces, plus basic network connectivity troubleshooting skills. * Ability to use SQL queries, application logs, or interface monitoring tools to validate data and investigate issues. * Strong communication, collaboration, and follow\-through skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in English with plant users, technical teams, and vendors, and clearly document issues and resolutions. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in automotive components or other discrete manufacturing environments. * Familiarity with PLC platforms such as Siemens or Allen\-Bradley, including the ability to read relevant logic or perform online diagnostics. * Experience installing, deploying, configuring, commissioning, or maintaining SCADA or industrial data collection platforms. * Practical experience with at least one programming or scripting language, such as C\#, Python, or Java, to help maintain interfaces or develop basic support tools. * Experience integrating data from vision inspection, tightening, press\-fit, leak testing, precision measurement, or similar equipment; or experience with recipe management, parameter validation, and unit\-level traceability. * Experience supporting MES integration with SAP, AS/RS, or AGVs, or participating in new production line or plant launches. **On\-Site Support and After\-Hours On\-Call Requirements** This role is primarily based on\-site at the Lewisburg plant. Working hours may need to be adjusted to accommodate production schedules, equipment commissioning, and system launches. Travel to Alabama and other relevant plants is required as project needs arise. The engineer will participate in after\-hours on\-call support as scheduled by the team, responding promptly to urgent incidents such as line stoppages, unavailable critical systems, interrupted equipment data collection, or significant data issues. Support includes remote troubleshooting and on\-site assistance when necessary. All on\-site activities and system changes must follow plant safety and change management requirements.

jobs.title: Staff AI Solutions Engineer - Nuclear & Safety
jobs.description: As a global leader in radiation safety, detection and measurement, Mirion Technologies is advancing radiation safety through innovative technologies and solutions. Mirion's Nuclear \& Safety business group builds the hardware, software, and services that keep nuclear power plants, laboratories and research facilities, defense operations, and radiation\-hazard workplaces safe and effective. We're investing in a small, high\-impact team of embedded AI Solutions Engineers who will sit inside our Nuclear \& Safety business units and turn everyday operational friction across manufacturing, quality, service, and back\-office workflows, into measurable efficiency gains using modern AI. This is not a research role and not a central\-platform role. You will spend most of your time with the people who run the business (i.e. plant managers, quality engineers, field service leaders, product managers), finding the highest\-leverage problems and then personally designing, building, and shipping the solution. Your toolkit spans the full range of applied AI: computer vision for visual inspection and image\-based QA, spectral and sensor\-data analytics, basic software development, and agentic AI / LLM\-based automation for decision support and workflow orchestration. You'll report directly to the Chief AI and Digital Officer, giving you a direct line to enterprise AI strategy while you operate with the autonomy of a startup engineer inside a public, nuclear\-regulated industrial company. What You'll Do Find and frame the opportunity * Embed within the Nuclear \& Safety business unit, attending their staff meetings, walking their production floor, shadowing their field service and quality teams to fully understand the business and landscape of problems * Build a first\-hand map of where manual, error\-prone, or slow processes are costing time and money. * Translate ambiguous, non\-technical pain points ("our detector inspection and QA review takes too long," "we can't keep up with service tickets") into scoped, buildable AI solutions, and build the business case for prioritizing them. Build and ship * Design and deploy solutions for use cases such as automated visual inspection of detectors and assemblies, defect and anomaly detection, spectral and sensor\-data analysis, and image\-based quality verification. * Design and deploy agentic AI systems (LLM\-based agents, workflow orchestration, and automation) to reduce manual effort in manufacturing, service, quality and compliance documentation, and other back\-office functions. * Own the full lifecycle: rapid prototyping, pilot with real users, hardening for production, and handoff or ongoing support, leveraging shared enterprise services and without waiting for a large team to do it for you. Communicate and drive adoption * Present progress, trade\-offs, and results in plain business language to business counterparts (plant managers, quality leaders, and executives who don't have an AI background) and adjust your approach based on their feedback. * Define and track the metrics (cycle time, error rate, cost, throughput) that prove a solution is actually working, and course\-correct quickly when it isn't. * Lead change management and light training so solutions get adopted, not shelved. Operate within the broader AI function * Partner with the Chief AI \& Digital Officer and central AI/Digital team to stay aligned on architecture, security, data governance, and tooling standards, and to bring reusable patterns back to the center. * Apply appropriate rigor for a regulated nuclear environment (nuclear quality assurance, validation, documentation, export controls, cybersecurity) in partnership with Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance colleagues. What Success Looks Like in Year One * At least 2–3 AI\-driven solutions in production, each tied to a measurable operational KPI (time saved, defect reduction, cost avoidance, throughput gained). * A trusted, self\-sustaining relationship with business unit leadership. They should come to you with problems rather than reaching out to the CAIDO, directly. * A reusable playbook or pattern (for computer vision, for agentic workflows, or both) that can be extended to other Nuclear \& Safety business units or replicated by peer AI solutions engineers. What You Bring Required * 5\+ years shipping production software or applied ML/AI systems, with real users depending on what you built. * Experience in software engineering and cloud\-based application development and deployment * Hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or a comparable custom agent framework), including prompt design and retrieval\-augmented approaches. * Strong core software engineering: Python, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), APIs, and enough MLOps/DevOps fluency to get something into production and keep it running. * A demonstrated track record of high agency. Ideally a history of projects you identified, scoped, and delivered with minimal direction, not just tickets you executed that were assigned in JIRA. * Excellent communication skills with non\-technical audiences. Strong ability to clearly explain what a model does and doesn't do without jargon, and knowledge of how to build trust with non\-technical operators. * Comfort with ambiguity and autonomy. You will often be the only AI/software person in the room and working daily with those with little\-to\-no AI skills. You will be part of a team of centralized peers with strong skills but will operate independently to deliver business\-unit\-specific results. Strongly Preferred * Hands\-on experience building computer vision solutions (e.g., OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow, image classification/detection/segmentation pipelines), or ML on spectra, waveforms, and sensor time\-series data. * Experience in Azure or AWS, Databricks, and Claude/OpenAI integration via AWS Bedrock or Azure Foundry * Experience in a regulated industry — nuclear power, defense, medical devices, or industrial manufacturing under a formal quality system (e.g., ISO 9001, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, NQA\-1\). * Prior experience as an embedded, business\-facing, or "forward\-deployed" engineer, solutions engineer, or applied AI generalist, rather than a purely research\-facing ML role. * Domain exposure to nuclear power plant instrumentation and controls, radiation detection and measurement, gamma spectroscopy, health physics, or radiation safety and monitoring workflows. Why This Role * Direct visibility with the Chief AI \& Digital Officer and a real hand in shaping how AI gets built and scaled across Mirion Nuclear \& Safety. * The rare combination of startup\-style autonomy and ownership with the stability, resources, and mission of a global public company protecting workers, communities, and the environment. * A builder's role. You will ship things that change how people work, not produce slide decks about how AI might someday help. **Mirion Technologies (NYSE:** MIR) is a global leader in radiation safety, science, and medicine, protecting people and the planet from the harmful effects of ionizing radiation. Mirion Nuclear \& Safety powers Nuclear Power Plants, Laboratory \& Research (including spectroscopy and scientific analysis), Radiation Safety \& Monitoring, and Defense. Mirion offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes Vacation \& PTO Time, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching, HSA and FSA options, life and disability insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness resources, and several voluntary benefits including legal assistance, identity protection, and pet insurance.

jobs.title: Control Systems & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: NSC Global is seeking a **Control Systems \& Automation Engineer** to support site\-level industrial automation and control infrastructure. This role requires **100% on\-site presence** to interact directly with manufacturing control cabinets, PLCs, DCS panels, SCADA systems, and process equipment on the production floor. You will be responsible for hardware commissioning, safety interlock testing, alarm rationalization, and in\-situ calibration of field instruments within regulated, access\-controlled environments (including GMP manufacturing areas). Responsibilities: * **Site Infrastructure \& Hardware Support:** Conduct hands\-on inspection, commissioning, and maintenance of physical control cabinets, DCS panels, PLCs, and field devices. * **System Programming \& Configuration:** Program, configure, and troubleshoot DCS, SCADA, and PLC systems across major industrial vendor platforms. * **Instrumentation \& Calibration:** Perform in\-situ calibration and maintenance for process instrumentation measuring flow, temperature, pressure, and level. * **Functional Safety \& Alarm Management:** Execute safety interlock testing, implement alarm management standards, and participate in functional safety assessments. * **OT Network Maintenance:** Support, configure, and maintain Operational Technology (OT) network communications across the plant environment. * **Compliance \& Safety Management:** Follow strict site access protocols, adhere to GMP change control procedures for safety\-critical system modifications, and participate in HAZOP/PSM evaluations. Qualifications: **Technical Qualifications \& Skills** * **DCS / SCADA / PLC Platforms:** Proficiency with platforms such as Siemens PCS7, Rockwell ControlLogix, ABB System 800xA, or Honeywell Experion. * **Industrial Automation Languages:** Expertise in IEC 61131\-3 programming standards (Ladder Diagram, Function Block Diagram, Sequential Function Chart, Structured Text). * **Process Instrumentation:** Strong working knowledge of physical measurement and calibration for flow, temperature, pressure, and level instruments. * **Safety \& Alarm Standards:** Experience with Alarm Management (EEMUA 191 / ISA\-18\.2\) and Functional Safety / Safety Integrity Levels (IEC 61511, SIL). * **OT Network Protocols:** Familiarity with industrial fieldbus and Ethernet protocols, including PROFIBUS, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, OPC\-UA, and Modbus. * **Process Safety \& Change Control:** Understanding of HAZOP participation, Process Safety Management (PSM) fundamentals, and GMP change control protocols. **Site \& Work Requirements** * **On\-Site Physical Access:** Must be able to physically inspect, test, and troubleshoot cabinets, panels, and equipment on the factory floor. Remote work is not applicable for this position. * **Site Security \& Badging:** Ability to meet strict site security clearances and badging requirements for regulated manufacturing zones (e.g., GMP areas).

The Hardware and Embedded Engineering Manager leads DYMO’s Electrical, Mechanical, and Firmware Engineering functions and serves as the technical authority for the integrated hardware platform across new product development and sustaining engineering. The role translates system requirements into coordinated hardware architecture, subsystem requirements, interfaces, and technical decisions across electrical, mechanical, and firmware disciplines, ensuring the complete hardware solution meets requirements for performance, reliability, connectivity, safety, manufacturability, and cost. The manager retains direct technical authority for electrical engineering while leading and integrating the Mechanical and Firmware technical authorities responsible for detailed architecture and design within their respective disciplines. The role technically directs and challenges Original Design Manufacturer\-developed hardware solutions and ensures compliance with DYMO requirements and acceptance criteria. This is a highly hands\-on technical role, with at least 80% of time spent as an individual contributor focused on electrical engineering and/or firmware development and no more than 10–20% dedicated to functional management. The manager partners closely with the Systems Engineer/Product Architect, who owns overall product architecture, system requirements, hardware, firmware, and software allocation, cross\-system interfaces, system integration, and final system\-level technical acceptance. \#LI\-MC2 **Responsibilities** * Serve in a hands\-on manager role, spending at least 80% of time as an individual contributor focused on electrical engineering and/or firmware development. * Lead integrated hardware architecture across Electrical, Mechanical, and Firmware Engineering, translating system requirements into coordinated hardware requirements, subsystem allocations, interfaces, and acceptance criteria. * Serve as DYMO’s integrated hardware and embedded technical authority, owning hardware architecture, requirements allocation, cross\-discipline interfaces, critical technical decisions, and acceptance criteria while retaining direct technical authority for the electrical subsystem. * Define and control critical electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and firmware interfaces, including power and charging, motors and motion control, printhead control, sensors, thermal management, connectivity, electromagnetic interference and compatibility, displays, mechanisms, media handling, and hardware/firmware communications. * Lead the Electrical, Mechanical, and Firmware Engineering organization, establishing clear technical ownership, technical depth, and accountability for engineering results. * Direct Original Design Manufacturer hardware and embedded development across electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and firmware, ensuring designs meet DYMO architecture, requirements, interfaces, engineering standards, and acceptance criteria. * Lead critical hardware design reviews covering mechanical and electrical designs, firmware architecture and code, component selections, design for manufacturability, and verification evidence. * Own hardware and embedded connectivity architecture and requirements, including Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, wireless modules, antenna integration, radio frequency performance, grounding and shielding, electromagnetic compatibility, range, throughput, and connection stability. * Ensure designs meet performance and reliability requirements, including component derating, tolerance analysis, thermal behavior, immunity, emissions, electrical safety, and foreseeable operating conditions. * Own hardware\-level failure resolution and technical readiness, challenging root\-cause conclusions and ensuring corrective actions and objective verification before acceptance. * Provide technical leadership for component obsolescence, substitutions, regulatory modifications, cost reductions, and sustaining changes. * Apply automation and artificial intelligence\-assisted methods to test\-log analysis, anomaly detection, failure\-pattern identification, and engineering knowledge capture. * Standardize proven architectures, components, interfaces, design rules, and reusable test methods while evaluating emerging technologies for future product platforms. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; advanced degree preferred. * 12\+ years of experience developing complex embedded electromechanical products, with deep electrical engineering expertise and technical leadership across mechanical engineering, firmware, connectivity, and system integration. * Deep electrical engineering expertise with the ability to make architecture and design decisions across power, embedded electronics, wireless and radio frequency technologies, electromagnetic compatibility, connectivity, sensors, motors, and electromechanical systems. * Demonstrated ability to translate system requirements into hardware and subsystem requirements, interfaces, architecture, design decisions, and measurable acceptance criteria. * Demonstrated success leading integrated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and firmware development from requirements and architecture through validation, certification, mass production, and sustaining engineering. * Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams while maintaining clear technical ownership and accountability. * Experience directing Original Design Manufacturers, suppliers, and external engineering partners developing high\-volume products. * Strong technical judgment and ability to make evidence\-based decisions involving performance, reliability, safety, cost, quality, and schedule. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex electrical risks, design tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical teams and business leaders. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Join North Coast Container as a Full\-Time Controls Engineer and take ownership of automation in a hands\-on manufacturing environment in Charlotte, NC! In this onsite, first\-shift role you'll take control systems from concept and design through installation, startup and continuous improvement. You'll work alongside Engineering, Maintenance and Production to keep our equipment reliable, safe and productive. Your work will directly affect equipment uptime, production performance and how maintainable our plant systems are over the long term. You'll be trusted to own projects, solve real problems on the plant floor and help build a workplace that values integrity and safety. At North Coast Container, your contributions will be recognized and valued. A culture of teamwork and continuous improvement is waiting for you. Our benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance and Paid Time Off. Step into a role where you can make a real impact and help shape the future of manufacturing. Apply today! **North Coast Container: Who We Are** North Coast Container (NCC) is the leading independent manufacturer of steel drums in North America because of our unwavering customer focus. **Are you excited about this Controls Engineer job?** As a Controls Engineer at North Coast Container, you'll develop, install, commission and improve our plant automation systems. That includes PLC programs, HMI applications, safety systems and MES data collection. You'll write, test and document maintainable, reusable ladder logic, with a focus on Allen\-Bradley platforms, and design HMI screens that are easy to use for complex machinery. When issues come up, you'll provide hands\-on controls, electrical and mechanical troubleshooting to restore production safely and keep downtime to a minimum. You'll also design and specify control system architecture, including panels, instrumentation, networks and communication protocols. Panels will be built to NFPA 79, NEC and UL 508A requirements. You'll select and size components, recommend spare parts, and create and maintain schematics, panel layouts and technical documentation. Before installation, you'll review designs with internal teams and outside partners. You'll manage capital and improvement projects to scope, schedule, quality and budget, and you'll monitor machine data and alarms to drive reliability. Occasional travel to other NCC locations and occasional off\-shift, on\-call support may be required. **Would you be a great Controls Engineer?** The ideal candidate has a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field. An associate degree with relevant experience, or an equivalent mix of education and experience, will also be considered. You should have at least five years of hands\-on controls engineering experience in manufacturing. That includes advanced skill in programming and troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, safety devices and automated equipment, and especially in Allen\-Bradley ladder logic. You should also have strong knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, real mechanical aptitude, and working knowledge of OSHA requirements and industrial electrical standards. You should be comfortable with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple projects are essential. So is clear communication across every level of the organization. Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, ISO 9001, CMMS, machine diagnostics or industrial ovens and NFPA 86 is a plus. Above all, a commitment to integrity, safety and customer focus will guide your work. **Your next step** If you have these qualities and meet the basic job requirements, we'd love to have you on our team. Apply now using our online application!

At North, we’re building the next\-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the role** North saves customers money by buying and managing cloud commitments on their behalf. Every recommendation depends on predicting how a customer's usage will change, and every mistake costs real money, either in missed savings or in commitments that go unused. You'll join the Commitments team, working day to day with the engineers who build our Flex and Auto offerings. You'll own the analysis behind coverage targets and purchase recommendations, building on the usage forecasts from our forecasting service. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Analyze how usage forecasts become coverage targets and purchase recommendations, and work with Commitments engineers on how to improve them. * Quantify risk and expected savings for each recommendation so customers and our team can trust the numbers. * Analyze commitment performance across customers to find where our approach works and where it doesn't. * Work with engineers to turn your findings into product and customer\-facing teams. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of experience as a data scientist, where your analysis shaped product or business decisions. * Strong foundation in statistics, with experience turning forecasts into decisions. * Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working with large, messy usage and billing datasets. * Experience with optimization or decision\-making under uncertainty. * Experience working closely with engineers and product, and turning complex analysis into practical recommendations. * Clear writing, and the ability to explain uncertainty to people who need to make a decision. * Pragmatic, informed use of AI tools to speed up analysis and coding. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with cloud pricing, reserved instances, savings plans, or committed use discounts. * Background in finance, pricing, or risk modeling. * Experience with machine learning methods. * Experience designing experiments or causal analyses to measure the impact of changes. * Experience working with large datasets on AWS. * Familiarity with FinOps concepts. **Work Setup** Hybrid role based in New York City, with an office in Dumbo, Brooklyn Team members typically work in the office 2–3 days per week OR Remote US **Benefits*** Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 vision insurance * Flexible spending account (FSA) for health expenses and commuter benefits * 30 day sabbatical every 4 years **The pay range for this role is:** 178,000 \- 220,000 USD per year(Brooklyn HQ) 170,000 \- 215,000 USD per year(US Remote)

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.description: **About North Cloud** The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them. At North, we’re building the next\-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the Role** Platform Engineering is the layer every part of North builds on: the services and libraries teams share, the integrations that bring in customer spend from cloud, AI, and data providers, the data platform behind every number customers see, and the infrastructure and tooling that let us build, ship, and run the product. Done well, platform engineering is a multiplier: it makes the right way to build the easy way, so North is easy to use and hard to mess up for every engineer who builds on it. You'll lead the Platform Engineering team, which owns that whole layer today. You'll report to the VP of Engineering and work closely with them as the team scales into an organization, including how it's structured, when an area is ready for its own manager, and how we hire and grow those managers. The team is in place and its direction is set. We're looking for someone who shares our engineering philosophy and can apply it to the platform as it grows. You'll manage the engineers directly, and the role has two equally important parts. One is helping the team deliver reliably and own what they build. The other is technical depth. We work through continuous improvement in pursuit of excellence, and that means challenging engineers on designs, code, and operations with the experience to back it up. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead and grow the engineers across Platform Engineering through regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, and career development. * Work with the VP of Engineering on how Platform Engineering grows from a team into an organization, including when a team is ready for its own manager, then hire and develop those managers. * Treat the platform as a product for North's engineers. Build golden paths, shared patterns, and self\-service tooling with guardrails instead of gates. * Turn recurring questions, incidents, and drift into platform improvements that reach existing services, not just new ones. * Hire for the platform teams as they grow, and help new engineers ramp up quickly. * Turn team charters into plans and commitments the rest of North can rely on, and raise risks early. * Make sure work starts from clear specs and technical designs, and that teams operate what they ship. * Strengthen reliability practices, including on\-call, incident response, and observability. * Work with product, the Product Engineering teams, and customer\-facing teams so platform work is driven by what customers and the business need. * Balance long\-term platform investment against near\-term product needs, and explain those tradeoffs clearly. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years managing engineers and leading multiple teams at once. * Deep, hands\-on experience in backend, infrastructure, or data systems, enough to challenge designs and raise the technical bar. * A clear in at least one Orbis AI focus area: agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, or high\-performance analytics * Working knowledge of modern LLM and retrieval investigative research workflows **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions * **Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration. **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia. *Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobs.description: **Software Engineer – Manufacturing Applications** ================================================== At Okuma America Corporation, innovation is more than a goal. It is how we help manufacturers achieve greater productivity, precision, and confidence on the shop floor. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, manufacturing technology, and CNC automation while collaborating with internal teams, technology partners, and customers around the world. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications and CAM plug\-ins that extract tooling, holder, and fixture data from commercial CAM systems. * Develop software that translates STEP (ISO 10303\), ISO 13399, GTC, and CAM\-native tooling data into formats optimized for Okuma OSP controls. * Create solutions that map tooling attributes such as tool type, length offsets, radius offsets, holder assignments, and cutting geometry into control\-ready datasets. * Process, interpret, and tessellate 3D solid geometry for machine simulation, visualization, and collision avoidance applications. * Develop and support applications using C\#, .NET, WinForms, and WPF technologies. * Design scalable software architectures, reusable libraries, and supporting services that promote long\-term maintainability and performance. * Build automated testing frameworks and validation tools to ensure software quality, reliability, and accuracy. * Utilize source control systems, branching methodologies, and CI/CD practices to support efficient development and software release processes. * Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, API specifications, deployment procedures, and support resources. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to coding standards that encourage consistency, quality, and knowledge sharing. * Translate business requirements and technical objectives into effective software solutions and detailed technical specifications. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software issues while providing ongoing support and enhancement development. * Collaborate with engineering teams, customers, and technology partners to identify opportunities for product enhancement and process improvement. * Support software implementation projects and customer\-facing initiatives as needed. * Travel periodically to customer sites, partner organizations, and company facilities to support development activities, implementation efforts, and project success. * Adhere to company policies, safety practices, and quality standards. * Perform additional responsibilities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives as assigned. **Preferred Qualifications \& Skills** -------------------------------------- ### **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience developing software applications using C\# and the Microsoft .NET framework. * Experience with WinForms, WPF, and modern software architecture principles. * Knowledge of source control systems such as Git and software lifecycle management practices. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and quality assurance methodologies. * Familiarity with manufacturing, CNC machining, CAM software, CAD/CAM integration, or industrial automation environments preferred. * Experience working with 3D geometry processing, simulation technologies, STEP files, ISO 13399 standards, or related manufacturing data formats is highly desirable. ### **Technical Strengths** * Object\-oriented programming and software design patterns. * API development and integration. * Data modeling and data translation systems. * Geometry processing and visualization technologies. * Software debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * Technical documentation and system architecture design. **The Okuma Difference** At Okuma, innovation is more than a goal. It is part of who we are. As one of the world's leading manufacturers of CNC machine tools, we invest in advanced technology, employee development, and strong customer relationships. Our team members enjoy a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional growth are encouraged. When you join Okuma, you become part of an organization that values excellence, teamwork, integrity, and customer success. You'll have opportunities to influence corporate growth strategies, strengthen our market presence, and help shape the future of digital engagement and business development within manufacturing. ** ntial functions of the position. development, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. * Knowledge of object\-oriented programming principles and software engineering best practices. * Understanding of CAD/CAM systems, 3D geometry, and solid model formats such as STEP and STL. * Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical software solutions. * Knowledge of software testing methodologies and quality assurance principles. * Familiarity with API integrations, data translation, and interoperability between software platforms. * Ability to document software designs, requirements, and support procedures in a clear and organized manner. * Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to multitask and manage a range of responsibilities and competing priorities while working under pressure to meet deadlines * Superb time management and organizational skills with the ability to meet regular and frequent deadlines **Technical:** * Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET application development. * jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Robotics Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- Franklin W. Olin College of Engineering is seeking an Assistant Professor of Robotics Engineering for Needham, MA. **Duties:** Assistant Professor of Robotics Engineering role focuses on advancing research and teaching in robotics and artificial intelligence with an emphasis on human\-centered, value\-driven engineering. The position involves conducting original research, mentoring students, and contributing to the development of innovative curricula. Faculty in this role teach, advise, and serve the College community while also achieving external impact through scholarship and professional contributions. Conduct research with a focus on designing human\-compatible robotics and AI systems that create value for people. Hire, lead, and mentor students in robotics and AI research projects. Participate in college\-wide research initiatives to promote work and encourage student engagement in robotics research. Teach one to two courses per semester designed to develop student engineering skills, with emphasis on robotics research. Advise up to 12 students per year on their academic progression. Share faculty responsibility for recommending curriculum content and structure, ascertaining degree requirements, and verifying fulfillment of graduation criteria. Serve on institutional committees and teams that help build and sustain Olin College, such as the Admissions Committee, Academic Review Board. Achieve external impact beyond Olin College through research dissemination, professional contributions, and teaching programs. This is an in\-person/on\-campus position based in Needham, MA. **Requirements:** Ph.D. (or foreign equivalent) in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field of study; One year of experience as an Assistant Professor, Teacher’s Assistant, Research Assistant, or postdoctoral Researcher or related occupation involving teaching, research, or equivalent academic experience in Robotics Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. Must have gained experience with the following (Experience may be gained concurrently with education): * Robotics system design and engineering, including designing and integrating complete robotic systems that involve mechanical, electrical, and computational subsystems. * Demonstrated experience with circuit theory, embedded electronics, sensors, and actuators for robotic applications. * Artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques applied to robotics including applying techniques such as perception, planning, and learning algorithms to autonomous and semi\-autonomous robotic systems. * Human–robot interaction, with emphasis on designing systems that support human needs and values. * Experience designing intelligent systems grounded in human\-centered design principles, including usability, safety, and effective human machine collaboration. * Demonstrated experience with control theory and real\-time systems for robotic applications including classical, modern, and learning\-based control methods, with the ability to implement real\-time control architectures for dynamic robotic platforms. * Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating hands\-on, project\-based undergraduate learning experiences in engineering. * Experience supervising and mentoring undergraduate or graduate students in laboratory, capstone, and research environments. * Published research findings in peer\-reviewed academic journals and conferences. **Wage/Hours:** $107,077\.23 per year (M\-F/Full\-time: 40 hours/week) **Contact:** Apply online at: Careers \| Job Application **Company Description** ----------------------- Olin College of Engineering seeks employees who are passionate about working collaboratively within and outside of the Olin community to support the College’s mission and vision for the future. At Olin, we are educating the next generation of engineering innovators and shifting the definition of engineering. Not only do our students ask, “Who are we designing this for, and what are their values?” They also ask questions about the impact of their work on society. As Olin evolves under new leadership, we seek to become a more representative and aware community, a place where *everyone is a learner* and where *everyone is an educator*. Olin will become a place where experimentation—including making and learning from mistakes—will be embraced across the institution, not just in the classroom. Collaboration is key to Olin’s curriculum and culture, and we will work intentionally to reinforce the values and culture to which we aspire. We are a community that thrives on being together; we value trust. The College supports teams to collaboratively decide how they can best do their work, and display a commitment to the community, all while providing individuals with overall work\-life flexibility. Olin College is situated on 75 acres in Needham, Massachusetts. We are approximately ten miles from Boston, one mile from the MBTA Commuter Rail train station, and approximately four miles from the Woodland Station from the MBTA Green Line. We have plenty of free parking on campus. You can find more details on our Visiting Campus page. Olin College is committed to supporting an innovative, integrated learning and working environment. As a small campus, the in\-person experience and cross\-team collaboration is what helps build a strong, dynamic community for our students, faculty and staff. Typically, most roles at Olin College are intended to be in\-person and on\-campus. Certain paid positions may be eligible for flexible working arrangements, at the College’s sole discretion. Any approved remote work arrangement for pay *must be* performed in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts where Olin is registered to do business. Individual flexible and remote work options can be discussed during the interview process. **Benefits** ------------ Olin College is proud to offer faculty and staff a comprehensive benefits package that provides choice and value.
