jobs.title: Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)
jobs.description: **Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)** ============================================== *Also known as: Creative Workflow Specialist · AI Workflow Designer* **About OpenArt** ================= OpenArt is a leading AI Creative Platform for visual storytelling, used by millions worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We're bringing those tools together into one agentic creative environment: it understands what you mean, orchestrates the right capabilities, and still leaves you in full control of the work. We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we're shaping that future. **About the Role** ================== We're building tools that expand what's creatively possible — and, increasingly, an agent that does the work: it understands what a creator wants, picks the right models and tools, runs the job, and hands back something they can see, adjust, and finish. For that to hold up in professional production, the agent has to know the work from the inside. That's where you come in. We need someone who sits between creators and product to turn real pain points in professional workflows into solutions that run and can be proven. If you know professional creative production from the inside and you're used to building your own ideas into interactive prototypes with AI, this might be your seat. We're not just looking for someone who makes demos. We're looking for someone who finds the problem, researches the workflow, delivers the prototype end to end, makes the case for it, and then hands it to engineering to ship. **Why Join OpenArt** ==================== * **Your prototypes become products.** What you build won't stop at a demo. Validated prototypes go straight onto the product roadmap and are taken to launch by engineering. * **Work at the frontier of AI and creativity.** You'll be among the first to get hands\-on with new models and capabilities, and as a practitioner, you'll decide what shape they take inside creators' workflows — and what the agent should do with them on a creator's behalf. * **Direct impact on product direction.** Your judgment won't sit in a review queue. From identifying problems to validating prototypes, you'll directly shape what OpenArt builds next. * **Hyper\-growth and huge market opportunity.** OpenArt is one of the largest AI video generation platforms globally, with millions of monthly active users and partnerships with top model players including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, BytePlus, and Kling. * **Define where creative tools go next.** Generation gets cheaper every month; what creators and clients pay for is finished work. An agent that does the whole job is where the category is heading, and the person who knows production from the inside is the one who decides what it does. **Requirements** ================ * **Fluency in professional creative pipelines.** Hands\-on experience in professional creative production such as advertising, film, or content. You understand every stage from brief to delivery and can pinpoint where the real bottlenecks are. * **Moves fluidly between design and engineering.** AI is your core tool for building. You're proficient with AI coding tools, model APIs, agent frameworks, and lightweight code, and can independently turn concepts into working prototypes fast. * **End\-to\-end delivery.** You can independently take work from problem definition and workflow research through interaction design, visual design, and a usable prototype, delivered to a standard professional users can work with directly. * **Strong product taste.** You hold a high bar for craft, polish, and interaction quality, and you know the difference between something that works and something that works well. * **A body of work that proves it.** A portfolio or GitHub showing the tools, prototypes, products, or experiments you've built. We care far more about what you've made than where you've worked. **Nice to Have** ================ * **Proficiency with professional creative tools.** Editing, compositing, motion, or 3D tools. You don't just know how to use them; you know where they fall short on real projects. * **Background in advertising, film, or content production.** You've felt the pressure of professional production firsthand and know what clients and teams actually need before a deadline. * **Experience at a creative lab, innovation agency, or AI product team.** You're comfortable moving through ambiguity and turning new technology into something concrete and usable. * **You've built with agents.** Tool\-calling, MCP, skills, or your own automations — anything where the AI did part of the job for you, and you learned where it should and shouldn't be trusted. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Identify where workflows break.** Embed in the real production work of our in\-house creative team and enterprise clients to pinpoint bottlenecks — and the places where an agent doing the work first would change what a team can ship. * **Teach the agent the job.** Turn what you learn into workflows the agent can run end to end — a brief into a set of finished ad variants, one video into ten languages, a winning ad into every placement size — and define what "done to a professional standard" means for each, so what comes back is usable without a second pass. * **Turn complex generative workflows into intuitive experiences.** As models and workflows grow more capable and more complex, decide what the agent should simply handle and where a professional needs to step in to see, adjust, and finish — so creators stay in control of the work instead of waiting on a black box. * **Rapidly prototype new concepts.** Use AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, and APIs to explore interaction patterns and validate ideas, taking them from early concept to polished interface, including motion, transitions, and micro\-interactions. * **Define what each prototype needs to prove.** Before each prototype, be clear on the hypothesis it's testing. After, assess what was learned and make a clear call: scale, iterate, or stop. * **Drive from concept to launch.** Work closely with product, model, and engineering teams to turn validated prototypes into shipped features, and build up reusable components and interaction patterns along the way, so the next workflow reaches creators faster. **Compensation** ================ * Competitive TC including base salary, bonus, and equity (based on experience). * Meaningful equity ownership in what you build. **Work Setup** ============== * San Carlos, CA (full\-time, on\-site or hybrid) * Visa sponsorship available Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: Outset invented a better way to do research: AI\-powered user interviews. Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale. The research industry is massive (\>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high\-cost services. That's our opportunity. Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises. Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross\-sectional levels of analysis. The Research Engineer reports to the Head Scientist and builds and maintains the systems that let the team's scientists run their studies correctly, reproducibly, and at scale. The scientists design the studies and define the measurements; you make sure every experiment executes exactly as designed, that results can be reproduced from stored inputs, and that research code stays in step with the shipped product. The ideal candidate has supported scientists in an academic computational social science lab or a comparable research setting and has hands\-on experience engineering systems built on large language models. **Responsibilities** * Own the evaluation infrastructure that tests competing modeling approaches, so that new tests can be set up quickly, run concurrently and automatically, and be monitored. * Implement measurement pipelines exactly as specified by the scientists, with deterministic and traceable outputs. * Maintain versioned evaluation datasets with held\-out sets that are never used for training. * Build and maintain data pipelines for human\-participant data, external datasets, and model training data, including linkage of records belonging to the same participant across sources. * Keep research code in step with the production product so that validated improvements ship promptly. * Detect and prevent threats to the validity of evaluations. * Track compute and API spend across experiments and their implications for production\-stage costs * Manage repositories, code review, documentation, and the reproducibility of the team's coding workflow. * Identify implementation choices that can be made more correct or more efficient, and propose changes. **Qualifications** * Several years of software engineering experience, including experience supporting researchers in a lab or comparable setting. * Experience translating specific scientific requirements and experiment designs into code. * Experience building and operating large\-scale data pipelines on human behavior data, and confirming that the pipelines matched the criteria and design the researchers specified. * Strong Python, including the ability to read and audit code produced by agentic coding tools. * Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, tabular data, and Git\-based workflows. * Experience with cloud infrastructure and with running many jobs concurrently. * Working understanding of machine learning, including how transformer\-based language models behave, how model APIs are used, and what fine\-tuning involves. * A habit of writing deterministic, reproducible, cost\-aware, and well\-documented code. **Preferred** ------------- * Hands\-on experience engineering large language model systems: prompt pipelines, evaluation harnesses, embedding computation, agentic systems, and/or fine\-tuning infrastructure. * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight language models on multi\-GPU hardware. * Experience serving open\-weight models with an inference framework such as vLLM or SGLang, including batched inference and prefix caching for many requests that share a common prompt. * Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads. * Experience with survey or panel data and data collection platforms. * Experience extracting and storing model activations for downstream analysis. * Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads, including GPU provisioning across cloud providers. * Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents. Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. We’re a tight\-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises. Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross\-sectional levels of analysis. The Research Scientist works directly with and reports to the Head Scientist. Together you will choose what to study, design the studies, define how results are measured, interpret the findings, and write them up for internal decision\-making and, where appropriate, for academic publication. You will bring current methodological training in computational social science, data science, survey\-methodology, human\-computation interaction, and experiment design. **Responsibilities** * Co\-design and run studies that compare system\-generated responses with responses from humans, using both qualitative and quantitative measures. * Design, justify, and hone measures of performance. * Apply and adapt state\-of\-the\-art statistical techniques common to survey methodology and large\-scale social data analysis, to benchmark and improve sample\- and population\-level simulation performance. * Design evaluations and experiments with pre\-specified analysis plans. * Design and oversee human rating studies, including rater training, coding rubrics, and inter\-rater agreement measurement. * Design data collection from third\-party data sources and directly from human participants, including longitudinal and repeated\-measures studies. * Contribute to the research agenda for new modeling approaches, including evaluation of fine\-tuned models and of model calibration. * Specify analyses precisely enough for an engineer to implement. * Co\-author papers, preprints, and presentations. **Qualifications** * A completed or nearly completed PhD in computational social science, communication, HCI, sociology, political science, psychology, statistics, or a related field. * Peer\-reviewed publications on which you were a primary author. * Working command of graduate\-level statistical methodology common to social science, including the assumptions behind each. * Experience analyzing large\-scale telemetry and behavioral datasets, with attention to the validity of the resulting inference. * Familiarity with machine learning, spanning classical, nonparametric, and LLM\-based approaches, including how transformer\-based language models work, what fine\-tuning does, and how the major model families differ. * Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, and tabular data. * Ability to work in an environment where most code is produced through agentic coding tools, and to read and check that code. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight language models on survey, experimental, or behavioral data. * Experience building or evaluating calibrated confidence or error\-prediction models, including deriving decision thresholds from human judgments. * Experience measuring similarity of open\-ended text, for example with embedding\-based methods. * Experience designing or running panel\-based data collection with human participants. * Experience presenting research at academic and/or industry conferences. * Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents. * Familiarity with the startup ecosystem * Familiarity with qualitative interviews and ethnographic methods * Familiarity with topics in computational linguistics Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

They work on personalization, recommendations, and other AI\-driven experiences for Paramount\+ and Pluto TV. You’ll bring the structure, visibility and coordination that let researchers and engineers advance fast, and you’ll understand the technology well enough to ask the right questions and spot risk early. What you’ll do Own end\-to\-end delivery of programs spanning multiple teams, from early experiments through production launch, across research, engineering and product. Facilitate root\-cause clarity on blocking issues and escalate decisions with crisp options and a recommendation. Translate technical tradeoffs into clear plans for technical and non\-technical audiences. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Fullstack
jobs.description: PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI\-powered pathology. Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis are critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes. We believe in using the best tool for the job and are constantly evaluating our tech stack. Our current tools include: * Python * Vue.js * Django \+ DRF * Docker * AWS: EKS, S3, RDS/PostgreSQL, SQS, MSK/Kafka **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical leader on the team building AISight, our digital pathology platform used by pathologists and labs worldwide. This is a fullstack role, but we don't expect equal depth everywhere. We want someone with deep expertise in either frontend or backend who works comfortably across the whole stack. You will set technical direction for the platform, take on our hardest cross\-cutting problems, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. * You will own the architecture of major areas of the platform and drive technical strategy in line with the product roadmap, balancing near\-term delivery against long\-term scalability and maintainability. * You will lead the design and delivery of complex, multi\-team initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through production. That means writing and reviewing technical designs, finding risks early, and making tradeoffs explicit. * You will stay hands\-on, writing production code on the most critical and technically demanding parts of the system. * You will set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, security and performance across codebases, and drive improvements to our development practices and tooling. * You will work with product, design, machine learning, infrastructure, QA and regulatory teams to make sure the software we ship is reliable, protects data integrity and patient data, and meets the requirements of a regulated medical device environment, including design controls and validation. * You will mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, grow technical leadership on the team, and help shape how we hire and onboard. * You will represent engineering in conversations with customers, partners and stakeholders, explaining complex technical concepts to non\-experts. **Who You Are (Required)** -------------------------- * You have a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * You have 8\+ years of full lifecycle software development experience, including significant time in a senior or technical lead role. * You have a track record of architecting and shipping large\-scale production systems, and of leading technical initiatives across team boundaries. * You have deep expertise in at least one of these areas, and working proficiency in the other: * Backend: designing and building Python\-based applications and APIs (Django or FastAPI), data modeling, relational databases (PostgreSQL) and distributed or event\-driven systems. * Frontend: building complex, performant web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React or equivalent), including state management, frontend architecture and UX quality. * You have a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design. * You have hands\-on experience building and operating systems on a cloud platform (AWS preferred). * You influence technical decisions through clear writing, sound judgment and collaboration, not authority. * You have excellent communication skills and can work effectively with a distributed team and with non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building software in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, HIPAA, CE\-IVDR) or in healthtech. * Experience with medical imaging, digital pathology, or large image and data visualization (e.g., whole\-slide image viewers, WebGL or canvas rendering). * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitLab CI). * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with an infrastructure\-as\-code framework (e.g., Terraform, CDK). * Experience integrating ML models or AI\-powered features into production applications. This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA. Relocation benefits are not available for this position. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60\+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. You will lead a dedicated engineering team through two\-week sprints to build directed warehouse tools, manage yard operations, and optimize global inventory distribution. This role sits at the intersection of complex supply chain challenges and rapid technology expansion, driving massive cost savings and high\-impact operational efficiency across our expanding global footprint. ### **What is a day in the life of a Product Manager \- Transportation?** * Connect daily with the offshore engineering team (8:00 AM–9:00 AM MT) to facilitate standups and align on technical execution. * Conduct sprint planning, define user stories/tasks, assign sprint points, and run retrospectives every two weeks. * Partner closely with UX designers to design and refine directed internal tools for warehouse associates. * Engage with internal stakeholders to identify logistics pain points, gather product requirements, and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT). * Analyze operational data to identify opportunities for optimizing freight execution, carrier ordering, and yard management processes. * Deep dive independently into complex supply chain and transportation problem sets to define scalable solution architectures. ### **What will I need to thrive in this role?** * 2\+ years of product management experience, preferably within logistics, transportation, warehousing, or supply chain environments. * Proven experience leading software engineering teams through full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and two\-week sprint cycles. * Background working with major retailers, e\-commerce giants (e.g., Amazon, Walmart), global logistics providers, or freight/trucking companies. * Strong ability to work independently with minimal oversight, taking full ownership of problem spaces. * Proficiency with analytical and product tools such as Snowflake, Excel, AI development assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor), and the Google Workspace suite. * Exceptional cross\-functional communication skills to build trust and align distributed engineering, design, and executive stakeholders. ### **What does high performance look and sprint velocity. * Build strong trust, cohesion, and a unified direction across cross\-functional US and overseas engineering/design teams. * Proactively solve complex operational problems and drive measurable financial impact through reduced shipping and chargeback costs. ### **What is my potential for career growth?** * Opportunity to lead greenfield product initiatives within a fast\-growing tech business expanding 30–40% annually. * Direct exposure to enterprise\-level supply chain scaling, double\-digit facility network expansion, and global logistics automation. * Path to take complete ownership over multi\-year product roadmaps across complex fulfillment and transportation verticals. * Professional network development through collaboration with senior leadership and global operations experts. ### **What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?** * **30 Days:** Build relationships across engineering and operational teams, gain a complete understanding of internal systems, and master the existing multi\-year transportation product roadmap. * **60 Days:** Take active ownership of two\-week sprint planning cycles, partner with UX to refine warehouse tool designs, and begin delive  mentored by the VP of Product / Director of Product Management. ### **Sounds great! What’s the company culture?** We are looking for individuals who are: * **Game Changers** \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes. * **Data Fanatics** \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. * **Partner Obsessed** \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. * **Team of Doers** \- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. ### **What is the hiring process?** * Phone Interview * Video Interview * Top\-Grading Interview / Panel Interview * On\-Site Visit / Final Interview * Reference Checks * Executive Review * Offer ### **How can I stand out as an applicant?** **Strong Nice\-to\-Haves:** * Experience in global supply chain logistics, cross\-border freight distribution, or yard management software. * Prior background at high\-scale e\-commerce platforms (Amazon, Walmart) or global logistics providers (e.g., Flexport). * Hands\-on experience utilizing modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate product workflow and problem\-solving. **Interview Standout Tips:** * Demonstrate your ability to take an ambiguous problem space and break it down into structured software requirements. * Highlight specific examples where you independently owned a product space with minimal daily oversight. * Show a clear track record of successfully managing distributed offshore engineering and design teams across multiple time zones. **Why should I work at Pattern?** Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include: * Unlimited PTO * Paid Holidays * Onsite Fitness Center * Company Paid Life Insurance * Casual Dress Code * Competitive Pay * Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance * 401(k) match. Responsibilities * Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot industrial Ethernet and OT network infrastructure. * Support manufacturing systems, plant\-floor connectivity, automation and controls, MES/SCADA integrations, and operational uptime. * Partner with Automation, IT, Information Security, Operations, Maintenance, and vendors. * Apply OT cybersecurity, segmentation, access controls, monitoring, compliance, and incident\-response practices. * Maintain network documentation, standards, governance, lifecycle plans, and continuous\-improvement initiatives. Required * Experience supporting OT/industrial networks in a manufacturing environment. * Knowledge of industrial networking, switching, routing, firewalls, remote access, and network troubleshooting. * Experience with manufacturing systems and plant\-floor technology, with strong collaboration across IT and Operations. * Understanding of OT cybersecurity and secure network design. Preferred * Experience with automation/controls, MES, SCADA, Industry 4\.0, and digital\-factory programs. * Relevant networking, cybersecurity, or industrial\-technology certifications. Success is measured by reliable plant\-floor connectivity, secure and compliant OT infrastructure, responsive operational support, clear documentation, and successful technology improvements. This is an onsite role with up to 10% travel. Department: Information Services. Job level: Experienced, Grade 09\. Job family: IT Infrastructure \& Systems Administration. You should be proficient in: * ccna * networking

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** **JOB TITLE:** Senior Data Engineer **DEPARTMENT:** 500 – IT **REPORTS TO:** Chief of Information Officer **JOB SUMMARY:** The Senior Data Engineer – Databricks is responsible for building and evolving PharmaLink’s enterprise data, analytics, and AI platform. This hands\-on role spans the modern Databricks ecosystem, including data engineering, lakehouse architecture, analytics and dashboards, AI, Databricks Apps, and Lakebase. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, independent problem\-solving, technical ownership, and the ability to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable production solutions. A hands\-on builder approach is essential, with a focus on developing solutions rather than simply administering platforms. The ideal candidate can work across data engineering, platform architecture, analytics, AI, and data applications; independently investigate complex problems; and take solutions from initial design through production. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, build, and operate enterprise data solutions on Databricks. * Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake. * Design curated data models and reusable data products for analytics, applications, and AI. * Implement Unity Catalog, security, lineage, access controls, and data\-governance capabilities. * Build and optimize Databricks SQL Warehouses and AI/BI Dashboards. * Develop data and AI applications using Databricks Apps. * Design and implement appropriate solutions using Databricks Lakebase. * Enable AI/ML and Generative AI use cases using Databricks capabilities. * Build automated data\-quality, reconciliation, anomaly\-detection, and monitoring processes. * Integrate data from databases, SaaS platforms, APIs, files, and other enterprise systems. * Optimize Spark workloads, SQL queries, pipelines, performance, and platform cost. * Establish engineering standards for Git, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and production deployment. * Troubleshoot complex production and data issues and perform root\-cause analysis. * Partner with Data Governance, BI, application, and business teams to deliver trusted data products. Requirements: QUALIFICATIONS: * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering roles. * 4\+ years of hands\-on Databricks experience in production environments. * Advanced SQL, Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark skills. * Strong experience with Delta Lake and Unity Catalog. * Strong ETL/ELT, data modeling, and enterprise data architecture experience. * Experience with Databricks SQL and AI/BI Dashboards. * Familiarity with Databricks capabilities across AI/ML, Generative AI, Databricks Apps, and Lakebase. * Strong relational database and data\-engineering fundamentals. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and production support. * Experience working with cloud\-based enterprise data platforms. * Must maintain a positive attitude in a high\-performance team environment. * Must pass background check and random drug screenings. * Must be adaptable and flexible in dealing with a diverse work force PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: * Databricks on Microsoft Azure. * Azure Data Factory. * Microsoft SQL Server. * Fivetran or similar CDC/ELT technologies. * Power BI. * Databricks Workflows. * MLflow and AI/model lifecycle capabilities. * API and application development experience. * Azure DevOps or GitHub\-based CI/CD. * Databricks professional certification. * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: * Requires light physical activity performing non\-strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature (i.e., sustained phone, headset, and keyboard use) as well as periods of prolonged sitting.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **We are building a team of trailblazers, who embody growth, impact, and excellence.** ====================================================================================== **Job Description** At Pinnacle, our vision is to make the world reliable, one customer at a time. What does Reliability mean to you? For Pinnacle, reliability means our customers can trust that their facilities operate when and how they are supposed to. With a focus on data, Pinnacle drives to increase safety, efficiency, and evolve facilities to an optimized state through reliability. Pinnacle serves a variety of Industries, including: * Oil \& Gas * Food \& Beverage * Specialty \& Petrochemical * Pharmaceutical * Mining * Agriculture \& Fertilizer * Lumber * Water \& Wastewater Rooted in exploration, we constantly seek innovative ways to enhance industrial reliability. By fostering team development and embracing growth, we deliver added value to customers, creating a lasting global impact. This commitment drives us to cultivate bold future leaders, continuously reshaping the understanding of reliability. Innovation resides at the heart of our core values—excellence, impact, and growth—propelling us toward our vision. At Pinnacle, the Reliability Data Analyst (RDA) role is not a destination — it’s a proving ground. RDAs are trusted with real customer problems early. You’ll own outcomes in complex industrial environments where data is imperfect, priorities shift, and judgment matters more than process. Success in this role is measured not just by what you deliver, but by how quickly you grow in responsibility, credibility, and impact. People who succeed here do not stay RDAs for long. They grow into Managers, Technical Experts, or Business/Sales\-facing leaders — based on strengths, results, and appetite for accountability. This role is demanding and highly visible. It is designed for people who want to be stretched.**What You’ll Own** ------------------- * Turn incomplete operational data into **clear, defensible reliability recommendations** * Lead customer\-facing reliability workstreams from ambiguity to execution * Identify failure trends, economic tradeoffs, and risk drivers — then **decide what matters** * Manage multiple priorities without needing step\-by\-step direction * Build trust with customers and internal leaders through consistent follow‑through * Progressively take on **larger scope, harder problems, and greater ownership** **Growth Is Expected Here** --------------------------- This role is built for growth — and growth is **not optional**. Within 12–18 months, high performers are expected to: * Take ownership of more complex customers or portfolios * Influence engagement strategy, not just execution * Begin developing strengths aligned to one of Pinnacle’s leadership paths: + **People Leadership \& Management** + **Technical Excellence \& Reliability Specialization** + **Customer Strategy and Sales** Your manager will support you — but **you are expected to drive your own development**. Increased autonomy, exposure, and responsibility are earned through performance. If you are looking for a static role, this is not it. **How You’ll Be Successful** ---------------------------- * You move forward even when inputs are messy or incomplete * You take accountability for outcomes, not just deliverables * You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly * You communicate clearly with engineers, operators, and leaders * You’re motivated by progress, challenge, and increasing responsibility * You demonstrate humility, curiosity, and a willingness to continuously grow **This Role Is For You If:** ---------------------------- * You want a role that will **stretch you beyond your current capabilities** * You enjoy learning through real responsibility, not simulations * You’re motivated by growth, not titles * You want exposure to customers, leadership, and hard decisions early in your career * You see this role as a foundation for **bigger scope** — not a long\-term landing spot **This Role Is** ***Not*** **For You If:** ------------------------------------------ * You prefer stable, narrowly defined responsibilities * You want to “get comfortable” before taking ownership * You expect growth to be time\-based instead of performance\-based * You’re only interested in analysis, not influence or execution * You want to stay in the same role long\-term **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or related Engineering field * \~4\+ years of experience in an industrial or reliability\-focused environment * Comfortable operating with ambiguity and evolving priorities * Strong communication skills and a bias toward action * Willingness to travel and adapt to customer needs *(Certifications, CMMS experience, and advanced analytics are valuable — but ownership, judgment, and growth mindset matter more.)* **The Pinnacle Way (TPW)** TPW is our definition and accountability to ensure a consistent and effective experience for our customers. TPW includes 4 key elements of the customer experience and it guides the way we work: We Understand: what the true goals and objectives are for the facility, leaders, and personnel that we engage. We will also go to great lengths to define the value of our work so we can measure our progress and return that value accordingly We Solve: whatever problems or obstacles are required to help each customer achieve their reliability goals. It is here that we make sure that we bring all our resources to bear to help that site reach new reliability heights We Execute: with excellence. This means that our work processes are tight, our quality is high, and our delivery is consistent We Align: when our team and the customer are operating with a cadence and structure that is clear and consistent, ensuring that our solutions and our execution are moving forward, we are documenting progress, and measuring value **Working Environment** * Conditions may include working inside and/or outside. May work around office machinery with moving parts and moving objects. Working near radiant and electrical energy. Working closely with others or working alone. Working extended or irregular hours and travelling by all possible modes of transportation. **Physical Job Requirements** * Ability to walk, stand, sit, kneel, push, stoop, reach above the shoulder, grasp, pull, bend repeatedly, climb stairs, identify colors, hear with aid, see, write, count, read, speak, analyze, lift and carry under 30 lbs., and perceive depth. **Tools and PPE Requirements** * Equipment (machines, tools, devices) used in performing the essential job function include but not limited to computers and related equipment, calculators, copiers, fax machines, and telephone. **Limitations and Disclaimer** This job description describes the general job duties, accountabilities and physical requirements associates with the position; **it is not an exhaustive list of all the duties, accountabilities, or skills required for the position.** The general job duties, accountabilities and physical requirements associated with the position are subject to modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some physical requirements may exclude individuals who pose a threat or risk to the health or safety to themselves or others. This job description neither states nor implies that the listed general job duties, accountabilities, and physical requirements associated with the position are the only tasks expected of an employee. An employee is also required to follow any other job\-related instructions and perform any other job\-related tasks requested by their supervisor and not in violation of any applicable laws, regulations, or rules. **Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills, and abilities**. To perform this job successfully, an employee must possess the abilities and aptitude to perform each duty, accountability, and physical requirement proficiently. **Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Pinnacle in the U.S. is required. This employer will not sponsor any applicants for the following work visa in this job category: H\-1B \- Cap Subject (Change of Status or Consular Notification). Note that an H\-1B Change of Employer is generally not considered to be Cap Subject.** **Pinnacle participates in E\-Verify, a federal government system used to verify employment authorization and social security number of each new employee.** *Pinnacle is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Infrastructure Security Engineer (Senior/Principal)
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** ===================== Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ================= As Positron scales, our engineering environment is evolving from a primarily on\-prem footprint to a hybrid\-cloud model. We are looking for a Senior or Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure and manage that transition. You will own identity and access management, cloud infrastructure for our developers, infrastructure as code, and the core developer tooling our hardware and software teams depend on every day. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role where you will define the foundations: how engineers authenticate, how infrastructure is provisioned and segmented, how secrets and artifacts are stored, and how we detect and respond to threats against our most critical systems. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Identity and Access Management*** Define, implement, and operate our identity platform, including Auth0 and role\-based access control (RBAC) across internal systems and cloud environments. * Establish least\-privilege access policies and lifecycle processes for users, service accounts, and machine identities. * Design and manage public key infrastructure (PKI), including certificate issuance, rotation, and revocation. **Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure*** Lead the migration of on\-prem workloads to a secure hybrid\-cloud environment on GCP. * Build and maintain cloud infrastructure for developers using infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible. * Design and enforce network segmentation between on\-prem, cloud, and critical infrastructure environments. **Developer Tooling and Platform Security*** Deploy and maintain artifact storage and other core developer tooling with security built in from the start. * Own secrets management across environments, ensuring credentials and keys are stored, accessed, and rotated safely. **Detection and Response*** Select, deploy, and operate a SIEM solution covering our critical infrastructure. * Build and lead incident response processes, from detection and triage through remediation and post\-incident review. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Expertise in identity and access management, including SSO, RBAC, and identity platforms such as Auth0, Okta, or similar. * Experience with Kubernetes, including managed or proprietary Kubernetes distributions. * Hands\-on experience building and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible. * Production experience with GCP, or with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work in GCP. * Proven experience deploying, tuning, and operating a SIEM solution. * Experience with PKI, including certificate management and lifecycle automation. * Demonstrated incident response experience, including leading investigations and remediation. * Experience deploying and maintaining artifact storage and secrets management systems. * Understanding of network segmentation and secure network design across on\-prem and cloud environments. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Broader security engineering experience beyond infrastructure, such as application or product security. * Experience designing security architecture for organizations moving from on\-prem to hybrid cloud. * Familiarity with endpoint detection and response (EDR) tooling and deployment. ### **Leveling and Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first three to six months, you will have defined and stood up our identity foundation, with Auth0 and RBAC in place across key systems. Developers will be provisioning cloud infrastructure through infrastructure as code, and the migration from on\-prem to hybrid cloud will be well underway on a secure, segmented footing. A SIEM solution will be live and monitoring our critical infrastructure, giving the team real visibility and a clear path to detect and respond to threats. **Why Join Us?** * Build the security and infrastructure foundations of a well\-funded AI hardware company from the ground up, with the ownership to make lasting architectural decisions. * Protect the systems behind next\-generation inference silicon, working alongside hardware and software engineers on some of the most important infrastructure in AI. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is Senior: $170,000 – $250,000, Principal: $250,000 \- $325,000\.. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future. **Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: As an AI Engineer at PowerPlan, you'll be one of the first engineers on our Applied AI team: an in\-house forward\-deployed engineer who works like a product owner and owns AI solutions end to end, from the first conversation with a department to a tool its people use every week. You'll embed with teams across the company, from customer support and professional services to finance and sales, learn how the work really gets done, and build with real autonomy. You'll report to the VP of Strategic Initiatives, the group that works closely with PowerPlan's executive leadership team on the company's top priorities, and you'll help shape how a brand\-new team works from the ground up. Nine in ten U.S. investor\-owned utilities trust PowerPlan's software to get their numbers right. Your job is to bring that same standard to how PowerPlan itself runs. Responsibilities: Success will be measured by how many solutions you get into weekly use, the measurable change each one delivers, and whether the departments you work with can run and change their tools without you. * In your first 30 days, embed with your first department, learn the work from the people who do it, and agree on a one\-page problem statement, a measured baseline, and real examples before you build. * Help write the playbook for a new team: standards for building with AI tools, keeping shared work current, and testing for quality and robustness, all shaped by what you learn on real builds. * By the end of your first quarter, get your first solution into weekly pilot use, tested against real examples, with time saved measured against your baseline. * Grow from one pilot to one or two solutions in weekly use by month six, and three across at least two departments by year end, including two larger cross\-department builds with the team's AI data engineer. * Redesign clumsy workflows with the people who run them instead of just speeding them up, with agentic coding tools as your default way of building. * Leave every department with runbooks, training, and people who can run and change what you built without you. * Publish your first reusable agent skills and workflow patterns by month six, grow them into a library the company reuses, and help set the standard for when AI output can be trusted and when a person should check it. Qualifications: * You have two to four years of professional experience building or shipping software products (as an engineer, product manager, or similar), or a master's degree in a related field and at least one year of that experience. * You've shipped software or a product other people rely on, at work or on your own, and can walk us through what you built, why, and what changed once people used it. * You think in systems and reason from first principles. You ask why a step exists before you automate it, and you can show us a process you changed rather than just sped up. * You can turn a conversation with an expert into a clear problem statement and a way to measure success. * Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode are your default way of working, and you know how to plan the work, direct the tool, and check what it produces. We build with Claude Code and provide the tools. * You write working Python or JavaScript, or build working software with agentic coding tools, and use SQL and APIs. * You explain tradeoffs plainly and have taught someone, formally or not, to change a tool themselves. * You hold a bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, industrial or systems engineering, or a closely related field. * You're based in Atlanta and can be in the office at least three days a week, and you're authorized to work in the United States (this role isn't eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future). **Even Better If…** * You have a minor or coursework in business, economics, or finance, or work experience in or alongside finance, accounting, professional services, or customer support. * You've used continuous improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma, or value stream mapping. * You've automated workflows inside business systems, or built agent skills, MCP connections, or other reusable pieces for AI tools. * You hold a master's degree in a related field, such as computer science, information systems, data science, or business analytics. **PowerPlan is an EOE** Applicant Privacy Notice Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About PrePass** PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day. That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real\-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation. ### **About the Role** The DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in driving automation, reliability, and scalability across PrePass’s software delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure. This role supports both development and production environments and is central to our migration and ongoing operations within GitHub, GitHub Actions, and Azure. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to improve deployment efficiency, system stability, and operational excellence. ### **Essential Responsibilities** **CI/CD Pipeline Management** * Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to support automated build, test, and deployment workflows. * Integrate pipelines with Azure services to enable multi\-cloud deployments. * Ensure pipelines are reusable, templated, and well\-documented to support team\-wide adoption. **Source Control \& Collaboration** * Manage GitHub repositories, enforce branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow), and oversee pull request workflows. * Partner with development teams to migrate codebases from Azure DevOps to GitHub, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication. **Cloud Infrastructure Management** * Provision, configure, and manage cloud resources in Azure (VMs, AKS, App Services, Function Apps, API Managment Gateway, Azure Container Apps). * Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. * Support hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures, including VPN configuration and network security. **Automation, Monitoring \& Reliability** * Automate operational tasks using scripting languages such as PowerShell or Bash. * Monitor and optimize application and infrastructure performance using Datadog and Azure Monitor. * Troubleshoot deployment issues and production outages, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive solutions. **Security \& Compliance** * Integrate security controls into CI/CD workflows following DevSecOps best practices. * Manage secrets and credentials securely across GitHub, Azure, and AWS environments. * Ensure systems and processes comply with organizational and regulatory standards. **Continuous Improvement** * Evaluate new tools and technologies to enhance DevOps practices and platform reliability. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical discussions and process improvements. **Requirements** ### **Qualifications** **Technical Skills** * Strong hands\-on experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD automation. * Proficiency with Azure cloud platform, including resource provisioning, networking, and security. * Experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code. * Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash. * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes or AKS. * Experience with monitoring and logging tools, including Datadog and Azure Monitor. * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and cloud security best practices. **Bonus / Preferred Skills** *(a plus, but not required)* * Experience with MySQL database management. * Familiarity with ArgoCD. * Experience with AWS. **Soft Skills** * Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset. * Ability to work effectively in agile, cross\-functional teams. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of experience in DevOps or a related engineering role. * Relevant Azure or DevOps certifications are a plus. **Benefits** ### **How We Will Take Care of You** * Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire. * Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Company\-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well\-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships). * Tuition Reimbursement Program. * Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts. * Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you). * Company\-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well\-being of employees. * Community Give\-Back initiatives. * Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives. ### **Join Us** **At PrePass, our mission drives us.** We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values. **Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Agentic SDLC
jobs.description: **About Us** At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick\-care" to proactive health care. Our award\-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non\-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient\-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again". The Senior Engineer II role is a senior technical leadership position responsible for delivering complex software solutions, driving technical strategy, and elevating engineering quality across teams. In this role, the engineer is expected to independently lead large, ambiguous, or mission\-critical initiatives and coordinate work across multiple engineering groups and stakeholders. **This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).** Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting\-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise \- join us to make a difference in people's lives! **What You'll Do** * **Develop complex software solutions:** Lead end\-to\-end delivery of large or ambiguous initiatives that span multiple systems or teams, leveraging AI\-assisted coding tools and autonomous development workflows where applicable. * **Own and lead projects:** Take full ownership of project execution, from design through rollout, integrating agentic workflows and automated guardrails to ensure technical and business goals are met. * **Provide technical guidance:** Offer deep expertise to team members, supporting them through code reviews, architectural decisions, and best practices for collaborating with AI coding agents. * **Mentor junior engineers:** Coach less\-experienced colleagues, helping them grow their technical, design, and problem\-solving capabilities while effectively utilizing agentic tools. * **Contribute to strategic planning:** Participate in high\-level planning discussions, informing the technical direction of key initiatives including the adoption of agentic SDLC practices. * **Solve complex engineering problems:** Independently diagnose and resolve the hardest technical issues in the domain, utilizing agent\-driven debugging and novel solutions. * **Influence technical direction:** Play a meaningful role in shaping project\- and team\-level technical decisions and long\-term architectural evolution toward modern agentic development patterns. * **Ensure system reliability:** Lead improvements in reliability, scalability, observability, and incident response; help define standards and processes that support operational excellence in automated and agent\-driven environments. * **Raise engineering quality:** Improve engineering patterns, tooling, documentation, and processes that increase productivity and code quality across multiple teams, incorporating automated code review and refactoring agents. * **Communicate at a senior level:** Clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, product managers, and leadership; serve as a trusted technical voice on modern software practices. * **Manage ambiguity:** Operate effectively in undefined or rapidly evolving situations, bringing clarity, structure, and direction for others, particularly in the transition toward agentic SDLC. **What You'll Bring** * **7\+ years** of experience delivering complex software systems and solving technical challenges. * **Strong backend experience** architecting and building robust services using Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI. * Experience writing comprehensive backend tests (e.g., Pytest) and ensuring strong test coverage. * Familiarity or decent frontend experience with frameworks like React, Next.js, and Typescript is a plus. * Ability to break down complex projects into components or milestones that other engineers can easily pick up. * Motivation to influence our engineering organization to level up the quality, reliability, and performance of the services we ship. * Demonstrated collaboration with co\-workers on cross\-functional teams. * Experience building consumer\-facing applications and internal tools. **Our Values** First: we are **Pioneers** * Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding. Second: we are **Platform\-Builders** * We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission. Above all: we are **Patients** * We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work. **What We Offer** * An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health * We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team \- Prenuvo provides free, whole\-body scans to each team member * Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds \- there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way * Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do \- our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize * Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing \- we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it * Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre\-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions. * We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family * **The base salary for this role ranges from $170,000\-$185,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location** *We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.* **Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain \[****prenuvo.com****]. jobs.title: Fire Protection Engineer - Federal Sector

Procon seeks a skilled Fire Protection Engineer to join our team focused on federal sector projects. Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline required. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification preferred. * 2–5 years of experience in fire protection and life safety (FP\&LS) design, design reviews, field surveys, inspections, or related engineering services. * Working knowledge of NFPA standards, ICC Fire and Building Codes, and other applicable fire protection and life safety regulations. * NICET Level III certification or a PE in Fire Protection required. * Demonstrated field experience with fire and life safety systems, including fire alarm testing, construction inspections, and technical assessments related to fire protection, safety, health, and risk mitigation. * Experience reviewing fire protection system designs, sprinkler plans, hydraulic calculations, and life safety documentation. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret codes, standards, and engineering requirements. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with owners, architects, engineers, contractors, and regulatory authorities. * Ability to travel up to 50% to project sites for inspections, audits, surveys, and construction observations. ### **Responsibilities \& Duties** * Review project drawings, specifications, and construction documents for compliance with applicable fire protection and life safety codes, standards, and best practices. * Perform technical reviews of building and development plans to ensure compliance with the Life Safety Code, NFPA standards, ICC codes, and other adopted regulations. * Conduct fire protection and life safety surveys, audits, and assessments at existing facilities and construction sites. * Perform field inspections and construction site walk\-throughs to verify contractor materials, installation methods, and workmanship comply with approved plans and applicable requirements. * Review sprinkler system designs and hydraulic calculations for accuracy and code compliance. * Evaluate and verify compliance of fire alarm systems, gaseous fire suppression systems, smoke control systems, and other fire protection features. * Prepare technical reports, inspection findings, survey documentation, and project records. * Respond to client and stakeholder inquiries regarding fire prevention, fire protection systems, and life safety requirements. * Support project teams across K\-12, federal, and commercial facilities throughout design, construction, testing, and commissioning phases. * Collaborate with registered Professional Engineers serving as Responsible Engineers\-in\-Charge to develop fire protection and life safety deliverables. * Lead and support fire protection and life safety initiatives, programs, and project activities. * Provide technical guidance and oversight to junior fire protection personnel when required and assist with departmental leadership activities in the absence of senior fire protection staff. * Identify deficiencies, recommend corrective actions, and work with project stakeholders to ensure issues are resolved effectively. * Gain progressive engineering experience under the supervision of licensed Professional Engineers, contributing toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure requirements. ### **Physical Requirements** This position requires regular onsite presence in an active construction environment. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including: * Walking and standing for extended periods while performing site observations and inspections. * Navigating active construction areas, including stairs, uneven surfaces, temporary walkways, and varying elevations. * Occasionally bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and climbing as necessary to observe construction activities. * Accessing mechanical, electrical, utility, process, and other construction areas as required. * Wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE) and complying with all applicable site safety requirements. * Working in indoor and outdoor environments with exposure to typical construction\-site conditions, including noise, dust, weather, and temperature fluctuations. * Occasionally lifting and carrying up to 25 pounds. **Benefits** Salary commensurate with experience. Interested and qualified candidates please submit a cover letter and a resume. Procon offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, including full medical/dental insurance and 401(K) plan. Procon is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected factor.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York ; US Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $200K – $300K • Offers Equity *Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The final offer may vary based on market location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.* **About Radar** Radar is the global leader in geolocation, with geofencing SDKs, maps APIs, and AI\-enabled solutions for marketing, fraud, and operations teams. Why is Radar the best place to work? * We're trusted by some of the world's best companies, from high\-growth startups to the Fortune 500\. * We have incredible scale: We're processing over 1 billion API calls per day from hundreds of millions of devices. * We're well\-resourced, and we've raised $85\.5M from world\-class investors, including Accel and Insight Partners. * We have a high\-performance culture, with ambitious and entrepreneurial teammates in every role. * We recently moved into an amazing new office in Flatiron, Manhattan, NYC. * We were recently named a top 10 best place to work in NYC by Crain's. Despite our growth and scale, we're still just getting started. That's where you come in. **About the role:** We're looking for a Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Search to improve the data and search systems behind Radar's geocoding platform. Our daily traffic is over 1 Billion API calls / day (15,000 requests / second), so you will be operating at scale. You'll improve the quality and coverage of our location data, build and automate the pipelines that keep it growing, and improve how we understand queries, retrieve candidates, and rank results across geocoding and autocomplete. You'll use ML and LLMs where they can materially improve these systems, from data enrichment and matching to query understanding and search relevance. This is a software engineering role first, you don't need a research background, but you should be excited to work across data, search, and backend systems and reach for ML when it's the right tool. This role will be based out of our NYC HQ. **How we work:** Most of our engineering team are former technical co\-founders or former Radar interns from schools like Waterloo and CMU. Most engineers at Radar fit one of two molds, technically: either Staff level expertise in one stack, or "Multi\-Stack" at any level. We say "Multi\-Stack" because "Full\-Stack" has the connotation of "Frontend and Backend", but Radar Engineers might also work on Mobile or Data engineering. Not that you need to be an expert in all of those, but a desire to learn, jump around to different stacks, and get things done is the important part. We care a lot about shipping fast and talking to customers. We're committed to our product vision of full\-stack location infrastructure, but we also know that customer feedback is a treasure map to gold. Even though Slack is the brain of our company, working together in\-person in our NYC HQ is the fastest way for us to get things done. We meet on Mondays to plan out work for the week in small groups and use Linear for planning. To us, a week is a long time, and we expect to ship big things every week. **The stack:** Our core backend service is HorizonDB, a geospatial database written in Rust that powers geocoding: forward and reverse geocoding, autocomplete, and address validation. It's built on custom search indexes and stores like Tantivy, RocksDB, and FSTs, with ML models for query understanding and ranking. Our geospatial data pipelines are written in Scala and Python on Airflow, merging commercial and open data sources into the indexes HorizonDB serves. The API layer is a Node.js TypeScript app, and we use MongoDB, S3/Athena, and Redis. Everything is deployed to AWS via Kubernetes on EKS using Terraform. Most engineers are in the on\-call rotation. We sponsor OpenStreetMaps, MapLibre, and OpenAddresses. **How we use AI:** * Engineers choose what AI tools they use, Claude and Codex being the most popular. * We're actively building Claude skills \- for example we've taught it how to debug HorizonDB, our geospatial database. * All code changes are reviewed by an Engineer knowledgeable in that area. Claude and Codex also review all PRs. * There is a range of how much engineers use AI. Most use it daily if not weekly. * We are excited about what AI can do, but we also recognize the risks and don't compromise our coding standards. **The hiring process:** After a call with our Technical Recruiter, you'll do several technical Zoom calls with members of our engineering team: code screen, coding round, and system design round. If those go well we'll invite you to our NYC HQ for a final round interview. You'll meet one of our co\-founders, someone from outside engineering, and meet more people from Radar. We'll go into more depth about how we work to see if there is a match. **What you’ll do:** * Improve geocoding and autocomplete quality through better query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and relevance * Use ML and LLMs to enrich, label, match, and expand our location data at scale * Automate the data pipelines that keep our coverage and detail growing, reducing manual work and making routine corrections easier to handle automatically * Onboard new and messy data sources, improving how we normalize, match, and integrate US and international location data * Work across the boundary between data and search, improving how location data is indexed, retrieved, ranked, and surfaced to users * Range across the stack, from data pipelines in Scala and Python to search and serving in HorizonDB (Rust) * Have your work power over 1 Billion API calls / day * Talk to Radar customers and prospects, hear their feedback, incorporate it into your work, and make them successful **You should:** * Think of yourself as a generalist engineer first, not tied to any particular stack * Are interested in talking to customers or prospects and making them successful * Are deeply curious about how things work, and have the tenacity to sit with hard problems and power through them **Bonus points if you:** * Are a former technical co\-founder * Have worked on a high throughput, high growth SaaS application * Have worked on geospatial infrastructure * Have applied ML or LLMs to a real product or data problem * Have worked on search, ranking, relevance, query understanding, or information retrieval systems **You’ll work with:** * **Tim Julien**, CTO * **Rishant Dwivedi**, Engineering Manager * Our customers and prospects * Our Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Sales teams **What we offer:** * Competitive salary * Meaningful stock options in a fast\-growing company * 401(k) plan with 4% match * New HQ in Flatiron, NYC * Top\-notch equipment * Catered lunches * Unlimited PTO * Health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% coverage for employees * 12 weeks of paid parental leave * Commuter and fitness benefits *We’ll share full details of our benefits package at the offer stage. Benefits may vary by location.* *Radar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K
