jobs.title: Director, AI Transformation
jobs.description: ### About Us: Rare Beauty Brands is a prestige skincare company with a portfolio that includes Kate Somerville, Patchology, and Good Day. We are growing fast, and our strategy is clear: acquire and build mid\-sized premium skincare brands that serve discerning consumers, and run them better than anyone else could. AI is now central to how we plan to do that. Rare Beauty Brands is an equal opportunity employer. The Role -------- Rare Beauty Brands is hiring a Director, AI Transformation to move the company from using AI tools to running on them. The role reports directly to the President \& CEO and works across every function: brand, digital and ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, finance, and people. Most companies, RBB included, have adopted AI at the individual level: people use it to write faster, summarize, and draft. The next stage is different. It means redesigning how work gets done, building agents and automations into real processes, and measuring the return. Getting there takes a dedicated owner with the technical range to build it and the business judgment to know what is worth building. That is this job. You will sit with each department head, find the friction in how their teams operate today, and then design, build, and ship solutions that remove it. Some of that work you will do yourself. Some you will do with vendors, agencies, and the people already on the team. All of it has to show up in scalability, efficiency, profitability, or growth. ### Responsibilities: **Find the work worth transforming** * Partner with each member of the executive leadership team to map current workflows, pain points, and sources of friction in their functions * Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of AI and automation opportunities, ranked by business impact, effort, and risk * Say no to shiny projects with no ROI, and be able to explain why **Build and ship** * Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents, automations, and integrations across our systems (ERP, ecommerce platforms, Amazon, CRM and email marketing, data and reporting tools, and the tools we have not bought yet) * Do hands\-on work yourself where it is faster, and direct vendors, agencies, or internal builders where it is not * Own the technical architecture: how our tools connect, where data lives, how agents get access, and what guardrails are in place **Make it stick** * Lead the change management side: training, documentation, adoption tracking, and partnering with teams to redesign processes in ways that ensure adoption * Build internal capability so the company gets more self\-sufficient over time, not more dependent on you **Govern it** * Own AI governance at RBB and chair a small AI governance group (CEO, select members of the Executive Leadership Team, HR) that approves policy and signs off on higher\-risk deployments * Update and maintain RBB’s AI policy: acceptable use, approved tools, what data can go into which systems, brand safety for anything customer\-facing, and where a human has to review before anything ships * Run an agent and tool registry. Every agent, automation, and AI tool in use has a named business owner, a documented purpose, the systems and data it can touch, its cost, and a review date. Nothing goes live unregistered * Set guardrails for agents that take action: least\-privilege access, limits on what they can spend or change, logging, and a fast way to shut them off, especially when they touch customers, money, or inventory * Protect company and customer data: classify what is sensitive, control who and what can access it, and run a security and privacy review on every AI vendor before we sign (how they store, retain, and train on our data) * Get ahead of shadow AI: know which tools people are actually using, bring the useful ones into approved channels, and retire the risky ones * Own the response when an agent gets something wrong, exposes data, or behaves unexpectedly: how it is caught, fixed, and reported * Track the privacy and AI regulations that apply to RBB and keep us compliant without slowing the work down **Measure and report** * Define the metrics for every major initiative before it starts (hours saved, cost avoided, revenue lifted, cycle time cut) and report against them * Give the CEO and ELT a clear, regular read on what is working, what is not, and what is next, including where AI risk stands: what is in the registry, what has been reviewed, and jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Platform
jobs.description: **ABOUT RETOOL** Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. But most companies don't have the resources to properly invest in these tools, leading to a lot of old, clunky internal software, or worse, teams still stuck in manual and spreadsheet workflows. AI has changed who gets to build software. The definition of "developer" now includes analysts, operators, and domain experts creating solutions directly—and the tools they reach for are multiplying by the week. That's both an opportunity and a challenge: as more people build with more AI tools, the risk of shipping ungoverned software into production grows just as fast. At Retool, we're building the platform that makes all of it safe to ship. Build with any AI tool you want, then deploy into one place that connects to your real business data, enforces enterprise policies automatically, and lets teams create once and reuse everywhere with shared, trusted components. The cost of building software has collapsed. The cost of governing it hasn't—and that's the problem we solve. Developers and domain experts have already automated over 100 million hours of work on our platform, freeing them to focus on creative problem\-solving and strategic work that drives real business value. The people closest to the problem can now build the software to solve it, safely, and within enterprise guardrails. Let's build the future together. **WHY WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU** We’re building AI\-native products where model behavior is part of the product, not just an implementation detail. As LLMs become more capable, the bottleneck is no longer access to models—it’s making non\-deterministic systems reliable, evaluable, and trustworthy in production. We’re hiring AI Engineers to own that problem end to end. This is not a role for someone who simply integrates AI APIs into features. It’s for engineers who take responsibility for how probabilistic systems behave over time, how quality is measured in the presence of variance, and how capabilities improve without regressing. If model regressions, subtle behavior drift, or edge\-case failures keep you up at night—and you enjoy that kind of ownership—we want to talk. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As an AI Engineer, you’ll own model\-driven behavior in production systems, working across product, infrastructure, and evaluation layers. Your work will directly shape what users experience—and how confidently the team can ship. You might: * Own the behavior of AI\-powered features across multiple product surfaces, including quality, safety, variance, and failure modes * Design and evolve prompting, retrieval, routing, and tool\-use strategies that embrace non\-determinism while bounding its downside * Build and maintain evaluation systems that measure model performance using statistical signals, distributions, and trends—not just pass/fail tests * Detect, diagnose, and resolve non\-deterministic failures such as hallucinations, partial correctness, instruction drift, or sensitivity to context changes * Define and implement guardrails, fallbacks, and degradation paths that keep systems useful even when models behave unexpectedly * Partner with product and infra teams to decide when probabilistic behavior is “good enough” to ship—and when it isn’t * Influence model selection, model behavior, and tool design to balance quality, cost, latency, and robustness for real user workflows You’ll work across the stack (e.g., TypeScript, Node.js, React), but your leverage won’t come from code volume alone—it will come from shaping runtime behavior with precision, measurement, and intent. **WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)** This role is: * Accountable for AI behavior, not just system correctness * Grounded in evaluation, iteration, and regression prevention under non\-determinism * Comfortable designing systems where outputs vary, confidence is probabilistic, and correctness is contextual * Focused on shipping dependable products on top of imperfect components This role is not: * Adding LLM calls to existing features and moving on * Treating models as black boxes with undefined behavior * Shipping AI features without owning their long\-term reliability, drift, or user trust **THE SKILLSET YOU’LL BRING** * 6\+ years of professional engineering experience, with ownership over complex systems in production * Demonstrated experience owning AI/LLM behavior beyond basic integration, including mitigation of variance and failure modes * Comfort reasoning about probabilistic systems and tradeoffs (quality vs. cost, recall vs. precision, speed vs. robustness) * Experience designing or maintaining evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, regression detection, or human\-in\-the\-loop feedback loops * Strong product intuition—you care deeply about what “good” looks like even when outputs are non\-deterministic * Ability to operate independently in ambiguous problem spaces and set quality standards others rely on * Strong opinions, weakly held—you iterate quickly and adjust based on evidence and observed runtime behavior **BONUS POINTS** * Experience with RAG, agentic systems, or tool\-using models in production * Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval pipelines * Exposure to fine\-tuning, model routing, or post\-training techniques * Experience building shared AI infrastructure used by multiple teams * History of mentoring engineers on designing for non\-determinism and evaluation\-driven development **WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH** You’ll join a small, senior team focused on advancing AI capabilities across the product. You’ll collaborate closely with product engineers, infra engineers, designers, and PMs—often acting as the final owner of AI behavior and quality before features reach users. Your work will set standards that others build on. If you enjoy being the person teams rely on when AI behavior matters most—and certainty is never guaranteed—you’ll thrive here. **READY TO BUILD RELIABLE AI SYSTEMS?** If you’re excited to move beyond demos and take real ownership of non\-deterministic behavior in production—defining quality, preventing regressions, and turning variability into a strength—we’d love to meet you. For candidates based in the United States, the pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents base salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings (OTE) for commissionable roles. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Retool and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors such as (but not limited to), scope and responsibilities, the candidate’s experience and qualifications, and location. Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Retool provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans. The base pay range for this role is $163,800 – $306,000 per year. Retool offers generous benefits to all employees and hybrid work location. For more information, please visit the benefits and perks section of our careers page! Retool is currently set up to employ all roles in the US and specific roles in the UK. To find roles that can be employed in the UK, please refer to our careers page and review the indicated locations.

jobs.title: Principal DevOps Engineer/Lead (AI/ML Infrastructure) - Remote US
jobs.description: **Revvity** Revvity is a developer and provider of end\-to\-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000\+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health. Find your future at Revvity. Revvity Signals makes market\-leading software that empowers scientists across Life Science R\&D, clinical research, and specialty chemicals to make better medicines and products, faster. Our flagship offering is the SaaS Signals Research Platform that provides knowledge capture, collaboration, analysis and visualization tools across the full depth and breadth of scientific discovery workflows. The viral adoption of our software is accelerating innovation, expediting drug development for a healthier world and facilitating the creation of sustainable materials. Join us as a **Principal DevOps Engineer/Lead (AI/ML Infrastructure)**,where you'll play a pivotal role building out, maintaining and operating our AI infrastructure, that is part of the Signals Platform. This is your chance to work closely with a dedicated team of experience developers building out AI capabilities within our product. We are seeking a senior\-level technical expert working within the R\&D organization, who integrates and orchestrates the entire lifecycle of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) projects. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between AI researchers, and traditional software development teams to ensure AI models are reliably built, tested, and deployed into production at scale. This role requires a blend of deep expertise in DevOps principles, software engineering, and AI/ML infrastructure, with a strong focus on automation, scalability, and security. **Main functions** * Architect, design, and lead the implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure for AI/ML workloads * Build and maintain the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines specifically for AI models, managing everything from data ingestion to model serving and monitoring * Act as a subject matter expert and mentor for junior engineers, driving the adoption of best practices for AI/ML platform development, code management, and deployment * Work closely with AI researchers, and software engineers to optimize performance and streamline the end\-to\-end development and experimentation process. * Ensure the reliability, security, and performance of AI systems. * Stay ahead of industry trends and bring innovative AI solutions to the table. **Basic Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, ML Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering, with several years in a senior or leadership capacity. * 5\+ years of deep, expert\-level knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), including their AI/ML and containerization services. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with ML orchestration and platform tools like Kubeflow, MLflow, or Amazon SageMaker. * 5\-8\+ years of deep expertise with Docker and Kubernetes for managing and scaling AI/ML workloads. * 5\-8\+ years strong coding skills in languages such as Python, Go, or Bash for automation. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Proficiency with tools like Terraform or Ansible to manage and provision infrastructure. * Experience building robust and automated CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross\-functional technical and business teams. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **About Greenlight Rent** Greenlight Rent, formerly Rhino \+ Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year. We're the market\-leading rental housing platform building simpler, more accessible ways for people to move into homes — and for property managers to lease with confidence. Our technology removes friction from the move\-in process, lowers upfront costs for renters, and helps property managers make faster, more accurate decisions. We support a network of 3 million rental units nationwide and work with 47 of the NMHC Top 100 property owners, including Greystar, Brookfield, Asset Living, UDR, and more. We pioneered security deposit insurance and continue to push the industry forward with a growing suite of products — from deposit management to lease guarantees and loss\-of\-employment protection. We're growing quickly, tackling real problems at scale, and building technology that's changing how renting works. **The role** As a Staff Engineer on our data team, you'll be a senior software engineer who builds the systems that produce, move and serve our data, not just the pipelines and queries on top of them. You'll set technical direction for how data flows through Greenlight Rent, from the application services and APIs that generate it to the warehouse, models and tools the business runs on. You'll partner with product, finance and operations to turn rental\-housing problems into reliable software and trustworthy data. Our teams are small, about three engineers each, and AI tools let every one of them cover a lot of ground. Staff Engineers here stay hands\-on: most of the week goes to building, and the rest to leading the team and growing the people on it. **What you'll do** * Design and build the data foundations of Greenlight Rent: event and data models, ingestion from our application databases and partner integrations (property management systems, payment providers), and the warehouse and transformation layer * Write production application code too: the services, APIs and jobs that generate and use data, not only what happens downstream of them * Own measurable outcomes with your product and business partners, and make the scope and sequencing calls that get you there * Own the reliability and correctness of the data the business depends on, including monthly close, reporting and partner data * Write high\-quality code and set standards for testing, code review, observability and data quality, including when AI\-generated code needs a closer look * Make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and tradeoff decisions, and document them clearly * Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and lead a few direct reports * Keep sensitive financial and personal data secure and compliant **What you bring** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including technical leadership at the senior or staff level * A software engineer first: deep expertise in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Ruby, Go, TypeScript or Java), and a record of building and shipping application systems, not only data pipelines * Strong data engineering: SQL, data modeling, warehouses (e.g., Snowflake or BigQuery), transformation (e.g., dbt) and orchestration (e.g., Prefect or Airflow) * Experience designing and scaling APIs, distributed systems and relational databases * Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and CI/CD * Product sense: you care about why something gets built and whether it worked, not just how it's built * Fluency with AI coding tools, and the judgment to know when their output isn't good enough * A track record of leading ambiguous, high\-impact projects to completion * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical partners **Nice to have** * Experience in fintech, insurtech, payments or proptech * Familiarity with regulated environments (e.g., SOC 2, PCI, consumer\-finance rules) * Experience building 0\-to\-1 products or data platforms at a startup or growth\-stage company * Experience managing engineers, or a wish to grow into it **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Salary Range:** $195,000 \- $235,000 Greenlight Rent has partnered with a number of compensation benchmarking tools to determine competitive and fair market pay bands for our size and stage. Our goal is to ensure each employee is paid equitably and competitively while also maintaining a consistent and standardized methodology. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors including qualifications for the role, experience level and balancing internal equity relative to other teammates. Base salary is just one part of our Total Rewards Package here at Greenlight Rent. In connection with this position, we also offer: * Competitive cash compensation package including base salary, milestone based bonus, and other financial perks * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage (up to 90% employer contribution) \- eligible from your start date * 401(k), HSA, Life \& Disability Insurance Coverage ($0 employee contribution for additional insurances) * Unlimited PTO Policy * Generous Paid Parental Leave * Stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Greenlight’s success * Remote\-first work culture with opportunities to collaborate as a team in person * Monthly lifestyle stipend to fit your needs (meals, wellness, co\-working)

jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **Senior IT Infrastructure \& Operations Engineer** **The Opportunity** We are seeking a hands\-on Senior IT Infrastructure \& Operations Engineer to support reliable, secure, and scalable technology services across its subsidiaries and locations. This position combines enterprise systems administration, network operations, identity and access management, and infrastructure security. The engineer will resolve complex operational issues, support infrastructure improvements, and collaborate with Service Desk, Cybersecurity, GRC, business stakeholders, and corporate IT leadership. **What You Will Do** * Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity services. * Support enterprise networking, including switching, routing, wireless, VLANs, WAN connectivity, VPNs, firewalls, and network performance and security monitoring. * Manage virtualization environments, including VMware and/or Hyper\-V, virtual machine provisioning, capacity, maintenance, and operational health; support physical data center infrastructure. * Oversee identity and access operations, including onboarding/offboarding, authentication issues, security groups, permissions, MFA, and approved access changes. * Coordinate server and endpoint patching, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, security monitoring, and incident response with Cybersecurity and other technical teams. * Analyze logs, events, and SIEM/endpoint security alerts to identify operational or security issues requiring action. * Support backups, recovery, disaster recovery readiness, and infrastructure availability across multiple sites. * Act as an escalation resource for Service Desk teams; troubleshoot complex incidents, improve ticket documentation, and ensure appropriate routing and follow\-through. * Partner with GRC and business owners on user access reviews, audit evidence, configuration validation, and remediation tracking. * Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, implementations, testing, and cross\-site projects; maintain accurate technical procedures and documentation. * Collaborate with internal teams and vendors; communicate technical risks, priorities, and status to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Participate in limited on\-call or after\-hours support for critical incidents and scheduled maintenance; travel periodically to company locations as needed. **Required Qualifications** * At least 5 years of hands\-on experience in enterprise systems, network, or infrastructure administration. * Strong experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Microsoft 365; working knowledge of Entra ID and hybrid identity. * Practical knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, switching, routing, wireless, VPNs, and firewalls. * Experience supporting virtualization, infrastructure monitoring, patching, troubleshooting, and security remediation. * Understanding of identity and access management, endpoint protection, least privilege, authentication, and security controls. * Ability to independently diagnose complex technical issues, prioritize work, document resolutions, and collaborate across multiple locations. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Service Desk, IT infrastructure, Cybersecurity, GRC, and business teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Fortinet, Cisco, and Aruba networking or wireless technologies. * Experience with VMware, Hyper\-V, enterprise backup and recovery, and physical data center operations. * Familiarity with Splunk or other SIEM tools, CrowdStrike or other EDR tools, and vulnerability management platforms such as Qualys. * PowerShell scripting and automation experience; endpoint management, software deployment, or mobile device management experience. * Experience supporting audits, user access reviews, PCI\-related controls, penetration testing, or multi\-site enterprise environments. * Bachelor’s degree in an IT\-related discipline or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience; relevant Microsoft, Cisco, Fortinet, CompTIA Network\+, or Security\+ certifications. **Work Environment \& Schedule** This is an individual\-contributor role supporting multiple business locations. Depending on the assigned facility, work may involve data center or manufacturing environments and require appropriate safety practices or personal protective equipment. Specific work location, travel expectations, compensation, and benefits will be confirmed for the final posting. Standard Business Hours Monday\-Friday with Hybrid options *For more information about us please visit:* *www.riogrande.com* * ***Rio Grande is a Metal Free environment within our operations areas.*** At Rio Grande, our employees are the heart of our more than 80\-year legacy in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Our culture is guided by our 3R principles: Respect, Responsibility, and Results. We believe in a bias to action mindset that turns ideas into outcomes and in empowering employees to take initiative, grow through continuous learning, and making meaningful impacts every day. Recognized as a 2025 Platinum Award Family Friendly Business, we promote a work\-life balance, clear expectations, and a supportive environment, including quality benefits, robust wellness resources, and an onsite fitness facility. Through our employee recognition and community involvement, we celebrate individuality, foster belonging, and ensure every voice is valued. A career at Rio Grande offers more than a job. You’ll join a work place where your contributions matter and your growth is supported. Your work will help shape the future of the company and support our customers and industry. Guided by our core values, Rio Grande is committed to treating all people with dignity and respect. We are an equal\-opportunity employer with a zero\-tolerance policy for harassment or discrimination of any kind. As an advocate for equity and equality, we hire, train, and promote qualified people of all backgrounds. We consider employment candidates without regard to race, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other underrepresented class. We value our associates and have won the yearly Healthiest Places to Work and Family Friendly Business awards on multiple occasions. **The Reward:** Rio Grande provides a generous benefit package for full\-time (30\+ hours a week) associates that includes: * Medical plan with low premium rates and no high deductible (includes dental and vision) and telemedicine * 401(k) matching program * Paid time\-off benefits, plus an additional seven paid holidays * Paid life insurance and optional additional life insurance * Long\-term and short\-term disability * Flexible spending account * Pet insurance * Tuition reimbursement * On\-site gym and company wellness program * Bereavement leave * Employee discounts at Rio Grande * Local and national discounts on various travel and entertainment * Competitive compensation, including an opportunity to share in the profits Our associates strive for joint accountability. We work together for the success of our stakeholders, and we provide a thoughtful, fun, and creative environment to support them. We encourage professional and personal development through a variety of training opportunities and a focus on promoting from within. **The Company:** Established in 1944, Rio Grande, a Berkshire\-Hathaway manufacturer/distributor, has thousands of valued customers around the world. We are a principle\-based company with a highly evolved team\-based environment. We can show you how a profoundly effective organization lives these values every day. You can find our guiding principles, The 3 R’s, Respect, Responsibility and Results, on our website as well as information about our community support and how we protect the environment. Within our 186,000 sq. ft., solar\-powered facility, with covered parking, Rio Grande has sales, marketing, supply chain, IT and administrative offices, a climate\-controlled distribution center with more than 40,000 items, and a comprehensive, well\-equipped manufacturing operation. Manufactured products include jewelry\-making equipment (from basic tools to highly sophisticated induction casting machines) and jewelry components—both die\-struck and cast. Capabilities include CAD/CAM, casting, stamp and form, metal finishing, CNC machining, manual milling, tool \& die and electronics/mechanical assembly.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Financial AI Product
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. ### **About the Financial AI Product Team** Rippling’s Financial Product team builds the systems that power some of the most critical financial workflows for modern businesses — including payroll, payments, reconciliation, compliance, and operational finance. These products sit at the intersection of money movement, employee trust, customer operations, and regulatory complexity. The work is high stakes: financial systems must be accurate, reliable, auditable, and resilient, even as they handle messy real\-world data and complex business rules across customers, countries, and use cases. We are using AI to make these workflows dramatically simpler. That means building systems that can interpret inconsistent data, automate manual review, surface exceptions, explain outcomes, and accelerate implementation — while preserving the deterministic controls financial products require. The goal is not AI for its own sake; it is practical, production\-grade AI that helps customers run financial workflows with more speed, confidence, and accuracy. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will help define how AI becomes a core part of financial product and infrastructure at Rippling.### **What you will do** * Build AI\-powered product capabilities for complex financial workflows such as onboarding, data ingestion, reconciliation, validation, exception handling, and operational review. * Design systems that combine model\-driven reasoning with deterministic financial execution. * Build workflows that trace financial values back to source evidence, surface unresolved gaps, and prevent downstream execution when validation fails. * Create ingestion and normalization systems that can handle messy exports, historical records, customer\-provided files, and inconsistent provider formats. * Develop evals, testing harnesses, observability, and feedback loops to measure AI quality in workflows where “almost always right” is not good enough. * Partner closely with product, design, operations, compliance, and platform teams to identify high\-impact AI opportunities and turn them into reliable product capabilities. * Work through ambiguous product areas, prototype quickly, and scale successful solutions into reusable product and platform primitives. * Help set the engineering bar for correctness, auditability, security, reliability, and production safety in AI\-enabled and new AI native financial products. ### **What you will need** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems at meaningful scale. * Experience designing backend systems, data models, APIs, workflows, or platform infrastructure for complex business domains. * Strong judgment around reliability, correctness, edge cases, and operational risk. * Interest in applied AI, LLMs, agents, evals, retrieval, structured extraction, or AI\-assisted workflows. * Ability to reason clearly about where AI should be used, where deterministic systems should take over, and how to build guardrails around model\-driven workflows. * Product sense and comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where the right answer is not obvious upfront. * Ability to partner with product managers, domain experts, operations teams, and engineers to turn messy real\-world workflows into simple, scalable software. * A high\-ownership mindset: you can take a problem from vague customer pain through architecture, implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. ### **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), **Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy**, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

What you'll do Partner and build * Work directly with teams to understand their needs and help triage, scope, and prioritize requests with stakeholders. * Use AI coding tools to design and build custom solutions and integrations with existing platforms. Own it from concept to completion * Take projects from an initial conversation through deployment and ongoing support. * Support what you ship: fix issues, answer user questions, and take part in an on\-call rotation for production tools. * Test early, gather feedback from the people using what you build, and iterate. * With senior guidance, learn production safeguards: safe database changes, monitoring, and rollbacks. Build validation and reconciliation checks across Jenzabar, Slate, and Canvas, and define record\-matching rules between systems. * Security and FERPA: Implement and test Unity Catalog row filters and column masks, verifying that each user sees only the data they are authorized to see. Review and approve data access requests under FERPA, GLBA, and College policy. * Supervision and vendor management: Supervise and mentor co\-ops, interns, and student workers assigned to the portal program. Additional backup will be a full stack developer which is a Union position. * Compliance \& Governance: Perform duties in strict compliance with the Commonwealth of Massachusetts regulations, NECHE accreditation criteria, and individual collective bargaining agreements (if applicable). * Perform other related job\-related duties as assigned. **Job Requirements:** **Qualifications:** * Required Minimum Education: Master's degree in computer science, data science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Competencies: * Demonstrated excellence in written, verbal, and digital communication skills, including the ability to communicate information clearly and professionally to students, faculty, staff, administrators, union representatives, and community partners while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism. * Demonstrated commitment to working in a culturally diverse, urban community college setting. * Strong SQL, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and query tuning. * Proficiency in Python. * Experience building and maintaining production data pipelines or data applications. * Comfort with Git\-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD. * Ability to read a data model, trace a field back to its source, and reason about how records move between systems. * Ability to translate needs from senior leadership and non\-technical staff into clear specifications and priorities. * Experience developing data governance policies or standards. * Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion, and willingness to complete FERPA training before accessing production data. * Consistent documentation habits. * Practical experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude, with sound judgment about verifying generated output. * Substitution Statement: An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered. * Preferred Qualifications (optional): * Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog. * Azure experience: ADLS Gen2, Entra ID, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps. * Experience with Databricks Apps, Streamlit, Dash, or similar Python app frameworks. * Dimensional modeling and medallion architecture. * Experience building with LLMs: retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering, or agent frameworks. * Higher education experience, particularly with Jenzabar J1, Slate, or Canvas data. * Understanding of FERPA and GLBA obligations for PII and financial data. * Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools. * Experience mentoring students or interns, or managing vendor relationships. **Additional jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform Lead (Horizon AI)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **Data Platform Lead** ---------------------- Horizon AI is building the operating system for how organizations run themselves. The first step is autonomous data centers. A fleet of AI agents senses the state of STN’s GPU infrastructure, reasons about what it finds, and increasingly acts on it. This is running in production against real fleet data, not a prototype. Agents already take action where the risk is bounded and the outcome is verifiable. Everything riskier arrives as a recommendation for a human, and the work is moving decisions from the second category into the first, one class at a time, on evidence rather than optimism. Data centers are the proving ground, not the destination. We start here because infrastructure is measurable and unforgiving: an agent is either right, or the fleet tells you it was wrong. What we build here generalizes, and we know where it goes next. **Level:** Principal (MTS 5\) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer **The role.** Build the data foundation the platform reasons over. Today our agents assemble a picture of the fleet by querying several separate systems, and we cannot prove wider autonomy because we do not systematically capture how humans decide. You fix both. **The problems you inherit** * Fleet state is scattered across a relational store, a DCIM system, and multiple time\-series and monitoring systems. Each has its own query path. There is no unified model. \- No decision\-capture pipeline exists. We record what agents did, but not what operators saw, concluded, and chose. That record is the evidence base for granting agents wider autonomy. * Our retrieval pipeline is document\-oriented rather than fleet\-state\-oriented. * We consume telemetry from systems other teams operate, where retention and granularity are tuned for dashboards rather than for learning from history. **You will** * Design and build the fleet knowledge model: assets, topology, configuration, and current state, queryable by an agent in one call rather than five * Build the decision\-capture pipeline, and instrument the operator workflow so we accumulate labelled human decisions from day one * Own the data access layer that abstracts telemetry sources, so we can keep consuming today and build our own collection if that stops scaling * Negotiate our requirements with the teams who own the telemetry: signals, granularity, retention, raw event access * Own the scale path, including vector index behaviour and the analytics separation a growing schema will eventually need **You have** * Strong data modelling judgment, particularly modelling physical or infrastructure domains as something queryable * Experience with time\-series and event data at scale, including cardinality and retention trade\-offs * Depth in PostgreSQL, including vector search, and comfort with a large evolving schema \- Enough infrastructure literacy to know what a fleet actually is: nodes, GPUs, fabric, schedulers, power. Familiarity with DCIM tooling is a strong plus * A bias toward shipping a usable model early over designing a complete one **Nice to have:** GPU fleet or HPC exposure, DCGM, Slurm, entity resolution across inconsistent sources

testing, vulnerability remediation, incident response, and threat analysis initiatives. * Ability to assess technical risk and translate findings into practical business recommendations. * Strong Bachelor//'s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, AWS Security, Microsoft Security, or equivalent credentials. * Experience developing enterprise security standards and technical security governance frameworks. * Experience with cloud security reviews, architecture assessments, and security modernization initiatives. * Familiarity with security tooling, automation frameworks, and cloud\-native security controls.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Premium Discovery
jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **About the team** ------------------ Premium is the Scribd Inc. pillar behind two reading products: Everand, the audiobook and ebook subscription app, and Fable, the social app where readers track, discuss and discover books. Helping readers find their next book is central to both, so search and recommendations sit at the heart of the products. You'll join Premium's new Discovery squad. It's a small, dedicated group of recommendations, search, applied research and ML engineers working full time on discovery for Everand and Fable. The squad works closely with Orion, Scribd's ML platform team. Orion runs the feature store, model registry, embedding\-based retrieval and model serving behind discovery across Scribd, Slideshare and Everand. **Role overview** ----------------- We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own recommendations for Fable and grow into the technical lead for Premium recommendations. Fable's recommender today is a collaborative\-filtering model built in house. It has served readers well, but it has no real\-time signals and no learned ranking, and it can't recommend to new or lapsed readers. Your first big project is to move Fable onto Orion, so Fable and Everand share a modern recommendation stack. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead the migration of Fable's recommendations onto Orion, covering data, features, training, serving and experiments, while keeping today's recommendations running. * Extend Orion's rankers, feature store and embedding\-based retrieval to support Fable, in partnership with the Orion ML platform team. * Own the health of Fable's recommendation systems in production: quality, latency, cost and on\-call. * Bring Fable's social signals (shelves, ratings, reviews, book clubs, reader similarity) into recommendations for both Fable and Everand. * Design and analyze A/B tests with product managers and analysts to decide what ships. * Act as technical lead for Premium recommendations. Shape the roadmap with product managers, and see work that depends on other teams' systems through to delivery. * Raise the bar on engineering practice in the squad through design reviews, code quality and operational readiness. **Tech you'll work with** ------------------------- You'll work across two stacks: Fable's on Google Cloud and Orion's on AWS. * **Fable:** Python (FastAPI, Django), PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Kubernetes, Google Cloud including Vertex AI * **Orion and Everand:** Python, Go and gRPC, Ruby on Rails, Databricks and Spark, Airflow, AWS SageMaker, Weaviate for embedding\-based retrieval, feature store and model registry * **Infrastructure:** AWS (EKS, ECS, Lambda, SQS, ElastiCache), Datadog, Terraform **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must have** * 5\+ years as a professional ML or software engineer, with a track record of shipping production ML systems. * Hands\-on experience building and running recommender systems in production, such as collaborative filtering or matrix factorization, two\-tower or embedding retrieval, and learned ranking. * Experience with large\-scale data processing (Spark, Databricks, BigQuery or similar). * Experience on at least one major cloud (AWS or GCP), including deploying services on containers (Kubernetes, ECS or similar). * Experience designing and analyzing online experiments. * A record of leading projects that depend on other teams, and of working directly with product managers. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. # ch as user similarity, follows or groups. * Search and semantic retrieval (Elasticsearch, Vertex AI Search, vector databases). * Experience on consumer apps for reading, media or social. \- At Scribd, Inc. your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $170,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $265,000 \[maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California]. In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $140,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $252,000 \[maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California]. In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between 179,000 CAD\[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to 237,500 CAD\[maximum salary in our highest geographic market]. We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job\-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package. **Working at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- **Are you currently based in a location where Scribd, Inc. can employ you?** Employees must have their **primary residence in or near** one of the following cities. This includes surrounding metro areas or locations within a typical commuting distance: **United States****:** Atlanta \| Austin \| Boston \| Dallas \| Denver \| Chicago \| Houston \| Jacksonville \| Los Angeles \| Miami \| New York City \| Phoenix \| Portland \| Sacramento \| Salt Lake City \| San Diego \| San Francisco \| Seattle \| Washington D.C. **Canada****:** Ottawa \| Toronto \| Vancouver **Mexico****:** Mexico City **Benefits at Scribd, Inc.** * Scribd Flex (flexible work model) * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support and disability coverage * Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick time, holidays, winter break, volunteer time, and sabbaticals * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Retirement matching and employee equity * Learning and development programs and professional growth opportunities * Wellness and home office stipends * Complimentary access to the Scribd, Inc. suite of products * Enterprise access to leading AI tools **Get to Know Scribd, Inc.** **About Scribd, Inc.** **Life at Scribd, Inc.** *We want our interview process to be accessible to everyone. You can inform us of any reasonable adjustments we can make to better accommodate your needs by emailing accommodations@scribd.com about the need for adjustments at any point in the interview process.* *If you apply for a job with Scribd, Inc. or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available* *here**.* *Scribd, Inc. is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, and believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.*

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies Certified as a Great Place to Work® Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services \& Insurance Junior Forward Deployed Engineer **PRIMARY PURPOSE** : The Junior Forward Deployed Engineer within the Transformation Office serves as the hands‑on architect of the enterprise data supply chain for the organization’s most advanced analytics, data science, and AI initiatives. This role performs the critical engineering work required to deliver high‑fidelity, production‑grade data that powers machine learning models, feature stores, and generative AI applications. Operating as a “day‑one” builder, the Gen AI Engineer designs and delivers data pipelines that bridge legacy on‑premise systems—including mainframes, SQL Server, and DB2—with modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems. The role ensures that data is not merely transferred, but deliberately engineered to meet the statistical, performance, and governance requirements of model training, inference, and RAG‑based AI systems. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Designs, builds, and maintains resilient ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from on‑premise systems, AWS services (S3, RDS), and Azure platforms (Blob Storage, Azure SQL), centralizing and curating data for consumption in Snowflake and downstream AI services. * Develops and maintains feature stores and analytically optimized datasets that support machine learning workflows, ensuring data is clean, versioned, reproducible, and statistically valid for Data Science teams. * Engineers data pipelines that enable generative AI use cases, including the automated extraction, transformation, chunking, and loading of structured and unstructured data into vector databases across AWS and Azure environments. * Acts as a Snowflake power user and technical lead, implementing advanced data modeling patterns, Snowpipe automation, and compute and storage optimization to support high‑concurrency analytics and AI workloads. * Executes non‑invasive data extraction strategies to unlock mission‑critical data from decades‑old legacy systems while preserving system stability and avoiding disruption to core business operations. * Designs and manages complex, cross‑platform data workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, AWS Step Functions, and Azure Data Factory to ensure reliable, synchronized data movement across the organization’s multi‑cloud architecture. * Partners closely with central IT, database administrators, infrastructure, and security teams to resolve connectivity and access challenges—including PrivateLink, IAM, network segmentation, and firewall controls—while securing production approval for new data integrations. * Implements automated data quality, validation, and observability frameworks to detect data drift, anomalies, and integrity issues that could negatively impact production analytics, machine learning, or AI systems. * Drives efficiency across the data ecosystem by optimizing storage, compute usage, and query performance in Snowflake, AWS, and Azure, ensuring responsible cost management and measurable ROI for Transformation Office initiatives. Operates as a dedicated engineering partner to MLOps, Data Science, and AI teams, rapidly iterating on evolving data requirements and translating experimental use cases into scalable, production‑ready data solutions. * **ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES** * Performs other duties as assigned. Travel as required. * **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education \& Licensing** Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field from an accredited college or university preferred. **Experience** Six (6\) years of hands\-on data engineering experience, with a track record of building production\-grade pipelines for Data Science and AI in multi\-cloud environments or equivalent combination of education and experience required. **Skills \& Knowledge** * Expert\-level proficiency in Snowflake architecture, including data sharing, performance tuning, and the integration of Snowflake with external cloud AI services * Advanced, hands\-on knowledge of AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda) and Azure (Data Factory, Synapse) data services * Mastery of Python, SQL, and PySpark. Deep experience with data orchestration and containerization (Docker) * Proven ability to interface with "old world" tech (on\-premise SQL, Mainframe extracts, flat files) and transform it for modern cloud consumption * A strong understanding of the specific data needs for Machine Learning (feature engineering) and Generative AI (vectorization and embedding pipelines) * A "get\-it\-done" attitude, capable of navigating enterprise bureaucracy and technical debt to ship code at the speed required by a Transformation Office * Ability to work in a team environment Ability to meet or exceed Performance Competencies * **WORK ENVIRONMENT** When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations. **Mental** **:** Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work\-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines **Physical** **:** Computer keyboarding, travel as required **Auditory/Visual** **:** Hearing, vision and talking The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by a colleague assigned to this description. jobs.title: VP-Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI Engineering
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR** -------------------------- As the **VP – Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI Engineering** at Slate Automotive, you will be the founding architect of our GenAI capability. We are not just building an electric truck — we are building an AI\-native company. You will design, build, and ship the Generative AI systems that transform how we engineer vehicles, run manufacturing, and serve customers. This is a deeply hands\-on role: you will write code, make architectural calls, and lead by example. You will build and lead a lean, high\-leverage team of GenAI engineers, MLOps engineers, and applied scientists — and personally stay in the code — to solve challenges no one in the auto industry has cracked yet. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * **Build the GenAI Stack from Scratch:** Architect and ship the end\-to\-end GenAI platform — context layer, data layer, model serving, agent frameworks, and evaluation pipelines — on a modern cloud foundation. * **Lead by Building:** You are a player\-coach. You will recruit and grow a world\-class team of GenAI engineers, but you will stay in the code — reviewing PRs, making architecture calls, and shipping alongside your team. * **Ship Agentic Systems Across the Company:** Deploy GenAI agents across vehicle engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, software development, and GTM — converting human\-driven workflows into AI\-driven ones that run faster and cheaper. * **Build Slate’s Proprietary AI Moat:** Construct the Context Layer — a living knowledge base of agentic, human, robotic, and enterprise decisions — and the unified Data Layer that trains purpose\-built models on real Slate decisions. This IP is our long\-term competitive advantage. * **Drive GenAI into the Physical World:** Take GenAI beyond the laptop — partner with Vehicle Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed AI into the factory floor, design tooling, and supply chain, upgrading traditional auto manufacturing from the inside. * **Set the Standard for AI\-First Engineering:** Establish the engineering culture, standards, and practices that make Slate a destination for world\-class AI talent — and that make our GenAI output measurably better than the industry. **WHAT YOU BRING** * **12\+ years** of engineering experience, including **3\+ years** building and shipping production GenAI systems (LLM\-based applications, agents, RAG pipelines), with **5\+ years** in a senior technical leadership capacity. * **GenAI Architecture:** Deep hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), open\-source model deployment, vector databases, agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar), and prompt engineering at scale. * **MLOps \& Production Systems:** Proven track record taking GenAI from prototype to production — including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and continuous improvement loops. * **Fine\-Tuning \& Custom Models:** Experience fine\-tuning and training purpose\-built models for domain\-specific tasks. Familiarity with the tradeoffs between hosted APIs, open\-source models, and custom training for cost, latency, and IP reasons. * **Data \& Cloud Foundation:** Solid grounding in modern data stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Comfortable reasoning about cost, latency, and data architecture as first\-class constraints. * **Academic Grounding:** BS required; MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field preferred — but exceptional track record beats pedigree every time. **SALARY RANGE** The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors. $222,431\.00 \- $370,719\.00 Base Pay Range (Annual) Additional Compensation and Benefits: Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at **slate\-talent\_acquisition@slate.auto.**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Rust
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area. More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation! **About The Team** The Hub Applications team builds core functionality of the software that runs on SmartThings hubs and keeps them connected to the cloud. Written primarily in Rust, our software is responsible for letting millions of connected homes reliably control their devices, stay in sync, and receive improvements over time. Some of our core responsibilities are:* **Local device execution:** Building and maintaining the runtime that lets hubs run device integrations directly on the hub. * **Hub and cloud data flow:** Ensuring device state, events, and commands move reliably between hubs and the cloud, that cloud and hub data records stay synchronized, and that hubs recover gracefully after losing connectivity. * **Core hub software architecture:** Reshaping the hub’s core services so they’re easier to maintain, faster, and ready for new hardware.. * **Configuration and system management:** Designing how hubs receive, validate, and safely roll back configuration, and keeping core system behavior such as timekeeping consistent and resilient. * **Release quality and observability:** Monitoring software releases across the hub population and building the metrics and tooling that surface problems early. **About The Role** We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Applications team. This is a deeply hands\-on role for someone with expert\-level Rust skills. You’ll write, review, and set the standard for the Rust code that runs on millions of SmartThings hubs, where performance, memory use, and reliability on resource\-constrained devices matter. Comfort with Rust’s ownership model, concurrency, and error handling is essential, as is experience working across the boundary between Rust and existing C code. You’ll help drive long\-term technical strategy for our core areas, including evolving the hub’s foundational software toward a more modular, maintainable design. Operating with autonomy, you’ll bring clarity to complex, cross\-functional challenges and act as a go\-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives. Close partnership with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams will shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. Mentoring engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and guiding how the team adopts AI\-assisted development and operational practices are also part of the role. This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown, with paid attached parking!). The pay range for this role is $139,000 to $198,000, with an annual bonus target of 20%.### **Key Responsibilities** In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:* **Technical Strategy Ownership:** Own the long\-term technical direction for one or more Hub Applications domains. * **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Lead large, cross\-team projects as the technical owner, from design through rollout. * **Architect for Reliability \& Scale:** Guide architecture and design decisions for systems such as local device execution, hub\-to\-cloud data synchronization, and hub configuration and software asset management, with stability, resilience to unreliable connectivity, and operational excellence as first\-class concerns. * **Rust Technical Leadership:** Serve as a deep Rust expert for the team. Set the standard for how we write, review, and test Rust that runs on resource\-constrained devices, with performance, memory efficiency, and safe concurrency as everyday concerns. Guide the evolution of existing code, including where Rust meets legacy C. * **AI Practices \& Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward\-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs. * **Mentor \& Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, in p capacity * Expert\-level proficiency in Rust, with deep knowledge of ownership and lifetimes, async and multithreaded concurrency, error handling, and writing performant, memory\-efficient code for resource\-constrained devices * Strong systems programming experience on embedded Linux or similar constrained environments, including debugging crashes, memory issues, and performance problems in production * Experience designing for unreliable networks: offline operation, state reconciliation, retry and backoff behavior, and graceful recovery * Strong knowledge of AI development tools and practices * Proven ability to lead architecture and design reviews, set technical direction across teams, and bring about simple solutions to complex problems * Strong track record of cross\-functional collaboration with firmware, cloud, and product teams * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience translating technical strategy for both technical and non\-technical audiences **Desired Skills*** Experience interoperating Rust with C or C\+\+ codebases, including incremental migration of legacy code * Experience with IoT connectivity protocols and standards (Matter, Zigbee, Thread, MQTT) * Experience with embedded scripting runtimes or sandboxed code execution (e.g. Lua, WebAssembly) * Experience with IoT fleet management: staged rollouts, feature flags, monitoring, and lifecycle management at scale * Experience with observability tooling and release monitoring for large deployed device populations * Experience with CI/CD and automated validation for embedded software ### **SmartThings Benefits** * We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. EV chargers are also onsite. * In\-office catered lunches once a week. * Access to the onsite gym. Base compensation range for this position is **$139,000 to $198,000\.** Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. If you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process or to perform the requirements of the job, we will work with you to meet your needs in compliance with applicable laws. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. Bringing together developers, device makers, and service providers to make the world a smarter place. From a door that knows when to lock itself, to a living room that can get the party started or a sink that can help to call a plumber; the opportunities are endless to make everyday objects around us more useful. So if you’re innovative, not afraid to challenge status quo, collaborative and have a passion for technology, then you’ve found your next home with SmartThings!
