jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Workflows
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer **Company:** Snapsheet **Job Location:** USA,Remote **Job Type:** Full\-time, direct hire **About Snapsheet**: Snapsheet is claims technology the way it should be: purposeful, precise, and designed to deliver outcomes. Where others bolt things on, we engineer them into our core systems and processes across cloud\-based claims management, virtual vehicle appraisals, and elite loss and recovery services. Trusted by over 170\+ P\&C Carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, and logistics companies, our open architecture is built to fit how our companies work, not the other way around. **Role Overview:** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Snapsheet’s Workflows team who is passionate about technology, eager to learn, and ready to create impactful solutions. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the evolution of our industry\-leading claims engine. The Workflows team builds the platform that powers automation across Snapsheet, using configurable stages, event handlers, and scheduled system actions. In this role, you will design and build distributed systems and RESTful APIs that handle high volumes of events, manage complex data relationships, and run the logic that coordinates automated processes across our products. **What we are looking for:** * BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field * 5\+ years of full\-stack web development experience + Designing and building APIs + Designing schemas and performant queries for relational databases + Understanding of scalability challenges and performance of server\-side code * Prior professional experience using React and/or Typescript a plus * Prior experience using Ruby on Rails a plus * Experience with AI tools and AI\-assisted software development (AI SDLC) is a plus * Eagerness to learn from and work with a collaborative team * Commitment to quality and passion for technology and creating cutting\-edge solutions * Ability to manage tasks and to contribute towards multiple initiatives during a sprint **Our tech stack:*** Frameworks: Ruby on Rails and React * Methodology: Agile * Infrastructure: MySQL, S3, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Lambda, Docker, CloudFront **We’re Built to Grow With You – And That Starts With How We Support You** At Snapsheet, we know that growth doesn’t happen in a vacuum—it’s fueled by the right support at the right time. That’s why we’ve built a benefits experience designed to grow with you, wherever life takes you. * Choose from 2 robust medical plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield—plus, we contribute to your HSA when you enroll in our high\-deductible health plan. * Offer two dental plans and one vision plan to keep you and your family healthy. * Peace of mind with company\-paid Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance. * Additional protection through voluntary benefits like Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Legal Assistance. * 401(k) with a 4% company match—because your future is worth investing in. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 6 sessions per life incident to support your mental well\-being. **Perks That Make Growing Here Even Better:** * Flexible PTO and 7\.5 company\-observed holidays to recharge on your terms. * In\-person connection points throughout the year including our annual Summit and Roadshows. * Snapsheet SWAG and surprise mailers to keep the spirit alive. * Endless opportunity to shape your path—career growth, learning, and real impact are all within reach. * Health and wellness campaigns that evolve with you year over year. **Compensation that Grows with You** For this position, the base salary range is $135,000 \- $165,000\. While this range serves as a guideline, your actual compensation will reflect your unique experience, skill set, and location. At Snapsheet, we believe growth should be rewarded—our compensation and benefits are built to evolve with you as your career does. *We are currently unable to accept applications for candidates who reside in the following states: Alaska, California, Hawaii, Montana, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Wyoming.* * *Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time.* *Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Snapsheet, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.* *Snapsheet is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or accommodations, please let us know by emailing* *talent@snapsheet.me**.* *Snapsheet is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran,* *status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.* \#BI\-Remote \#LI\-Remote **Snapsheet is an equal opportunity employer.** Gjqes5rYdr

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Software Developer **Company:** SMRTR **Location:** United States or Canada, Remote **Employment Type :** Full\-time **About SMRTR** SMRTR builds software that helps businesses run more efficiently. Together with our sister companies Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner, and DTEC, a distribution ERP provider, we are part of Solen Software Group. Our customers rely on us every day, and our Subscriptions, Renewals, Collections \& Accounting team keeps that relationship healthy, making sure software subscriptions, renewals and services are billed on time and accurately, and that outstanding balances are resolved quickly and professionally. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a software developer with 3–5 years of experience to build product features and integrations for NG and SMRTR TRAC. Our stack is Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with services on the JVM (Scala). Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI\-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. You will join a small, experienced team where what you build reaches customers quickly. **Key Responsibilities** **Product development** * Build features across the front end (Vue, TypeScript) and back end (Node.js, Scala/JVM) for NG and SMRTR TRAC. * Design and work with PostgreSQL data models and queries (and some MongoDB), with attention to performance. * Fix defects and improve the reliability of the products you work on. **Integrations and APIs** * Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between NG / SMRTR TRAC and ERP systems such as SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI and NCR, following the team's integration patterns. * Contribute to AI document capture (classification and data extraction) and the print\-to\-NG driver. **Delivery and collaboration** * Turn requirements from Professional Services, Sales and customers into working software, with guidance from engineering leadership. * Estimate your own tasks and deliver to agreed dates. * Support go\-lives and help troubleshoot production issues. **Engineering practices** * Write tested, reviewed and secure code in our GitHub\-based workflow with CI/CD. * Write clear technical documentation and release notes. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to work faster, safely. **What You Bring** **Required** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript and Node.js. * PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and query performance. * JVM experience, preferably Scala. * Experience building REST APIs and integrating with third\-party systems. * Git\-based workflows, code review and automated testing. * Clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, customers. * Authorized to work in the United States or Canada; set up for remote work. **Nice to Have** * MongoDB. * Android or Xamarin. * ERP integration experience (e.g., SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI, NCR). * Document management, OCR or AI document capture. * Experience with manufacturing, distribution or food \& beverage software. **How Success Is Measured** * Features and integrations delivered on schedule * Quality: defects and production incidents in your code * Accuracy of estimates on your own work * Growing ownership of product areas over the year **Compensation and Benefits** * Base salary of USD 65,000–85,000 (United States) or CAD 95,000–110,000 (Canada), depending on experience and location * Benefits according to country of employment (in the US: health, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) with company match) * Paid time off and company holidays * Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team **Recruitment Disclaimer** Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels. ***We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.***

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Data & Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. ### **Sr. Principal Engineer, Data \& Machine Learning** **San Mateo, CA** ### **Why PlayStation Data \& Intelligence** PlayStation reaches more than 100\+ million people. Behind those experiences is one of the largest consumer data estates in entertainment: tens of petabytes under management and trillions of telemetry events a year, powering personalization, experimentation, partner analytics and enterprise decisions across the company. We are in the middle of a multi\-year shift in how that data creates value. Today intelligence often arrives after the moment has passed. Our goal is a connected intelligence layer where trusted context about players, content, partners and the business is built once, reused everywhere, activated at the point of decision, and improved by evidence about what happened next. That includes serving AI models and agents with the same governed meaning, quality and permissions we give to people. This role helps shape how that is built across PlayStation. **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer, Data \& Machine Learning to serve as chief architect for our Data \& Intelligence organization and as the senior technical authority for how SIE builds, reuses and activates trusted data and intelligence. This is one of SIE's most senior individual\-contributor roles. You will report directly to the Vice President of the organization, sit on the leadership team alongside the Sr. Directors who run our two delivery portfolios, chair our architecture review forum, and lead a community of Principal Engineers anchored to the major architectural seams. You will have no direct reports by design; your leverage comes from the architecture, the standards and the decisions the whole organization builds against. This is a hands\-on role. You will author architectures and reference implementations, prototype uncertain approaches, review the designs and code that matter most, and step in directly when a technical problem puts an important outcome at risk. **What You'll Own** You will set the architecture for, and drive reuse across, the initiatives that define the next three years of data and intelligence at PlayStation: * **A single, reusable understanding of the player.** The context, lifecycle and lifetime\-value intelligence that powers experiences and decisions across PlayStation, built once and reused rather than rebuilt per use case. * **Content and game understanding.** Intelligence about titles, experiences and how players engage with them, connected through engagement and content graphs to improve discovery, personalization and new AI experiences. * **Creator and partner intelligence.** Reusable title, launch and lifecycle intelligence available to partners at the point of decision, before launch, while live and after. * **Unified measurement.** Experimentation, attribution and causal measurement so the company knows what changed an outcome, by how much, and what to do next. * **Activation.** Real\-time signals, activation data products and APIs that deliver trusted context into the systems that personalize and act. * **Semantic and conversational intelligence.** A shared layer of business meaning and metrics that people, analytical tools and AI agents can query and trust. * **Enterprise decision data.** Decision\-grade finance and supply\-chain data that accelerates transformation programs across SIE. * **Trusted foundations and golden paths.** Data contracts, certification, lineage, unified events and standard publish\-to\-consume paths, with trust designed into the lifecycle; and launch data readiness so priority launches have their signals and measures from day one. **What You'll Do** * Translate our multi\-year Data \& Intelligence strategy into a coherent technical strategy and target architecture, with clear principles for trusted data products, ML systems, shared intelligence, evaluation, activation and lifecycle management. * Chair the architecture review forum: set its charter and cadence, publish decisions, track adoption and hold the line on non\-conforming designs. * Own the boundary decisions between platform capabilities built for reuse and domain delivery, and keep them stable. * Define and ratify the standards teams build against: data contracts, golden nd machine learning direction in senior leadership forums, partner organizations and, where appropriate, the broader industry. ### **What We're Looking For** * 15\+ years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including 9\+ years leading the architecture and delivery of large\-scale, complex systems. * A track record of authoring architectures, standards or platforms that were adopted across multiple organizations and stayed in use. * Experience taking data, ML or decisioning systems serving tens of millions of consumers into production and operating them at scale. * Experience chairing, or being the deciding technical voice in, an architecture review forum spanning multiple engineering organizations. * Deep expertise in at least two of: reusable data products, semantic and metadata layers and data contracts; ML platforms, lifecycle management, evaluation and decisioning; real\-time signals, distributed inference and activation platforms; experimentation and causal measurement; generative AI, retrieval and agentic systems; responsible AI, privacy and technical governance. * Strong command of distributed systems, cloud, data architecture, APIs, security, reliability, observability and performance engineering. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, engineering and product leaders, and cross\-functional partners without direct authority. * Outstanding written communication. This role leads through documents. * Experience mentoring Staff, Principal or similarly senior technical professionals. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Data and ML applied in gaming, entertainment, media, digital commerce or another large\-scale consumer ecosystem. * Personalization, recommendations, customer intelligence, content intelligence, experimentation or predictive decisioning at scale. * Shared data or ML platforms serving multiple products and organizational domains. * Feature, vector, graph, semantic or knowledge platforms; AI gateways and LLMOps. * Experience translating research or emerging technology into production capabilities. * Contributions to the field through open source, patents, publications, standards or conference talks. **Why You'll Love This Role** * Set the technical direction for data and intelligence across PlayStation. * Own the architecture behind experiences reaching more than 100 million people. * Report directly to the VP and sit on the organization's leadership team. * Build once, reuse everywhere: the mandate is to end duplicated work, not add to it. * Work with strong Principal and Staff engineers, data scientists and product leaders across the company. * Stay hands\-on at the most senior IC level. \#LI\-KS1 Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** The Principal Data Scientist for Enterprise Data \& Customer Analytics provides senior technical leadership in the design, development, deployment, and responsible use of advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions. This role transforms complex enterprise and customer data into actionable intelligence, production\-ready models, and reusable analytical capabilities that improve customer experiences, business decisions, and operational outcomes. The position combines deep data science and software engineering expertise with business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and enterprise influence. The Principal Data Scientist works across business and technology teams to identify high\-value opportunities, establish technical standards, guide model development, and communicate complex findings in a clear and decision\-oriented manner. **JOB REQUIREMENTS** **Education and Experience** * Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a closely related quantitative field is required. * Must have a minimum of 6 years of experience working with large, diverse, and sensitive datasets and translating analytical results into measurable business value. * Extensive progressive experience applying data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or artificial intelligence to complex business problems, including experience serving as a senior technical lead or principal\-level individual contributor. * Demonstrated experience developing, validating, deploying, monitoring, and improving analytical and machine learning models in enterprise environments. Experience in the energy, utility, customer analytics, or other highly regulated industry is preferred. * **Technical Knowledge and Skills** * Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark for data preparation, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, statistical analysis, machine learning, and production\-scale model development. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of Databricks, including collaborative development, distributed computing with Apache Spark, ML lifecycle practices, model tracking, governed data access, and deployment patterns. * Advanced knowledge of statistical methods, experimental design, causal reasoning, predictive modeling, forecasting, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, and model evaluation. * Demonstrated knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, natural language processing, neural networks, ensemble methods, recommendation techniques, and other modern machine learning approaches. * Strong knowledge of large language models, including prompt design, model interaction patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, evaluation, grounding, guardrails, and responsible AI considerations. * Experience developing or adapting models through techniques such as fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient tuning, feature engineering, hyperparameter optimization, and systematic experimentation. * Ability to design reliable model evaluation approaches for predictive and generative AI solutions, including quality, accuracy, bias, explainability, safety, drift, performance, and business\-impact measures. * Strong SQL and data engineering skills, including experience integrating structured and unstructured data across enterprise platforms and building repeatable analytical pipelines. * Knowledge of cloud\-based data and AI platforms, software development practices, version control, automated testing, APIs, CI/CD, and MLOps or LLMOps practices. * Ability to debug and troubleshoot complex data, code, model, and performance issues across the analytical lifecycle. Working knowledge of data governance, data privacy, security, model risk, ethical AI, and the appropriate handling of customer and enterprise data. * **Leadership and Business Skills** * Ability to identify and shape high\-value data science and AI opportunities in partnership with customer, operational, product, and technology stakeholders. * Strong consulting, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into meaningful business insight for audiences at all levels of the organization. * Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction, establish standards, influence without direct authority, and mentor data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business partners. * Ability to balance innovation with production reliability, governance, customer impact, cost, and long\-term maintainability. * Self\-directed, results\-oriented, and able to manage multiple complex assignments with limited technical guidance. Commitment to continuous learning and awareness of emerging data science, machine learning, and generative AI trends. * **MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Partner with Enterprise Data \& Customer Analytics leaders and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and refine use cases that improve customer experienc ery quality. Unless separately assigned, the role does not have direct authority for hiring, termination, performance appraisal, or discipline. **CORE BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES** The successful candidate will demonstrate understanding and application of the Southern Company behaviors: Unquestionable Trust, Superior Performance, and Total Commitment. * Acts ethically and protects customer, employee, and company data. * Delivers results with accountability, sound judgment, and attention to quality. * Thinks strategically and maintains an enterprise perspective when designing sustainable solutions. * Innovates responsibly and tests assumptions with evidence. * Builds constructive partnerships and works effectively across business and technology teams. * Communicates candidly, clearly, and respectfully. * Develops others through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical mentorship. * Adapts to changing priorities and acts with appropriate speed and decisiveness. Demonstrates commitment to continuous learning, inclusion, and safe work practices. * **PREFERRED DIFFERENTIATORS** * Experience delivering customer analytics use cases such as segmentation, propensity, personalization, forecasting, customer journey analysis, service optimization, or next\-best\-action recommendations. * Experience combining enterprise data products with advanced analytics and generative AI capabilities. * Published research, patents, conference presentations, open\-source contributions, or recognized thought leadership in data science, machine learning, or artificial intelligence. * Experience establishing reusable analytical frameworks, technical standards, or enterprise communities of practice. **About Southern Company** Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com . Southern Company invests in the well\-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well\-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO\-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process. Southern Company is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer - On-Site (Texas)
jobs.description: **Position Title**: Senior Analytics Engineer **FSLA Status**: Exempt (17C) **Reports to**: Director of Data Analytics and Strategy **Location:** Tyler or Dallas Fort Worth, Texas * Only Candidates currently residing in the Texas area will be considered. No relocation assistance or fully remote options available. * Open to a hybrid work schedule \- 3 days in the office/2 days working from home. **Job Summary:** The Senior Analytics Engineer is a senior technical role within Southside Bank’s data team, focused on building and maintaining the Snowflake data platform that supports analytics, reporting, and AI capabilities across the organization. This person will lead day\-to\-day work across data ingestion, dbt modeling, and data quality, and will be the team’s primary resource on Snowflake AI and Cortex features. Platform decisions are made collaboratively as a team, with this role carrying individual accountability for specific workstreams and initiatives. **Essential Functions**: * Designs, builds, and maintains scalable ELT pipelines using Fivetran or similar ingestion tools to bring new data sources into the Snowflake environment. * Develops and owns dbt projects, including data models, tests, documentation, and semantic layer definitions. * Contributes to the architecture and maintenance of the Snowflake environment, with individual accountability for areas including database and schema design, role\-based access control (RBAC), virtual warehouse management, cost governance, and performance optimization. * Serves as the team’s lead on Snowflake AI and Cortex features, driving the implementation of LLM\-powered analytics, document intelligence, and AI\-driven workflows in partnership with business stakeholders and teammates. * Partners with business units, compliance, finance, and operations teams to understand data requirements and translate them into documented data models. * Defines and enforces data quality standards through dbt tests, monitoring pipelines, and data observability practices. * Builds and maintains data lineage documentation to ensure transparency and traceability across the data platform. * Evaluates and onboards new data sources, collaborating with source system owners to ensure reliable, timely, and accurate data delivery. * Supports the development of dashboards, self\-service analytics tools, and reporting layers used by business stakeholders across the Bank. * Monitors Snowflake platform releases, dbt updates, and developments in financial services AI/ML to evaluate applicability to the Bank’s environment. * Maintains confidentiality of all sensitive Bank information. * Maintains a positive and caring atmosphere for customers and employees consistent with Southside Bank’s mission, CORE Values, and Blue Book culture guide. * Provides enthusiastic, professional, and courteous service to Southside Bank customers and employees. * Participates in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals. * Understands and agrees to abide by the policies and procedures established at Southside Bank. * Responsible for complying with audit policies and procedures as they pertain to this position. * Performs duties in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and related anti\-money laundering laws, and in accordance with the Bank’s Information Security Program. * Must comply with all applicable laws and regulations. **Additional Functions:** * Provides leadership to others through example and sharing of knowledge/skill. * Complies with all safety policies, practices, and procedures. Report all unsafe activities to supervisor and/or Human Resources. * Performs additional duties, as assigned or directed. **Required Education/Experience**: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent work experience considered. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related data role; 8\+ years preferred. * 3\+ years of hands\-on, production\-level Snowflake experience required; SnowPro Core or Advanced certification is a strong plus. * Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dbt projects in a production environment, including models, tests, macros, and documentation. * Experience with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, or comparable ELT platforms. * Experience in banking, financial services, or a similarly regulated industry preferred. **Necessary Skills**: * Deep expertise in Snowflake, including virtual warehouses, Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, RBAC, clustering, and cost optimization. * Advanced SQL skills and strong proficiency in dbt (data build tool), including Jinja templating, materializations, and incremental models. * Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex and AI/ML features, including LLM functions, document AI, and Snowpark. * Experience with Python for data engineering tasks, including Snowpark Python preferred. * Working knowledge of data modeling concepts including dimensional modeling (Kimball), Data Vault, and medallion architecture. * Experience integrating and working with financial data systems (core banking, loan origination, general ledger, ACH, wire) is a plus. * Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and data lineage best practices. * Working knowledge of model risk management (MRM) principles, including model validation, documentation, and governance requirements applicable to financial institutions. * Familiarity with data privacy principles and requirements applicable to financial institutions, including internal data classification and handling standards. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical business stakeholders. * Ability to work independently and take ownership of specific domains and initiatives within a small, collaborative team environment. * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, regulated environment with evolving business priorities. * Able to develop and sustain sound working relationships and credibility at all levels within the organization. * Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. **Physical Activity/Dexterity:** * Manual dexterity sufficient to reach/handle items and work with fingers. Works with fingers and perceives attributes of objects and materials. **Physical Environment Demands:** * Must be able to remain in a stationary position 90% of the time. * The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to visit other offices, conference rooms, office machinery, etc. * Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and telephone. * Constantly positions self to operate on a computer. * The person in this position frequently communicates with other people throughout each day. Must be able to exchange accurate information when conversing. **Work Schedule/Hours:** * Monday through Friday; 8:00am – 5:00pm. * On call for planned after\-hours deployments, system changes, and critical project support, as needed. * Available for overtime, as needed. **Travel:** * Minimal overnight travel (up to 10%) by land and/or air. **Southside Bank uses E\-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees.** **Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities** The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c)

jobs.title: Software Developer III
jobs.description: At **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)**, our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people\-first philosophy. **This position is a 6 month contract\-to\-hire.** **As a Software Developer III**, you will be responsible for the designs, codes, and develops new financial applications or web based systems and/or modifies existing core financial application systems and web based systems. **Why Join SCCU?** * **Member\-Focused Mission**: Be part of a not\-for\-profit organization that reinvests in its members. * **Flexible Schedule Options** * **Career Growth**: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on\-the\-job training. **Software Developer III Key Responsibilities** * Responds to end user trouble calls to resolve routine application software problems or assist with hardware issues remotely when possible. Routes calls as needs for more non\-routine questions. Track tickets in an incident management system to properly identify problem and resolution for a shared knowledge base or escalate and assign as needed for higher level support. * Designs, develops, tests, and integrates moderately complex internal and external core and web applications, services, and sites, including maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting in order to fulfill business needs. Assists in determining cost and schedule of various software projects using current and proven software engineering * Provides tier III technical support for staff on internal and external core and web applications and systems. * Confers with vendors, other IT team members, users, and department managers to determine requirements for new or modified software and hardware. Tests new hardware and software configurations for usability and proper function, including cross\-browser functional capability. Develops web security safeguards and technologies. Consistently meets assigned project deadlines and goals. * Reviews, analyzes, and modifies the application systems including encoding, testing, debugging, and documentation. Analyzes and resolves problems associated with application systems. Detects, diagnoses, and reports related problems. * Uses AI to analyze requirements, identify questions and gaps, explore implementation approaches, generate or refactor code, explain existing code, and assist with troubleshooting. * Creates effective prompts and context that clearly communicate the objective, application and business context, technical requirements, constraints, coding standards, acceptance criteria, existing patterns, examples, and expected output format. * Uses iterative prompting and context refinement rather than relying on a single AI response. * Uses AI, where appropriate, to create or improve unit tests, test scenarios, edge cases, negative tests, documentation, code\-review summaries, implementation punch lists/checklists, deployment instructions, release notes, troubleshooting guidance, and knowledge articles. * Uses AI to help identify security concerns, inappropriate dependencies, error\-handling gaps, maintainability issues, missing tests, technical debt, and potential performance concerns. * Validates AI\-generated code and content before use. The developer remains responsible for ensuring generated output is correct, secure, maintainable, properly tested, and aligned with organizational standards. **Software Developer III Requirements** 5 to 8 years prior experience with software analysis, design, development, testing, debugging, integration, deployment, support and documentation of core and web based systems following the software development lifecycle, or combination of applicable experience, education, and training which provides the knowledge and skills needed to perform job duties. Front\-end Developer skills: Front\-end web development, React, JavaScript, CSS, JQuery, SASS, Bootstrap, and WCMS platforms. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Systems (Go)
jobs.description: Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi\-stage work reliably and at scale. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on a challenging class of problems: long\-running AI workflows that call models, tools, and external APIs; maintain state across extended executions; produce structured content and generated media; interact with human reviewers; recover from partial failures; and consistently deliver accurate results to users. The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non\-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress. The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed\-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM\-backed applications, AI agents, or agent\-based systems in production**. You will join at a stage where significant architecture remains to be designed and built. Engineers in this role will have substantial ownership over the patterns, services, infrastructure, and engineering standards that shape the University's AI systems. **Remote Work Eligibility** This position is eligible for remote work for candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees. Eligible states currently include: **Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.** Candidates must reside in an eligible state at the time of employment. Remote\-work eligibility is subject to University employment requirements and may change based on applicable state requirements. ### **Engineering Environment** The engineering problems addressed by this team include: * **Durable workflow orchestration:** Long\-running, multi\-stage pipelines using persistent state, job queues, checkpoints, resumability, idempotent execution, and recovery from interrupted or orphaned work. * **Multi\-provider model infrastructure:** Routing across commercial model providers with model registries, token and cost controls, rate\-limit handling, retries, circuit breakers, health monitoring, and provider failover. * **Agent and tool orchestration:** Systems in which AI agents interact with tools, APIs, data sources, application services, and deterministic business logic to complete multi\-step work. * **Prompt engineering infrastructure:** Treating prompts as version\-controlled production artifacts with review, testing, regression protection, and measurable behavior. * **Testing non\-deterministic systems:** Recorded and replayable provider interactions, deterministic fixtures, evaluation harnesses, baselines, and regression testing for AI behavior. * **Correctness and quality controls:** Structured\-output validation, automated evaluation, domain\-specific requirements, evidence checking, and safeguards against confident but incorrect model output. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows:** Review and approval stages within automated processes, including systems capable of safely responding when users modify state or inputs during execution. * **Generated media pipelines:** Systems capable of producing and managing documents, audio, imagery, video, and other generated assets. * **Production service architecture:** Go\-based APIs and backend services, relational data stores, job infrastructure, observability, and integrations supporting user\-facing applications. * **Secure ingestion:** Processing user\-supplied and potentially untrusted documents while maintaining appropriate security and authorization boundaries. ### **Two Engineering Emphases** Engineers will meet the same overall technical bar but may bring deeper expertise in one of two areas: ### **Platform and Pipeline** Focused on distributed systems, workflow orchestration, durable state, job queues, recovery, provider infrastructure, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. This emphasis is particularly well suited for experienced systems engineers who view AI models as powerful components that introduce a new set of distributed\-systems and reliability challenges. ### **Agents and Quality** Focused on agent and tool architecture, prompt systems, context management, evaluation frameworks, regression testing, judge models, evidence validation, and end\-to\-end output quality. This emphasis is particularly well suited for engineers who approach AI behavior through experimentation, measurement, testing, and systematic improvement. Candidates may indicate an area of preference; however, specialization in one area is not required. ### **Essential Functions** * Design, develop, test, deploy, an cation, experience, and qualifications and internal equity ### **Conditions of Employment:** * A job\-related assessment may be required during the interview process. * Must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and be physically present in the office (unless otherwise noted). * **Employment Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Stanbridge University does not provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship or participate in employer\-sponsored or employer\-dependent work authorization programs. * **Sponsorship:** Sponsorship now or in the future could include having Stanbridge University sponsor, complete employer documentation, provide attestations or training plans, or otherwise participate in a work\-authorization or employment\-based immigration program in order for an individual to begin or continue employment. Stanbridge University does not provide any such sponsorship. * Employment verification will be conducted to validate work experience per accreditation standards. * Offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. * Official transcripts are required prior to hire. Degrees earned outside the United States must be evaluated by a recognized credential evaluation service to determine U.S. degree equivalency and applicable subject\-area coursework. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. ### **Work Environment** * Standard professional and technology\-focused work environment. * Duties are typically performed while sitting at a desk or computer workstation. * Position requires extensive interaction with computers, software development environments, cloud services, AI systems, and technical infrastructure. * Subject to collaboration with cross\-functional teams, changing technical requirements, and demanding project timelines. ### **Physical Demands** * Regularly sits for extended periods. * Physical ability to perform department\-related duties. * Proficient in using electronic keyboards and office equipment. * Effective verbal communication via phone, video conferencing, and in person. * Ability to read fine print, operate computers, and understand voices clearly. * Able to lift, carry, and/or move objects weighing 10–25 pounds as needed. ### **Employee Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k) * Exciting university events * Seasonal motivational health and wellness challenges * Work/Life Balance initiatives * Onsite wellness program / Staff Chiropractor * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) ### **Institutional Values** **Diversity and Inclusion** Stanbridge University’s motto, “Strength through Diversity,” reflects our deep commitment to honoring the diverse backgrounds of our students, faculty, staff, and surrounding communities. We strive to build an inclusive learning environment and uphold anti\-discrimination practices in all aspects of university life. **Innovation and Technology** We embrace cutting\-edge technology to enhance student learning through interactive, hands\-on experiences, including virtual reality and simulation labs—ensuring students are prepared for the demands of modern healthcare practice. **Community Engagement** Through initiatives such as Stanbridge outREACH, students are empowered to give back to local and global communities, cultivating compassion, civic responsibility, and social awareness. ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** Stanbridge University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Controls Programmer – C#/.NET
jobs.description: Description: **Bring Your Software Expertise to Steven Douglas Corp. (SDC)** At **SDC**, we design, engineer, and build custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges for customers across medical, consumer products, industrial, automotive, and other industries. As a family\-owned and growing business, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions by blending proven engineering principles with creative approaches to automation. We are looking for a Controls Programmer who combines strong C\#/.NET development skills with a hands\-on understanding of industrial hardware. In this role, you will work primarily on advanced test and process equipment we build for one of our key customers in the solar manufacturing industry. Most of these systems are PC\-controlled, meaning the application you build is the sole controller, directly driving sensors, motors, drives, and data acquisition hardware in real time. We are looking for team players who enjoy working side by side with our controls engineers and technicians to design, build, and deploy software that keeps this equipment running reliably. **Why Join SDC?** * **Software That Runs Real Machines:** Your applications won’t sit on top of the equipment; they’ll be the controller, running machines on the plant floor and through months\-long tests. * **Collaborative Environment:** Work closely with our controls engineers, technicians, and project managers from design through debug, runoff, and customer startup. * **Family\-Owned Culture:** Experience a supportive and agile environment that values technical excellence and personal growth. **What You’ll Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy C\# Windows applications that run on industrial machinery and interface directly with sensors, motors, drives, data acquisition devices, and other controls hardware. * Build and support applications where the PC serves as the primary controller in the system, managing real\-time I/O and device communication. * Work directly with controls engineers to understand machine behavior, hardware interfaces, and operator workflows, and translate them into clean, maintainable software. * Support deployment and troubleshooting of your applications during machine debug, runoff, and customer Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). * Maintain and improve existing software tools and code libraries, applying good source control and documentation practices. * Collaborate with the controls team to identify where custom software can improve machine reliability, data visibility, or troubleshooting speed. * Travel approximately 10% to support customer startups and project implementation. Requirements: **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying C\# Windows applications in a .NET environment. * Hands\-on experience developing applications that interface directly with industrial hardware, such as sensors, motors, drives, data acquisition devices, or instrumentation, on machinery or manufacturing/test equipment. * Experience building applications where the PC is the primary controller in the system, handling real\-time I/O, device communication, and control logic. * Solid understanding of software fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, application architecture, debugging, and version control workflows. * Comfortable working on the plant floor alongside engineers and technicians to understand machine behavior and translate it into usable software. * Ability to use AI tools and code generation to work more efficiently while maintaining full responsibility for all output. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with SQL or other databases for storing and retrieving machine or process data. * Experience with GitHub or other source control platforms. * Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data processing, or test automation. * Experience with other industrial controls platforms, such as Allen\-Bradley PLCs, HMIs, Ignition, robotics, or machine vision systems. * Ability to read and understand electrical schematics. **What Success Looks Like** * Successful Electrical Controls Programmers at SDC: * Deliver reliable, well\-structured Windows applications that operators and engineers can use every day. * Build software that communicates cleanly and reliably with the sensors, motors, and hardware it controls. * Develop software capable of running months\-long tests without interruption. * Communicate clearly with engineers, technicians, and project teams about what the software does and why. * Continuously improve our code libraries, tools, and development practices. * Help make every machine's software as solid as the hardware it runs on. **What We Expect From Everyone at SDC** * Every role at SDC is built on a shared set of expectations that define how we work together. * Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and accountability in everything you do. * Treat coworkers, customers, suppliers, and partners with respect. * Communicate openly and collaboratively across all departments. * Take ownership by identifying issues early, proposing solutions, and following through. * Adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a positive, team\-first attitude. * Produce high\-quality, detail\-oriented work that supports safety, quality, and continuous improvement. * Be dependable, willing to learn, and ready to support teammates whenever needed. * Contribute to a workplace built on trust, teamwork, and shared success. **Why Join Steven Douglas Corp.?** * Work on challenging, custom automation projects—not repetitive production support. * Collaborate with an experienced team of engineers, machinists, electricians, assemblers, and project managers. * See your designs come to life from concept through customer startup. * Help shape engineering standards and influence how future machines are built. * Grow your technical skills while working with robotics, vision systems, servo motion, AI\-enabled inspection, and advanced automation technologies. * Join a stable, family\-owned company committed to long\-term growth, innovation, and investing in its people. **Benefits** * Competitive salary based on experience. * Performance\-based incentive opportunities. * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, with supplemental coverage options. * Company\-sponsored Health Savings Account (HSA). * Employee Assistance Program (EAP). * 401(k) with a 4% employer match per pay period. * Paid vacation, sick leave, and 10 company\-paid holidays. * Ongoing opportunities for professional development and career growth.

jobs.title: Vice President, Information Security
jobs.description: **Full\-time \| Washington D.C. \| Reports to the Chief Technology Officer \| Travel: 10%** ### **Protect the data that proves what works for learners** Non\-degree credentials are changing how people move from learning to earning, but growth has outpaced clarity. Outcomes data is scattered, which makes it nearly impossible to tell real impact from activity. CredLens exists to fix that. Launched in 2024 with support from Strada Education Foundation, CredLens is a nonprofit national data trust. We connect issuer\-verified credential records to real\-world employment, earnings, and education outcomes. Partners use that evidence to improve programs, guide investment, and build stronger career pathways for learners. Trust is the product. Every client relationship is governed by a Data Contributor and Use Agreement (DCUA), and its terms are enforced in software. As a national data trust, we have to show, not just say, that every piece of processing follows those agreements and that we’re protecting the data entrusted to us. **You won't be starting from scratch.** The program is already mature: two full SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 and ISO 27018 certification since 2025, TX\-RAMP Level 2 certification, and a recent independent Privacy Impact Assessment that highlighted the program's maturity. **This is an operator and scaler role.** Reporting to the CTO and supported by the VP, Legal and Data Protection who’s also our Chief Privacy Officer, you'll run the day\-to\-day program and lead a small core team extended by specialist firms and an independent Technology and Security Advisory Board. You'll directly support the Cyber Governance Committee and the CredLens Board. CredLens is moving from early traction to broad adoption across issuers, state agencies, and higher education. Your job is to make security speed up customer due diligence, not slow it down. If you want to run a high\-integrity security program, shape privacy\-enhancing technology strategy at national scale, and do it in service of a mission that matters, we'd like to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ *Approximate time allocation for the first 12–18 months* **Run Security Operations, Compliance, and Controls Assurance (\~30%)** Keep a certified program disciplined, measurable, and audit\-ready. You will: * Run the information security management system day to day: continuous control monitoring, vulnerability management with remediation to target timeframes, quarterly access reviews, external\-transfer approvals, vendor assessments, policy upkeep, and security and data\-handling training. * Maintain SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27018, and TX\-RAMP without major findings, and manage auditor, penetration\-test, internal\-audit, and privacy\-assessment relationships and the annual re\-test calendar. * Serve as incident commander: own the incident response plan, run annual technical and executive tabletop and DR/BC exercises, meet notification commitments with Legal, and drive corrective actions to closure. * Oversee cloud security posture across AWS and Snowflake, including the PII enclave, account separation, identity and access controls, logging, and backup integrity. **Lead Privacy\-Enhancing Technologies and Data\-Layer Privacy Strategy (\~25%)** Define how a national data trust protects sensitive data at the data layer itself. You will: * Set the multi\-year strategy for privacy\-enhancing technologies (PETs) across the platform and data\-partner ecosystem, including tokenization, privacy\-preserving record linkage, and encryption of sensitive fields, in line with established industry standards. * Partner with the CTO on roadmap prioritization and with the VP, Legal and Data Protection on the partner agreements and pilots that adoption depends on; engage the Technology and Security Advisory Board on method selection. * Advance the data\-minimization principles set by the Cyber Governance Committee: hold the least data, in the least exposed form, for the least time. * Extend independent assurance to privacy, building on the Privacy Impact Assessment and SOC 2 program. **Make Security a Growth Engine for Customers, Partners, and the Market (\~15%)** Turn a strong program into faster, more confident buying decisions. You will: * Own the Trust Center, HECVAT and questionnaire responses, and customer security reviews so security speeds the sales cycle as the client base grows. * Manage data\-partner security relationships and third\-party risk across data brokers, matching partners, and the IRS intermediary, and review partner interfaces and transfer controls. * Lead a NIST 800\-53 gap assessment and GovRAMP/StateRAMP readiness, and pursue certification when Sales validates demand. * Support DCUA onboarding so security and privacy requirements are built into every new agreement. **Drive Governance, Risk, and Board Reporting (\~15%)** Give leadership and the Board a clear view of risk and progress. You will: * Prepare and present the quarter  **Commercial awareness:** You treat security assurance as a growth enabler and match investment to validated market demand. * **Sound judgment:** You make good calls on risk acceptance, escalation, and disruptive containment decisions. * **Comfort with ambiguity:** You thrive at the pace of an organization in a high\-growth phase. ### **Why CredLens** CredLens is a nonprofit national data trust built to answer one of the biggest open questions in education and workforce development: which non\-degree credentials actually lead to better jobs, earnings, and further education? By connecting issuer\-verified credential records to real\-world outcomes, we give issuers, state agencies, higher education, and investors evidence they can trust, so learners can make better choices and programs can get better. We were launched with support from Strada Education Foundation, a national nonprofit focused on strengthening the connections between education and employment, especially for people who have faced the greatest barriers to economic opportunity. At CredLens, you'll have the focus and pace of a growth\-stage organization, backed by a mission\-driven parent. You'll own a mature, certified program at a pivotal moment, work closely with senior leadership and the Board, and help set the standard for how outcomes data is protected nationwide. ### **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Generous PTO and paid holidays * 401(k) retirement plan with employer contributions * Paid parental leave * Wellness reimbursement * Professional development resources *The pay range listed is based on national compensation benchmark data and may vary depending on skills, experience, job\-related knowledge, variations in cost of labor, and, in some cases, geographic location. The exact job offer will be determined based on several factors, such as the candidate's individual skills, qualifications and experience relative to the requirements of the role. jobs.title: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Controls Engineer
jobs.description: The Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Controls Engineer is responsible for designing, improving, and supporting control systems for RNG production facilities, with a practical focus on reliable plant operation. This role combines home\-office engineering, field troubleshooting, commissioning support, and ongoing optimization of instrumentation, PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems. The Controls Engineer works closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, OEM suppliers, and environmental teams to improve gas quality, plant uptime, process safety, and regulatory compliance across operating anaerobic digestion facilities. **This is a Remote position with** **travel required****25\-50%** **to our on operations facilities as needed.** **Responsibilities** **Controls \& Automation** * Design, program, and maintain PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems for RNG plant operations. * Develop and optimize control strategies for feedstock receiving systems, gas upgrading systems, compression systems, flare systems, digesters, and utility systems. * Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols including Modbus, Ethernet/IP, Profibus, and OPC. * Develop and maintain controls standards, preferred hardware configurations, programming practices, network architecture, and documentation templates that can be applied consistently across multiple RNG facilities while still allowing site\-specific adaptation. * Support design, procurement, installation, commissioning and startup of new equipment and plant expansions. * Implement alarm management and process interlocks to improve plant safety and reliability. * Review control system deliverables from OEMs, system integrators, and engineering contractors, including control narratives, cause\-and\-effect logic, loop diagrams, I/O lists, network drawings, panel drawings, factory acceptance test procedures, and commissioning documentation. **Instrumentation \& Electrical Systems** * Specify, install, calibrate, and maintain process instrumentation including pressure, flow, temperature, methane analyzers, H₂S analyzers, and moisture analyzers. * Troubleshoot control valves, VFDs, motors, analyzers, and field devices. * Review and maintain P\&IDs, control narratives, electrical one\-lines, and instrument loop drawings. * Support electrical systems up to medium voltage where applicable. **Process Optimization** * Analyze plant performance data to improve methane recovery, gas quality, and system efficiency. * Develop and monitor KPIs and performance dashboards for operational improvement. * Optimize digester gas handling, upgrading systems, and pipeline injection controls. * Support root cause analysis for process upsets and downtime events. **Compliance \& Safety** * Ensure plant control systems are designed, configured, documented, and maintained in accordance with applicable OSHA, NEC, NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, ISA, EPA, and local regulatory requirements. * Support environmental reporting and emissions compliance through data collection systems. * Participate in Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), Management of Change (MOC), and HAZOP reviews. * Prepare or review controls\-related Management of Change documentation for software revisions, setpoint changes, interlock modifications, alarm changes, instrument replacements, and control strategy updates that affect plant operation or safety. * Maintain appropriate industrial control system cybersecurity practices, including user access control, network segmentation, backup and recovery practices, vendor remote access controls, and coordination with corporate information technology standards. **Maintenance \& Reliability** * Develop preventative maintenance plans for controls and instrumentation systems. * Lead troubleshooting efforts during unplanned outages. * Provide remote and on\-site troubleshooting support for operating facilities, including review of trend data, alarm history, equipment status, analyzer readings, and operator feedback to diagnose controls\-related causes of downtime or unstable operation. * Support spare parts inventory management for critical controls components. * Coordinate with OEM $145,000 \- $160,000 annually (dependent on experience and geographical location) Why join the Suburban Propane team? For eligibility and a full list of our benefit offerings please visit: https://jobs.suburbanpropane.com/benefits/. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor  data trends. * Willingness to travel regularly to operating RNG facilities and project sites, with additional travel during commissioning, startup, outages, troubleshooting events, or major controls upgrades. * Willingness to respond to emergencies remotely on a 24/7 basis. **Preferred** * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Experience in renewable natural gas, anaerobic digestion, landfill gas, wastewater treatment, waste\-to\-energy, refining, petrochemical processing, chemical manufacturing, midstream gas, or other process industries involving complex rotating equipment, analyzers, utilities, safety systems, and continuous operations. * Knowledge of membrane separation, PSA systems, amine systems, or cryogenic gas upgrading. * Experience with pipeline injection and gas quality compliance. * ISA Certified Automation Professional (CAP) certification. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives. **Lead AI Engineer** **The details** * Location: Sweet James Headquarters (Newport Beach, CA), on\-site * Team: Technology * Reports to: Chief Technology Officer * Compensation: $200,000 to $250,000 base salary, depending on experience **The role** Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI\-forward experience for every client\-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in\-house, and you will be one of the people building them. Sweet James is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to own the direction, standards, and health of the AI platform and to lead the engineers who build it. This is a player\-coach seat for a staff\-level engineer ready to manage: You will set the architecture, turn the roadmap into a build plan the team can execute, and remain hands\-on in the code. You will report to the Chief Technology Officer and own how the platform is built and run. The distinction from our Senior AI Engineer seat is scope: Senior engineers own features end to end; you own the system they fit into and the people who build it. **Responsibilities** * Direction: Own the architecture of the AI platform (e.g., document intake and filing, fact extraction, case search, the internal assistant and its agents, voice agents) and review every major design before it is built. The roadmap is set by the Chief Technology Officer and product leadership; you decide how it gets built. * Standards: Define how the team ships, including code review, testing, and the evaluation sets every AI feature must clear before release. * Platform health: Own uptime, monitoring, incident response, and access controls across the platform, and ensure no system depends on one person. * People and capacity: Allocate the team's capacity against the priorities the Chief Technology Officer sets, make the trade\-offs when demand exceeds it, and coach, review, and hire the engineers who carry the work. * Delivery: Ship production code yourself every week. * Business partnership: Decide with attorneys, case managers, and operations leaders which work is worth automating next, and report results in hours returned, error rates, and adoption. * Data governance: Set the rules for least\-privilege access, audit trails, and which client and medical data may reach which model. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Experience: 8\+ years building production software, with a track record as the technical lead on systems other engineers depended on. * Leadership: Mentoring, design review, and ownership of a team's output; formal people management is welcome but not required. * LLM craft: Systems shipped to real users spanning prompt and tool design, retrieval, structured extraction, evaluation, and cost and latency tuning. * Stack: Strong Python and TypeScript/Node, production SQL in Postgres, Docker, containerized cloud services (Azure preferred), CI/CD, and monitoring. * Operations: Ownership of uptime, including on\-call, incident reviews, and rollbacks. * Communication: Clear design docs, runbooks, and plain\-language explanations for non\-engineers. **Preferred:** * Models and tooling: Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs at production scale; agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol; vector search (e.g., pgvector); self\-hosted or open\-weight models (e.g., vLLM, Baseten). * Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n. * Salesforce: The data model and APIs; Litify a plus. * Voice: Voice AI and telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Industry: Legal, insurance, or healthcare. jobs.title: Wireless Algorithms Engineer (MAC Layer Scheduling)
jobs.description: **Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology** At **Tarana**, we're more than just a fast\-growing tech company—we’re a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering **fiber\-class internet speeds** worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible. We are looking for engineers we can grow into this role. You do not need wireless experience. What matters is that you learn quickly, think deeply, and are excited by problems where the answer is not already known. You will be working on the MAC scheduler, the software that decides, thousands of times per second, how spectrum and antenna resources are allocated among users on a sector. It is a hard problem, and it's still evolving. You will work with engineers designing the algorithms running in our product today. You will start by fixing real bugs in production code, which is the fastest way to learn a system of this scale, and you will own a sub\-component. Later, we expect you to propose algorithmic changes that directly affect the performance of our deployed network. This is an opportunity to go from learning an unfamiliar system to shaping the algorithms at its core. **What You’ll Do:** * Learn wireless from the ground up: how signals propagate, why interference happens, what a scheduler is actually optimizing * Read a lot of code written by people who thought hard about it, and get your own code reviewed by them * Debug problems on real hardware, where the answer is often not in the software * Work with field telemetry from a live network and learn to find signal in it * Build simulations to test whether an idea works before anyone commits to building it **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and the mathematics underneath them: probability, linear algebra, and enough comfort with proofs to reason about why something works * You can already program well. C\+\+ or C preferred, but if you are strong in another language and have written performance\-sensitive code, we will take that seriously * Evidence that you build things because you want to, not because they were assigned. A project you took further than the class required, something you wrote to solve your own problem, a system you built and kept improving * The ability to explain your reasoning clearly, including the parts you are unsure about **What Would Make You Stand Out** * Wireless or communications coursework, including signal processing or information theory. * Optimization, control theory, or applied machine learning. * Embedded or systems programming, or experience where performance and memory constraints mattered. **What we offer:** **We don’t just build next\-gen wireless technology — we build people.** The salary range for this position is: $90,000 to $120,000 Compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location. Tarana provides competitive benefits to employees in this role, including medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401K match, flexible time off, and stock options. **Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity.** **About Us** Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R\&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game\-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com. P7cUsmpBPr
