jobs.title: TechOps Network Administrator/Engineer
jobs.description: **ROLE OVERVIEW** The Network Engineer supports the technology systems that keep our business operating at the Central Support Office and across more than 50 apartment communities. Networking is the primary focus, but this is not a narrow technical role. The right person must be willing to troubleshoot, learn, travel, and help solve technology problems wherever they exist. We are hiring for culture first and skillset second. The ideal candidate has a genuine passion for technology, strong work ethic, curiosity, and the desire to become a better professional. Technical skills matter, but ownership, dependability, communication, and willingness to learn are what will determine long\-term success. **WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** This role is built for someone who enjoys solving problems and wants more than a basic support job. We are especially interested in candidates who have spent 1\-2 years in a Managed Service Provider environment, have been exposed to many different technologies, and feel ready for a bigger challenge. The best fit is a jack\-of\-all\-trades technology professional who is hungry, dependable, and willing to work hard to grow. They do not need to know everything on day one, but they must be curious, accountable, and comfortable figuring things out. **CORE EXPECTATIONS*** Passion for technology and continuous learning. * Strong troubleshooting mindset and willingness to dig into problems. * Dependable, punctual, and accountable in a high\-expectation environment. * Comfortable supporting both corporate office needs and property\-level technology needs. * Willing to travel to communities and company locations approximately 2\-4 days per month. * Able to communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical associates. * Willing to help outside a narrow job description when the business needs it. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** The Network Engineer helps maintain reliable internet, wireless, firewall, and network connectivity across the organization. This includes troubleshooting outages, improving reliability, supporting new projects, working with vendors, documenting standards, and helping prevent repeat issues. The role also supports broader technology infrastructure when needed. A candidate with MSP experience is attractive because they are often used to moving quickly, handling different systems, supporting different users, and solving unfamiliar problems without needing perfect instructions. **PREFERRED BACKGROUND*** 1\-2 years of Managed Service Provider experience strongly encouraged. * Exposure to networking, wireless systems, firewalls, end\-user support, vendors, and business technology systems. * Experience supporting multiple locations, customers, departments, or technology environments. * Comfortable learning new systems and becoming more valuable over time.

jobs.title: Open-Rank Professor, Engineering
jobs.description: The University of Austin (UATX) educates citizens and leaders capable of assuring national prosperity and the success of constitutional liberty. We seek talented, energetic, and productive individuals to help us develop America’s newest university into an inspiring model of best practices in student formation. Ideal candidates will be passionate about teaching, eager to innovate, and committed to reforming higher education. The Center for Sciences at UATX invites applications for positions in Engineering, open to candidates at any academic rank. **Student Development** We teach small classes of talented and motivated students, accustomed to high expectations and rigorous standards. Annual teaching loads are typically 18 quarter hours, and include courses across all class levels. We teach in our area of specialty for upper division courses, but can and do teach more broadly across areas related to ours in the lower division. **External Impact through** **Research and Creative Work** UATX research respects a broader standard than many institutions and ranges from traditional journal and conference publications to outward\-facing work with startups and larger firms. Research is evaluated on intellectual significance and on practical, constructive impact on the human condition. **Building and Sustaining the Institution** UATX is both a university and a startup, so service is light on bureaucracy and long on innovation and initiative. Faculty are involved in designing and building a creative improvement to traditional higher education. **Engineering Concentration** The UATX Engineering program comprises an intensive series of courses across engineering disciplines, followed by specialized study in areas of student interest, and a major project of 27 quarter hours. Candidates for faculty must have the following qualifications: * PhD in an engineering discipline. PhD in physics or chemistry will be considered. * Strong teaching ability. * A record of engineering research or advanced work in technology. * Multidisciplinary viewpoint and breadth of interest within the hard sciences. * Ability to mentor students in a variety of engineering\-related projects. **The Center for Sciences** **@ UATX** The Center for Sciences at the University of Austin teaches students to think and reason quantitatively and scientifically, and to creatively apply mathematics, economics, science, and technology to constructive purpose. All UATX students in Sciences concentrations or tracks complete an intense core STEM curriculum, and have opportunities to focus in one or more of mathematics, quantitative economics, computer science, AI, physics or applied engineering. All UATX students also complete a core curriculum, *Intellectual Foundations*, that includes courses on literature, philosophy, history, mathematics, science, and economics, and that prepares Sciences students for leadership in scientific and technological fields. UATX is currently building out its new Applied Engineering Lab in Bastrop, Texas, where students engage in hands\-on learning to design, build, and test complex electromechanical systems. The lab sits next door to The Boring Company's headquarters and across the street from SpaceX's Starlink factory. Bastrop is becoming one of the country's most important centers of advanced manufacturing. Located just 45 minutes from our downtown Austin campus, the lab immerses students directly at the center of this dynamic industrial corridor. **Appointment** Faculty will be appointed at the rank of Assistant, Associate, or full Professor, with an anticipated start date of Fall 2027\. Part\-time appointments will be considered; applicants interested in a part\-time appointment should indicate this preference in their cover letter. Compensation is competitive, commensurate with rank and includes comprehensive benefits and a research stipend. UATX operates on a quarter schedule, with an annual teaching load of 18 quarter hours, equivalent to a 12\-semester\-hour or 2/2 teaching load in a semester system. This structure supports excellence in undergraduate teaching while allowing faculty to maintain substantive research agendas. UATX is committed to building a permanent faculty. Although the University does not operate under a traditional tenure system, faculty positions are long\-term academic appointments, supported by renewable five\-year contracts. This model reflects UATX's commitment to institutional stability as well as high standards, building an enduring community of engaged teachers and active scholars. **Application Materials** Upload a CV and a cover letter via this website. The cover letter should describe a candidate’s interest in the position, their relevant teaching and research experience, and their alignment with the distinctive mission of the University of Austin. Review of applications will begin immediately. Applications submitted by January 4, 2027 will receive priority review. Applicants who are selected for further review may be asked to submit writing samples, a list of references, and/or a teaching portfolio. **University of Austin** **(UATX)** The University of Austin (UATX) is a non\-partisan institution committed to the fearless pursuit of truth and the highest standards of scholarship and pedagogy. The university does not accept federal funding and does not charge its students tuition. Standardized testing is required for admission. The average student scores on standardized tests such as the SAT, ACT, and CLT are in the top 5% nationwide. Seminar\-style teaching is common, and the typical section size is 12 to 20 students. The curriculum at UATX emphasizes the distinctive value of Western civilization and the unique prosperity of American civilization alongside fields such as math, computer science, physics, applied engineering, business, and law. More information can be found on the university website: https://uaustin.org/. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Mid level Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ You will design, build, and operate production\-grade multi\-agent systems for commercial and federal customers. The work spans the LangChain ecosystem, reliable agent loops, advanced retrieval architectures, and ontologies that ground agent reasoning. You will also connect agents to enterprise tools and to each other through MCP and A2A. This role suits an engineer who thinks in systems: how agents reason, retrieve, act, recover from failure, and get evaluated and observed in production. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ Agent development and orchestration * Build single\- and multi\-agent applications with LangChain and LangGraph, including stateful graphs, supervisor/worker and hierarchical patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. * Engineer robust agentic loops (plan, act, observe, reflect) with clear termination conditions, retry and self\-correction logic, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets. * Apply loop engineering to tune iteration depth, tool\-call strategy, memory handling, and state persistence so agents behave predictably. * Use LangSmith for tracing, debugging, prompt and dataset management, and automated evaluation; maintain regression suites for agent behavior. Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Build and optimize Agentic RAG (agent\-driven query planning and iterative retrieval), Adaptive RAG (routing by query complexity), Corrective and Self\-RAG, GraphRAG (knowledge\-graph retrieval and reasoning), and Cache\-Augmented Generation with semantic caching. * Design chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re\-ranking, and query\-rewriting strategies. * Measure retrieval quality with faithfulness, context precision and recall, and answer relevance. Ontologies, context, and skills * Develop domain ontologies and knowledge graphs (OWL/RDF or property\-graph models) that ground agent reasoning and power GraphRAG. * Practice context engineering: decide how instructions, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool results are assembled in the context window. * Build reusable agent skills and tool libraries with clear interfaces, documentation, and versioning. Interoperability protocols * Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients that expose enterprise data, APIs, and tools to agents securely. * Implement Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) patterns for agent discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation, and cross\-vendor communication. Engineering and delivery * Write production\-quality Python (TypeScript optional) with tests, CI/CD, and secure coding practices. * Take agents from prototype to production with product, data, and platform teams. * Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and internal standards for agentic systems. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10 years of software engineering, with at least 4 years building LLM\-powered applications. * Hands\-on production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. * Demonstrated experience designing agentic loops, tool calling, memory, and multi\-agent orchestration. * Practical experience implementing several RAG variants (Agentic, Adaptive, GraphRAG, Cache RAG/CAG) and evaluating their quality. * Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs and applying them to retrieval or reasoning. * Strong context engineering and prompt design for complex agent workflows. * Experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and working knowledge of the A2A protocol. * Proficiency in Python, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous programming. * Solid grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, context limits) and their mitigations. Trillion is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to race, religion, gender, native origin, age, disability, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Sr Security Technologist - Governance, Risk, and Compliance
jobs.description: **About the Role** Uber's Tech Risk and Assurance team, part of Engineering Security, helps Uber understand its cybersecurity risk, decide what to do about it, and prove that controls work. Our goal is to make every experience with Uber simple, secure, and safe for riders, eaters, drivers, and partners. As a Senior Security Technologist, GRC, you will run key parts of Uber's cyber risk management program: risk intake and assessment, risk treatment and acceptance decisions, and the reporting leaders use to see where risk sits and what has been decided. You will partner with engineering, security, audit, privacy, and compliance teams to turn control gaps, threat context, and regulatory requirements into treatment plans that engineering teams can execute, and follow those plans through to closure. This role combines risk judgment with hands\-on technical skill. You will be comfortable reading architecture and design documents, querying data, and building automation on GRC platforms and workflow tools so that risk processes scale without adding manual work. You will work within program goals set with senior leadership and own the design and delivery of the components assigned to you. **What You'll Do** * Own cyber risk intake, triage, and prioritization for your program area, so that each risk has a clear owner, a well\-formed risk statement, and a timely treatment decision. * Lead risk assessments, including annual and targeted assessments of systems, applications, and new business areas, and present results with clear recommendations. * Run the risk exception and acceptance workflow. Confirm that requests have the right context, route them to the right approver, track conditions and expiry dates, and escalate decisions that exceed delegated authority or risk tolerance. * Partner with engineering teams to define risk treatment plans, identify sustainable fixes, and drive mitigation to the last mile rather than stopping at documentation. * Contribute to control design reviews and risk decisions that require judgment, stakeholder alignment, and trade\-off management. * Own the roadmap and delivery of one or more components of Uber's risk and compliance tooling. Gather requirements from partner teams, write technical specifications, and work with engineers to ship releases in an Agile delivery model. * Configure and improve workflows on GRC platforms such as ServiceNow eGRC and Jira, including forms, business rules, client scripts, UI actions, and automation rules. * Build automation that removes manual steps from risk workflows using Python, SQL, platform APIs, workflow tools, and approved AI tools. Examples include routing approvals, expiring acceptances, and drafting first\-pass risk summaries for human review. * Load, transform, and reconcile data between GRC platforms and other systems, and perform system and integration testing with sample and live data. * Build and maintain risk reporting for leaders and partner teams, including KRIs, exposure trends, acceptance aging, decision status, and escalation triggers. Design dashboards and reports that support program requirements. * Prepare material for risk governance forums, including decision papers that set out the risk, the options, and a recommendation. * Improve risk workflows through better tooling, clearer operating models, and reusable knowledge assets such as runbooks and templates. * Mentor and onboard analysts and junior team members on risk analysis, risk statement quality, treatment planning, and stakeholder communication. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, risk roles. * Experience running parts of a security risk program end to end, including risk assessments, treatment decisions, and cross\-functional follow\-through. * Strong understanding of security controls and risk treatment, with the technical fluency to work with engineers on implementation details in areas such as identity and access, cloud infrastructure, logging, vulnerability management, and secure configuration. * Hands\-on automation experience, including scripting in Python or a similar language, querying data with SQL, and using APIs or workflow tools to automate a process. * Knowledge of control frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800\-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CIS. * Experience working across multiple stakeholders, handling ambiguity, and driving accountability with limited supervision. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting risk, status, and decision points to director\-level and technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Security or audit certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor. * Hands\-on experience with the ServiceNow e experience in incident response at a large tech company, where scale and complexity were significant factors. * Broad cybersecurity domain knowledge \- including infrastructure security, endpoint security, product security, and data security \- to contextualize incidents within the broader security ecosystem. * Hands\-on scripting and/or coding skills (Python, Go, or similar) to build custom tooling, automate workflows, and/or enhance response capabilities. * Experience utilizing or integrating generative AI/ML technologies to streamline incident detection, triage, and remediation workflows. Role \#3 \- What the Candidate Will Do \- * Conduct rapid response, mitigation, investigations and forensics on highest priority incidents impacting Uber and user data. * Partner with global team members to drive response and investigations globally. * Partner closely with incident commanders, leading incident investigations. * Produce concise yet thorough case reports for internal and external stakeholders. * Lead automation projects and develop automation to improve the consistency and efficiency of incident response leveraging GenAI. * Lead projects/initiatives to help mature the incident response program and reduce cybersecurity risk at Uber and Uber’s subsidiaries. * Support and mentor others on automation development. \- Basic Qualifications \- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related field * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience on a security engineering team * Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Python or Go * Strong foundation in security principles. * Cybersecurity knowledge across multiple domains such as network, hosts, applications, data, cloud etc. * Familiarity with common threat actor attack patterns and TTPs. * Strong problem\-solving skills. \- Preferred Qualifications \- * Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field * Experience with cybersecurity forensic methodologies and software. * Experience driving complex incidents or leading large investigations end\-to\-end. * Experience with building automations for incident response. * Experience leading large\-scale threat hunts. * Applied knowledge of cyber intel frameworks such as ATT\&CK framework and kill\-chain model. * Experience working crisis events for a global company. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Advertiser Growth
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- Unity's Advertiser Growth team leverages artificial intelligence and statistical optimization to maximize returns and reduce effort for advertisers running campaigns on the Unity ad network. Our ads reach billions of devices, and every improvement we ship directly moves outcomes for thousands of advertisers worldwide. We are looking for a senior Machine Learning engineer to lead the design of the optimization algorithms at the heart of this mission. In this role, you will be a technical authority on how we automate campaign optimization: how bids, budgets, and targeting decisions are made to serve each advertiser's goals with minimal manual effort. You will bridge advanced quantitative methodology and large\-scale engineering, working where multi\-objective optimization, exploration\-exploitation trade\-offs, long\-term value measurement, and LLM\-powered agentic systems meet real\-time production systems. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * Multi\-objective campaign optimization: Design and ship algorithms that optimize across a variety of advertiser goals \- installs, ROAS, retention, and spend efficiency \- under real\-world budget and marketplace constraints. * Exploration–exploitation strategy: Design strategies (e.g., bandits, reinforcement learning) that balance short\-term performance against long\-term value, so campaigns learn efficiently without sacrificing advertiser returns. * Long\-term impact measurement: Develop efficient methodologies to measure the long\-term impact of model and product changes, including surrogate metrics that give short\-term signals for long\-term advertiser and user value. * Metrics frameworks for launch decisions: Define the metrics frameworks that guide what we ship \- clear, trustworthy criteria that connect model improvements to advertiser outcomes and business results. * Agentic automation for advertisers: Build LLM agent systems that automate campaign diagnostics and setup recommendations \- agents that analyze campaign performance, identify root causes and recommend or apply configuration changes, so advertisers state their goals and trust the system to deliver. * Cross\-functional technical leadership: Serve as a lead subject matter expert for ML, Product, and Engineering partners, ensuring quantitative rigor from model design through live production auctions. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Experience in machine learning, data science, or applied research, ideally within ad tech, marketplaces, or other large\-scale optimization domains. * Advanced education: An MS or PhD in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or equivalent). * Quantitative depth: The skills to design algorithms that optimize among competing goals, design exploration\-exploitation strategies balancing short\-term and long\-term value, build efficient methodologies for measuring long\-term impact, and define metrics frameworks that guide launch decisions. * Agentic system experience: Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agentic systems \- tool use, orchestration, retrieval over domain data, and evaluation of agent quality \- ideally applied to diagnostics, recommendations, or workflow automation. * Technical proficiency: Strong programming skills in Python or Scala, and experience with large\-scale data processing frameworks such as Spark, Snowflake, or BigQuery. * Production track record: A history of shipping ML systems that operate on high\-volume, real\-time data and delivering measurable business impact. * Strategic leadership: Ability to translate complex quantitative concepts into clear product roadmaps and mentor engineers on modeling and optimization rigor. **You might also have** ----------------------- * Prior experience with dynamic ads or creative optimization. E.g., dynamic creative assembly, creative ranking and selection, or generative creative pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with bidding, pricing, pacing, or auction systems in digital advertising. * Familiarity with long\-term value (LTV) prediction and surrogate metric design in mobile gaming or digital advertising. * Experience with reinforcement learning or contextual bandits in production. * Experience fine\-tuning or evaluating LLMs, or building multi\-agent orchestration frameworks. **Additional information** -------------------------- Annual gross base salary: $148,700 \- $244,600 USD *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program **Life at Unity** Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. jobs.title: Principal Electrochemical Engineer
jobs.description: VVater is America's Next Water Company, delivering the future of purification through its award\-winning Farady Reactor (CES Best of Innovation 2025, World Future Award 2025, Time Best Invention Award 2025\), proprietary ALTEP (Advanced Low Tension Electroporation Process), Advanced Dissolved Air Flotation, and Micro \& Nano Bubble technologies. Unlike outdated chemical, filter, and membrane systems, VVater's electric\-field breakthroughs eliminate PFAS, microplastics, microorganisms, and other contaminants with record retention times, without toxic byproducts or costly consumables. With over 4\.3B gallons treated and validation from global leaders, VVater is scaling into municipal drinking water and wastewater, DPR/IPR, onsite reuse for data centers, commercial buildings, and resorts, residential purification, and consumer health water, delivering a 60% smaller footprint, 40% CapEx savings, 80% OpEx savings, and 40% less energy use. **Job Description:** **THIS IS AN ONSITE POSITION BASED IN AUSTIN, TEXAS \- NO REMOTE OR HYBRID AVAILABILITY FOR THIS POSITION** The Principal Electrochemical Engineer is the technical owner of the electrochemical treatment systems. You will lead the way in how reactors are conceived, modeled, built, tested, and scaled: electrode materials and geometry, cell and stack architecture, hydrodynamics, power delivery, and durability. You will take a reactor from a single bench cell to a field\-deployed, manufacturable module that performs reliably on real water. An electrochemical engineer who works from first principles (thermodynamics, kinetics, mass transport, and current distribution) and who has already carried at least one electrochemical technology out of the lab and into pilot or commercial operation. You will work with process research, electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing teams. VVater moves at a fast pace to accelerate the development and adoption of cutting\-edge technologies in the water industry. The right person will be energized by that pace rather than depleted by it. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design of electrochemical reactors, cells, and stacks: electrode materials and geometry, flow field and hydrodynamics, current and potential distribution, gas management, sealing, and materials of construction * Select, develop, and qualify electrode materials and coatings for activity, selectivity, conductivity, and service life in real water matrices * Diagnose and solve degradation mechanisms, including passivation, scaling, fouling, corrosion, and coating loss, and design reactors * Collaborate with the electrical engineering team to define power delivery and relate electrical operating parameters to electrochemical performance and energy use * Elucidate reaction mechanisms and kinetics for target contaminants and byproducts, and quantify efficiency, selectivity, and specific energy consumption * Apply electroanalytical methods (CV, LSV, EIS, chronoamperometry, chronopotentiometry, rotating disk, and reference\-electrode techniques) to extract kinetic, thermodynamic, and mass\-transport parameters * Build multiphysics and CFD models (e.g., COMSOL, ANSYS) of current distribution, mass transport, bubble\-laden multiphase flow, and heat generation to guide design and scale\-up * Use structured experimental design and data\-driven optimization (DOE, Bayesian and machine\-learning methods) to accelerate development cycles * Scale reactors from bench cells to pilot and commercial modules, defining scale\-up rules and validating performance at each step * Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), field commissioning, and troubleshooting of deployed reactors * Develop SOPs, operating envelopes, and safety protocols for electrochemical systems, including gas evolution, electrical safety, and byproduct management * Pulsed, pulse\-reverse, or AC electrochemical processes, and working knowledge of power electronics and how waveform shapes electrode behavior and electrochemical processes * Commercial scale\-up of electrochemical systems (electrolyzers, flow reactors, electrochemical separation stacks, or similar), including skid integration and field commissioning * Electrode or stack manufacturing, coatings, or design for manufacturability in a production environment * Support the technology roadmap with company leadership, aligned with reuse, industrial, and data center market needs. Generate intellectual property * Mentor engineers and scientists, build out Technology Development laboratory capabilities, and raise the technical bar across the team * Represent VVater technically with customers, partners, universities, and national labs, and at conferences and in publications **Qualifications** * PhD in Chemical/Electrical Engineering, Electrochemistry, Materials Science, or a related field; exceptional candidates with an MS and equivalent depth will be considered * 8\+ years of post\-degree experience in electrochemical engineering, technology development, or applied electrochemical research; doctoral research counts toward this experience * Demonstrated record of designing, building, and scaling electrochemical reactors, cells, or stacks from bench to pilot or commercial scale, including hands\-on testing on real feeds * Deep command of electrochemical engineering fundamentals: thermodynamics, electrode kinetics, mass transport, current and potential distribution, and Faradaic efficiency * Hands\-on expertise with electroanalytical techniques and potentiostat/galvanostat instrumentation * Experience with electrode materials, coatings, and degradation and durability analysis * Proficiency with multiphysics modeling (COMSOL or equivalent) and with Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for data analysis * Hands\-on fluency with modern AI tools (Claude, or equivalents); ability to vibe\-code internal engineering tools, models, and automations * Exceptional written and verbal communication; Research proposal, design specification, and a customer\-facing technical report * Comfort with ambiguity and the judgment to decide what to test next without waiting for direction **Preferred Experience** * Experience in a startup or applied R\&D organization taking first\-of\-kind Echem technology to market * Multiphase flow and bubble management in gas\-evolving electrochemical reactors; CFD * Corrosion science and materials selection for aggressive aqueous environments * Instrumentation, data acquisition (e.g., LabVIEW), and PLC/SCADA integration for test stands and pilot systems * Familiarity with drinking water and reuse requirements that affect electrochemical systems, such as byproduct formation limits and NSF/ANSI 61 materials compliance **\*\***As a part of our process to ensure a comprehensive evaluation of all applicants, assessment tests are required as part of our recruitment process. Unfortunately, should you elect not to participate in completing the assessment tests, your application will not be able to progress to the next stage or will not be taken into consideration during evaluation.

jobs.title: Client Engineer
jobs.description: Varsity, a company under Treeline, is looking for a Client Engineer to handle complex technical issues across both remote and onsite client environments. Based in the Bay area, this is a hybrid role that combines senior\-level remote support work with direct, in\-person client engagement in the field. You will pick up escalations from Specialist I, work through root cause on complex problems, and travel to client sites across the Bay area as needed to deploy technology, resolve issues, and build client relationships in person. Beyond technical depth, this role requires someone who is genuinely at ease with people: able to walk into a client environment, read the room quickly, and communicate clearly and professionally whether you are speaking with an executive or an individual end user. Strong independent judgment, a valid driver's license, and the ability to manage ambiguity in both remote and field settings are all essential. **ABOUT US** Varsity is a technology services company operating as part of Treeline. Treeline is building a comprehensive software stack to transform traditional Managed Service Providers into a software\-defined model powered by automation and AI. Together, our work is grounded in the belief that organizations deserve technology partners who combine deep expertise with a genuine commitment to the people they serve. We help clients in the nonprofit, education, and healthcare sectors make strategic technology decisions that create real impact in their communities. Developing and implementing great solutions requires both proven methodology and people who place a high value on delivering exceptional service. **Requirements** **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Escalation Resolution:** Receive and resolve tickets escalated from Specialist I, taking full ownership from intake through root\-cause resolution and client communication. * **Triage and Scope Assessment:** Quickly assess escalated issues to determine whether resolution is achievable remotely or requires an onsite visit, and whether it can be resolved promptly or requires a structured, longer\-cycle approach. Communicate scope and timeline clearly to clients and internal stakeholders. * **Onsite Field Support:** Travel to client sites across the Bay area as needed to deploy technology, resolve issues that require hands\-on work, and maintain strong in\-person client relationships. * **Audience Awareness:** Calibrate communication and prioritization to the person you are supporting. Managers and executives have different needs and expectations than individual end users, and you will adjust accordingly without being prompted. * **Infrastructure\-Layer Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve issues at the infrastructure level including M365 tenant configuration, networking, endpoint management at scale, and cross\-system dependencies. * **M365 Administration:** Manage complex administration tasks across Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, and Entra ID/AAD, including policy configuration, permissions, and cross\-tenant issues. * **macOS Support:** Provide advanced macOS support across security and system settings, application deployment and management, MDM tools and Apple Business Manager, application syncing and integration with iOS and Apple Cloud, and resolution of complex security and login issues. * **Networking:** Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall issues across client environments and coordinate with network vendors when needed. * **AI Platform Support:** Support end users and client organizations working with generative AI platforms including Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude. Apply working knowledge of prompt techniques and the underlying technologies behind these tools to troubleshoot and advise effectively. * **Client Communication:** Communicate directly with client contacts and end users on complex issues, setting expectations, explaining technical findings clearly, and maintaining trust through longer resolution cycles. * **Tooling:** Work within our PSA and RMM platforms to manage escalated work, maintain accurate records, and support reporting visibility across client accounts. * **Documentation:** Produce thorough, reusable documentation on complex resolutions, configurations, and recurring patterns, leaving the environment better than you found it. * **Multi\-Client Environment Management:** Maintain working knowledge of multiple client environments simultaneously and recognize when an issue in one environment may reflect a pattern elsewhere. **QUALIFICATIONS** To perform this job successfully, a candidate must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and be in possession of the following minimum qualifications: * 3 to 5 years of experience in IT support, with demonstrated experience resolving escalated or complex issues in a managed services environment. * Based in the Bay area, with a valid driver's license and reliable personal transportation for client site visits. * Strong hands\-on M365 administration: Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID/AAD, including policy, permissions, and tenant\-level configuration. * Advanced macOS support experience: security and system settings, application deployment, MDM tools, Apple Business Manager, iOS and Apple Cloud integration, and complex login and security issue resolution. * Experience troubleshooting networking issues: DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall concepts beyond the basics. * Solid working knowledge of generative AI platforms including Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude, with applied experience in prompt techniques and a clear understanding of the underlying technologies. * Proficiency with RMM and PSA platforms; willingness to learn our specific tooling quickly. * Ability to quickly assess whether an issue requires remote or onsite resolution and whether it can be resolved promptly or requires a longer\-cycle approach. * Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to adapt tone, detail level, and prioritization when supporting individual users, managers, and executives. * Strong interpersonal skills; able to build rapport with clients quickly and maintain professional, trusted relationships across a variety of personalities and seniority levels. * Comfortable representing the company in person at client sites; presents professionally and communicates with confidence in face\-to\-face settings. * Methodical approach to ambiguous problems: diagnose before you fix, document as you go. * Certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS\-102\), or equivalent are preferred. * Experience supporting multi\-client MSP environments strongly preferred. **Benefits** **WHY WORK WITH US** We are a small, highly effective team that values impactful execution, modern tooling, and minimal bureaucracy. Communication is open, collaboration is genuine, and the work is meaningful. A few other things that define how we operate: * We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, flexible working conditions, and the chance to be part of a team that takes its work seriously. * We are an agile organization and we are always improving. * We believe our people are what make us effective. * Every individual is responsible for doing their part and supporting the team around them. * Our benefits are designed to support the health and wellness of employees and their families. * We are committed to using technology to make a real difference for the organizations we serve. * We offer 100% Medical/Dental/Vision. * Pay range for this role: $75,000 to $90,000 per year, based on experience. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are an ambitious individual who wants to build a career in the evolving IT managed services landscape, then we would love to hear from you. *Note: Background checks will be performed as a condition of employment.*

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer (Forward Deployment)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Agentic AI Engineer (Forward Deployment)** **Experience: \-**8\+ Years **Location: \-**3 days work from office Edina, MN (1st preference) Chicago, IL (2nd Preference) Irving, TX (3rd Preference) **What is in it for you?** We are seeking a hands\-on **Senior Agentic AI Developer / Forward Deployed Engineer** to design, build, integrate, and operationalize enterprise applications. The engineer will work closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, product owners, architects, data engineers, quality engineers, and platform teams to translate business problems into secure, testable, and supportable solutions. This is an **embedded delivery** role with end\-to\-end implementation ownership, covering discovery, technical design, application and data development, AI integration, evaluation, deployment, and operational readiness. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable implementing deterministic business rules and developing governed AI\-assisted capabilities. This is not solely a prompt\-engineering, model\-research, or architecture\-advisory position. **Roles and Responsibilities:** **Embedded Discovery and Solution Delivery:** Partner directly with business users and subject\-matter experts to understand workflows, pain points, exceptions, and desired outcomes. Translate business requirements into technical specifications, user stories, testable acceptance criteria, and incremental delivery plans. Identify when deterministic logic, conventional automation, retrieval, or an AI agent is the appropriate solution. Build working vertical slices that demonstrate business value rather than disconnected proofs of concept. Communicate technical trade\-offs, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. **Agentic AI and LLM Application Engineering:** Develop bounded AI capabilities for research, explanation, recommendation, and workflow assistance. Implement structured outputs, context retrieval, tool/function calling, prompt versioning, and output validation. Design tool contracts with explicit permissions, schemas, failure behavior, and audit requirements. Ground AI responses in approved, versioned sources and preserve links to supporting evidence. Implement human review, escalation, abstention, and fallback behavior. Enforce authorization boundaries in application code and tool permissions\-not through prompts alone. Evaluate model and framework options against approved enterprise requirements for quality, security, latency, and cost. **Software and Data Engineering:** Build production\-quality backend services, APIs, data\-processing components, and workflow integrations. Develop Databricks notebooks/jobs and SQL transformations for ingestion, normalization, matching, comparison, and validation. Implement data\-quality checks, schema validation, deduplication, reconciliation, and versioned processing rules.mMaintain reproducibility through pinned rule sets, input references, and traceable execution records. Collaborate on reviewer\-facing interfaces and end\-to\-end application behavior. Engineer reliable integrations using appropriate retry, idempotency, timeout, and recovery patterns. **Quality, Evaluation, and Verification:** Create unit, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and negative tests. Develop representative evaluation datasets with domain experts. Assess AI outputs for grounding, correctness, usefulness, safety, and appropriate abstention. Test unauthorized tool use, prompt injection, sensitive\-data exposure, and failure scenarios. Trace delivered functionality and verification evidence to acceptance criteria. Review AI\-generated code with the same rigor as manually written code. **Security, Governance, and AI\-DLC:** Follow the applicable AI\-DLC lifecycle, approved tooling paths, review requirements, and release controls. Implement least\-privilege access, secure authentication, secrets management, and data\-access restrictions. Use synthetic, mock, or approved de\-identified development data where required. Maintain architecture decisions, prompt/tool documentation, approval evidence, and delivery records. Escalate unresolved data classification, privacy, model approval, and risk decisions to accountable owners. Preserve human authority over final business decisions and production promotion. **Operational Readiness:** Instrument application behaviour, retrieval, tool calls, model usage, failures, and dependencies. Establish prompt/model traceability and appropriate telemetry protections. Implement usage and cost attribution, monitoring, s, and agreed reliability measures. Produce deployment guidance, rollback procedures, runbooks, and support handover materials. Work with platform and operations teams while retaining delivery\-team accountability for application quality and remediation.**Duration: \-** **Educational Qualifications: \-** Engineering Degree BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc. Technical certification in multiple technologies is desirable. **Skills: \-** **Mandatory skills** Strong hands\-on Python and SQL development skills. Demonstrated delivery of an LLM\-enabled application beyond a basic chatbot or notebook demonstration. Experience with tool/function calling, structured responses, retrieval\-grounded generation, and AI evaluation. Strong backend/API engineering skills, including validation, authentication, authorization, error handling, and automated testing. Experience with Databricks or a comparable enterprise data platform, with the ability to work effectively in Databricks. Understanding of relational databases, data modeling, audit trails, and transactional integrity. Experience with cloud\-hosted applications, preferably on Azure. Proficiency with Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and reproducible deployment practices. Ability to diagnose issues across application, data, integration, and infrastructure boundaries. Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to work independently within a cross\-functional delivery team. Practical understanding of sensitive\-data handling and secure enterprise development. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with FastAPI, React, and TypeScript. Familiarity with NestJS, Next.js, and PostgreSQL. Experience with Databricks Apps, Jobs, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and asset bundles. Experience with Azure Blob Storage, managed identities, and application monitoring. Experience with an agent framework such as LangChain/LangGraph, Azure AI Foundry Agents, or an equivalent framework; willingness to use the approved project stack. Familiarity with retrieval evaluation, knowledge\-base versioning, and reviewer\-feedback workflows. Experience in healthcare data, data\-use agreements, compliance\-sensitive workflows, or enterprise data validation. Experience using approved AI coding assistants while maintaining code provenance, testing, and human review. **Skills** RAG Pipeline, AgenticAI, Python, Azure

jobs.title: SimCorp Dimension Lead I SaaS Migration
jobs.description: **Job Title: SimCorp Dimension UAT Test Lead / Senior Business Analyst (SaaS Migration)** **Position Type: Contract / Permanent** **Location: Onsite at Atlanta /Herndon** **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced SimCorp Dimension Specialist to lead and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for our migration from an on\-premises/ self\-hosted environment to the SimCorp SaaS Cloud platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep domain knowledge of SimCorp Dimension workflows, multi\-fund accounting structures, and front\-to\-back asset management operations. You will design, build, and execute comprehensive UAT test cases to ensure seamless data integrity, parallel run validation, and business continuity before go\-live. **Key Responsibilities** * Test Strategy \& Planning: Define the UAT test scope, acceptance criteria, and execution timelines specifically for the SimCorp SaaS migration. * Test Case Development: Design comprehensive UAT test scenarios covering multi\-fund setups, investment operations, accounting, and third\-party integrations. * Data \& Position Reconciliation: Lead the validation of the Security Master, live/historical positions, cash balances, and historical NAV calculations between legacy and SaaS environments. * End\-to\-End Workflow Testing: Execute test cases for trade execution, settlement, corporate actions, compliance rules, and automated batch processing. * Defect \& Triaging Management: Identify, log, and prioritize software configurations, environment issues, or data discrepancies, coordinating directly with SimCorp support and internal IT. * Business Liaison: Act as the core bridge between the technical migration team, external SimCorp engineers, and internal business users (portfolio managers, operations, and accounting teams). Required Skills \& Qualifications * SimCorp Dimension Expertise: Minimum 3–5\+ years of hands\-on configuration or testing experience with SimCorp Dimension (specifically modules like Portfolio Calculation, Asset Manager, Investment Accounting, or Batch/DFS). * Migration Experience: Proven track record participating in a SimCorp upgrade, data migration, or transition to a Cloud/SaaS delivery model. * Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of buy\-side investment operations, asset management, multi\-fund accounting structures, and financial instruments (Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives, or Private Markets). * Reconciliation Expertise: Advanced skills in data validation, ledger matching, and auditing complex financial datasets. * Testing Tooling: Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM) and automated regression testing tools used alongside SimCorp. This role is a hybrid, but it leans heavily toward a Business Analyst (BA) / Operations kind of resource. In the world of SimCorp Dimension, this is commonly referred to as a Functional or Business Consultant, rather than a technical IT developer. **Why It Leans Toward BA / Ops** * They test business outcomes: An IT tester checks if code crashes; a SimCorp BA checks if the NAV (Net Asset Value) calculation is correct down to the penny after migration. * They understand the market: The resource needs to understand financial instruments, trade lifecycles, and corporate actions. * They speak the users' language: They bridge the gap between your portfolio managers/accountants and the underlying system configurations. **What IT/Technical Skills They Do Need** While they aren't writing software code, they still need strong technical data skills, including: * Advanced Excel \& SQL: To extract data from the legacy system and the new SaaS system to run complex match\-and\-reconciliation macros. * System Configuration: Understanding how SimCorp’s internal logic, batch jobs, and Communication Channels (DFS) move data around.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Data Science
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** The Principal Engineer – Data Science joins the high\-visibility Impact Analytics team within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC). In this role, you will operate as an advanced individual contributor (IC) combining top\-tier technical execution with strategic initiative ownership. You will work independently to drive deep\-dive data manipulation, advanced statistical modeling, and machine learning solutions, serving as the technical lead on critical analytical projects across the business. Working across Consumer, Network, and Strategy domains, you will transform massive, complex datasets into production\-grade predictive models and actionable strategies that unlock high\-impact financial opportunities for executive leadership. ### **Responsibilities include:** * Hands\-On Technical Execution: Independently query, clean, merge, and manipulate massive structured and unstructured datasets across big data systems using SQL and Python. * Advanced ML \& Predictive Modeling: Design, build, validate, and deploy advanced machine learning algorithms (supervised and unsupervised) and robust time series forecasting models to solve complex, ambiguous business problems. * Initiative \& Technical Leadership: Drive high\-visibility analytics projects end\-to\-end—from initial scoping and data extraction to model building, testing, validation, and executive presentation. * Data Visualization \& Insights: Develop intuitive dashboards and visual reporting frameworks (using Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, Grafana, etc.) to translate complex model output into key executive metrics. * Strategic Stakeholder Partnering: Serve as a consultative technical partner to Consumer, Network, and Strategy teams, translating business challenges into data science workflows and presenting actionable recommendations to leadership. * Model Rigor \& Innovation: Envision and test for corner cases, ensure rigorous model governance and validation, and continuously integrate state\-of\-the\-art AI/ML and forecasting methodologies into the team’s repository. ### **What We’re Looking For...** You are an expert technical practitioner who thrives in an independent, fast\-paced environment. jobs.description: **Mechanical Design Engineer, Frontier AI Hardware** **About us:** Voyant Photonics is pushing the boundaries of silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip\-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands\-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales. **About the Role:** We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineer to design, document, and release the mechanical hardware for our LiDAR sensing products and the tooling used to build and test them. You will own parts and assemblies from concept through release and support the alignment and assembly processes that bring our sensors to life. In a startup environment, speed matters, and so does getting it right the first time. **What You'll Do:** * Design mechanical components, housings, assemblies, and development platforms for LiDAR sensors in SolidWorks * Create clear, complete, manufacturing\-ready drawings with proper GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5 * Perform tolerance stack\-up analyses to verify fit, function, and optical alignment budgets * Translate system‑level requirements into robust mechanical architecture and detailed designs * Design fixtures, jigs, and tooling for assembly, alignment, inspection, and test * Support and improve lens alignment stations and related optical assembly processes * Manage engineering change requests and revisions (ECR/ECO), keeping documentation and BOMs accurate * Work with suppliers to resolve manufacturability questions and ensure part quality * Drive design\-to\-cost and value engineering efforts to reduce part cost and complexity without compromising performance * Collaborate with optical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers to turn requirements into robust designs * Iterate quickly through prototypes and builds, then move designs toward production **What We're Looking For** * B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience * Minimum of 4\+ years of mechanical design experience for precision hardware products * Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including assemblies, detailed part modeling and drawings * Working knowledge of GD\&T and its practical application to functional and inspection requirements * Experience performing tolerance stack\-up analysis (worst\-case and statistical) * Experience with tool and fixture design **Nice to Have** * Experience with precision optomechanical design, such as lens mounting and adhesive bonding. * Experience with thermal analysis and structural FEA, especially for compact electro\-optical packaging * Hands\-on machining, , assembly, or test experience **Life at Voyant** We build frontier hardware \& systems from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. Our work is hands\-on and primarily in person, but we don’t run on a rigid 9\-to\-5\. We partner with customers across time zones, so some calls start early or run late, and we adjust schedules around them. We run a high\-trust, high\-accountability environment: you’ll own meaningful work, move quickly and often wear more than one hat. Voyant provides catered lunch every day at HQ, and we’re a diverse group of food lovers from around the world who enjoy sharing food, culture and technical ideas around the lunch table. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science
jobs.description: Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion! **This is a full\-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO.** As a **Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science**, you will own the controls system of a major development program, starting with one of our large, multi\-subsystem laser test facilities. Our Applied Science group delivers control systems that integrate advanced hardware to demonstrate cutting\-edge science, and in this role you will design, implement, verify, and commission the control, data acquisition, and interlock systems that enable scientific experimentation. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with coordination responsibility: you will plan and assign sprint work to other team members, deliver software releases on schedule, work directly with system operators, and coordinate controls activities with the other engineering teams on the program. We are looking for an engineer who brings strong diagnostic thinking, test stand experience, and demonstrable software capability, along with the organization to keep a multi\-team controls effort on track. ### **Responsibilities** * Own the controls system for a major development program as a hands\-on individual contributor, including requirements, architecture, and delivery of its control, data acquisition, and interlock systems across multiple subsystems. * Lead sprint planning for the program's controls work, assign and track tasks, review contributions, and ensure software releases are delivered on time. * Coordinate controls work with other engineering stakeholders, such as optics, pulsed power, mechanical, software, and operations teams. You will lead collaboration with these teams to define system interfaces, set priorities, and schedule system access time for controls development and testing. * Gather feedback from system operators and other users, prioritize improvements, and respond to and resolve bug reports. * Apply diagnostic and systems\-level troubleshooting methodologies to identify root causes of system, software, or hardware issues. * Plan and lead controls support for test campaigns, including readiness reviews, functional checkout, system integration testing, and on\-the\-floor support during experiments. * Design, develop, and commission control systems for test and measurement applications, including laboratory and industrial test stands. * Lead verification and validation (V\&V) activities for the controls system, including test planning, test procedure development, execution, and reporting. * Develop control, automation, and data acquisition software using Python, LabVIEW, and related tools. * Integrate hardware and software for test systems, including instrumentation, DAQ hardware, off\-the\-shelf benchtop equipment, and custom hardware. * Implement and maintain automated test frameworks, unit tests, and regression tests to support reliable system evolution. * Interface with and integrate a wide range of communication protocols and interfaces such as RS‑232/422/485, TCP/IP, Ethernet\-based fieldbuses such as EtherCAT, and instrument control protocols. * Own controls requirements development, interface definition, requirements traceability (RTM), and change control to support structured V\&V and quality processes. * Design hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test systems, and collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, and software engineers to ensure test systems accurately represent real\-world operating conditions. * Support commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and ongoing lifecycle support for test infrastructure. ### **Qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * **Experience**: 5\+ years of experience in control systems engineering, with a strong emphasis on test and measurement or validation environments. * Demonstrated experience designing and commissioning test stands, automated test equipment (ATE), or experimental systems. * Demonstrated experience owning a controls system on a multi\-disciplinary project, including sprint or release planning, task assignment, and on\-time delivery of software releases. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience coordinating across engineering teams and presenting status, risks, and design decisions to stakeholders. * Proficiency in LabVIEW, including development of maintainable, version\-controlled code. * Strong working knowledge ding triaging bug reports and incorporating user feedback into releases. * Experience with agile or sprint\-based planning tools and workflows (e.g., Jira) for engineering software delivery. * Experience with advanced architectural concepts, such as an Actor framework * Experience with Python * Familiarity with instrumentation standards and interfaces (e.g., SCPI, GPIB, USB instruments). * Experience with DAQ systems, high\-speed data capture, or synchronization/timing systems. * Exposure to systems integration best practices commonly used by professional control system integrators (e.g., lifecycle documentation, change control, structured testing). * Knowledge of safety\-related control concepts, interlocks, or fail\-safe system design. * Experience supporting testing in R\&D, prototype, or experimental environments. * Familiarity with documentation standards such as test plans, test procedures, verification matrices, and commissioning reports. * Experience collaborating with scientists, and developing support plans in service to scientific experiments \& objectives. Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job\-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. The range is published in accordance with Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and California Equal Pay Act. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Xcimer Energy is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified, diverse, and dedicated work force. Xcimer Energy hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork, in which all employees recognize and appreciate the diversity of individual team members. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Xcimer Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. **Benefits** Xcimer offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee health, well\-being, and long\-term success. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; basic and supplemental life insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; paid parental leave for employees at the time of birth or adoption; and a 401(k) with a company match of up to 6%. Eligible employees also receive equity, allowing them to share in the company’s long\-term success. Xcimer operates under a flexible Paid Time Off (ATO) approach. Rather than a fixed number of vacation days, employees are trusted to take the time they need to rest and recharge while meeting the expectations of their role and team. In addition, employees receive paid sick time, 13 company\-paid holidays, and an annual paid company shutdown. Benefits are available to regular employees, including part\-time and fixed\-term roles, as well as interns, with eligibility varying by benefit.
