These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Manufacturing NPI Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** XP Power is a major supplier of critical power conversion technology to the medical, technology, industrial, and defence markets. We are a fast\-growing company listed on the London Stock Exchange. We are looking for self\-motivated professionals who thrive in dynamic environments. We are proud of and committed to our culture that values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed, and Integrity. Joining our team means you will work in a high performing global company where employees collaborate and strive for excellence. **Job Description** Position Summary The Manufacturing NPI Engineer is the bridge between Engineering and Production for new AC\-DC power supplies and DC\-DC converters, from introduction at our US factory through transfer to volume production at our Vietnam factory. You will own the manufacturing readiness of new products from early design review through pilot builds and release to production, and then lead their transfer and handover to the Vietnam team — ensuring each product can be built right the first time, at target cost, yield, and quality, and in compliance with required quality requirements. In this role you will lead multiple concurrent NPI programs, serve as the manufacturing authority in design reviews, and help shape the site's NPI process and DFM standards. This is a hands\-on, on\-site role. You will spend significant time on the production floor and work closely with Design Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Production. Key Responsibilities New Product Introduction * Act as manufacturing technical lead on cross\-functional NPI teams, owning the manufacturing schedule, risk register, and cost, yield, and quality targets from concept through volume release. * Plan and execute NPI builds (EVT/DVT/PVT) across multiple concurrent programs, coordinating materials, equipment, documentation, and resources. * Represent manufacturing in stage\-gate/design reviews; perform DFM/DFA, and DFT reviews of PCB layouts, BOM, Gerbers, Assembly Drawings and Mechanical designs, and drive design changes that improve manufacturability. * Develop and own the production process flow, routings, and work instructions for SMT, through\-hole, final assembly, test, and burn\-in. * Lead pilot\-build reviews, capture lessons learned, and drive corrective actions to closure before release to volume. * Define readiness criteria and sign off on transfer to production, including yield, cycle time, and documentation completeness. * Develop and maintain site DFM/DFA design guidelines and NPI checklists; feed lessons learned back to design teams so they are applied to future products. * Work with CM to validate manufacturing processes and quality requirements. Production Transfer to Vietnam * Own the transfer of released products from the US site to the Vietnam factory, working in partnership with the Vietnam receiving team to develop and execute the transfer plan, schedule, risk mitigation, and readiness milestones. * Prepare and hand over a complete transfer package: MBOMs, drawings, routings, work instructions, PFMEAs, control plans, test procedures and software, fixtures, and lessons learned. * Coordinate replication or shipment of tooling, fixtures, and test equipment, and verify equivalent setup and performance at the receiving site. * Train the Vietnam engineering, test, quality, and production teams on each product and process, both on\-site in Vietnam and remotely; confirm competency through training records and supervised builds. * Lead transfer qualification builds (first article inspection, correlation of test results, process validation) and confirm the receiving site meets yield, quality, and cycle\-time targets. * Formally hand over ownership to the receiving team once production capability is demonstrated, and provide follow\-up support to resolve post\-transfer issues. Process Development * **SMT \& Through\-Hole** — Troubleshoot SMT and through\-hole build issues that originate in the design (e.g., footprints, component spacing, thermal relief, polarity markings), and drive design fixes that make products easier to manufacture. * Work with design engineers to ensure all agreed changes are documented through ECOs and reflected in updated schematics, PCB layouts, assembly drawings, and BOMs. * **Final Assembly** — Develop assembly methods, sequences, and fixtures for open\-frame and enclosed units, including PCBA\-to\-chassis integration, wire harness and cable routing, thermal interface and heatsink attachment, mechanical fastening and torque control, and labeling; drive mistake\-proofing (poka\-yoke) and line balance for efficient, repeatable builds. * **Test \& Burn\-In** — Partner with Test Engineering to specify and validate functional/ATE test, hipot, ground\-bond, and burn\-in processes; develop or modify test fixtures and scripts as needed. * Specify, justify (business case/ROI), procure, and qualify tooling, fixtures, and capital equipmen high\-voltage test equipment and on an active production floor. * Strong communication skills and the ability to influence and coordinate cross\-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications * Familiarity with IEC 60601\-1 production safety tests (hipot, leakage current, ground bond). * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (or higher); proficiency with Minitab. * Experience with Altium Designer for reviewing schematics and PCB layouts; familiarity with Valor or similar CAM tools for DFM analysis. * IPC\-A\-610 certification (CIS). * Experience working with manufacturing teams in Southeast Asia; Vietnamese language skills a plus. * Project management training or certification (e.g., PMP) and experience managing capital equipment projects. Background \& Knowledge Areas Ideal candidates will bring practical understanding in the following areas: * **Power electronics fundamentals** — switch\-mode power conversion, isolation, creepage/clearance, thermal dissipation, and how component choices affect manufacturability and reliability. * **PCBA manufacturing** — paste printing, placement, reflow and wave/selective soldering, and inspection (AOI, AXI); common defect modes and their causes. * **Mechanical \& final assembly** — assembly sequencing, fixture and jig design, torque and fastening methods, thermal interface materials, wire harnessing, and mistake\-proofing for high\-mix assembly. * **Test strategy** — functional/ATE test coverage, safety testing, burn\-in/ESS, and fixture design. * **Regulated quality systems** — design transfer, change control, traceability, and documentation practices under ISO 13485\. * **Lean manufacturing** — line layout, takt time, standard work, and waste reduction for low\-to\-medium volume, high\-mix production. Tools \& Systems * **ERP/MRP and PLM** — \[e.g., Oracle / SAP; Agile / Arena] * **Mechanical CAD** — SolidWorks (required) * **PCB CAD / DFM** — Altium Designer (preferred); Valor or equivalent Gerber/CAM tools * **Quality \& analysis** — PFMEA, control plans, SPC, Minitab * **Office** — Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, Project or equivalent) Work Environment \& Physical Requirements * Based on\-site at our US manufacturing facility (no remote work); regular time on the production floor. * Work around electronic assembly equipment, chemicals (solder, flux), and high\-voltage test stations; adherence to ESD and safety procedures required. PPE provided. * Ability to stand/walk for extended periods and lift up to \[25] lbs. * **Travel** — 10–20% domestic and international travel, primarily to our Vietnam factory to lead product transfers and on\-site training (trips may last 1–3 weeks), as well as to suppliers, customers, and other XP Power sites. A valid passport is required or must be obtained. * Occasional flexibility to support builds outside standard hours. **Additional Information** XP Power provides a safe and healthy working environment that is stimulating and collaborative, where employees are empowered to make a real difference. We place our people at the heart of everything we do. We understand that if we provide our people with the ultimate experience, they will provide the ultimate experience to our customers. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including: * 100% Employer Paid Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance for full\-time Employee\-only coverage; you share the cost of coverage for your dependents * Company Paid Bonus (*Percentage dependent on Company profitability*) * Company 401(k) Match (*up to 6%*) * Mental Health Benefits * Paid Time Off (*Accrued per pay period starting at 3 weeks per year*) * 13 Company Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off for Volunteer Work (*up to 8 hours per year*) * Employer Paid Supplemental Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Veterinary Pet Insurance * Company Social Events held throughout the year * A Friendly Culture Where People Collaborate and Strive for Excellence All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership. While our current plug\-ins function as external add\-ons, you will be responsible for re\-architecting Xometry's core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero\-latency DFM feedback and one\-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. **How You'll Contribute** ------------------------- * **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high\-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry\-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs. * **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real\-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI\-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil. * **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring\-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure. * **Scope and Impact:** You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership. * **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well\-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross\-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams. * **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise\-grade deployments, whether partner\-hosted or Xometry\-hosted, ensuring seamless multi\-tenant management. **What You'll Bring to Xometry** -------------------------------- * **Experience:** 12\+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms. * **Deep Technical Expertise:** Expert\-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications. * **Systems Architect:** Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards. * **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** A track record of securing endorsement for 6\-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment. * **Communication Excellence:** The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long\-term technology investments. * **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. **You Would Be A Great Fit With** --------------------------------- * **Platform Experience:** Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs. * **Industrial Tech Background:** Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems. * **Security \& Governance:** Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment. * **Distributed Systems:** Experience architecting large\-scale ML platforms or high\-frequency marketplace engines. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000annually \+ annual bonus, depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including: * 401(k) match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life and disability insurance * Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays * Maternity and bonding leave * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources * A stipend for catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays Xometry is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E\-Verify. \#LI\-Hybrid Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. For US based roles: Xometry participates in E\-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.description: Love turning real\-world problems into clean, working software? Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned senior engineer, come build systems that help labs, researchers, and instrument makers do their best work. **About Yahara:** We help scientific organizations solve hard problems and move their industries forward, from life sciences startups and CROs to the teams building lab software and scientific instruments. It's work we're proud of, and we're excited about the successes still ahead. Join a team recognized as one of Madison Magazine's Best Places to Work, where innovation thrives and collaboration drives success. We don't just build software. We empower people and transform industries. **I****mportant Notes about this Position:** * This is a hybrid position based out of our office in Madison, WI. * We are unable to provide sponsorship. **The Opportunity:** You'll build and grow software for life sciences startups, CROs, lab software teams, and scientific instrument developers. We're hiring across levels, from early\-career to senior, and we'll match the scope to your experience. Newer engineers grow alongside senior teammates who invest in them. Experienced engineers own features end to end and help shape the design. **Our Approach:** We build on strong engineering fundamentals: solid methodology, rigorous testing, and sound architecture. We use AI tools like Claude and Codex where they speed up delivery, while keeping critical thinking and engineering discipline at the center. We own the quality, accuracy, and understanding of the code we ship. **What You'll Do:** * Ship features that clients see and use, from first commit to live demo. * Build across the full stack, from the database to the UI. * Own your work end to end: understand it, build it, test it, deliver it. * Weigh different approaches and bring a recommendation, not just a question. * Level up the team through thoughtful code reviews, giving and getting feedback. * Shape the sprint in grooming, planning, and retros. * Learn your client's domain so you can ask better questions. * Use AI\-assisted tools like Claude Code every day, with a critical eye on the output. * Deploy and run applications on AWS or Azure. * Pick up new technologies as projects demand them. **What You'll Bring:** **Experience:** * Professional software development experience, whether that's your first couple of years or more than a decade. * A solid grasp of object\-oriented programming and software design. * Experience building web applications or services. * Comfort working on an Agile team. **Mindset:** * Curiosity about how the systems you build fit together. * Willingness to raise problems early instead of waiting for someone else to spot them. * Clear, professional communication with teammates and clients. * Drive to keep learning, especially as AI\-assisted development evolves. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with life sciences organizations, lab systems, or regulated scientific software. * Familiarity with HIPAA, FDA, or GxP requirements. * AWS or Azure certifications. * Experience leading a small project or mentoring other engineers. **Core Technologies (in no particular order):** * Microsoft .NET * JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks (React or similar) * Node.js * Python with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask * Postgres, SQL Server, or other relational databases * Cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services * Web service and API development * Containerization (Docker or Kubernetes) **Company Benefits \& Perks** * 20\+ days of PTO accruable in the first year! * Comprehensive health insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision) with HMO and PPO options * Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions * 401(k) with guaranteed company match (Traditional and Roth options) * 100% company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability * 100% company\-paid life insurance with option to increase coverage * 100% company\-paid identity theft protection * On\-site gym with basketball court * Hybrid/remote schedule with home office stipend * Fresh fruit, healthy snacks, and beverages provided daily * Bonus certification program (Microsoft, AWS, PMP, IIBA, etc.) * Employee Assistance Program (counseling, legal, financial services) * Monthly and Quarterly Recognition Awards with spot bonuses * Company\-supported community outreach and volunteer opportunities * Employee\-run committee involvement opportunities * Collaborative culture founded on realized values and incredible people If you need an accommodation as part of the employment process, please contact Human Resources via email at hradmin@yaharasoftware.com *Yahara Software LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.* This is a full\-time, salaried position with competitive salary and benefits. Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis and able to work on\-site in our office located in Madison, WI.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for software engineers who want to solve meaningful technical problems, contribute to systems at scale, and help shape what we build next. We work in an agile environment with two\-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. From day one, you'll contribute directly to the codebase and collaborate with experienced engineers from a wide range of leading universities and technology companies. We are looking for an engineer to help build and evolve Yext's **Knowledge Graph** product turning customer information into a connected, usable source of truth. You'll work on the core infrastructure, APIs, and workflows that help brands model, manage, and connect their knowledge across products and experiences. The work involves challenging engineering problems, including representing complex real\-world entities, processing large volumes of changing data, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that allow other teams to build confidently on top of the graph. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy foundational technology, thoughtful data modeling and system design, and seeing their work enable a wide range of customer experiences. This role is based in our New York City office, where in\-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in\-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration **What You'll Do** * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing operation * Contribute to the design, implementation, and deployment of highly scalable and reliable systems * Develop storage systems, libraries, and frameworks * Proactively contribute ideas for new features and identify opportunities to improve our products, systems, and engineering practices * Collaborate effectively with colleagues across engineering and with partners throughout the company * Write clean, tested, and well\-documented code * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate engineering work, explore solutions, improve code quality, and reduce repetitive tasks * Critically evaluate, test, and validate AI\-generated output rather than treating it as inherently correct * Maintain ownership of all work produced with AI assistance, including its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with our engineering standards **What You Have** * A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent college\-level education * 1\+ years of professional software engineering experience * A strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design * Fluency with Java, C\+\+, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go) * Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment * The ability to evaluate technical solutions critically, including code and recommendations produced by AI tools * Experience using—or a demonstrated interest in learning—AI\-assisted development tools as part of a responsible engineering workflow * Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools \#LI\-JB2 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

jobs.title: Senior Staff/Principal Software Engineer - GPU System Software, Onboard Execution
jobs.description: Zoox is building a purpose\-built robotaxi from the ground up and running it on public roads today, with riders. Every perception, prediction, and planning decision runs on an onboard compute: a fixed\-power, fixed\-thermal, safety\-critical, real\-time system. That makes GPU execution one of the most consequential engineering problems in the company. Each new model generation wants more compute. Each new vehicle generation needs to cost less, use less power, and stay safe. Closing that gap is not a kernel\-tuning exercise. It takes an end\-to\-end technical vision for how the whole onboard AI workload is scheduled, shared, isolated, and sized across GPUs, and the authority to drive that vision across ML, autonomy, middleware, and hardware organizations. You will join Zoox's Software Performance organization, which owns end\-to\-end performance of the onboard software stack: profiling and observability, GPU compute, and compute platform. You will work closely with Perception, Prediction, Planning, ML Infrastructure, and Hardware teams, and you will be a senior technical voice for onboard compute across the company. We are looking for the technical leader who sets that vision. You will define how Zoox runs AI on the vehicle, and you will own the strategy for doing more with less compute on every vehicle we build next. ### **In this role, you will:** * **Architect onboard GPU execution.** Define how perception, prediction, and planning workloads share onboard GPUs, including scheduling, multi\-tenancy, isolation, and deterministic latency under contention. * **Drive compute reduction.** Own the multi\-year roadmap to cut onboard compute per vehicle by setting latency and utilization budgets and landing the biggest levers across models, runtimes, middleware, and hardware in real releases. * **Shape hardware and platform direction.** Guide next\-generation compute decisions (GPU and SoC selection, topology, memory budgets) with workload models and performance projections that justify them, then lead performance bring\-up of each new platform. * **Lead inference performance at scale.** Set direction for the inference stack (TensorRT, CUDA, custom kernels, quantization) and partner with ML teams so models are designed for the hardware they ship on. * **Provide technical leadership.** Lead and mentor senior engineers, align directors and VPs through design docs, and make the hard calls when performance, safety, and schedule conflict. ### **Qualifications** * BS in computer science, computer engineering, or related field and 10\+ years in systems or performance engineering, including leading GPU or accelerator architecture across teams, or building and leading a performance engineering team. * Deep CUDA platform (programming model, runtime, and driver) and NVIDIA GPU microarchitecture expertise (Ampere through Blackwell, Orin, Thor). * Proven record setting technical direction and delivering large, measurable end\-to\-end gains in latency, utilization, or cost. * Working knowledge of ML inference optimization (TensorRT, XLA, Triton, quantization, fusion) and expert C\+\+ on Linux. * Ability to align ML, systems, hardware, and leadership on a shared technical plan. ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Real\-time or embedded GPU experience: autonomy, robotics, AR/VR, games, or HPC. Production GPU multi\-tenancy (MPS, MIG, priority streams). New GPU architecture or platform bring\-up, benchmarking methodology, or workload modeling and projections. **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer (Datapath) to join our team in a hybrid capacity (minimum 3 days a week in our Santa Clara, CA office), reporting to the Senior Manager Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department. You will play a critical role in expanding the capabilities of our datapath technology to drive the next level of product impact. Your work will directly add essential features and functionality to our core systems, ensuring scalable, high\-performance, and robust software design. #### **What You'll Do (Role Expectations)** * Define software design specifications and implement bug\-free code using test\-driven methodology * Identify opportunities to refactor existing code for maintainability and reusability while owning the resolution of complex customer issues * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional engineering teams including security, UI, platform, analytics, and quality assurance * Partner with Product Management to drive detailed product requirements * Lead a group of junior engineers by providing technical guidance, mentoring, and assisting in development details #### **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. * You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution. * You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. * You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. * You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. #### **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain * 7\+ years of experience developing large\-scale cloud networking and security applications, with expertise in software design and programming in C/C\+\+, Go, or Python * Deep knowledge of networking protocols and services such as DNS, HTTP, TCP/IP, and SSL/TLS, ideally with an understanding of firewall policy enforcement * Proven experience working with AWS/Azure/GCP networking components, including transit gateway, IGW, NATGW, NACL, security groups, GWLB, ILB, and Route53 * Hands\-on experience with AWS/Azure/GCP database services, PubSub mechanisms, and SDKs #### **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Experience leveraging AI/ML technologies to optimize network datapath efficiency, automate routing performance, or improve intelligent threat\-detection features * Familiarity or direct experience with developing security Firewall features * Prior experience building solutions for Software as a Service platforms and leveraging cloud\-native infrastructure services \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-YC2 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: * Various health plans * Time off plans for vacation and sick time * Parental leave options * Retirement options * Education reimbursement * In\-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - USA
jobs.description: **About Coderio** Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a solid technical foundation and a product\-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects—from architecture to execution. We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We collaborate closely with international teams and partners, building technology that creates an impact. Learn more: http://coderio.com ### **Job Overview** We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer based in the US to design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and scalable infrastructure across our cloud platform. In this role, you will play a key part in enabling Data Products throughout their lifecycle—sourcing data via batch and stream processing, optimizing data architecture, and ensuring data quality. You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to automate workflows and deploy resilient data pipelines in production. * **Work Location / Employment:** US\-based (Remote / Hybrid) — Must be authorized to work in the United States. ### **Tech Stack \& Key Technologies** * **Cloud Platforms:** AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, MWAA, S3\) \& GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) * **Languages \& Frameworks:** Python, PySpark, SQL (advanced optimization \& tuning) * **Data Engineering \& Ops:** Batch \& Stream Processing, ETL/ELT Pipelines, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Orchestration * **DevOps, Infrastructure \& Tools:** Docker, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, UNIX/Linux environments, MLOps best practices ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Pipeline Architecture \& Development:** Design, build, and deploy scalable, decoupled, and high\-performance data pipelines for batch and streaming data ingestion into Data Lakes and Data Warehouses. * **ETL/ELT Processing:** Develop and optimize efficient data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and advanced SQL. * **Collaboration with ML \& Data Science:** Partner with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to build resilient pipelines, automate MLOps workflows, and gather model interaction data to support retraining loops. * **Performance Optimization \& Monitoring:** Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipeline execution, query performance, and storage resource utilization across cloud platforms. * **Data Quality \& Governance:** Implement data quality frameworks and testing controls to ensure data integrity, reliability, and governance across raw and curated datasets. * **DevOps \& Standards:** Apply MLOps and DevOps best practices, maintain CI/CD pipelines, use Docker for containerization, and document technical standards and architectures. ### **Qualifications \& Requirements** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and running large\-scale data systems. * **Core Languages:** Mastery of Python and advanced SQL (query optimization and performance tuning). * **Cloud \& Big Data Tools:** Hands\-on experience with AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, MWAA, S3\) or GCP (BigQuery) and modern data processing engines (PySpark). * **Engineering Ecosystem:** Proficiency with UNIX environments, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. * **Data \& ML Lifecycle:** Solid understanding of data structures, batch/streaming processing, and familiarity with MLOps or the ML deployment lifecycle. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform). * Experience building and maintaining scalable REST APIs. * Exposure to prompt engineering workflows or generative AI data pipelines. **Why join Coderio?** At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a remote\-first company, passionate about technology, collaborative work, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive, challenging environment with real opportunities for growth. If you are motivated to build impactful solutions, we’re looking for you. Apply now. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Altronic has long been regarded as the world's leading manufacturer of ignition and control systems for industrial engines largely used in the oil and gas industry. Our products represent the industry standard for quality, which are all designed to improve engine performance and enhance reliability. The embedded software engineering position is responsible for developing and maintaining software/firmware/ bootloader for Altronic products. A primary focus on natural gas spark ignited ignition systems with precise timing control and low latency execution. Additionally details in industrial communication protocols and overall product development such as hardware interaction will also be required. This role encompasses an all inclusive development environment which means working closely with various other engineering disciplines, manufacturing, quality and test. This position is for the engineer that wants to be apart of and enjoys the entire product creation process. **Key Responsibilities:** * Formulate and design software system, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcome and consequences of design * Block diagram and architectural design interaction/creation * Use of communications protocols over hardware networks CAN, RS485, Ethernet * Design software for use on 32 microcontrollers such as ST and AVR * Conduct and participate in design reviews * Provide initial field support and knowledge of system level application * Communicate with other hardware and software engineers to evaluate interface between hardware and software **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Highly structured and documents code * Use of embedded languages such as C/C\+\+, assembly * Working knowledge of timers and counters * Circuit basics for interaction with connected hardware * working knowledge of microcontrollers, and typical microcontroller peripherals as well as serial and parallel busses * Highly skilled in debugging and use of advanced tools * Knowledge of temperature, pressure, vibration sensors and methods * In depth use of equipment such as Oscilloscopes, power supplies, frequency counters, frequency sources, 4\-20mA inputs and outputs, PC interfaces (Serial converters, CAN converters) Ethernet switches, etc.) * 2\-5 years experience **Work Environment:** This position operates in a professional office environment. Standard business hours apply, with flexibility to meet project deadlines as needed. **CompensationBenefits:** The company offers a competitive salary, health benefits, and opportunities for professional development.

jobs.title: Principal M&P Engineer, Metallics
jobs.description: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next\-gen aerospace sector building an end\-to\-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS"), aviation\-related physical artificial intelligence ("AI") solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors. Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members. We are seeking an experienced Materials and Processes (M\&P) Engineer to serve as the Metallics Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the airframe of our next\-generation electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, being certified under FAA airworthiness criteria derived from 14 CFR Part 23 eVTOL aircraft and Part 21\.17(b) powered\-lift. In this role, you will be the technical authority for metallic materials and processes across primary and secondary airframe structure, from alloy selection and specification development through qualification, production support, and FAA certification. This is a hands\-on role on a fast\-moving program. The ideal candidate brings deep metallurgical expertise, a strong command of aerospace specifications and certification requirements, and the judgment to make sound, timely decisions with incomplete information. You will thrive here if you bring a flexible mindset, a strong sense of urgency, and the ability to create structure and clarity in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving environment. We are looking for individuals who are slightly impatient, flexible under changing priorities and perform under pressure. **What you'll do** * Technical authority: Serve as the M\&P Metallics SME; owning metallic material and process decisions for aluminum, titanium, steel, and corrosion\-resistant alloys used in structure, engine, battery components, fittings, and fasteners. * Certification: Develop compliance data and substantiation for M\&P\-related airworthiness requirements, and interface with the FAA, DERs, and internal certification teams to support certification activities. Develop, author, review internal MPE specs, test plans, other specs. * Cross\-functional partnership: Work closely with stress, design, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and certification teams to make timely trade\-offs that keep the program moving. * Build the function: Help build and mature Archer's M\&P metallics capability, including lab test methods, processes, tools, and mentorship of junior engineers. * Qualification and allowables: Plan and execute metallic material and process qualification programs, including test plans, test matrices, conformity, data review, and reports; establish material strength properties and design values using MMPDS and statistically based methods. * Specifications and design guidance: Author and maintain Archer material and process specifications, design guidelines, and standards, including heat treatment, surface treatment, plating, shot peening, welding/joining, machining, and inspection requirements. * Material selection: Lead alloy, temper, and product\-form selection (plate, sheet, extrusion, forging, casting, bar, and additively manufactured parts), balancing strength, fatigue and damage tolerance, corrosion resistance, weight, cost, and manufacturability. * Corrosion control: Define corrosion prevention and control requirements for metallic structure, including galvanic compatibility, dissimilar\-material isolation (including metal\-to\-composite interfaces), sealants, and finish systems. * Production and supplier support: Support manufacturing and suppliers through material review board (MRB) dispositions, nonconformance resolution, first article inspections (FAI), special\-process source approvals, and supplier audits (including NADCAP\-accredited and not accredited processes). * Failure analysis: Lead failure analysis and root cause investigations using fractography, metallography, SEM/EDS, and hardness and conductivity testing, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure. **What you'll need** * Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; Master's or PhD preferred. * Minimum 8 years of aerospace M\&P experience focused on metallic materials and processes (6 years with an advanced degree), including direct support of metallic structures. * Demonstrated track record leading material and process qualification, specification development, and FAA (or equivalent EASA/military) certification activities. * Aerospace alloys: In\-depth knowledge of aerospace aluminum (2xxx, 6xxx, 7xxx series and tempers), titanium (e.g., Ti\-6Al\-4V), precipitation\-hardening and s corrosion cracking, and hydrogen embrittlement. * Special processes: Working knowledge of heat treatment (e.g., AMS 2770, AMS 2759\), anodizing and conversion coating (e.g., MIL\-PRF\-8625, MIL\-DTL\-5541\), passivation (AMS 2700\), plating, shot peening (AMS 2430/AMS 2432\), and welding/joining (e.g., AWS D17\.1\). * Standards and data: Fluency with MMPDS, SAE AMS, ASTM, MIL, and NAS specifications, as well as galvanic compatibility guidance such as MIL\-STD\-889\. * Inspection and NDT: Experience with nondestructive testing methods, including dye penetrant (ASTM E1417\), magnetic particle (ASTM E1444\), ultrasonic, and eddy current, and with defining acceptance criteria. * Regulatory knowledge: Familiarity with FAA regulations, Advisory Circulars, and M\&P\-related airworthiness requirements, including material and process control, fabrication methods, and material strength properties and design values. * Failure analysis: Hands\-on experience with fractography, metallography, and SEM/EDS for root cause analysis. Define metallic F\&DT methodology (slow crack growth, safe\-life) in coordination with structures team **Preferred qualifications** * Experience on a new aircraft development and type certification program, ideally in eVTOL, general aviation, or rotorcraft. * Experience with forgings and castings, including casting factors and classification (e.g., AMS 2175\). * Experience with metallic–composite hybrid structures, fastener systems, and bonded or sealed joints. * Experience with conducting supplier audits, establishing or approving NADCAP\-accredited special processes, AS9100 quality management system * FAA DER or Designee experience, or experience working directly with Designees and FAA Aircraft Certification Offices. * Please note that this job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and does not include an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications At Archer we aim to attract, retain, and motivate talent that possess the skills and leadership necessary to grow our business. We drive a pay\-for\-performance culture and reward performance that supports the Company's business strategy. For this position we are targeting a base pay between $219,000\- $273,700 . Actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. ##### Archer is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs. Applicants who may require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should provide their name and contact information to Archer's People Team at people@archer.com. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis. ##### Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Archer's Candidate Privacy Policy. ##### Certain positions may be eligible for visa sponsorship. ##### Archer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. All aspects of employment are decided on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. ##### Archer Aviation does not engage with external recruiting agencies/individual recruiters with whom it does not have a prior written agreement. Archer reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes that it receives and bears no responsibility for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes. If you are a recruiting agency or individual recruiter wishing to do business with Archer, please reach out to People@archer.com. All employment processes are managed by the Archer People Team.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, Services and Tasks
jobs.description: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. **State the Business Title** Lead Software Engineer, Services and Tasks **Role Summary** The Lead Software Engineer will lead full\-stack development efforts across clinical workflow solutions, combining hands\-on engineering with technical leadership and design oversight. This hybrid role is based in Boston, MA, and supports the development of scalable, reliable software using React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, APIs, relational databases, and distributed systems. The role also includes evaluating and applying generative AI and AI\-assisted software engineering tools to improve productivity and quality. This position will report to the Senior Engineering Manager. **Team Summary** The Clinicals Services \& Tasks team owns the end\-to\-end arc of clinical work at the point of care \- from the moment an order is created, through the documents that inform and result from it to the tasks that carry that work to completion across the practice. The team supports the systems and workflows that help clinicians and care teams move efficiently through complex work while reducing friction and cognitive load. This includes building and maintaining stable platform capabilities, improving user\-facing workflows, and ensuring the underlying services can support dependable performance at scale. Team members work across application layers, service boundaries, and data models to improve the experience of clinical work from initiation to completion. **Essential Job Responsibilities** * Lead full\-stack engineering efforts across React\-based frontend applications, Java services, and supporting APIs. * Provide technical mentorship, architectural guidance, and design oversight to engineers on the team. * Develop and maintain features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and modern frontend architecture patterns. * Design and support APIs and service integrations across distributed systems, including monolith and microservices environments. * Build and optimize relational data models and database\-backed application functionality. * Collaborate with product, design, and engineering partners to translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions. * Evaluate and apply generative AI and AI\-assisted software engineering tools to improve development workflows, code quality, and delivery efficiency. * Drive technical decisions that strengthen scalability, reliability, maintainability, and system clarity. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and support durable fixes across application layers. * Travel as needed to support team or business needs. **Additional Job Responsibilities** * Contribute to planning and prioritization discussions for team delivery. * Support code reviews and promote consistent engineering practices. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to improve workflow clarity and implementation alignment. * Help refine engineering standards, documentation, and team operating practices. * Assist in evaluating legacy technologies and migration paths in large\-scale production environments. * Explore GraphQL, Unix/Linux, and other tools or technologies that may improve platform capabilities. * Participate in incident response and operational follow\-up when needed. * Recommend improvements to developer productivity, deployment workflows, and testing practices. * Share knowledge across the broader engineering organization through informal mentoring and technical discussions. **Expected Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience in software engineering or full\-stack application development. * Demonstrated experience leading full\-stack development teams, including technical mentoring and design oversight. * Proficiency with React, modern frontend architecture, and core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Strong programming experience in Java. * Experience working with generative AI and AI\-assisted software engineering tools in day\-to\-day development workflows. * Solid experience with relational databases and data modeling. * Experience designing and supporting APIs and working across distributed systems and evolving system architectures, including monolith and microservices environments. * Exposure to GraphQL, Unix/Linux environments, and legacy technologies in large\-scale production systems is a plus. * Strong communication skills, ownership, and accountability, with a demonstrated track record of adopting new technologies. * Ability to work in a hybrid environment in Boston, MA. * Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and cross\-functional partners in a product\-focused environment ***Expected Compensation*** $143,000 \- $243,000*The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job\-related experience,* *relevant knowledge* *and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package \- depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long\-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.* ***About athenahealth*** ***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.* ***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.* ***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.* ***What we can do for you:*** *Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.* *We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.* *In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.* *Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers* *https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal\-opportunity*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That's how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry's most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space. AutoStore – moving things forward. **The Role:** AutoStore is hiring an Entry\-Level Software Engineer to join our team at the start of their career. You will help design, build, and test the software that powers our automated storage and fulfillment systems, working alongside experienced engineers on real production code. We are looking for a recent graduate with a strong academic record and, ideally, some internship experience. You don't need to know everything on day one. What matters most is a genuine passion for software, curiosity about how things work, and an eagerness to learn quickly. You will receive structured mentoring and hands\-on training, including in C\+\+ and Python, the core languages our team works with. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** **Software Development** * Design, write, and maintain clean, well\-structured code in C\+\+ and Python under the guidance of senior engineers. * Implement new features and fix bugs across our software products. * Apply object\-oriented design principles and follow the team's coding standards. **Testing and Quality** * Write unit and integration tests for the code you develop. * Debug and troubleshoot issues, and learn to find root causes. * Take part in code reviews, both receiving feedback and reviewing teammates' code as you grow. **Collaboration and Delivery** * Work in an agile team, contributing to sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives. * Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, and code reviews. * Work with QA, DevOps, and product teammates to deliver working software. **Learning and Growth** * Develop your C\+\+ and Python skills on the job through training, mentoring, and real project work. * Write and update technical documentation as you learn our systems. Ask questions early and often, and share what you learn with the team. * **Key Qualifications:** ----------------------- * Working knowledge of C\+\+ and Python, or of another object\-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, C\#). * If your experience is in a language other than C\+\+ and Python, a commitment to learning both on the job. * Basic familiarity with Git and version control. * A genuine passion for technology and a strong eagerness to learn. * Good problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly in a team. * Cumulative GPA (CGPA) of 3\.5 or higher on a 4\.0 scale, or equivalent. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, completed recently or within the next six months. * **Nice to Have:** * Internship, co\-op, or placement experience in software engineering. * Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design. * Exposure to unit testing frameworks (e.g., GoogleTest, pytest). * Basic experience with Linux, the command line, or debugging tools. * Exposure to embedded systems, robotics, or real\-time software. * Experience with networking and communication protocols, including TCP/IP, MQTT, REST APIs, and WebSockets. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, or hackathon experience. * **We Offer:** ------------- AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Oracle Apex Developer

You can work remotely from anywhere in Europe, or hybrid from our offices in Helsinki, Oulu or Tampere. You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to. **What you will do** -------------------- You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own: * **Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline:** Make our existing ticket\-to\-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time\-to\-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership. * **Make autonomy safe:** Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low\-risk, easily verified work runs hands\-off. * **Lead AI\-native engineering by example:** Set the bar for AI\-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own work what a pipeline\-first engineer ships, and raise the craft of the engineers around you. * **Drive adoption with the teams:** Embed with squads and their AI DRIs, find where the pipeline breaks on real work, fix the system rather than the single output, and turn what works into paved paths, skills, templates and docs other engineers can extend. * **Partner cross\-functionally:** Work with platform, developer productivity, security and privacy, AI infrastructure, mobile and backend squads, product and design, and engineering leadership to make trade\-offs explicit and keep everyone moving on one system instead of five parallel ones. **Requirements** ---------------- We'd love to hear from you if you are: * **An experienced builder:** 6\+ years building and operating production systems that other engineers depend on, including developer tooling, internal platforms, or AI infrastructure ineers, managers and non\-engineering partners. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - AI Training Data
jobs.description: **About Warp** At Warp Sciences, our mission is to help the world discover new medicines faster—and build the capacity to do it here in America. We bring AI, robotics, and life sciences together in automated labs that design, run, and learn from experiments, with each experiment making the next one better. We’re not developing drugs of our own. We’re building the infrastructure for the people who do. Warp is building autonomous laboratories that can run scientific experiments end\-to\-end. Our work combines robotics, automation, and advanced AI to enable breakthrough discoveries in chemistry and beyond. High\-quality real\-world data powers our systems, models, and robots. We are looking for a senior, hands\-on AI data builder to own what our models learn from. You’ll set the data strategy and build the systems to execute it across our chemistry foundation model, our lab perception stack, and our robot\-learning system. You will determine what data matters, where to source or generate it, and how to turn it into measurable capability gains. Your scope will span open datasets, synthetic data, RL rollouts, expert feedback, teleoperation, and physical lab execution. You'll connect these sources through Vault, our shared data storage and lineage system, making useful data faster to produce, easier to trust, and simpler to reuse as Warp scales. **What You’ll Do** * Own the data agenda: Translate model failures and lab priorities into a collection and generation plan. Decide the right mix of open, licensed, synthetic, and real\-world data. Prioritize coverage gaps, difficult cases, and highest\-value expert involvement. * Develop external data: Source and assess chemistry, scientific, and multimodal datasets. Evaluate licensing, provenance, quality, and relevance. Build extraction, normalization, and enrichment pipelines that convert promising sources into useful training and evaluation data. * Build synthetic data \& RL data loops: Generate examples, model rollouts, and simulated trajectories. Develop rewards, verifiers, and data filtering with researchers. Use evaluation and RL feedback to improve generators, sampling, and curricula. Test for reward hacking, contamination, and transferability of synthetic gains. * Make physical experience useful for learning: Help design and conduct lab and teleoperation data collection with chemists and robotics teams. Capture demonstrations, corrections, failures, and recovery attempts, keeping all data aligned with the experimental context. * Build AI\-native curation workflows: Use models and agents to label, enrich, deduplicate, and mine data, with human review where it adds value. Own quality checks, dataset composition, and versioning. Make annotation and feedback efficient. * Measure data by capabilities it creates: Partner with researchers on data ablation, supervised fine\-tuning, and RL experiments. Use held\-out evaluations and real failures to improve the data mix. Track capability lift, coverage, efficiency, and cost per useful example—not just dataset size. * Make the shared data foundation work: Own the path from collection and generation. Build reliable ingestion, storage, lineage, retrieval, and dataset delivery with clean interfaces. Partner with infrastructure engineers to keep this process fast, dependable, and easy to maintain as we grow. **What We’re Looking For** * A track record of improving model capabilities through better data, with hands\-on ownership from identifying a gap to building the dataset and measuring results. * Practical experience with ML data development: synthetic generation, model rollouts, multimodal datasets, expert annotation, or real\-world collection. * Strong understanding of data composition, sampling, demonstrations, rewards, and verifiers, and how they affect fine\-tuning and RL. * Strong software engineering skills in Python, with experience building data pipelines, model\-driven tools, and reproducible experiments. * Good judgment on data quality, provenance, licensing, leakage, and evaluation, and the ability to inspect and critically analyze examples. * Ability to set priorities across teams while staying hands\-on. Use of AI tools and agents to multiply output and verify work. Collaborative mindset with researchers, chemists, and robotics engineers. **Helpful But Not Required** * Experience with chemistry or scientific data, vision\-language models, video understanding, or embodied AI. * Background in teleoperation, demonstrations, simulation, active learning, or human\-feedback workflows. * Experience with RL\-based data generation and selection, reward modeling, verifiable tasks, or large\-scale synthetic\-data pipelines. **What Success Looks Like** * Warp knows what data to acquire or generate next and can turn it into useful model inputs quickly and reliably. * New data drives measurable improvements in chemistry reasoning, lab perception, and robot behavior. * Data collection, generation, and learning loops get more efficient over time, and the shared data foundation becomes easier to use and scale. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Warp is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision\-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodations** Warp provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.
